// src\App.tsx
import { lazy, Suspense, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import Nav from "./components/Navigation";
import ErrorBoundary from "./components/ErrorBoundary";
import { RoleProvider, useRole } from "./components/RoleContext";
import { ThemeProvider } from "./components/ThemeContext";
import RoleRoute from "./components/RoleRoute";
import './styles/global.scss';

const Home = lazy(() => import("./pages/home"));
const Schedule = lazy(() => import("./pages/schedule"));
const Cabinet = lazy(() => import("./pages/cabinet"));
const Journal = lazy(() => import("./pages/journal"));
const JournalCatalog = lazy(() => import("./components/JournalCatalog"));
const Planner = lazy(() => import("./pages/planner"));
const Stats = lazy(() => import("./pages/stats"));
const StudentPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/student"));
const MessagesPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/messages"));
const TeacherPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/teacher"));
const StudentHome = lazy(() => import("./pages/studentHome"));
const StudentCabinet = lazy(() => import("./pages/studentCabinet"));
const StudentJournal = lazy(() => import("./pages/studentJournal"));
const NotFound = lazy(() => import("./pages/notFound"));

const LayoutWithNav = () => {
    const location = useLocation();
    const { role } = useRole();
    const [blobs, setBlobs] = useState<Array<{top?: string, left?: string, bottom?: string, right?: string}>>([]);
    const getRandomPercentage = () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 80) + 10;
    useEffect(() => {
        const newBlobs = Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => {
            if (i % 2 === 0) {
                return { top: `${getRandomPercentage()}%`, left: `${getRandomPercentage()}%` };
            } else {
                return { bottom: `${getRandomPercentage()}%`, right: `${getRandomPercentage()}%` };
            }
        });
        setBlobs(newBlobs);
    }, [location]);

    return (
        <div className="dashboard-layout">
            <Nav />

            <main className="main-content">
                {blobs.map((style, index) => (
                    <div 
                        key={index} 
                        className={`blob blob-${index % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd'}`} 
                        style={style}
                    ></div>
                ))}

                <ErrorBoundary key={`${role}:${location.pathname}`}><Suspense fallback={<div className="page-loader" role="status"><span /><p>Загружаем раздел…</p></div>}><Routes>
                    <Route path="/" element={role === "student" ? <StudentHome /> : <Home />} />
                    <Route path="/schedule" element={<Schedule />} />
                    <Route path="/cabinet" element={role === "student" ? <StudentCabinet /> : <Cabinet />} />
                    <Route path="/journal/:subjectId/:groupId" element={role === "student" ? <StudentJournal /> : <Journal />} />
                    <Route path="/journal/:subjectId" element={role === "student" ? <StudentJournal /> : <JournalCatalog />} />
                    <Route path="/journal" element={role === "student" ? <StudentJournal /> : <JournalCatalog />} />
                    <Route path="/planner" element={<RoleRoute allow="teacher"><Planner /></RoleRoute>} />
                    <Route path="/stats" element={<RoleRoute allow="teacher"><Stats /></RoleRoute>} />
                    <Route path="/students/:studentId" element={<StudentPage />} />
                    <Route path="/teachers/:teacherId" element={<TeacherPage />} />
                    <Route path="/messages" element={<MessagesPage />} />
                    <Route path="/notifications" element={<Navigate to="/?notifications=open" replace />} />
                    <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
                </Routes></Suspense></ErrorBoundary>
            </main>
        </div>
    );
};

export default function App() {
    return (
        <BrowserRouter basename={import.meta.env.BASE_URL}>
            <ThemeProvider>
                <RoleProvider>
                    <LayoutWithNav />
                </RoleProvider>
            </ThemeProvider>
        </BrowserRouter>
    );
}

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\AnswerComposer\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { SubmissionAttempt } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import { getAnswerDraftKey, readAnswerDraft, removeAnswerDraft, saveAnswerDraft } from "../../../data/answerDraftStore";
import { formatFileSize } from "../../../domain/files";
import useUnsavedChangesWarning from "../../../hooks/useUnsavedChangesWarning";
import AttachmentPicker from "../../AttachmentPicker";
import ArrowCircle from "../../ArrowCircle";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  studentId: string;
  assignmentId: string;
  assignmentVersion: string;
  attempt?: SubmissionAttempt;
  saving: boolean;
  onSend(text: string, file: File | null): Promise<boolean>;
}

const AnswerComposer = ({ studentId, assignmentId, assignmentVersion, attempt, saving, onSend }: Props) => {
  const headingId = useId();
  const textId = useId();
  const hintId = useId();
  const draftStatusId = useId();
  const previewId = useId();
  const draftKey = getAnswerDraftKey(studentId, assignmentId, attempt?.id);
  const [initial] = useState(() => readAnswerDraft(draftKey));
  const [text, setText] = useState(initial.draft?.text ?? attempt?.text ?? "");
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [missingFile, setMissingFile] = useState(initial.draft?.fileName);
  const [draftError, setDraftError] = useState(initial.error);
  const [draftSaved, setDraftSaved] = useState(Boolean(initial.draft));
  const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState(false);
  const [previewVersion, setPreviewVersion] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState("");
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const previewRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const sendLock = useRef(false);
  const hasLocalChanges = text !== (attempt?.text ?? "") || Boolean(file || missingFile);
  const busy = saving || sending;
  const conditionsChanged = previewing && previewVersion !== assignmentVersion;
  useUnsavedChangesWarning(hasLocalChanges && !submitted);
  useEffect(() => { if (previewing) previewRef.current?.focus(); }, [previewing]);

  const persist = (nextText: string, fileName?: string) => {
    const saved = saveAnswerDraft(draftKey, { text: nextText, fileName });
    setDraftSaved(saved);
    setDraftError(saved ? "" : "Текст сейчас только в форме. Браузер не разрешил сохранить черновик — скопируйте его перед уходом со страницы.");
    setSendError("");
  };
  const returnToEditing = () => { setPreviewing(false); requestAnimationFrame(() => textareaRef.current?.focus()); };
  const send = async () => {
    if (!previewing || conditionsChanged || busy || submitted || sendLock.current || !text.trim() || missingFile) return;
    sendLock.current = true;
    setSending(true);
    setSendError("");
    try {
      if (await onSend(text.trim(), file)) {
        setSubmitted(true);
        removeAnswerDraft(draftKey);
      }
      else { setSendError("Ответ не отправлен. Текст и выбранный файл остались в форме."); returnToEditing(); }
    } catch {
      setSendError("Ответ не отправлен. Текст и выбранный файл остались в форме — повторите попытку.");
      returnToEditing();
    } finally { sendLock.current = false; setSending(false); }
  };

  return <section className={styles.composer} aria-labelledby={headingId} aria-busy={busy}>
    <header className={styles.header}><div><span>Моя работа</span><h3 id={headingId}>{attempt ? "Исправленный ответ" : "Подготовить ответ"}</h3></div><span className={styles.step}>{previewing ? "2 · Проверка" : "1 · Подготовка"}</span></header>
    {attempt?.teacherComment && <div className={styles.feedback}><strong>Что нужно исправить</strong><p>{attempt.teacherComment}</p></div>}
    {submitted ? <p className={styles.success} role="status">Ответ отправлен преподавателю. Он появится в истории попыток.</p> : previewing ? <div className={styles.preview}>
      <h4 id={previewId} ref={previewRef} tabIndex={-1}>Проверьте перед отправкой</h4>
      <div className={styles.answerText} role="region" aria-labelledby={previewId} tabIndex={0}>{text.trim()}</div>
      <div className={styles.attachment}><span>Вложение</span><strong>{file ? `${file.name} · ${formatFileSize(file.size)}` : attempt?.attachmentName ?? "Без файла"}</strong></div>
      <p className={styles.hint}>После отправки изменить ответ можно только после возврата преподавателем на доработку.</p>
      {conditionsChanged && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">Преподаватель изменил условия или срок задания. Перечитайте их выше, вернитесь к редактированию и проверьте ответ заново. Текст сохранён в форме.</p>}
      <div className={styles.actions}><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={returnToEditing}>Редактировать</button><button type="button" disabled={busy || conditionsChanged} className={styles.primary} onClick={() => { void send(); }}>{busy ? "Отправляем…" : attempt ? "Отправить повторно" : "Отправить преподавателю"}<ArrowCircle /></button></div>
    </div> : <form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (text.trim() && !missingFile && !busy) { setPreviewVersion(assignmentVersion); setPreviewing(true); } }}>
      <label htmlFor={textId}>Текст ответа <span>Обязательно</span></label>
      <textarea id={textId} ref={textareaRef} required disabled={busy} aria-describedby={`${hintId} ${draftStatusId}`} placeholder="Решение, выводы или комментарий к приложенному файлу" value={text} onChange={(event) => { setText(event.target.value); persist(event.target.value, file?.name ?? missingFile); }} />
      <div id={draftStatusId} className={styles.draftStatus}><span>{draftError ? "Текст не сохранён в черновик" : draftSaved ? "Текст сохранён до закрытия вкладки" : "Черновик ещё не сохранён"}</span><span>{text.length.toLocaleString("ru-RU")} симв.</span></div>
      <AttachmentPicker label="Файл ответа" file={file} retainedName={attempt?.attachmentName} disabled={busy} onChange={(next) => { setFile(next); setMissingFile(undefined); persist(text, next?.name); }} />
      {file && <p className={styles.hint}>Файл выбран для отправки, но не сохраняется в черновике. После обновления страницы его нужно прикрепить заново.</p>}
      {missingFile && <div className={styles.fileReminder} role="status"><span>Прикрепите «{missingFile}» заново. В черновике сохранён только текст, не сам файл.</span><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setMissingFile(undefined); persist(text); }}>{attempt?.attachmentName ? "Оставить прежнее вложение" : "Продолжить без файла"}</button></div>}
      <div className={styles.actions}><span id={hintId} className={styles.hint}>Черновик виден только вам. Файл необязателен. Перед отправкой можно проверить ответ.</span><button type="submit" className={styles.primary} disabled={busy || !text.trim() || Boolean(missingFile)}>Проверить ответ<ArrowCircle /></button></div>
    </form>}
    {draftError && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{draftError}</p>}
    {sendError && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{sendError}</p>}
  </section>;
};

export default AnswerComposer;

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\AssignmentPreview\index.tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import type { AssignmentForm } from "../../../domain/assignmentForm";
import { getAssignmentVisibility } from "../../../domain/assignmentForm";
import { formatFileSize } from "../../../domain/files";
import Modal from "../../Modal";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { form: AssignmentForm; attachmentName?: string; attachmentSize?: number; publishing: boolean; saving: boolean; error: string; onBack(): void; onSave(): void }
const STATUS_LABELS = { draft: "Черновик", published: "Опубликовано", closed: "Приём завершён", archived: "Архив" };
const AssignmentPreview = ({ form, attachmentName, attachmentSize, publishing, saving, error, onBack, onSave }: Props) => {
  const titleId = useId();
  const deadlinePassed = Date.parse(form.deadline) < Date.now();
  return <Modal labelledBy={titleId} onClose={() => { if (!saving) onBack(); }} className={styles.dialog}>
    <header><span>Перед сохранением</span><h2 id={titleId}>Проверьте задание</h2><p>Условие, файл и сроки — всё в одном месте.</p></header>
    <article className={styles.preview}><div className={styles.meta}><span>{form.lessonType}</span><span>{STATUS_LABELS[form.status]}</span></div><h3>{form.title.trim()}</h3><p className={styles.context}>{form.subject} · {form.group}</p><dl><div><dt>Занятие</dt><dd>{new Date(form.lessonDate).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</dd></div><div><dt>Срок сдачи</dt><dd>{new Date(form.deadline).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</dd></div></dl><section className={styles.condition}><h4>Условие задания</h4><p>{form.description.trim()}</p></section><div className={styles.attachment}><span>Файл задания</span><strong>{attachmentName ?? "Без вложения"}</strong>{attachmentSize !== undefined && <small>{formatFileSize(attachmentSize)}</small>}</div></article>
    <div className={styles.visibility}><strong>Кто увидит задание</strong><p>{getAssignmentVisibility(form.status)}</p>{form.status === "published" && <small>{form.allowLateSubmissions ? "Ответы после срока разрешены." : "После дедлайна приём ответов закрывается."}</small>}</div>
    {form.status === "published" && deadlinePassed && <p className={styles.warning} role="status">Срок сдачи уже прошёл. {form.allowLateSubmissions ? "Студенты смогут сдать работу с отметкой об опоздании." : "Студенты не смогут отправить ответ. Вернитесь к редактированию, если нужно изменить срок."}</p>}
    {error && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <footer><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onBack}>Вернуться к редактированию</button><button type="button" disabled={saving} className={styles.primary} onClick={onSave}>{saving ? "Сохраняем…" : publishing ? "Опубликовать задание" : form.status === "draft" ? "Сохранить черновик" : form.status === "closed" ? "Завершить приём" : form.status === "archived" ? "Отправить в архив" : "Сохранить изменения"}</button></footer>
  </Modal>;
};
export default AssignmentPreview;

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\AttemptHistory\index.test.tsx
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { SubmissionAttempt } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import AttemptHistory from ".";

const attempt: SubmissionAttempt = { id: "first", number: 1, text: "Первый ответ", status: "revision", teacherComment: "Исправьте вывод", sentAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-12T13:00", submittedLate: false };

describe("attempt history", () => {
  it("keeps the newest answer visible and earlier attempts in disclosure", () => {
    const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(<AttemptHistory attempts={[attempt, { ...attempt, id: "second", number: 2, text: "Исправленный ответ", status: "submitted", teacherComment: undefined }]} />);
    expect(markup).toContain("Предыдущие попытки");
    expect(markup.indexOf("Исправленный ответ")).toBeLessThan(markup.indexOf("<details"));
    expect(markup.indexOf("Первый ответ")).toBeGreaterThan(markup.indexOf("<details"));
    expect(markup).toContain("Исправьте вывод");
    expect(markup).not.toContain("<details open");
  });

  it("does not duplicate the current result when the review panel shows it", () => {
    const graded = { ...attempt, status: "graded" as const, grade: "4" };
    expect(renderToStaticMarkup(<AttemptHistory attempts={[graded]} hideCurrentResult />)).not.toContain('aria-label="Оценка 4"');
    expect(renderToStaticMarkup(<AttemptHistory attempts={[graded]} />)).toContain('aria-label="Оценка 4"');
  });

  it("does not show an empty history for one or zero attempts", () => {
    expect(renderToStaticMarkup(<AttemptHistory attempts={[attempt]} />)).not.toContain("<details");
    expect(renderToStaticMarkup(<AttemptHistory attempts={[]} />)).toBe("");
  });
});


// src\components\AssignmentCenter\AttemptHistory\index.tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { downloadAssignmentFile, SubmissionAttempt } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import DownloadButton from "../../DownloadButton";
import ArrowCircle from "../../ArrowCircle";
import SubmissionResult from "../SubmissionResult";

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<SubmissionAttempt["status"], string> = {
  submitted: "На проверке",
  revision: "Возвращена на доработку",
  graded: "Оценена",
};

interface Props {
  attempts: SubmissionAttempt[];
  hideCurrentResult?: boolean;
  label?: string;
}

const AnswerText = ({ text }: { text: string }) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const textId = useId();
  const long = text.length > 900 || text.split("\n").length > 10;
  return <div className={styles.answer}>
    <p id={textId} className={`${styles.answerText} ${long && !expanded ? styles.collapsed : ""}`}>{text || "Ответ без текста"}</p>
    {long && <button type="button" className={styles.expandAnswer} aria-expanded={expanded} aria-controls={textId} onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}>{expanded ? "Свернуть ответ" : "Читать ответ полностью"}<ArrowCircle direction={expanded ? "up" : "down"} /></button>}
  </div>;
};

const AttemptHistory = ({ attempts, hideCurrentResult = false, label = "Мой ответ" }: Props) => {
  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const current = attempts[attempts.length - 1];
  if (!current) return null;
  const previous = attempts.slice(0, -1).reverse();
  const renderAttempt = (attempt: SubmissionAttempt, latest = false) => <article className={styles.attempt} key={attempt.id}>
    <header className={styles.attemptHeading}>
      <strong>{latest ? label : `Попытка ${attempt.number}`}</strong>
      <span className={styles.attemptNumber}>{latest ? `Попытка ${attempt.number}` : STATUS_LABELS[attempt.status]}</span>
    </header>
    <div className={styles.attemptMeta}><time dateTime={attempt.sentAt}>{new Date(attempt.sentAt).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</time>{attempt.submittedLate && <span className={styles.late}>После дедлайна</span>}</div>
    <AnswerText text={attempt.text} />
    {attempt.attachmentId && attempt.attachmentName && <div className={styles.attachment}><span>Вложение к ответу</span><DownloadButton name={attempt.attachmentName} className={styles.attemptFile} onDownload={() => downloadAssignmentFile(attempt.attachmentId!, attempt.attachmentName!)} /></div>}
    {attempt.status !== "submitted" && (!latest || !hideCurrentResult) && <SubmissionResult attempt={attempt} />}
  </article>;

  return <div className={styles.history}>
    {renderAttempt(current, true)}
    {previous.length > 0 && <details className={styles.previous} onToggle={(event) => setHistoryOpen(event.currentTarget.open)}><summary><span>Предыдущие попытки <b>{previous.length}</b></span><ArrowCircle direction={historyOpen ? "up" : "down"} /></summary><div className={styles.timeline}>{previous.map((attempt) => renderAttempt(attempt))}</div></details>}
  </div>;
};

export default AttemptHistory;

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<AssignmentStatus, string> = { draft: "Черновик", published: "Опубликовано", closed: "Завершено", archived: "Архив" };
class AnswerSendError extends Error {}
class AssignmentSaveError extends Error {}
const localDateTime = (date: Date) => {
  const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000;
  return new Date(date.getTime() - offset).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
};
const createDefaultForm = (subject?: string, group?: string) => {
  const lesson = new Date();
  lesson.setDate(lesson.getDate() + 1);
  lesson.setHours(9, 0, 0, 0);
  const deadline = new Date(lesson);
  deadline.setDate(deadline.getDate() + 3);
  deadline.setHours(23, 59, 0, 0);
  return { subject: subject ?? SUBJECTS[0], group: group ?? GROUPS[0], lessonDate: localDateTime(lesson), lessonType: "Практика" as LessonType, title: "", description: "", deadline: localDateTime(deadline), status: "published" as AssignmentStatus, allowLateSubmissions: false };
};

interface Props { subject?: string; group?: string }
type AssignmentFilter = "all" | AssignmentStatus;

const AssignmentCenter = ({ subject, group }: Props) => {
  const { role, currentUser } = useRole();
  const membership = currentUser.memberships.find((item) => item.subjectId === getAcademicSubjectByName(subject)?.id);
  const membershipGroup = getAcademicGroup(membership?.groupIds[0])?.name ?? DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP;
  const student = { id: currentUser.role === "student" ? currentUser.id : DEMO_STUDENT_ID, name: currentUser.role === "student" ? currentUser.name : "Анна Смирнова", group: group ?? membershipGroup };
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState(getAssignments);
  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState(getSubmissions);
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const requestedAssignment = searchParams.get("assignment");
  const requestedSubmission = role === "teacher" ? searchParams.get("submission") : null;
  const selectedAssignmentRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const selectedSubmissionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const componentId = useId();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [assignmentFilter, setAssignmentFilter] = useState<AssignmentFilter>("all");
  const [assignmentQuery, setAssignmentQuery] = useState("");
  const [taskFile, setTaskFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const answerSendLock = useRef(false);
  const [reviewDrafts, setReviewDrafts] = useState<Record<string, ReviewDraft>>({});
  const updateReviewDraft = (attemptId: string, values: Partial<ReviewDraft>) => setReviewDrafts((current) => ({ ...current, [attemptId]: { ...(current[attemptId] ?? { comment: "", grade: "" }), ...values } }));
  const [operationError, setOperationError] = useState("");
  const [operationMessage, setOperationMessage] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState<Assignment | null>(null);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState("");
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => createDefaultForm(subject, group));
  const [originalForm, setOriginalForm] = useState(form);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState("");
  const editingVersionRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const assignmentSaveLock = useRef(false);
  const [pendingFormAction, setPendingFormAction] = useState<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const formErrorRef = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const formDirty = creating && (JSON.stringify(form) !== JSON.stringify(originalForm) || Boolean(taskFile));
  const hasReviewDraft = role === "teacher" && submissions.some((submission) => {
    const attempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(submission);
    const draft = reviewDrafts[attempt?.id ?? submission.id];
    return attempt?.status === "submitted" && Boolean(draft?.comment.trim() || draft?.grade);
  });
  useUnsavedChangesWarning(formDirty || hasReviewDraft);
  const journal = useJournal(getAcademicSubjectByName(subject)?.id ?? "", getAcademicGroupByName(group)?.id ?? "");
  const formSubjectId = getAcademicSubjectByName(form.subject)?.id;
  const availableGroups = formSubjectId ? getSubjectGroups(formSubjectId) : ACADEMIC_GROUPS;

  useEffect(() => subscribeAssignmentStore(() => {
    setAssignments(getAssignments());
    setSubmissions(getSubmissions());
  }), []);

  const mine = useMemo(() => submissions.filter((item) => item.studentId === student.id), [submissions, student.id]);
  const visible = assignments
    .filter((item) => currentUser.memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === item.subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(item.groupId)) && (role === "teacher" || isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(item, student.group)) && (!subject || item.subject === subject) && (!group || item.group === group))
    .sort((a, b) => a.deadline.localeCompare(b.deadline));
  const visibleIds = new Set(visible.map((item) => item.id));
  const expanded = requestedAssignment && visibleIds.has(requestedAssignment) ? requestedAssignment : null;
  const setExpanded = (id: string | null) => setSearchParams((current) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
    if (id) { next.set("assignment", id); next.set("tab", "assignments"); }
    else next.delete("assignment");
    next.delete("submission");
    return next;
  }, { replace: true });

  useEffect(() => {
    setAssignmentFilter("all");
  }, [requestedAssignment]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!expanded) return;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const target = selectedSubmissionRef.current ?? selectedAssignmentRef.current;
      target?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "auto" });
      if (selectedSubmissionRef.current) selectedSubmissionRef.current.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      else target?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-assignment-toggle="true"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [expanded, requestedSubmission]);
  const displayedAssignments = visible.filter((item) => (assignmentFilter === "all" || item.status === assignmentFilter) && matchesSearchText(`${item.title} ${item.description} ${item.subject} ${item.group}`, assignmentQuery));
  const resetAssignmentFilters = () => {
    setAssignmentQuery("");
    setAssignmentFilter("all");
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      selectedAssignmentRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-assignment-toggle="true"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  };
  const selectSubmission = (id: string) => setSearchParams((current) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
    next.set("submission", id);
    return next;
  }, { replace: true });
  const visibleAnswers = submissions.filter((item) => visibleIds.has(item.assignmentId));
  const awaitingReview = visibleAnswers.filter((item) => getSubmissionStatus(item) === "submitted").length;
  const checkedAnswers = visibleAnswers.filter((item) => getSubmissionStatus(item) === "graded").length;
  const revisions = visibleAnswers.filter((item) => getSubmissionStatus(item) === "revision").length;
  const studentActionRequired = visible.filter((item) => {
    const answer = mine.find((entry) => entry.assignmentId === item.id);
    return isSubmissionAllowed(item) && (!answer || getSubmissionStatus(answer) === "revision");
  }).length;
  const persistAssignments = (items: Assignment[]) => { saveAssignments(items); setAssignments(items); };
  const persistSubmissions = (items: Submission[]) => { saveSubmissions(items); setSubmissions(items); };

  const create = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const error = getAssignmentFormError(form, currentUser.memberships);
    setFormError(error);
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    if (error) requestAnimationFrame(() => formErrorRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: false }));
    if (!error && role === "teacher") setPreviewing(true);
  };

  const saveAssignment = async (status = form.status) => {
    if (saving || assignmentSaveLock.current || role !== "teacher") return;
    const targetForm = { ...form, status };
    const error = getAssignmentFormError(targetForm, currentUser.memberships);
    if (error) { setFormError(error); if (!previewing) requestAnimationFrame(() => formErrorRef.current?.focus()); return; }
    assignmentSaveLock.current = true;
    setFormError("");
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    setSaving(true);
    let attachmentId: string | undefined;
    try {
    attachmentId = taskFile ? await saveAssignmentFile(taskFile) : undefined;
    const latestAssignments = getAssignments();
    const previous = editingId ? latestAssignments.find((item) => item.id === editingId) : undefined;
    if (editingId && !previous) throw new AssignmentSaveError("Задание уже удалено. Текст оставлен в форме: скопируйте его перед закрытием.");
    if (previous && previous.updatedAt !== editingVersionRef.current) throw new AssignmentSaveError("Задание изменилось в другой вкладке. Сохранение остановлено, чтобы не затереть изменения. Скопируйте свой текст и откройте актуальную версию.");
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const subjectName = subject ?? form.subject;
    const groupName = group ?? form.group;
    const item: Assignment = { id: editingId ?? crypto.randomUUID(), ...targetForm, title: form.title.trim(), description: form.description.trim(), subjectId: getAcademicSubjectByName(subjectName)?.id ?? "unknown-subject", groupId: getAcademicGroupByName(groupName)?.id ?? "unknown-group", subject: subjectName, group: groupName, attachmentId: attachmentId ?? previous?.attachmentId, attachmentName: taskFile?.name ?? previous?.attachmentName, createdAt: previous?.createdAt ?? now, updatedAt: now };
    persistAssignments(editingId ? latestAssignments.map((entry) => entry.id === editingId ? item : entry) : [item, ...latestAssignments]);
    if (attachmentId && previous?.attachmentId && previous.attachmentId !== attachmentId) void deleteAssignmentFile(previous.attachmentId).catch(() => {});
    if (item.status === "published" && previous?.status !== "published") {
      try { addNotification({ recipientUserId: DEMO_STUDENT_ID, kind: "assignment", title: item.title, body: `${item.subject} · срок до ${new Date(item.deadline).toLocaleString("ru-RU")}`, href: getAssignmentHref(item), dedupeKey: `assignment-published:${item.id}` }); } catch { /* Задание сохранено; сбой уведомления не должен откатывать его. */ }
    }
    setCreating(false);
    setPreviewing(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setTaskFile(null);
    resetAssignmentFilters();
    setExpanded(item.id);
    setOperationMessage(editingId ? "Изменения задания сохранены." : item.status === "draft" ? "Черновик сохранён. Студенты увидят задание после публикации." : "Задание сохранено.");
    } catch (error) {
      if (attachmentId) void deleteAssignmentFile(attachmentId).catch(() => {});
      setFormError(error instanceof AssignmentSaveError ? error.message : "Не удалось сохранить задание. Проверьте доступ к хранилищу и повторите попытку.");
      if (!previewing) requestAnimationFrame(() => formErrorRef.current?.focus());
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      assignmentSaveLock.current = false;
    }
  };

  const focusEditor = () => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    formRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "auto" });
    titleRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });
  const afterDiscard = (action: () => void) => {
    if (saving) return;
    if (formDirty) setPendingFormAction(() => action); else action();
  };
  const startAssignment = () => {
    if (creating) { focusEditor(); return; }
    const initial = createDefaultForm(subject, group);
    setForm(initial);
    setOriginalForm(initial);
    setFormError("");
    editingVersionRef.current = null;
    setEditingId(null);
    setTaskFile(null);
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    setCreating(true);
    setPreviewing(false);
    focusEditor();
  };
  const closeEditor = () => afterDiscard(() => {
    setCreating(false);
    setPreviewing(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setTaskFile(null);
    setFormError("");
    setOperationError("");
  });
  const editAssignment = (assignment: Assignment, publish = false) => {
    afterDiscard(() => {
      const initial = { subject: assignment.subject, group: assignment.group, lessonDate: assignment.lessonDate, lessonType: assignment.lessonType, title: assignment.title, description: assignment.description, deadline: assignment.deadline, status: assignment.status, allowLateSubmissions: assignment.allowLateSubmissions };
      setOriginalForm(initial);
      setFormError("");
      editingVersionRef.current = assignment.updatedAt;
      setForm(publish ? { ...initial, status: "published" } : initial);
      setEditingId(assignment.id);
      setTaskFile(null);
      setOperationError("");
      setOperationMessage("");
      setCreating(true);
      setPreviewing(publish);
      setExpanded(null);
      if (!publish) focusEditor();
    });
  };

  const publishDraft = (assignment: Assignment) => {
    if (saving || role !== "teacher" || assignment.status !== "draft" || !visibleIds.has(assignment.id)) return;
    editAssignment(assignment, true);
  };

  const deleteAssignment = async (assignment: Assignment) => {
    if (saving || role !== "teacher" || !visibleIds.has(assignment.id)) return;
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    setDeleteError("");
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const removed = removeAssignmentRecords(assignment.id);
      const fileIds = new Set([removed.assignment?.attachmentId, ...removed.submissions.flatMap((item) => getSubmissionAttempts(item).map((attempt) => attempt.attachmentId))].filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)));
      const cleanup = await Promise.allSettled([...fileIds].map(deleteAssignmentFile));
      setPendingDelete(null);
      setExpanded(null);
      setOperationMessage(cleanup.some((result) => result.status === "rejected") ? "Задание и ответы удалены. Некоторые вложения не удалось очистить из хранилища браузера." : "Задание и связанные ответы удалены.");
    } catch {
      setDeleteError("Не удалось удалить задание. Проверьте доступ к хранилищу и повторите попытку.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const sendAnswer = async (assignment: Assignment, text: string, file: File | null): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (saving || answerSendLock.current || role !== "student" || !text.trim() || !visibleIds.has(assignment.id)) return false;
    answerSendLock.current = true;
    const expectedAttempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(mine.find((item) => item.assignmentId === assignment.id));
    const readTarget = () => {
      const target = getAssignments().find((item) => item.id === assignment.id);
      if (!target || !isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(target, student.group) || !currentUser.memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === target.subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(target.groupId)) || !isSubmissionAllowed(target)) throw new AnswerSendError("Приём ответов уже закрыт или задание недоступно. Отправка остановлена.");
      if (target.updatedAt !== assignment.updatedAt) throw new AnswerSendError("Условия задания изменились. Перечитайте их перед отправкой. Ответ не отправлен.");
      const records = getSubmissions();
      const previous = records.find((item) => item.assignmentId === assignment.id && item.studentId === student.id);
      const currentAttempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(previous);
      if ((previous && currentAttempt?.status !== "revision") || currentAttempt?.id !== expectedAttempt?.id || currentAttempt?.updatedAt !== expectedAttempt?.updatedAt) throw new AnswerSendError("Ответ уже изменён в другой вкладке. Проверьте актуальную попытку перед отправкой.");
      return { target, records, previous, currentAttempt };
    };
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    setSaving(true);
    let newAttachmentId: string | undefined;
    try {
    readTarget();
    newAttachmentId = file ? await saveAssignmentFile(file) : undefined;
    const { target, records, previous, currentAttempt } = readTarget();
    const attachmentId = newAttachmentId ?? currentAttempt?.attachmentId;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const attempt: SubmissionAttempt = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      number: getSubmissionAttempts(previous).length + 1,
      sentAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      text,
      attachmentId,
      attachmentName: file?.name ?? currentAttempt?.attachmentName,
      status: "submitted",
      submittedLate: isAttemptLate(target, now),
    };
    const attempts = [...getSubmissionAttempts(previous), attempt];
    const item: Submission = {
      id: previous?.id ?? crypto.randomUUID(),
      assignmentId: assignment.id,
      studentId: student.id,
      studentName: student.name,
      sentAt: previous?.sentAt ?? now,
      updatedAt: now,
      status: "submitted",
      text,
      attachmentId: attempt.attachmentId,
      attachmentName: attempt.attachmentName,
      attemptCount: attempts.length,
      attempts,
    };
    persistSubmissions([...records.filter((entry) => !(entry.assignmentId === assignment.id && entry.studentId === student.id)), item]);
    try { addNotification({ recipientUserId: DEMO_TEACHER_ID, kind: "submission", title: previous ? "Работа отправлена повторно" : "Получен новый ответ", body: `${student.name} · ${assignment.title} · попытка ${attempt.number}`, href: getAssignmentHref(assignment, item.id), dedupeKey: `submission:${item.id}:attempt:${attempt.number}` }); } catch { /* Ответ уже сохранён; уведомление можно восстановить отдельно. */ }
    setOperationMessage(previous ? "Новая попытка отправлена преподавателю." : "Ответ отправлен преподавателю. Статус проверки появится в этом задании.");
    return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (newAttachmentId) void deleteAssignmentFile(newAttachmentId).catch(() => {});
      setOperationError(error instanceof AnswerSendError ? error.message : "Не удалось отправить работу. Ответ остался в форме — повторите попытку.");
      setAssignments(getAssignments());
      setSubmissions(getSubmissions());
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      answerSendLock.current = false;
    }
  };

  const review = (submission: Submission, status: "revision" | "graded", comment: string, gradeValue: string): boolean => {
    if (saving || role !== "teacher" || !visibleIds.has(submission.assignmentId)) return false;
    const records = getSubmissions();
    const latest = records.find((item) => item.id === submission.id);
    const currentAttempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(latest);
    if (!latest || !currentAttempt || currentAttempt.status !== "submitted" || currentAttempt.id !== getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(submission)?.id) {
      setSubmissions(records);
      setOperationError("Ответ уже изменился. Проверьте актуальную попытку перед сохранением.");
      return false;
    }
    const teacherComment = comment.trim();
    const grade = gradeValue.trim();
    if ((status === "revision" && !teacherComment) || (status === "graded" && !["5", "4", "3", "2"].includes(grade))) return false;
    setOperationError("");
    setOperationMessage("");
    setSaving(true);
    try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const reviewedAttempt: SubmissionAttempt = {
      ...currentAttempt,
      status,
      grade: status === "graded" ? grade : undefined,
      teacherComment: teacherComment || undefined,
      reviewedAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    const attempts = getSubmissionAttempts(latest).map((attempt) => attempt.id === currentAttempt.id ? reviewedAttempt : attempt);
    const updated: Submission = { ...latest, status, grade: reviewedAttempt.grade, teacherComment: reviewedAttempt.teacherComment, updatedAt: now, attemptCount: attempts.length, attempts };
    persistSubmissions(records.map((item) => item.id === submission.id ? updated : item));
    const assignment = assignments.find((item) => item.id === submission.assignmentId);
    try { addNotification({ recipientUserId: submission.studentId, kind: status === "revision" ? "revision" : "grade", title: status === "revision" ? "Работа возвращена на доработку" : `Получена оценка ${grade}`, body: teacherComment || "Откройте задание, чтобы посмотреть результат.", href: assignment ? getAssignmentHref(assignment) : "/journal", dedupeKey: `submission-reviewed:${submission.id}:attempt:${currentAttempt.number}:${status}` }); } catch { /* Решение преподавателя уже сохранено. */ }
    setOperationMessage(status === "revision" ? "Работа возвращена на доработку. Студенту доступен ваш комментарий." : `Оценка ${grade} сохранена. Студенту доступен результат проверки.`);
    return true;
    } catch {
      setOperationError("Не удалось сохранить результат проверки. Повторите попытку.");
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return <div className={styles.layout}>
    <div className={styles.overview}>
      {role === "teacher" ? <><div><span>Заданий</span><strong>{visible.length}</strong></div><div><span>Ждут проверки</span><strong>{awaitingReview}</strong></div><div><span>На доработке</span><strong>{revisions}</strong></div><div><span>Проверено</span><strong>{checkedAnswers}</strong></div></> : <><div><span>Всего заданий</span><strong>{visible.length}</strong></div><div><span>Требуют действия</span><strong>{studentActionRequired}</strong></div><div><span>На проверке</span><strong>{mine.filter((item) => visibleIds.has(item.assignmentId) && getSubmissionStatus(item) === "submitted").length}</strong></div><div><span>Оценено</span><strong>{mine.filter((item) => visibleIds.has(item.assignmentId) && getSubmissionStatus(item) === "graded").length}</strong></div></>}
    </div>
    <div className={styles.toolbar}><div><strong>Лента заданий</strong><span> · полный цикл сдачи и проверки</span></div>{role === "teacher" && <button type="button" className={styles.primary} disabled={saving} onClick={startAssignment}>{creating ? "К редактированию" : "+ Добавить задание"}</button>}</div>
    {operationError && <p className={styles.operationError} role="alert">{operationError}</p>}
    {!operationError && operationMessage && <p className={styles.operationMessage} role="status">{operationMessage}</p>}
    {requestedAssignment && !expanded && <div className={styles.unavailable} role="status"><strong>Задание недоступно</strong><span>Возможно, оно удалено, ещё не опубликовано или относится к другой группе.</span><button type="button" onClick={() => setExpanded(null)}>Показать доступные задания</button></div>}
    {visible.length > 0 && <SearchField label="Поиск по заданиям" placeholder="Название, описание или предмет" value={assignmentQuery} onChange={setAssignmentQuery} />}
    {expanded && !displayedAssignments.some((item) => item.id === expanded) && <div className={styles.unavailable} role="status"><span>Открытое задание скрыто текущими фильтрами.</span><button type="button" onClick={resetAssignmentFilters}>Показать открытое задание</button></div>}
    {role === "teacher" && <div className={styles.assignmentFilters}>{([['all', 'Все'], ['draft', 'Черновики'], ['published', 'Опубликованные'], ['closed', 'Завершённые'], ['archived', 'Архив']] as const).map(([value, label]) => <button className={assignmentFilter === value ? styles.filterActive : ""} aria-pressed={assignmentFilter === value} onClick={() => setAssignmentFilter(value)} key={value}>{label}</button>)}</div>}
    {creating && <form ref={formRef} className={styles.createForm} onSubmit={create} aria-labelledby={`${componentId}-form-title`} aria-busy={saving}>
      <header className={styles.editorHeader}><div><span>{editingId ? "Редактирование" : "Новое задание"}</span><h2 id={`${componentId}-form-title`}>{editingId ? "Обновить задание" : "Подготовить задание"}</h2><p>{form.subject} · {form.group}</p></div><span className={styles.editorState}>{formDirty ? "Есть изменения" : editingId ? "Нет новых изменений" : "Поля готовы к заполнению"}</span></header>
      <fieldset className={styles.formFields} disabled={saving}><div className={styles.formGrid}>
      {!subject && <Dropdown label="Предмет" value={form.subject} onChange={(nextSubject) => { const nextSubjectId = getAcademicSubjectByName(nextSubject)?.id; setForm({ ...form, subject: nextSubject, group: (nextSubjectId ? getSubjectGroups(nextSubjectId)[0]?.name : undefined) ?? form.group }); }} options={SUBJECTS.map((item) => ({ value: item, label: item }))} />}
      {!group && <Dropdown label="Группа" value={form.group} onChange={(value) => setForm({ ...form, group: value })} options={availableGroups.map((item) => ({ value: item.name, label: item.name }))} />}
      <Dropdown label="Статус задания" value={form.status} onChange={(value) => setForm({ ...form, status: value as AssignmentStatus })} options={[{ value: "draft", label: "Черновик" }, { value: "published", label: "Опубликовать" }, { value: "closed", label: "Завершить" }, { value: "archived", label: "В архив" }]} /><Dropdown label="Тип занятия" value={form.lessonType} onChange={(value) => setForm({ ...form, lessonType: value as LessonType })} options={["Лекция", "Практика", "Лабораторная"].map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))} />
      <div className={styles.dateField}><span>Дата и время занятия</span><DateTimePicker value={form.lessonDate ? new Date(form.lessonDate) : undefined} onChange={(date) => date && setForm({ ...form, lessonDate: localDateTime(date) })} placeholder="Выберите занятие" ariaLabel="Дата и время занятия" /></div><Checkbox className={styles.checkboxField} label="Разрешить ответы после дедлайна" checked={form.allowLateSubmissions} disabled={saving} onChange={(checked) => setForm({ ...form, allowLateSubmissions: checked })} />
      <label className={styles.wide}>Название<input ref={titleRef} required value={form.title} placeholder="Например, практикум по условной вероятности" onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, title: event.target.value })} /></label><label className={styles.wide}>Описание<textarea required value={form.description} placeholder="Что нужно сделать, как оформить ответ и по каким критериям он оценивается" onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, description: event.target.value })} /></label>
      <div className={styles.dateField}><span>Срок сдачи</span><DateTimePicker value={form.deadline ? new Date(form.deadline) : undefined} onChange={(date) => date && setForm({ ...form, deadline: localDateTime(date) })} placeholder="Выберите дедлайн" ariaLabel="Срок сдачи" /></div><AttachmentPicker key={editingId ?? "new-task"} label="Файл задания" file={taskFile} onChange={setTaskFile} retainedName={assignments.find((item) => item.id === editingId)?.attachmentName} disabled={saving} />
    </div></fieldset><p className={styles.visibilityHint}><strong>После сохранения</strong>{getAssignmentVisibility(form.status)}</p>{formError && <p ref={formErrorRef} tabIndex={-1} className={styles.operationError} role="alert">{formError}</p>}<div className={styles.formActions}><span>{formDirty ? "Изменения ещё не сохранены" : editingId ? "Изменения будут видны после сохранения" : "Перед публикацией можно проверить результат"}</span><button disabled={saving} type="button" onClick={closeEditor}>Отмена</button>{(!editingId || assignments.find((item) => item.id === editingId)?.status === "draft") && form.status !== "draft" && <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => { void saveAssignment("draft"); }}>Сохранить черновик</button>}<button type="submit" disabled={saving} className={styles.primary}>{saving ? "Сохраняем…" : "Предпросмотр"}</button></div></form>}
    <div className={styles.list}>{displayedAssignments.map((assignment) => {
      const answers = submissions.filter((item) => item.assignmentId === assignment.id);
      const myAnswer = mine.find((item) => item.assignmentId === assignment.id);
      const currentAttempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(myAnswer);
      const open = expanded === assignment.id;
      const studentState = getStudentAssignmentState(assignment, myAnswer);
      const deadlineState = getAssignmentDeadlineState(assignment);
      const submissionClosed = !isSubmissionAllowed(assignment);
      const canSend = !submissionClosed && (!myAnswer || currentAttempt?.status === "revision");
      const stateLabel = studentState === "graded" ? `Оценка ${currentAttempt?.grade}` : studentState === "revision" ? submissionClosed ? "Доработка · приём закрыт" : "Нужна доработка" : studentState === "resubmitted" ? "Повторно отправлено" : studentState === "submitted" ? "На проверке" : assignment.status === "closed" ? "Приём завершён" : studentState === "late-allowed" ? "Можно сдать с опозданием" : studentState === "overdue" ? "Приём завершён" : "Ожидает сдачи";
      const detailsId = `${componentId}-${assignment.id}-details`;
      const waiting = answers.filter((answer) => getSubmissionStatus(answer) === "submitted").length;
      const cardTone = role === "teacher" ? assignment.status : studentState;
      const lessonDate = new Date(assignment.lessonDate);
      return <article className={`${styles.card} ${styles[`card_${cardTone}`] ?? ""} ${role === "student" && studentState === "graded" ? styles[`grade_${currentAttempt?.grade}`] ?? "" : ""} ${open ? styles.targetCard : ""}`} ref={open ? selectedAssignmentRef : undefined} key={assignment.id}>
        <button type="button" data-assignment-toggle="true" className={styles.cardHeader} onClick={() => setExpanded(open ? null : assignment.id)} aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={open ? detailsId : undefined}>
          <span className={styles.cardIntro}><span className={`${styles.assignmentStatus} ${styles[`assignmentStatus_${assignment.status}`] ?? ""}`}>{role === "teacher" ? STATUS_LABELS[assignment.status] : isSubmissionAllowed(assignment) ? "Приём открыт" : "Приём завершён"}</span><span className={styles.cardIdentity}><span className={styles.meta}><span className={styles.lessonType}>{assignment.lessonType}</span><time className={styles.lessonDate} dateTime={assignment.lessonDate}>{lessonDate.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short" })}</time></span><strong className={styles.cardTitle}>{assignment.title}</strong><small>{assignment.subject} · {assignment.group}</small></span></span>
          <span className={styles.headerAside}><span className={styles.deadlineLabel}>Срок сдачи</span><time className={`${styles.deadline} ${role === "student" && deadlineState === "overdue" && !myAnswer ? styles.deadlineOverdue : ""}`} dateTime={assignment.deadline}>{new Date(assignment.deadline).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</time><span className={styles.answerCounts}>{role === "teacher" ? <><span>Ответы <b>{answers.length}</b></span><span className={waiting ? styles.waitingCount : ""}>На проверке <b>{waiting}</b></span></> : <b>{stateLabel}</b>}</span></span>
          <ArrowCircle direction={open ? "up" : "down"} className={styles.cardArrow} />
        </button>
        {open && <div id={detailsId} className={styles.details}><section className={styles.assignmentBrief} aria-labelledby={`${detailsId}-brief`}><div className={styles.briefHeading}><h3 id={`${detailsId}-brief`}>Условие задания</h3>{role === "teacher" && <div className={styles.detailActions}>{assignment.status === "draft" && <button disabled={saving} className={styles.primary} onClick={() => publishDraft(assignment)}>Опубликовать</button>}<button disabled={saving} onClick={() => editAssignment(assignment)}>Редактировать</button><button disabled={saving} className={styles.dangerButton} onClick={() => { setDeleteError(""); setPendingDelete(assignment); }}>Удалить</button></div>}</div><p>{assignment.description}</p>{assignment.attachmentId && assignment.attachmentName && <div className={styles.taskAttachment}><span>Файл задания</span><DownloadButton name={assignment.attachmentName} className={styles.fileButton} onDownload={() => downloadAssignmentFile(assignment.attachmentId!, assignment.attachmentName!)} /></div>}</section>
          {role === "student" ? <>
            <div className={styles.workflowStatus}><span className={`${styles.workflowDot} ${styles[`workflowDot_${currentAttempt?.status ?? studentState}`]}`} /><div><strong>{stateLabel}</strong><span>{currentAttempt?.status === "submitted" ? "Работа зафиксирована. Изменить её можно после возврата преподавателем." : currentAttempt?.status === "graded" ? "Цикл задания завершён." : submissionClosed ? "Срок или приём работ завершён. Уточните возможность сдачи у преподавателя." : currentAttempt?.status === "revision" ? "Исправьте работу по комментарию и отправьте новую попытку." : "Подготовьте ответ и отправьте его преподавателю."}</span></div></div>
            <AssignmentProgress state={studentState} />
            {canSend && <AnswerComposer key={`${student.id}:${assignment.id}:${currentAttempt?.id ?? "first"}`} studentId={student.id} assignmentId={assignment.id} assignmentVersion={assignment.updatedAt} attempt={currentAttempt} saving={saving} onSend={(text, file) => sendAnswer(assignment, text, file)} />}
            {myAnswer && <div className={styles.studentHistory}><AttemptHistory attempts={getSubmissionAttempts(myAnswer)} /></div>}
          </> : <SubmissionWorkspace key={assignment.id} answers={answers} students={journal.students} rosterError={journal.error} currentId={requestedSubmission} targetRef={selectedSubmissionRef} saving={saving} drafts={reviewDrafts} onDraftChange={updateReviewDraft} onSelect={selectSubmission} onReview={review} />}
        </div>}
      </article>;
    })}{!displayedAssignments.length && <div className={styles.emptyState}>
      <strong>{visible.length ? "Задания не найдены" : "Заданий пока нет"}</strong>
      <span>{visible.length ? "Измените поисковый запрос или покажите все задания." : role === "teacher" ? "Создайте первое задание и опубликуйте его для группы." : "Преподаватель ещё не публиковал задания по предмету."}</span>
      {visible.length ? <button type="button" onClick={resetAssignmentFilters}>Показать все задания</button> : role === "teacher" && <button type="button" className={styles.primary} onClick={startAssignment}>+ Добавить задание</button>}
    </div>}</div>
    {pendingDelete && <ConfirmDialog title="Удалить задание?" busy={saving} error={deleteError} onCancel={() => setPendingDelete(null)} onConfirm={() => { void deleteAssignment(pendingDelete); }}><p><strong>{pendingDelete.title}</strong></p><p>Будут удалены задание, ответы студентов ({submissions.filter((item) => item.assignmentId === pendingDelete.id).length}) и вложения всех попыток. Восстановить их нельзя.</p></ConfirmDialog>}
    {previewing && <AssignmentPreview form={form} publishing={form.status === "published" && assignments.find((item) => item.id === editingId)?.status !== "published"} attachmentName={taskFile?.name ?? assignments.find((item) => item.id === editingId)?.attachmentName} attachmentSize={taskFile?.size} saving={saving} error={formError} onBack={() => setPreviewing(false)} onSave={() => { void saveAssignment(); }} />}
    {pendingFormAction && <ConfirmDialog title="Оставить изменения без сохранения?" confirmLabel="Не сохранять" cancelLabel="Продолжить редактирование" onCancel={() => setPendingFormAction(null)} onConfirm={() => { const action = pendingFormAction; setPendingFormAction(null); action(); }}><p>В открытом задании есть несохранённые изменения. Выбранный файл тоже не будет прикреплён.</p></ConfirmDialog>}
  </div>;
};

export default AssignmentCenter;

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\SubmissionCard\index.test.tsx
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Submission } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import SubmissionCard from ".";

const answer: Submission = { id: "answer-1", assignmentId: "task-1", studentId: "anna-smirnova", studentName: "Анна Смирнова", text: "Решение задачи", sentAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-12T13:00", status: "submitted" };
const render = (submission: Submission, saving = false) => renderToStaticMarkup(<SubmissionCard submission={submission} expanded comment="" grade="" saving={saving} onCommentChange={() => {}} onGradeChange={() => {}} onReview={() => {}} />);

describe("submission card", () => {
  it("shows the review form only for an awaiting answer", () => {
    const markup = render(answer);
    expect(markup).toContain("<textarea");
    expect(markup).toContain('role="combobox"');
    expect(markup).toContain("Сохранить оценку");
    expect(markup).toContain('aria-label="Ответ: Анна Смирнова"');
  });

  it.each(["5", "4", "3", "2"])("shows grade %s as a result, without a disabled form", (grade) => {
    const markup = render({ ...answer, status: "graded", grade, teacherComment: "Отлично оформлено" });
    expect(markup).toContain(`aria-label="Оценка ${grade}"`);
    expect(markup).toContain("Отлично оформлено");
    expect(markup).not.toContain("<textarea");
    expect(markup).not.toContain('role="combobox"');
    expect(markup).not.toContain("Сохранить оценку");
  });

  it("shows revision feedback instead of inactive review controls", () => {
    const markup = render({ ...answer, status: "revision", teacherComment: "Исправьте формулу" });
    expect(markup).toContain("Исправьте формулу");
    expect(markup).toContain("Ожидается новая попытка студента");
    expect(markup).not.toContain("<textarea");
    expect(markup).not.toContain("Сохранить оценку");
  });

  it.each([true, false])("offers an explicit save-and-advance action (has next: %s)", (hasNext) => {
    const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(<SubmissionCard submission={answer} expanded comment="" grade="" saving={false} onCommentChange={() => {}} onGradeChange={() => {}} onReview={() => {}} onReviewNext={() => {}} hasNext={hasNext} />);
    expect(markup).toContain(hasNext ? "Сохранить оценку и открыть следующий ответ" : "Сохранить оценку и завершить очередь");
    expect(markup).toContain("Сохранить оценку");
    expect(markup).toMatch(/disabled="" aria-label="Сохранить оценку и/);
  });
});


// src\components\AssignmentCenter\SubmissionCard\index.tsx
import { useId, type Ref } from "react";
import type { Submission } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import { getCurrentSubmissionAttempt, getSubmissionAttempts, getSubmissionStatus } from "../../../domain/assignments";
import Dropdown from "../../Dropdown";
import ArrowCircle from "../../ArrowCircle";
import AttemptHistory from "../AttemptHistory";
import SubmissionResult from "../SubmissionResult";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const STATUS_LABELS = { submitted: "Ждёт проверки", revision: "На доработке", graded: "Проверено" };

interface Props {
  submission: Submission;
  selected?: boolean;
  targetRef?: Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
  expanded?: boolean;
  onToggle?(button: HTMLButtonElement): void;
  comment: string;
  grade: string;
  saving: boolean;
  onCommentChange(value: string): void;
  onGradeChange(value: string): void;
  onReview(status: "revision" | "graded"): void;
  onReviewNext?(): void;
  hasNext?: boolean;
}

const SubmissionCard = ({ submission, selected = false, targetRef, expanded = false, onToggle, comment, grade, saving, onCommentChange, onGradeChange, onReview, onReviewNext, hasNext = false }: Props) => {
  const bodyId = useId();
  const status = getSubmissionStatus(submission) ?? "submitted";
  const attempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(submission);
  const initials = submission.studentName.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0]).join("");
  const hasDraft = Boolean(comment.trim() || grade);
  const canGrade = ["5", "4", "3", "2"].includes(grade);
  const sentAt = attempt?.sentAt ?? submission.sentAt;
  const sentDate = new Date(sentAt);
  const dateLabel = Number.isFinite(sentDate.getTime()) ? sentDate.toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }) : "Дата не указана";
  const savedGrade = status === "graded" && attempt?.grade;

  return <div ref={targetRef} data-submission-id={submission.id} tabIndex={selected ? -1 : undefined} aria-label={`Ответ: ${submission.studentName}`} className={`${styles.card} ${expanded ? styles.expanded : ""}`}>
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <button type="button" className={styles.toggle} onClick={(event) => onToggle?.(event.currentTarget)} aria-expanded={expanded} aria-controls={expanded ? bodyId : undefined} aria-label={`${expanded ? "Свернуть" : "Раскрыть"} ответ: ${submission.studentName}`}>
      <span className={styles.avatar} aria-hidden="true">{initials}</span>
      <span className={styles.identity}><strong>{submission.studentName}</strong><span className={styles.meta}><time dateTime={sentAt}>{dateLabel}</time><span>Попытка {attempt?.number ?? 1}</span>{attempt?.attachmentId && <span>Есть файл</span>}{attempt?.submittedLate && <span className={styles.late}>После дедлайна</span>}{status === "submitted" && hasDraft && <span className={styles.draftMark}>Есть черновик проверки</span>}</span></span>
      <span className={styles.summarySide}>{savedGrade && <strong className={`${styles.gradeBadge} ${styles[`grade_${savedGrade}`] ?? ""}`} aria-label={`Оценка ${savedGrade}`}>{savedGrade}</strong>}<span className={`${styles.status} ${styles[status]}`}>{STATUS_LABELS[status]}</span></span>
      <svg className={styles.chevron} viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 7 5 5 5-5" /></svg>
      </button>
    </header>
    {expanded && <div id={bodyId} className={`${styles.body} ${status !== "submitted" ? styles.reviewed : ""}`}>
      <AttemptHistory attempts={getSubmissionAttempts(submission)} hideCurrentResult label="Ответ студента" />
      {status === "submitted" ? <section className={styles.reviewPanel} aria-label={`Проверка работы ${submission.studentName}`} aria-busy={saving}>
        <div className={styles.panelHeading}><span>Обратная связь</span><h4>Проверка работы</h4></div>
        <p className={`${styles.draftHint} ${hasDraft ? styles.unsaved : ""}`} role="status">{saving ? "Сохраняем решение…" : hasDraft ? "Решение ещё не сохранено. Студент пока его не видит." : "Студент увидит оценку и комментарий после сохранения."}</p>
        <label>Комментарий<textarea disabled={saving} aria-label={`Комментарий для ${submission.studentName}`} placeholder="Что получилось и что улучшить" value={comment} onChange={(event) => onCommentChange(event.target.value)} /></label>
        <Dropdown label={`Оценка для ${submission.studentName}`} value={grade} placeholder="Выберите оценку" disabled={saving} onChange={onGradeChange} options={["5", "4", "3", "2"].map((value) => ({ value, label: value }))} />
        <div className={styles.gradeActions}><button type="button" className={styles.primary} disabled={saving || !canGrade} onClick={() => onReview("graded")}>{saving ? "Сохраняем…" : "Сохранить оценку"}</button>{onReviewNext && <button type="button" disabled={saving || !canGrade} aria-label={hasNext ? "Сохранить оценку и открыть следующий ответ" : "Сохранить оценку и завершить очередь"} onClick={onReviewNext}>{hasNext ? "Сохранить и далее" : "Сохранить и завершить"}<ArrowCircle /></button>}</div>
        <div className={styles.revisionAction}><button type="button" disabled={saving || !comment.trim()} onClick={() => onReview("revision")}>Вернуть на доработку</button><small>Для возврата укажите, что нужно исправить.</small></div>
      </section> : attempt && <SubmissionResult attempt={attempt} />}
    </div>}
  </div>;
};

export default SubmissionCard;

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\SubmissionResult\index.tsx
import type { SubmissionAttempt } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  attempt: SubmissionAttempt;
}

const SubmissionResult = ({ attempt }: Props) => {
  const graded = attempt.status === "graded";
  return <section className={`${styles.result} ${graded ? styles.graded : styles.revision}`} aria-label="Результат проверки">
    <span className={styles.eyebrow}>Результат проверки</span>
    <div className={styles.heading}>
      {graded && attempt.grade && <strong className={`${styles.grade} ${styles[`grade_${attempt.grade}`] ?? ""}`} aria-label={`Оценка ${attempt.grade}`}>{attempt.grade}</strong>}
      <div><strong>{graded ? "Работа проверена" : "Нужна доработка"}</strong><span>{graded ? "Результат доступен студенту" : "Ожидается новая попытка студента"}</span></div>
    </div>
    {attempt.teacherComment && <div className={styles.comment}><span>Комментарий преподавателя</span><p>{attempt.teacherComment}</p></div>}
    {attempt.reviewedAt && <time className={styles.date} dateTime={attempt.reviewedAt}>{graded ? "Оценка сохранена" : "Возвращено на доработку"} · {new Date(attempt.reviewedAt).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</time>}
  </section>;
};

export default SubmissionResult;

// src\components\AssignmentCenter\SubmissionWorkspace\index.test.tsx
import { createRef } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Submission } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import SubmissionWorkspace from ".";

const render = (answers: Submission[], rosterError = "") => renderToStaticMarkup(<SubmissionWorkspace answers={answers} students={[]} rosterError={rosterError} currentId={null} targetRef={createRef()} saving={false} drafts={{}} onDraftChange={() => {}} onSelect={() => {}} onReview={() => true} />);
const answer: Submission = { id: "one", studentId: "anna", studentName: "Анна", assignmentId: "task", text: "Ответ", sentAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", status: "revision", teacherComment: "Исправить" };

describe("submission workspace", () => {
  it("shows a useful empty state without an empty queue", () => {
    const markup = render([]);
    expect(markup).toContain("Ответов пока нет");
    expect(markup).not.toContain("Очередь проверки");
  });

  it("counts revision as considered, not as graded, and hides start when no pending answers", () => {
    const markup = render([answer]);
    expect(markup).toContain("Новых работ для проверки нет");
    expect(markup).toContain('value="1"');
    expect(markup).not.toContain("Начать проверку");
    expect(markup).toContain("На доработке");
  });

  it("does not invent a missing-student count when the roster fails", () => {
    const markup = render([], "storage failure");
    expect(markup).toContain('role="alert"');
    expect(markup).not.toContain("Ещё не сдали");
  });
});


// src\components\AssignmentCenter\SubmissionWorkspace\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import type { Submission } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import type { Student } from "../../Attendance/data/students";
import { getCurrentSubmissionAttempt, getSubmissionStatus } from "../../../domain/assignments";
import { getNextReviewSubmission, getReviewSubmissions, type ReviewDraft, type ReviewFilter, type ReviewSort } from "../../../domain/submissionReview";
import ArrowCircle from "../../ArrowCircle";
import Dropdown from "../../Dropdown";
import SearchField from "../../SearchField";
import SubmissionCard from "../SubmissionCard";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  answers: Submission[];
  students: Student[];
  rosterError: string;
  currentId: string | null;
  targetRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  saving: boolean;
  drafts: Record<string, ReviewDraft>;
  onDraftChange(attemptId: string, values: Partial<ReviewDraft>): void;
  onSelect(id: string): void;
  onReview(answer: Submission, status: "revision" | "graded", comment: string, grade: string): boolean;
}

const FILTERS = [["all", "Все"], ["submitted", "Ждут проверки"], ["revision", "На доработке"], ["graded", "Проверено"]] as const;

const SubmissionWorkspace = ({ answers, students, rosterError, currentId, targetRef, saving, drafts, onDraftChange, onSelect, onReview }: Props) => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<ReviewFilter>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<ReviewSort>("queue");
  const [missingOpen, setMissingOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reviewNotice, setReviewNotice] = useState("");
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(currentId);
  const listId = useId();
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const toggleAnchor = useRef<{ button: HTMLButtonElement; top: number } | null>(null);
  const filtered = getReviewSubmissions(answers, filter, query, sort);
  const queue = getReviewSubmissions(answers, "submitted", query, sort);
  const matching = getReviewSubmissions(answers, "all", query);
  const missing = students.filter((student) => !answers.some((answer) => answer.studentId === student.id));
  const considered = matching.filter((answer) => getSubmissionStatus(answer) !== "submitted").length;
  const queuePosition = queue.findIndex((answer) => answer.id === expandedId);
  const selectedHidden = expandedId && answers.some((answer) => answer.id === expandedId) && !filtered.some((answer) => answer.id === expandedId);
  const expandedVisible = filtered.some((answer) => answer.id === expandedId);
  useEffect(() => { setExpandedId(currentId); }, [currentId]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const anchor = toggleAnchor.current;
    toggleAnchor.current = null;
    if (!anchor?.button.isConnected) return;
    // Closing a preceding answer must not move the clicked heading in the viewport.
    const shift = anchor.button.getBoundingClientRect().top - anchor.top;
    if (Math.abs(shift) > .5) window.scrollBy({ top: shift, behavior: "auto" });
  }, [expandedId]);
  const resetFilters = () => { setQuery(""); setFilter("all"); };
  const selectAnswer = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedId(id);
    onSelect(id);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      targetRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      targetRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "auto" });
    });
  };
  const toggleAnswer = (id: string, button: HTMLButtonElement) => {
    toggleAnchor.current = { button, top: button.getBoundingClientRect().top };
    setExpandedId((current) => current === id ? null : id);
  };
  const showHiddenAnswer = () => {
    resetFilters();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const target = Array.from(listRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLDivElement>("[data-submission-id]") ?? []).find((node) => node.dataset.submissionId === expandedId);
      target?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      target?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "auto" });
    });
  };
  const selectNext = () => {
    const next = getNextReviewSubmission(answers, expandedId, query, sort) ?? queue[0];
    if (!next) return;
    setReviewNotice("");
    setFilter("submitted");
    selectAnswer(next.id);
  };
  const review = (answer: Submission, status: "revision" | "graded", advance = false) => {
    const key = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(answer)?.id ?? answer.id;
    const draft = drafts[key] ?? { comment: "", grade: "" };
    const next = getNextReviewSubmission(answers, answer.id, query, sort);
    if (!onReview(answer, status, draft.comment, draft.grade)) return;
    const result = status === "graded" ? `оценка ${draft.grade} сохранена` : "работа возвращена на доработку";
    const nextNotice = !advance ? "" : next ? ` Далее — ${next.studentName}.` : query.trim() ? " Очередь по текущему поиску завершена." : " Очередь проверки завершена.";
    setReviewNotice(`${answer.studentName}: ${result}.${nextNotice}`);
    if (advance) {
      setFilter(next ? "submitted" : "all");
      selectAnswer(next?.id ?? answer.id);
      if (!next) requestAnimationFrame(() => targetRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
    }
  };

  return <section className={styles.workspace} aria-label="Работы студентов">
    <div className={styles.controlPanel}>
    <header className={styles.header}><div><h3>Работы студентов</h3><p>Ответы, история сдачи и обратная связь</p></div><span className={styles.total}>Всего ответов <b>{answers.length}</b></span></header>
    {answers.length > 0 && <>
      <div className={styles.tools}><SearchField label="Поиск по студентам" placeholder="Имя или фамилия" value={query} onChange={setQuery} /><Dropdown label="Порядок работ" value={sort} onChange={(value) => setSort(value as ReviewSort)} options={[{ value: "queue", label: "Сначала на проверку" }, { value: "newest", label: "Сначала новые" }, { value: "oldest", label: "Сначала ранние" }, { value: "name", label: "По имени" }]} /></div>
      <div className={styles.filters} role="group" aria-label="Статусы ответов">{FILTERS.map(([value, label]) => <button type="button" className={filter === value ? styles.activeFilter : ""} aria-pressed={filter === value} key={value} onClick={() => setFilter(value)}><span>{label}</span><b>{getReviewSubmissions(answers, value, query).length}</b></button>)}<span className={styles.matchCount} role="status">Показано {filtered.length} из {answers.length}</span></div>
      <div className={styles.queue}>
        <div className={styles.queueHeading}><span>{query.trim() ? "По текущему поиску" : "Очередь проверки"}</span><strong>{queue.length ? `Ожидают проверки: ${queue.length}` : matching.length ? "Новых работ для проверки нет" : "Нет ответов по этому поиску"}</strong>{queuePosition >= 0 && <small>Открыта работа {queuePosition + 1} из {queue.length}</small>}</div>
        {matching.length > 0 && <div className={styles.progress}><div><span>Рассмотрено</span><b>{considered} / {matching.length}</b></div><progress max={matching.length} value={considered} aria-label="Оценены или возвращены на доработку" /></div>}
        {queue.length > 0 && <button type="button" disabled={saving} className={styles.nextButton} onClick={selectNext}>{queuePosition < 0 ? "Начать проверку" : queue.length > 1 ? "Следующий ответ" : "Открыть ответ"}<ArrowCircle /></button>}
      </div>
    </>}
    </div>
    {reviewNotice && <div className={styles.reviewNotice}><span role="status">{reviewNotice}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => setReviewNotice("")} aria-label="Скрыть сообщение о проверке">Понятно</button></div>}
    {selectedHidden && <div className={styles.hiddenTarget} role="status"><span>Открытый ответ скрыт текущими фильтрами.</span><button type="button" onClick={showHiddenAnswer}>Показать выбранный ответ</button></div>}
    <section className={styles.answers} aria-label="Список ответов студентов">
    {filtered.length > 0 && <div className={styles.listHeading}><div><h4>Ответы студентов</h4><span>{filter === "all" ? "Все статусы" : FILTERS.find(([value]) => value === filter)?.[1]} · {filtered.length} · Нажмите на студента, чтобы открыть ответ</span></div>{expandedVisible && <button type="button" disabled={saving} aria-controls={listId} onClick={() => setExpandedId(null)}>Свернуть ответ</button>}</div>}
    <div id={listId} ref={listRef} className={styles.list}>{filtered.length ? filtered.map((answer) => {
      const key = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(answer)?.id ?? answer.id;
      const draft = drafts[key] ?? { comment: "", grade: "" };
      const updateDraft = (values: Partial<ReviewDraft>) => onDraftChange(key, values);
      const next = getNextReviewSubmission(answers, answer.id, query, sort);
      return <SubmissionCard key={answer.id} submission={answer} selected={expandedId === answer.id} expanded={expandedId === answer.id} onToggle={(button) => toggleAnswer(answer.id, button)} targetRef={currentId === answer.id ? targetRef : undefined} comment={draft.comment} grade={draft.grade} saving={saving} onCommentChange={(comment) => updateDraft({ comment })} onGradeChange={(grade) => updateDraft({ grade })} onReview={(status) => review(answer, status)} onReviewNext={() => review(answer, "graded", true)} hasNext={Boolean(next)} />;
    }) : <div className={styles.empty}><strong>{!answers.length ? "Ответов пока нет" : query.trim() ? "Ответы не найдены" : "В этой категории работ нет"}</strong><span>{!answers.length ? "Когда студенты отправят ответы, они появятся здесь." : query.trim() ? "Проверьте имя или фамилию либо сбросьте фильтры." : "Выберите другой статус, чтобы посмотреть работы."}</span>{answers.length > 0 && <button type="button" onClick={resetFilters}>Сбросить фильтры</button>}</div>}</div>
    </section>
    {rosterError ? <p className={styles.error} role="alert">Не удалось прочитать состав группы. Список несдавших временно недоступен.</p> : <details className={styles.missing} onToggle={(event) => setMissingOpen(event.currentTarget.open)}><summary><span>Ещё не сдали</span><b>{missing.length}</b><ArrowCircle direction={missingOpen ? "up" : "down"} /></summary><div>{missing.map((student) => <span key={student.id}>{student.name}</span>)}{!missing.length && <span>Все студенты из журнала отправили ответы.</span>}</div></details>}
  </section>;
};

export default SubmissionWorkspace;

// src\components\AssignmentProgress\index.tsx
import type { StudentAssignmentState } from "../../domain/assignments";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface AssignmentProgressProps { state: StudentAssignmentState }

const AssignmentProgress = ({ state }: AssignmentProgressProps) => {
  const stage = state === "graded" ? 3 : state === "submitted" || state === "resubmitted" ? 2 : 1;
  const labels = [state === "revision" ? "Доработка" : "Ответ", "Отправка", "Проверка"];
  return <ol className={`${styles.progress} ${state === "revision" ? styles.revision : ""}`} aria-label="Этапы работы">
    {labels.map((label, index) => <li key={index} className={index + 1 < stage || state === "graded" ? styles.done : index + 1 === stage ? styles.current : ""} aria-current={index + 1 === stage && state !== "graded" ? "step" : undefined}>
      <span aria-hidden="true" />{label}
    </li>)}
  </ol>;
};

export default AssignmentProgress;
