// src\components\AttachmentPicker\index.tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent } from "react";
import { formatFileSize, getAttachmentError } from "../../domain/files";
import ArrowIcon from "../ArrowIcon";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  label: string;
  file: File | null;
  onChange(file: File | null): void;
  retainedName?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const AttachmentPicker = ({ label, file, onChange, retainedName, disabled = false }: Props) => {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const helpId = useId();
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const select = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const selected = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!selected) return;
    const message = getAttachmentError(selected);
    setError(message);
    if (!message) onChange(selected);
  };

  return <div className={styles.picker}>
    <div className={styles.heading}><strong>{label}</strong><span>Необязательно · до 25 МБ</span></div>
    <div className={styles.controls}>
      <button type="button" disabled={disabled} aria-describedby={helpId} onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}><ArrowIcon direction="up" size={16} />{file || retainedName ? "Заменить файл" : "Прикрепить файл"}</button>
      {file && <button type="button" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => { onChange(null); setError(""); }}>Убрать выбранный файл</button>}
    </div>
    <input ref={inputRef} type="file" hidden disabled={disabled} aria-label={label} onChange={select} />
    <span id={helpId} className={styles.filename}>{file ? `${file.name} · ${formatFileSize(file.size)}` : retainedName ? `Текущее вложение: ${retainedName}` : "PDF, документы, изображения или архив"}</span>
    {file && retainedName && <small>Текущее вложение будет заменено после сохранения.</small>}
    {!file && retainedName && <small>Без замены сохранится текущий файл.</small>}
    {error && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>}
  </div>;
};

export default AttachmentPicker;


// src\components\Attendance\data\students.tsx
// src/data/students.ts
import { eachDayOfInterval, getDay, format } from 'date-fns';

export type AttendanceStatus = 'unmarked' | 'present' | 'sick' | 'absent';
export type Grade = 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | null;

export interface Student {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  attendance: { [date: string]: AttendanceStatus };
  grades: { [date: string]: Grade }; // новый объект для оценок
}

// --- Рабочие дни октября 2025 ---
const START_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 1); 
const END_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 30);

export const workDays = eachDayOfInterval({ start: START_DATE, end: END_DATE })
  .filter(d => getDay(d) !== 0)
  .map(d => format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd'));

// --- Возможные статусы ---
const STATUS: AttendanceStatus[] = ['present', 'sick', 'absent'];

// --- Случайный выбор статуса ---
const randomStatus = () => STATUS[Math.floor(Math.random() * STATUS.length)];

// --- Возможные оценки ---
const GRADES: Grade[] = [2, 3, 4, 5];

// --- Случайная оценка ---
const randomGrade = () => GRADES[Math.floor(Math.random() * GRADES.length)];

// --- Генерация массива студентов ---
export const INITIAL_STUDENTS: Student[] = [
  'Иванов Иван', 'Петрова Мария', 'Сидоров Алексей', 'Козлова Елена', 'Николаев Дмитрий',
  'Морозова Анна', 'Федоров Сергей', 'Куликова Ольга', 'Смирнов Павел', 'Васильева Татьяна',
  'Андреев Виктор', 'Григорьева Юлия', 'Егоров Игорь', 'Соколова Наталья', 'Кузнецов Артём',
  'Лебедева Марина', 'Орлов Константин', 'Воронова Ирина', 'Тихонов Михаил', 'Киселева Светлана',
  'Зайцев Николай', 'Фролова Анастасия', 'Савельев Андрей', 'Михайлова Елизавета', 'Дмитриев Олег',
  'Павлова Виктория', 'Романов Аркадий', 'Алексеева Полина', 'Семёнов Владислав', 'Ефимова Ксения',
].map((name, index) => {
  const attendance: { [date: string]: AttendanceStatus } = {};
  const grades: { [date: string]: Grade } = {};

  workDays.forEach(date => {
    attendance[date] = randomStatus();
    grades[date] = randomGrade();
  });

  return {
    id: (index + 1).toString(),
    name,
    attendance,
    grades,
  };
});

import * as React from 'react';
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback, useId, useRef } from 'react';
import { format, eachDayOfInterval, getDay } from 'date-fns';
import { ru } from 'date-fns/locale';
import styles from './index.module.scss';
import {
  VisitMarkIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  MinusIcon,
  EditIcon,
  AcceptIcon,
  CloseIcon,
} from '../ButtonIcons/Icons';
import { Student, AttendanceStatus, Grade } from './data/students';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import type { AcademicLesson } from '../../domain/academic';
import { lessonTypeLabels } from '../../domain/academic';
import { countJournalDraftChanges, mergeJournalDraft } from '../../domain/journalDraft';
import useUnsavedChangesWarning from '../../hooks/useUnsavedChangesWarning';
import useBodyScrollLock from '../../hooks/useBodyScrollLock';
import ConfirmDialog from '../ConfirmDialog';
import SearchField from '../SearchField';
import { matchesSearchText } from '../../domain/search';

// Константы
const START_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 1);
const END_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 30);

const STATUS_COLORS = {
  unmarked: { fill: 'transparent', color2: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-text-secondary) 65%, transparent)' },
  present: { fill: 'var(--color-visit)', color2: 'var(--color-visit)' },
  sick: { fill: 'var(--color-sick)', color2: 'var(--color-sick)' },
  absent: { fill: 'var(--color-no-visit)', color2: 'var(--ui-error)' },
};

const GRADE_COLORS: Record<Exclude<Grade, null>, string> = {
  5: 'var(--color-grade-5)',
  4: 'var(--color-grade-4)',
  3: 'var(--color-grade-3)',
  2: 'var(--color-grade-2)',
};

const GRADE_ORDER: Grade[] = [null, 5, 4, 3, 2];
const ATTENDANCE_ORDER: AttendanceStatus[] = ['unmarked', 'present', 'sick', 'absent'];

// Утилиты
const generateDates = (start: Date, end: Date): Date[] =>
  eachDayOfInterval({ start, end }).filter(d => getDay(d) !== 0);

const getDateKey = (date: Date) => format(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd');

const getNextValue = <T,>(current: T, order: T[]): T => {
  const currentIndex = order.indexOf(current);
  const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % order.length;
  return order[nextIndex];
};

const getPrevValue = <T,>(current: T, order: T[]): T => {
  const currentIndex = order.indexOf(current);
  const prevIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + order.length) % order.length;
  return order[prevIndex];
};

const nextAttendance = (status: AttendanceStatus): AttendanceStatus =>
  getNextValue(status, ATTENDANCE_ORDER);

const prevAttendance = (status: AttendanceStatus): AttendanceStatus =>
  getPrevValue(status, ATTENDANCE_ORDER);

const nextGrade = (grade: Grade): Grade =>
  getNextValue(grade, GRADE_ORDER);

const prevGrade = (grade: Grade): Grade =>
  getPrevValue(grade, GRADE_ORDER);

// Компоненты
const MemoVisitMarkIcon = React.memo(VisitMarkIcon);

const GradeDot: React.FC<{ grade: Exclude<Grade, null> }> = ({ grade }) => (
  <span
    className={styles.gradeDot}
    style={{ backgroundColor: GRADE_COLORS[grade] }}
  />
);

interface TableCellProps {
  student: Student;
  date: Date;
  recordKey: string;
  gradeAllowed: boolean;
  rowIndex: number;
  colIndex: number;
  mode: 'attendance' | 'grades';
  hoveredCell: { row: number | null; col: number | null };
  activeCell: { row: number | null; col: number | null };
  isEditing: boolean;
  isTabStop: boolean;
  onCellFocus: (studentId: string, lessonId: string) => void;
  toggleAttendance: (id: string, key: string, direction: 'next' | 'prev') => void;
  toggleGrade: (id: string, key: string, direction: 'next' | 'prev') => void;
  setHoveredCell: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{ row: number | null; col: number | null }>>;
  setActiveCell: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{ row: number | null; col: number | null }>>;
}

const TableCellComponent: React.FC<TableCellProps> = React.memo(({
  student,
  date,
  recordKey,
  gradeAllowed,
  rowIndex,
  colIndex,
  mode,
  hoveredCell,
  activeCell,
  isEditing,
  isTabStop,
  onCellFocus,
  toggleAttendance,
  toggleGrade,
  setHoveredCell,
  setActiveCell,
}) => {
  const dateKey = recordKey;
  const isHovered = hoveredCell.row === rowIndex && hoveredCell.col === colIndex;
  const isActive = activeCell.row === rowIndex && activeCell.col === colIndex;
  const editButtonProps = {
    tabIndex: isTabStop ? 0 : -1,
    'data-journal-cell': true,
    'data-student': student.id,
    'data-lesson': recordKey,
    onFocus: () => onCellFocus(student.id, recordKey),
    onKeyDown: (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
      if (event.key !== 'Enter' || !event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || !isEditing) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (mode === 'attendance') toggleAttendance(student.id, recordKey, 'prev');
      else toggleGrade(student.id, recordKey, 'prev');
    },
  };

  const handleAction = useCallback(
    (direction: 'next' | 'prev') => (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      if (!isEditing) return;

      if (direction === 'prev') {
        e.preventDefault();
      }

      if (mode === 'attendance') {
        toggleAttendance(student.id, dateKey, direction);
      } else {
        toggleGrade(student.id, dateKey, direction);
      }
    },
    [isEditing, mode, student.id, dateKey, toggleAttendance, toggleGrade]
  );

  const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(
    () => setHoveredCell({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex }),
    [rowIndex, colIndex, setHoveredCell]
  );

  const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(
    () => {
      setHoveredCell({ row: null, col: null });
      setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null });
    },
    [setHoveredCell, setActiveCell]
  );

  const handleMouseDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      if (isEditing && (e.button === 0 || e.button === 2)) {
        setActiveCell({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex });
      }
    },
    [isEditing, rowIndex, colIndex, setActiveCell]
  );

  const handleMouseUp = useCallback(
    () => setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null }),
    [setActiveCell]
  );

  const baseClass = mode === 'grades' ? styles.gradeCell : '';
  const highlightClass = (isHovered || isActive) ? styles.highlightCurrentCell : '';

  if (mode === 'attendance') {
    const status = student.attendance?.[dateKey] ?? 'unmarked';
    let fill = STATUS_COLORS[status].fill;
    let color2 = STATUS_COLORS[status].color2;

    if (isActive) {
      fill =
        status === 'present'
          ? 'var(--color-visit-active)'
          : status === 'sick'
          ? 'var(--color-sick-active)'
          : status === 'absent'
          ? 'var(--color-no-visit-active)'
          : 'transparent';
      color2 = status === 'absent' ? 'var(--ui-error)' : 'var(--color-border-active)';
    } else if (isHovered) {
      color2 = status === 'absent' ? 'var(--ui-error)' : 'var(--color-border-hover)';
    }

    const label = `${student.name}, ${format(date, 'd MMMM', { locale: ru })}: ${status === 'present' ? 'Присутствие' : status === 'sick' ? 'Болезнь' : status === 'absent' ? 'Пропуск' : 'Не отмечено'}`;
    const mark = <MemoVisitMarkIcon color="var(--color-border)" size={32} fill={fill} color2={color2} />;

    return (
      <td
        className={`${baseClass} ${highlightClass}`}
        onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
        onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
      >
        {isEditing ? <button {...editButtonProps} type="button" className={styles.markButton} aria-label={label} title={`${label}. Нажатие — следующая отметка, Shift+Enter или правая кнопка — предыдущая.`} onClick={handleAction('next')} onContextMenu={handleAction('prev')}>{mark}</button> : <span className={styles.mark} role="img" aria-label={label} title={label}>{mark}</span>}
      </td>
    );
  }

  // Режим оценок
  if (!gradeAllowed) return <td className={`${styles.gradeCell} ${styles.ungradedCell}`} aria-label={`${format(date, 'd MMMM', { locale: ru })}: оценка за лекцию не предусмотрена`}>—</td>;
  const grade = student.grades?.[dateKey] ?? null;
  const gradeLabel = `${student.name}, ${format(date, 'd MMMM', { locale: ru })}: ${grade === null ? 'Нет оценки' : `Оценка ${grade}`}`;
  const gradeContent = grade !== null ? <span className={styles.gradeCellContent}><GradeDot grade={grade} /><span className={styles.gradeValue}>{grade}</span></span> : <span className={styles.emptyGrade}>·</span>;

  return (
    <td
      className={`${baseClass} ${highlightClass}`}
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
      onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
      onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
    >
      {isEditing ? <button {...editButtonProps} type="button" className={styles.markButton} aria-label={gradeLabel} title={`${gradeLabel}. Нажатие — следующая оценка, Shift+Enter или правая кнопка — предыдущая.`} onClick={handleAction('next')} onContextMenu={handleAction('prev')}>{gradeContent}</button> : <span className={styles.mark} role="img" aria-label={gradeLabel} title={gradeLabel}>{gradeContent}</span>}
    </td>
  );
}, (prev, next) => {
  // Кастомная проверка пропсов для оптимизации
  const studentChanged = prev.student !== next.student;
  const modeChanged = prev.mode !== next.mode;
  const editingChanged = prev.isEditing !== next.isEditing;
  const tabStopChanged = prev.isTabStop !== next.isTabStop;
  const coordsChanged = prev.rowIndex !== next.rowIndex || prev.colIndex !== next.colIndex;
  const recordChanged = prev.recordKey !== next.recordKey;
  const gradeRuleChanged = prev.gradeAllowed !== next.gradeAllowed;

  // Проверяем изменения hover/active только для этой ячейки
  const wasHovered = prev.hoveredCell.row === prev.rowIndex && prev.hoveredCell.col === prev.colIndex;
  const isHovered = next.hoveredCell.row === next.rowIndex && next.hoveredCell.col === next.colIndex;
  const hoverChanged = wasHovered !== isHovered;

  const wasActive = prev.activeCell.row === prev.rowIndex && prev.activeCell.col === prev.colIndex;
  const isActive = next.activeCell.row === next.rowIndex && next.activeCell.col === next.colIndex;
  const activeChanged = wasActive !== isActive;

  // Проверяем изменения данных студента
  const dateKey = prev.recordKey;
  const attendanceChanged = prev.student.attendance?.[dateKey] !== next.student.attendance?.[dateKey];
  const gradeChanged = prev.student.grades?.[dateKey] !== next.student.grades?.[dateKey];

  const shouldUpdate = studentChanged || modeChanged || editingChanged || tabStopChanged || coordsChanged || recordChanged || gradeRuleChanged ||
                      hoverChanged || activeChanged || attendanceChanged || gradeChanged;

  return !shouldUpdate;
});
TableCellComponent.displayName = 'TableCellComponent';

interface AttendanceTableProps {
  students: Student[];
  setStudents?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Student[]>>;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  dates?: Date[];
  lessons?: AcademicLesson[];
}

export const AttendanceTable: React.FC<AttendanceTableProps> = ({ students, setStudents, readOnly = false, dates, lessons }) => {
  // Мемоизированные значения
  const columns = useMemo(() => lessons ?? (dates ?? generateDates(START_DATE, END_DATE)).map((date) => ({ id: getDateKey(date), date: getDateKey(date) })), [dates, lessons]);
  const workDays = useMemo(() => columns.map((column) => new Date(`${column.date}T00:00:00`)), [columns]);
  const dateKeys = useMemo(() => columns.map((column) => column.id), [columns]);

  // Состояния
  const [hoveredCell, setHoveredCell] = useState({ row: null as number | null, col: null as number | null });
  const [activeCell, setActiveCell] = useState({ row: null as number | null, col: null as number | null });
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [isRosterEditing, setIsRosterEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draftStudents, setDraftStudents] = useState<Student[]>(students);
  const [originalStudents, setOriginalStudents] = useState<Student[]>(students);
  const [dragIndex, setDragIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [dragOverIndex, setDragOverIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'attendance' | 'grades'>('attendance');
  const [editError, setEditError] = useState('');
  const [discardOpen, setDiscardOpen] = useState(false);
  const [studentQuery, setStudentQuery] = useState('');
  const [editingNameId, setEditingNameId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keyboardCell, setKeyboardCell] = useState<{ studentId: string; lessonId: string } | null>(null);
  const editorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tableWrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const addedStudentRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const editButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const headingId = useId();
  const keyboardHintId = useId();
  const displayedStudents = isEditing ? draftStudents : students;
  const searching = Boolean(studentQuery.trim());
  const visibleRows = useMemo(() => displayedStudents
    .map((student, rowIndex) => ({ student, rowIndex }))
    .filter(({ student }) => matchesSearchText(student.name, studentQuery) || (isRosterEditing && student.id === editingNameId)),
  [displayedStudents, studentQuery, isRosterEditing, editingNameId]);
  const canReorder = isEditing && isRosterEditing && !searching;
  const editableColumns = useMemo(() => columns.filter((column) => mode === 'attendance' || !('type' in column) || (column as AcademicLesson).type !== 'lecture'), [columns, mode]);
  const keyboardStudentId = visibleRows.some(({ student }) => student.id === keyboardCell?.studentId) ? keyboardCell?.studentId : visibleRows[0]?.student.id;
  const keyboardLessonId = editableColumns.some((column) => column.id === keyboardCell?.lessonId) ? keyboardCell?.lessonId : editableColumns[0]?.id;
  const onCellFocus = useCallback((studentId: string, lessonId: string) => setKeyboardCell({ studentId, lessonId }), []);
  const changeCount = isEditing ? countJournalDraftChanges(originalStudents, draftStudents) : 0;
  const externalChanges = isEditing && countJournalDraftChanges(originalStudents, students) > 0;
  useUnsavedChangesWarning(isEditing && changeCount > 0);
  useBodyScrollLock(isEditing);

  // Эффекты
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) return;
    const focusFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => editorRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('button[aria-pressed="true"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(focusFrame);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => editButtonRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
    };
  }, [isEditing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!addedStudentRef.current) return;
    const row = Array.from(editorRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('[data-student-id]') ?? [])
      .find((element) => element.dataset.studentId === addedStudentRef.current);
    const input = row?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input');
    if (!input) return;
    addedStudentRef.current = null;
    row?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    input.select();
  }, [draftStudents, studentQuery]);

  const changeStudentQuery = (value: string) => {
    setStudentQuery(value);
    setEditingNameId(null);
    setKeyboardCell(null);
    setHoveredCell({ row: null, col: null });
    setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null });
    setDragIndex(null);
    setDragOverIndex(null);
    if (tableWrapperRef.current) tableWrapperRef.current.scrollTop = 0;
  };

  // Обработчики
  const startEditing = useCallback(() => {
    if (readOnly || !setStudents) return;
    const normalized = students.map(student => {
      const attendance = { ...student.attendance };
      const grades = { ...student.grades };

      columns.forEach(column => {
        const key = column.id;
        if (!attendance[key]) attendance[key] = 'unmarked';
        if (grades[key] === undefined) grades[key] = null;
      });

      return {
        ...student,
        attendance,
        grades,
      };
    });

    const deepCopy = normalized.map(s => ({
      ...s,
      attendance: { ...s.attendance },
      grades: { ...s.grades },
    }));

    setOriginalStudents(deepCopy);
    setDraftStudents(deepCopy);
    setIsEditing(true);
    setEditError('');
    setDiscardOpen(false);
    setIsRosterEditing(false);
    setEditingNameId(null);
    setHoveredCell({ row: null, col: null });
    setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null });
  }, [students, setStudents, columns, readOnly]);

  const acceptChanges = useCallback(() => {
    setEditError('');
    if (countJournalDraftChanges(originalStudents, draftStudents) > 0) {
      try { setStudents?.((latest) => mergeJournalDraft(originalStudents, draftStudents, latest)); }
      catch (error) { setEditError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Не удалось сохранить журнал. Черновик оставлен открытым.'); return; }
    }
    setIsEditing(false);
    setIsRosterEditing(false);
    setHoveredCell({ row: null, col: null });
    setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null });
  }, [originalStudents, draftStudents, setStudents]);

  const cancelChanges = useCallback(() => {
    setDraftStudents(originalStudents);
    setEditError('');
    setDiscardOpen(false);
    setIsEditing(false);
    setIsRosterEditing(false);
    setHoveredCell({ row: null, col: null });
    setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null });
  }, [originalStudents]);

  const requestCancel = () => { if (changeCount) setDiscardOpen(true); else cancelChanges(); };
  const handleEditorKeys = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isEditing || discardOpen || event.defaultPrevented || !event.currentTarget.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (studentQuery && event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement && event.target.type === 'search') changeStudentQuery('');
      else requestCancel();
      return;
    }
    if (event.key === 'Enter' && (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) { event.preventDefault(); acceptChanges(); return; }
    if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const controls = Array.from(event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled), input:not(:disabled), [tabindex="0"]')).filter((node) => node.tabIndex >= 0 && node.getClientRects().length > 0);
    const first = controls[0], last = controls[controls.length - 1];
    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { event.preventDefault(); last?.focus(); }
    else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first?.focus(); }
  };

  const handleTableKeys = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isEditing || event.defaultPrevented || event.altKey || event.shiftKey || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
    const button = event.target instanceof HTMLElement ? event.target.closest<HTMLButtonElement>('button[data-journal-cell]') : null;
    if (!button) return;
    let row = visibleRows.findIndex(({ student }) => student.id === button.dataset.student);
    let col = editableColumns.findIndex((column) => column.id === button.dataset.lesson);
    if (row < 0 || col < 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.key === 'Home' || event.key === 'End') {
      col = event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : editableColumns.length - 1;
      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) row = event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : visibleRows.length - 1;
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') col = Math.max(0, col - 1);
    else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') col = Math.min(editableColumns.length - 1, col + 1);
    else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') row = Math.max(0, row - 1);
    else row = Math.min(visibleRows.length - 1, row + 1);
    const target = Array.from(tableWrapperRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button[data-journal-cell]') ?? [])
      .find((element) => element.dataset.student === visibleRows[row].student.id && element.dataset.lesson === editableColumns[col].id);
    target?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    target?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest', behavior: 'auto' });
  };

  const moveStudent = useCallback((from: number, to: number) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev => {
      const newStudents = [...prev];
      const [movedStudent] = newStudents.splice(from, 1);
      newStudents.splice(to, 0, movedStudent);
      return newStudents;
    });
  }, []);

  const addStudent = useCallback(() => {
    const newStudent: Student = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      name: 'Новый ученик',
      attendance: {},
      grades: {},
    };

    columns.forEach(column => {
      const key = column.id;
      newStudent.attendance[key] = 'unmarked';
      newStudent.grades[key] = null;
    });

    setDraftStudents(prev => [...prev, newStudent]);
    setStudentQuery('');
    addedStudentRef.current = newStudent.id;
  }, [columns]);

  const deleteStudent = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev => prev.filter(student => student.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const toggleAttendance = useCallback((studentId: string, dateKey: string, direction: 'next' | 'prev') => {
    setDraftStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(student =>
        student.id !== studentId
          ? student
          : {
              ...student,
              attendance: {
                ...student.attendance,
                [dateKey]: direction === 'next'
                  ? nextAttendance(student.attendance?.[dateKey] ?? 'unmarked')
                  : prevAttendance(student.attendance?.[dateKey] ?? 'unmarked'),
              },
            }
      )
    );
  }, []);

  const toggleGrade = useCallback((studentId: string, dateKey: string, direction: 'next' | 'prev') => {
    setDraftStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(student =>
        student.id !== studentId
          ? student
          : {
              ...student,
              grades: {
                ...student.grades,
                [dateKey]: direction === 'next'
                  ? nextGrade(student.grades?.[dateKey] ?? null)
                  : prevGrade(student.grades?.[dateKey] ?? null),
              },
            }
      )
    );
  }, []);

  const updateStudentName = useCallback((studentId: string, name: string) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(student =>
        student.id === studentId ? { ...student, name } : student
      )
    );
  }, []);

  // Мемоизированные вычисления
  const calcAverage = useCallback((student: Student) => {
    const grades = dateKeys
      .map(key => student.grades?.[key])
      .filter((grade): grade is Exclude<Grade, null> => grade != null);

    if (grades.length === 0) return '-';

    const sum = grades.reduce((total, grade) => total + grade, 0);
    return (sum / grades.length).toFixed(2);
  }, [dateKeys]);

  const calcPresence = useCallback((student: Student) => {
    const markedKeys = dateKeys.filter(key => (student.attendance?.[key] ?? 'unmarked') !== 'unmarked');
    const total = markedKeys.length;
    const present = markedKeys.filter(key => student.attendance?.[key] === 'present').length;

    if (total === 0) return '—';
    return `${((present / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  }, [dateKeys]);

  // Обработчики drag & drop
  const handleDragStart = useCallback((index: number) => {
    if (canReorder) setDragIndex(index);
  }, [canReorder]);

  const handleDragEnter = useCallback((index: number) => {
    if (canReorder) setDragOverIndex(index);
  }, [canReorder]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (canReorder && dragIndex !== null && dragOverIndex !== null && dragIndex !== dragOverIndex) {
      moveStudent(dragIndex, dragOverIndex);
    }
    setDragIndex(null);
    setDragOverIndex(null);
  }, [canReorder, dragIndex, dragOverIndex, moveStudent]);

  // Рендер ячеек таблицы
  const renderTableCells = useCallback((student: Student, rowIndex: number) => {
    return columns.map((column, colIndex) => {
      const date = new Date(`${column.date}T00:00:00`);
      return (
      <TableCellComponent
        key={`${student.id}-${column.id}`}
        student={student}
        date={date}
        recordKey={column.id}
        gradeAllowed={!('type' in column) || (column as AcademicLesson).type !== 'lecture'}
        rowIndex={rowIndex}
        colIndex={colIndex}
        mode={mode}
        hoveredCell={hoveredCell}
        activeCell={activeCell}
        isEditing={isEditing}
        isTabStop={student.id === keyboardStudentId && column.id === keyboardLessonId}
        onCellFocus={onCellFocus}
        toggleAttendance={toggleAttendance}
        toggleGrade={toggleGrade}
        setHoveredCell={setHoveredCell}
        setActiveCell={setActiveCell}
      />
    );
    });
  }, [columns, mode, hoveredCell, activeCell, isEditing, keyboardStudentId, keyboardLessonId, onCellFocus, toggleAttendance, toggleGrade]);

  // Рендер строк таблицы
  const renderTableRows = useCallback(() => {
    return visibleRows.map(({ student, rowIndex }) => {
      const rowClasses = [
        hoveredCell.row === rowIndex ? styles.highlightRow : '',
        canReorder && dragOverIndex === rowIndex ? styles.dragOver : '',
        rowIndex % 2 === 1 ? styles.evenRow : '',
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');


      return (
        <tr
          key={student.id}
          data-student-id={student.id}
          draggable={canReorder}
          onDragStart={() => handleDragStart(rowIndex)}
          onDragEnter={() => handleDragEnter(rowIndex)}
          onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            if (!(event.relatedTarget instanceof Node) || !event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setEditingNameId(null);
          }}
          className={rowClasses}
        >
          <td className={styles.studentColumn}>
            {isEditing && isRosterEditing ? (
              <div className={styles.editNameWrapper}>
                <input
                  value={student.name}
                  onChange={e => updateStudentName(student.id, e.target.value)}
                  onFocus={() => setEditingNameId(student.id)}
                  aria-label="Имя ученика"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.inlineDeleteBtn}
                  onClick={() => deleteStudent(student.id)}
                  aria-label="Удалить ученика"
                >
                  <MinusIcon size={20} />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : readOnly || isEditing ? (
              <span title={student.name}>{student.name}</span>
            ) : (
              <Link
                className={styles.studentLink}
                to={`/students/${student.id}?name=${encodeURIComponent(student.name)}`}
                title={`Открыть профиль: ${student.name}`}
              >
                {student.name}
              </Link>
            )}
          </td>

          {renderTableCells(student, rowIndex)}

          <td className={styles.percentageCell}>
            {mode === 'attendance' ? calcPresence(student) : calcAverage(student)}
          </td>
        </tr>
      );
    });
  }, [
    visibleRows,
    canReorder,
    readOnly,
    isEditing,
    isRosterEditing,
    hoveredCell.row,
    dragOverIndex,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragEnter,
    handleDragEnd,
    updateStudentName,
    deleteStudent,
    renderTableCells,
    mode,
    calcPresence,
    calcAverage,
  ]);

  return (
    <div
      className={`${styles.attendanceTableContainer} ${isEditing ? styles.fullscreen : ''}`}
      ref={editorRef}
      role={isEditing ? 'dialog' : undefined}
      aria-modal={isEditing ? true : undefined}
      aria-labelledby={isEditing ? headingId : undefined}
      onKeyDown={handleEditorKeys}
    >
      <div className={styles.layoutWithControls}>
        <header className={styles.tableHeading}>
          <div><h2 id={headingId} className={styles.tableName}>{isEditing ? 'Редактирование журнала' : 'Журнал занятий'}</h2><p>{workDays[0] && format(workDays[0], 'LLLL yyyy', { locale: ru })} · Учеников: {(isEditing ? draftStudents : students).length} · Занятий: {columns.length}</p></div>
          <div className={styles.tableActions}>
            <div className={styles.modeSwitch} role="group" aria-label="Отображение журнала">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('attendance')} aria-pressed={mode === 'attendance'}>Посещаемость</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('grades')} aria-pressed={mode === 'grades'}>Оценки</button>
            </div>
            {!readOnly && !isEditing && setStudents && <button ref={editButtonRef} type="button" className={styles.editButton} onClick={startEditing}><EditIcon size={16} />Редактировать</button>}
            {readOnly && <span className={styles.viewBadge}>Только просмотр</span>}
            {isEditing && <span className={styles.draftBadge} role="status">{changeCount ? `Изменений: ${changeCount}` : 'Нет изменений'}</span>}
          </div>
        </header>
        {isEditing && <p id={keyboardHintId} className={styles.editHint}>В таблице: стрелки — переход, Home / End — края строки, Ctrl / ⌘ + Home / End — края таблицы. Нажатие, Enter или пробел — следующая отметка, Shift + Enter или правая кнопка мыши — предыдущая. Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter — сохранить, Esc — отменить.</p>}
        {isEditing && externalChanges && <p className={styles.externalNotice}>Журнал обновился в другом месте. Независимые правки будут объединены; при конфликте одной ячейки сохранение остановится.</p>}
        {isEditing && editError && <p className={styles.editError} role="alert">{editError}</p>}
        {(!readOnly || students.length > 1) && <div className={styles.studentSearch}>
          <SearchField label="Найти студента" value={studentQuery} onChange={changeStudentQuery} placeholder="Имя или фамилия" />
          <div className={styles.searchSummary}>
            <span role="status" aria-live="polite">{searching ? `Найдено: ${visibleRows.length} из ${displayedStudents.length}` : `В списке: ${displayedStudents.length}`}</span>
            {searching && <small>{isEditing ? 'Сохраняется весь журнал, включая скрытые строки.' : 'Поиск не меняет показатели и экспорт журнала.'}</small>}
            {searching && isRosterEditing && <small>Чтобы менять порядок строк, очистите поиск.</small>}
          </div>
        </div>}
        <div ref={tableWrapperRef} className={styles.tableWrapper} tabIndex={isEditing ? -1 : 0} role="region" aria-label="Таблица журнала, прокручивается по горизонтали и вертикали" aria-describedby={isEditing ? keyboardHintId : undefined} onKeyDown={handleTableKeys}>
          <table>
            <caption className={styles.visuallyHidden}>{mode === 'attendance' ? 'Посещаемость учеников по занятиям' : 'Оценки учеников по занятиям'}</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" className={styles.studentName}>Ученик</th>
                {columns.map((column) => {
                  const date = new Date(`${column.date}T00:00:00`);
                  const lesson = 'type' in column ? column as AcademicLesson : null;
                  return <th scope="col" key={column.id} title={lesson ? `${lessonTypeLabels[lesson.type]} · ${lesson.topic} · ${lesson.startsAt}, ауд. ${lesson.room}` : format(date, 'EEEE, d MMMM', { locale: ru })}>
                    <span>{format(date, 'dd.MM')}</span><small>{lesson ? `${lesson.startsAt} · ${lessonTypeLabels[lesson.type]}` : format(date, 'EEEEEE', { locale: ru })}</small>
                  </th>
                })}
                <th scope="col" className={styles.percentage}>
                  {mode === 'attendance' ? 'Явка' : 'Ср. балл'}<small>{mode === 'attendance' ? 'среди отметок' : 'за период'}</small>
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {renderTableRows()}

              {!visibleRows.length && <tr className={styles.emptyRow}><td colSpan={columns.length + 2}>
                <strong>{searching ? 'Студент не найден' : 'В журнале пока нет студентов'}</strong>
                <span>{searching ? 'Проверьте имя или фамилию. Регистр и ё/е не влияют на поиск.' : isEditing ? 'Откройте изменение списка и добавьте ученика.' : 'Состав группы ещё не заполнен.'}</span>
                {searching && <button type="button" className={styles.controlButton} onClick={() => changeStudentQuery('')}>Сбросить поиск</button>}
              </td></tr>}

              {isEditing && isRosterEditing && (
                <tr className={styles.addRow}>
                  <td colSpan={columns.length + 2}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={styles.inlineAddBtn}
                      onClick={addStudent}
                      aria-label="Добавить ученика"
                    >
                      <PlusIcon size={14} />
                      Добавить ученика
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {isEditing && (
          <div className={styles.controls}>
            <button type="button" className={`${styles.controlButton} ${isRosterEditing ? styles.activeButton : ""}`} onClick={() => setIsRosterEditing((value) => !value)} aria-pressed={isRosterEditing} aria-label="Изменить список учеников"><EditIcon size={18} /><span>Изменить</span></button>
            <span className={styles.controlHint}>{isRosterEditing ? 'Список учеников: имена и порядок строк' : changeCount ? `Правок: ${changeCount} · Галочка — сохранить` : 'Нет несохранённых изменений'}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={requestCancel}
              className={`${styles.controlButton} ${styles.cancelButton}`}
              aria-label="Отменить изменения"
              title="Отменить изменения"
            >
              <CloseIcon size={20} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={acceptChanges}
              className={`${styles.controlButton} ${styles.saveButton}`}
              aria-label="Сохранить изменения"
              title="Сохранить изменения · Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter"
            >
              <AcceptIcon size={22} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {discardOpen && <ConfirmDialog title="Отменить изменения журнала?" confirmLabel="Отменить изменения" cancelLabel="Продолжить редактирование" onCancel={() => setDiscardOpen(false)} onConfirm={cancelChanges}><p>Несохранённых правок: {changeCount}. Будет закрыт только ваш черновик; уже сохранённые данные журнала не изменятся.</p></ConfirmDialog>}
    </div>
  );
};


// src\components\Attendance\indexorigin.tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { format, eachDayOfInterval, getDay } from 'date-fns';
import { ru } from 'date-fns/locale';
import styles from './index.module.scss';
import {
  VisitMarkIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  MinusIcon,
  EditIcon,
  AcceptIcon,
  CloseIcon,
} from '../ButtonIcons/Icons';
import { Student, AttendanceStatus, Grade } from './data/students';

const STATUS_COLORS = {
  unmarked: { fill: 'transparent', color2: 'var(--color-border)' },
  present: { fill: 'var(--color-visit)', color2: 'var(--color-visit)' },
  sick: { fill: 'var(--color-sick)', color2: 'var(--color-border)' },
  absent: { fill: 'var(--color-no-visit)', color2: 'var(--color-border)' },
};

const START_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 1);
const END_DATE = new Date(2025, 9, 30);

const generateDates = (start: Date, end: Date): Date[] =>
  eachDayOfInterval({ start, end }).filter(d => getDay(d) !== 0);

interface AttendanceTableProps {
  students: Student[];
  setStudents: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Student[]>>;
}

export const AttendanceTable: React.FC<AttendanceTableProps> = ({ students, setStudents }) => {
  const workDays = useMemo(() => generateDates(START_DATE, END_DATE), []);
  const [hoveredRow, setHoveredRow] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [hoveredCol, setHoveredCol] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [activeCell, setActiveCell] = useState<{ row: number | null; col: number | null }>({ row: null, col: null });
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draftStudents, setDraftStudents] = useState<Student[]>(students);
  const [originalStudents, setOriginalStudents] = useState<Student[]>(students);
  const [dragIndex, setDragIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [dragOverIndex, setDragOverIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'attendance' | 'grades'>('attendance');
  const [hoveredTable, setHoveredTable] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // блокируем скролл страницы только когда редактируем
    document.body.style.overflow = isEditing ? 'hidden' : '';
  }, [isEditing]);

  const startEditing = () => {
    const normalized = students.map(s => {
      const att = { ...s.attendance };
      const grades: { [key: string]: Grade } = {};
      workDays.forEach(d => {
        const key = format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
        if (!att[key]) att[key] = 'absent';
        grades[key] = s.grades?.[key] ?? null;
      });
      return { ...s, attendance: att, grades };
    });

    setOriginalStudents(normalized.map(s => ({ ...s, attendance: { ...s.attendance }, grades: { ...s.grades } })));
    setDraftStudents(normalized.map(s => ({ ...s, attendance: { ...s.attendance }, grades: { ...s.grades } })));
    setStudents(normalized);
    setIsEditing(true);
  };

  const acceptChanges = () => {
    setStudents(draftStudents);
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const cancelChanges = () => {
    setDraftStudents(originalStudents);
    setStudents(originalStudents);
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const moveStudent = (from: number, to: number) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev => {
      const arr = [...prev];
      const [item] = arr.splice(from, 1);
      arr.splice(to, 0, item);
      return arr;
    });
  };

  const addStudent = () => {
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    const newStudent: Student = { id, name: 'Новый ученик', attendance: {}, grades: {} };
    workDays.forEach(d => {
      const key = format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      newStudent.attendance[key] = 'absent';
      newStudent.grades[key] = null;
    });
    setDraftStudents(prev => [...prev, newStudent]);
  };

  const deleteStudent = (id: string) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== id));
  };

  const toggleAttendance = (studentId: string, dateKey: string) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(s => {
        if (s.id !== studentId) return s;
        const cur: AttendanceStatus = s.attendance[dateKey] ?? 'absent';
        const next: AttendanceStatus = cur === 'absent' ? 'present' : cur === 'present' ? 'sick' : 'absent';
        return { ...s, attendance: { ...s.attendance, [dateKey]: next } };
      })
    );
  };

  const toggleGrade = (studentId: string, dateKey: string) => {
    setDraftStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(s => {
        if (s.id !== studentId) return s;
        const cur: Grade = s.grades?.[dateKey] ?? null;
        const next: Grade = cur === null ? 5 : cur === 5 ? 4 : cur === 4 ? 3 : cur === 3 ? 2 : null;
        return { ...s, grades: { ...s.grades, [dateKey]: next } };
      })
    );
  };

  const calcAverage = (student: Student) => {
    const gradesArray = workDays
      .map(d => student.grades?.[format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd')])
      .filter((g): g is Exclude<Grade, null> => g !== null);
    if (gradesArray.length === 0) return '-';
    const sum = gradesArray.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    return (sum / gradesArray.length).toFixed(2);
  };

  const calcPresence = (student: Student) => {
    const total = workDays.length;
    const present = workDays.filter(d => student.attendance[format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd')] === 'present').length;
    return total === 0 ? '0%' : `${((present / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  };

  return (
  <div 
    className={`${styles.attendanceTableContainer} ${isEditing ? styles.fullscreen : ''}`}
    onMouseEnter={() => !isEditing && setHoveredTable(true)}
    onMouseLeave={() => !isEditing && setHoveredTable(false)}
  >
    {/* Overlay + иконка редактирования до нажатия */}
    {!isEditing && (
  <div className={styles.overlay}>
    {hoveredTable && (
      <button
        className={styles.editOverlayButton}
        onClick={startEditing}
        onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && startEditing()}
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label="Редактировать таблицу"
      >
        <div className={styles.editIconWrapper}>
          <EditIcon size={48} color="var(--color-light)" />
        </div>
        <span className={styles.editOverlayText}>Изменить</span>
      </button>
    )}
  </div>
)}

    <div className={styles.layoutWithControls}>
      {isEditing? <h2>Таблица {mode === "attendance" ? 'посещаемости' : 'оценок'} </h2> : ''}

      <div className={styles.tableWrapper}>
        <table className={!isEditing ? styles.inactiveTable : ''}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th className={styles.studentName}>Ученик</th>
              {workDays.map((date, colIndex) => (
                <th
                  key={colIndex}
                  title={format(date, 'EEEE, d MMMM', { locale: ru })}
                  className={hoveredCol === colIndex ? styles.highlightHeader : ''}
                >
                  {format(date, 'dd.MM')}
                </th>
              ))}
              <th className={styles.percentage}>{mode === 'attendance' ? '%' : 'Ср. балл'}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {draftStudents.map((student, rowIndex) => (
              <tr
                key={student.id}
                draggable={isEditing}
                onDragStart={() => isEditing && setDragIndex(rowIndex)}
                onDragEnter={() => isEditing && setDragOverIndex(rowIndex)}
                onDragEnd={() => {
                  if (isEditing && dragIndex !== null && dragOverIndex !== null)
                    moveStudent(dragIndex, dragOverIndex);
                  setDragIndex(null);
                  setDragOverIndex(null);
                }}
                className={`${hoveredRow === rowIndex ? styles.highlightRow : ''}${
                  isEditing && dragOverIndex === rowIndex ? styles.dragOver : ''
                }`}
              >
                <td className={`${styles.studentColumn} ${hoveredRow === rowIndex ? styles.highlightName : ''}`}>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <div className={styles.editNameWrapper}>
                      <input
                        value={student.name}
                        onChange={e =>
                          setDraftStudents(prev => prev.map(s => (s.id === student.id ? { ...s, name: e.target.value } : s)))
                        }
                      />
                      <button className={styles.inlineDeleteBtn} onClick={() => deleteStudent(student.id)}>
                        <MinusIcon size={24} fill="var(--color-ligth)" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    student.name
                  )}
                </td>

                {workDays.map((date, colIndex) => {
                  const dateKey = format(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
                  const isHovered = hoveredRow === rowIndex && hoveredCol === colIndex;
                  const isActive = activeCell.row === rowIndex && activeCell.col === colIndex;

                  if (mode === 'attendance') {
                    const status: AttendanceStatus = student.attendance[dateKey] ?? 'absent';
                    const base = STATUS_COLORS[status];
                    let fill = base.fill;
                    let color2 = base.color2;
                    const border = 'var(--color-border)';

                    if (isActive) {
                      fill =
                        status === 'present'
                          ? 'var(--color-visit-active)'
                          : status === 'sick'
                          ? 'var(--color-sick-active)'
                          : 'var(--color-no-visit-active)';
                      color2 = 'var(--color-border-active)';
                    } else if (isHovered) color2 = 'var(--color-border-hover)';

                    return (
                      <td
                        key={`${student.id}-${dateKey}`}
                        className={`${isHovered ? styles.highlightCurrentCell : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => isEditing && toggleAttendance(student.id, dateKey)}
                        onMouseEnter={() => {
                          setHoveredRow(rowIndex);
                          setHoveredCol(colIndex);
                        }}
                        onMouseLeave={() => {
                          setHoveredRow(null);
                          setHoveredCol(null);
                        }}
                        onMouseDown={() => setActiveCell({ row: rowIndex, col: colIndex })}
                        onMouseUp={() => setActiveCell({ row: null, col: null })}
                      >
                        <VisitMarkIcon color={border} color2={color2} fill={fill} size={36} />
                      </td>
                    );
                  } else {
                    const grade: Grade = student.grades?.[dateKey] ?? null;
                    return (
                      <td
                        key={`${student.id}-${dateKey}`}
                        className={`${styles.gradeCell} ${
                          isHovered || (mode === 'grades' && isActive) ? styles.highlightCurrentCell : ''
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => isEditing && toggleGrade(student.id, dateKey)}
                        onMouseEnter={() => {
                          setHoveredRow(rowIndex);
                          setHoveredCol(colIndex);
                        }}
                        onMouseLeave={() => {
                          setHoveredRow(null);
                          setHoveredCol(null);
                        }}
                      >
                        {grade ?? ''}
                      </td>
                    );
                  }
                })}

                <td className={styles.percentageCell}>
                  {mode === 'attendance' ? calcPresence(student) : calcAverage(student)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}

            {isEditing && (
              <tr className={styles.addRow}>
                <td colSpan={workDays.length + 2}>
                  <button className={styles.inlineAddBtn} onClick={addStudent}>
                    <PlusIcon size={12} fill="var(--color-ligth)" /> Добавить ученика
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Кнопки управления (редактирование, оценки) */}
      {isEditing && (
        <div className={styles.controls}>
          <button
            className={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setMode(prev => (prev === 'attendance' ? 'grades' : 'attendance'))}
          >
            {mode === 'attendance' ? 'Оценки' : 'Посещаемость'}
          </button>
          <div style={{ flex: 1 }}></div>
          <button onClick={cancelChanges} className={styles.controlButton}>
            <CloseIcon size={24} color="var(--color-light)" fill="var(--color-light)" />
          </button>
          <button onClick={acceptChanges} className={styles.controlButton}>
            <AcceptIcon size={24} color="var(--color-light)" fill="var(--color-light)" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  </div>
);

};


// src\components\AttendanceLegend\index.module.scss
@use "../../styles/variables" as *;

.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: $color-text-secondary; font-size: .68rem; list-style: none; }
.legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid $color-border; border-radius: 7px; background: $color-dark-secondary; line-height: 1.4; }
.legend li > span { display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; }


// src\components\AttendanceLegend\index.tsx
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import { VisitMarkIcon } from "../ButtonIcons/Icons";

const items = [
  { status: "present", label: "Присутствовал", fill: "var(--ui-success)", ring: "var(--ui-success)" },
  { status: "sick", label: "Уважительная причина", fill: "var(--ui-warning)", ring: "var(--ui-warning)" },
  { status: "absent", label: "Пропуск", fill: "var(--ui-border)", ring: "var(--ui-error)" },
  { status: "unmarked", label: "Не отмечено", fill: "transparent", ring: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-text-secondary) 65%, transparent)" },
];

const AttendanceLegend = () => <ul className={styles.legend} aria-label="Обозначения посещаемости">{items.map((item) => <li key={item.status}><span aria-hidden="true"><VisitMarkIcon size={22} color="var(--ui-dark-primary)" fill={item.fill} color2={item.ring} /></span>{item.label}</li>)}</ul>;
export default AttendanceLegend;

  size = 48,

}) => {
  return (
    <svg
      width={size}

    >
      <path
        d="M 41.642796,11.142454 20.414429,32.942163 8.0334897,21.517873 4.9991943,24.818787 20.911695,39.499069 21.268555,39.110381 45.000803,14.740255 Z"
        stroke={color}
        strokeWidth={2}
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        fill={fill}
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

// src\components\CalendarWidget\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { getCalendarMonthDays, getDayInMonth, parseCalendarDate } from "../../domain/calendar";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import Tooltip from "../Tooltip";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface CalendarProps {
  months?: number;
  selectedDate?: Date;
  onSelectDate?(date: Date): void;
  getDaySummary?(date: Date): { lessons: number; tasks: number | null };
}

const DAYS = ["Пн", "Вт", "Ср", "Чт", "Пт", "Сб", "Вс"];

const Calendar = ({ months = 1, selectedDate, onSelectDate, getDaySummary }: CalendarProps) => {
  const today = new Date();
  const selectedKey = toLocalDateKey(selectedDate ?? today);
  const [firstMonth, setFirstMonth] = useState(() => new Date((selectedDate ?? today).getFullYear(), (selectedDate ?? today).getMonth(), 1));
  const [focusedKey, setFocusedKey] = useState(selectedKey);
  const externalSelection = useRef(selectedKey);
  const calendarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const focusRequested = useRef(false);
  const helpId = useId();
  const visibleMonths = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, months) }, (_, index) => new Date(firstMonth.getFullYear(), firstMonth.getMonth() + index, 1));
  const title = visibleMonths.map((date) => date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })).join(" · ");
  const selectedSummary = getDaySummary?.(selectedDate ?? today) ?? { lessons: 0, tasks: 0 };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (externalSelection.current === selectedKey) return;
    externalSelection.current = selectedKey;
    const date = parseCalendarDate(selectedKey);
    if (!date) return;
    setFirstMonth(new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), 1));
    setFocusedKey(selectedKey);
  }, [selectedKey]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!focusRequested.current) return;
    focusRequested.current = false;
    calendarRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-calendar-date="${focusedKey}"][data-calendar-current="true"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [focusedKey, firstMonth]);
  const moveMonth = (offset: number) => {
    const month = new Date(firstMonth.getFullYear(), firstMonth.getMonth() + offset, 1);
    const focusedDate = parseCalendarDate(focusedKey) ?? selectedDate ?? today;
    setFirstMonth(month);
    setFocusedKey(toLocalDateKey(getDayInMonth(focusedDate, month)));
  };
  const onDayKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, date: Date) => {
    if (event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return;
    const next = new Date(date);
    const weekday = (date.getDay() + 6) % 7;
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next.setDate(next.getDate() - 1);
    else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next.setDate(next.getDate() + 1);
    else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") next.setDate(next.getDate() - 7);
    else if (event.key === "ArrowDown") next.setDate(next.getDate() + 7);
    else if (event.key === "Home") next.setDate(next.getDate() - weekday);
    else if (event.key === "End") next.setDate(next.getDate() + 6 - weekday);
    else if (event.key === "PageUp" || event.key === "PageDown") {
      const month = new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + (event.key === "PageUp" ? -1 : 1), 1);
      next.setTime(getDayInMonth(date, month).getTime());
    } else return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (toLocalDateKey(next) === toLocalDateKey(date)) return;
    const lastMonth = visibleMonths[visibleMonths.length - 1];
    if (next < firstMonth || next >= new Date(lastMonth.getFullYear(), lastMonth.getMonth() + 1, 1)) setFirstMonth(new Date(next.getFullYear(), next.getMonth(), 1));
    focusRequested.current = true;
    setFocusedKey(toLocalDateKey(next));
  };

  return <div className={styles.calendarWidget} ref={calendarRef}>
    <div className={styles.calendarToolbar}>
      <button type="button" className={styles.navButton} onClick={() => moveMonth(-1)} aria-label="Предыдущий месяц"><ArrowCircle direction="left" /></button>
      <strong aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">{title}</strong>
      <button type="button" className={styles.navButton} onClick={() => moveMonth(1)} aria-label="Следующий месяц"><ArrowCircle /></button>
    </div>
    {onSelectDate && <div className={styles.legend}><span><i className={styles.lessonDot} />Занятия</span><span><i className={styles.taskDot} />Задачи</span><button type="button" onClick={() => { const date = new Date(); setFirstMonth(new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), 1)); setFocusedKey(toLocalDateKey(date)); onSelectDate(date); }}>Сегодня</button></div>}
    <p id={helpId} className={styles.srOnly}>Стрелки — соседний день или неделя. Home и End — начало и конец недели. Page Up и Page Down — смена месяца. Enter — выбрать день.</p>
    <div className={styles.calendarContainer}>
      {visibleMonths.map((monthDate) => <div className={styles.calendarMonth} key={`${monthDate.getFullYear()}-${monthDate.getMonth()}`}>
        <div className={styles.calendarGrid}>
          {DAYS.map((day) => <span key={day} className={styles.calendarDayName}>{day}</span>)}
          {getCalendarMonthDays(monthDate).map((date) => {
            const isCurrentMonth = date.getMonth() === monthDate.getMonth() && date.getFullYear() === monthDate.getFullYear();
            const isToday = date.getDate() === today.getDate() && date.getMonth() === today.getMonth() && date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear();
            const isWeekend = date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6;
            const dateKey = toLocalDateKey(date);
            const summary = getDaySummary?.(date) ?? { lessons: 0, tasks: 0 };
            const label = `Занятия: ${summary.lessons}, задачи: ${summary.tasks ?? "недоступны"}`;
            return <Tooltip key={dateKey} label={label}><button
              type="button"
              data-calendar-date={dateKey}
              data-calendar-current={isCurrentMonth}
              tabIndex={dateKey === focusedKey && isCurrentMonth ? 0 : -1}
              aria-describedby={helpId}
              aria-current={isToday ? "date" : undefined}
              aria-pressed={onSelectDate ? dateKey === selectedKey : undefined}
              aria-label={`${date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}. ${label}`}
              className={`${styles.calendarDay} ${!isCurrentMonth ? styles.outsideDay : ""} ${isWeekend ? styles.weekend : ""} ${isToday ? styles.today : ""} ${onSelectDate && dateKey === selectedKey ? styles.selected : ""}`}
              onFocus={() => setFocusedKey(dateKey)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => onDayKeyDown(event, date)}
              onClick={() => { if (!isCurrentMonth) { focusRequested.current = true; setFirstMonth(new Date(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), 1)); } setFocusedKey(dateKey); onSelectDate?.(date); }}
            ><time dateTime={dateKey}>{date.getDate()}</time><span className={styles.dots} aria-hidden="true">{summary.lessons > 0 && <i className={styles.lessonDot} />}{(summary.tasks ?? 0) > 0 && <i className={styles.taskDot} />}</span></button></Tooltip>;
          })}
        </div>
      </div>)}
    </div>
    {onSelectDate && <div className={styles.daySummary} aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"><span>{(selectedDate ?? today).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" })}</span><strong>{`Занятия: ${selectedSummary.lessons}, задачи: ${selectedSummary.tasks ?? "недоступны"}`}</strong><p>Выберите день, чтобы увидеть его занятия и задачи в обзоре.</p></div>}
  </div>;
};

export default Calendar;


// src\components\Charts\BarChart\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import styles from "../../settingsCharts.module.scss";

interface BarChartProps {
  labels: string[];
  values: number[];
  id?: string | number;   // ← добавлено по твоему запросу
  maxValue?: number;
  height?: number;
}

export default function BarChart({
  labels,
  values,
  id,
  maxValue,
  height = 350,
}: BarChartProps) {
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);

  // --- Уникальные ключи, чтобы labels могли повторяться ---
  const keyedLabels = useMemo(
    () => labels.map((l, i) => `${l}__${i}`),
    [labels]
  );

  // --- Данные под длину labels ---
  const chartData = useMemo(
    () => (values ?? []).slice(0, labels.length),
    [values, labels]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!svgRef.current) return;

    const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
    svg.selectAll("*").remove();

    const containerWidth =
      svgRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth || 400;

    const margin = { top: 30, right: 40, bottom: 60, left: 40 };
    const innerWidth = Math.max(chartData.length * 60, containerWidth);
    const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    svg
      .attr("width", innerWidth + margin.left + margin.right)
      .attr("height", height);

    const g = svg
      .append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

    // --- шкалы ---
    const xScale = d3
      .scaleBand<string>()
      .domain(keyedLabels)
      .range([0, innerWidth])
      .padding(0.3);

    const yScale = d3
      .scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, maxValue ?? Math.max(...chartData)])
      .range([innerHeight, 0])
      .nice();

    // --- сетка ---
    g.append("g")
      .call(
        d3
          .axisLeft(yScale)
          .ticks(6)
          .tickSize(-innerWidth)
          .tickFormat(() => "")
      )
      .selectAll("line")
      .attr("stroke", "var(--grid-color)");

    g.select(".domain")?.remove();

    // --- оси ---
    g.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${innerHeight})`)
      .call(
        d3
          .axisBottom(xScale)
          .tickSize(0)
          .tickFormat((d) => {
            const index = keyedLabels.indexOf(d);
            return labels[index];
          })
      )
      .selectAll("text")
      .style("font-size", "12px")
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
      .attr("transform", "rotate(-35)");

    g.append("g")
      .call(d3.axisLeft(yScale).ticks(6))
      .selectAll("text")
      .style("font-size", "12px");

    // --- линейный градиент ---
    const defs = svg.append("defs");
    const barGradient = defs
      .append("linearGradient")
      .attr("id", "bar-gradient")
      .attr("x1", "0%")
      .attr("x2", "0%")
      .attr("y1", "0%")
      .attr("y2", "100%");

    barGradient
      .append("stop")
      .attr("offset", "0%")
      .attr("stop-color", "var(--area-start)")
      .attr("stop-opacity", 0.7);

    barGradient
      .append("stop")
      .attr("offset", "100%")
      .attr("stop-color", "var(--area-end)")
      .attr("stop-opacity", 0);



    // --- тултип ---
    const tooltip = d3
      .select("body")
      .append("div")
      .style("position", "absolute")
      .style("background", "var(--tooltip-bg)")
      .style("color", "var(--tooltip-text)")
      .style("padding", "5px 10px")
      .style("font-size", "14px")
      .style("border-radius", "8px")
      .style("pointer-events", "none")
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .style("z-index", 10);

    // --- БАРЫ ---
    const bars = g
      .selectAll(".bar")
      .data(chartData)
      .join("rect")
      .attr("class", "bar")
      .attr("x", (_, i) => xScale(keyedLabels[i])!)
      .attr("y", innerHeight)
      .attr("width", xScale.bandwidth())
      .attr("height", 0)
      .attr("fill", "url(#bar-gradient)");

    // Анимация появления
    bars
      .transition()
      .duration(800)
      .attr("y", (d) => yScale(d))
      .attr("height", (d) => innerHeight - yScale(d));

    bars.on("mouseover", function (event, d) {
      const nodes = bars.nodes();
      const i = nodes.indexOf(this as SVGRectElement);


      tooltip
        .style("opacity", 1)
        .html(`${labels[i]}: ${d}`)
        .style("left", event.pageX + 10 + "px")
        .style("top", event.pageY - 25 + "px");

      d3.select(this)
        .transition()
        .duration(150)
        .attr("fill", "var(--line-end)");
    });

    bars.on("mousemove", (event) => {
      tooltip
        .style("left", event.pageX + 10 + "px")
        .style("top", event.pageY - 25 + "px");
    });

    bars.on("mouseout", function () {
      tooltip.style("opacity", 0);


      d3.select(this)
        .transition()
        .duration(150)
        .attr("fill", "url(#bar-gradient)");
    });

    return () => {
      tooltip.remove();
    };
  }, [labels, chartData, maxValue, height, keyedLabels]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.chartContainer} id={id ? String(id) : undefined}>
      <svg ref={svgRef} />
    </div>
  );
}


// src\components\Charts\BarChartTop\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import styles from "../settingsCharts.module.scss";

interface BarChartProps {
    labels: string[];
    values: number[];
    id?: string | number;
    maxValue?: number;
    height?: number;
    barHeight?: number;
}

export default function BarChart({
    labels,
    values,
    id,
    maxValue,
    height = 350,
    barHeight = 30,
}: BarChartProps) {
    const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);

    const keyedData = useMemo(() => {
        return labels.map((label, i) => ({
            key: `${label}__${i}`,
            label,
            value: values[i] ?? 0,
            index: i,
        }));
    }, [labels, values]);

    const chartData = useMemo(() => [...keyedData].sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value), [keyedData]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!svgRef.current) return;
        const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
        svg.selectAll("*").remove();

        const containerWidth = svgRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth || 400;
        const margin = { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 };
        const innerWidth = containerWidth - margin.left - margin.right;

        const maxVisibleBars = Math.floor(height / barHeight);
        const visibleData = chartData.slice(0, maxVisibleBars);

        svg.attr("width", containerWidth).attr("height", height);
        const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

        const yScale = d3
            .scaleBand()
            .domain(visibleData.map((d) => d.key))
            .range([0, barHeight * visibleData.length])
            .padding(0);

        const xScale = d3
            .scaleLinear()
            .domain([0, maxValue ?? d3.max(visibleData, (d) => d.value)!])
            .range([0, innerWidth])
            .nice();

        // --- горизонтальный градиент ---
        const defs = svg.append("defs");
        const barGradient = defs
            .append("linearGradient")
            .attr("id", "bar-gradient")
            .attr("x1", "0%")
            .attr("x2", "100%")
            .attr("y1", "0%")
            .attr("y2", "0%");

        barGradient.append("stop").attr("offset", "0%").attr("stop-color", "var(--line-end)");
        barGradient.append("stop").attr("offset", "100%").attr("stop-color", "var(--line-start)");

        const filter = defs.append("filter").attr("id", "drop-shadow");
    filter.append("feDropShadow")
        .attr("dx", 0)
        .attr("dy", 2)
        .attr("stdDeviation", 3)
        .attr("flood-color", "#000")
        .attr("flood-opacity", 1);
        // --- заполнение градиентом ---
        const bars = g
            .selectAll(".bar")
            .data(visibleData.slice().reverse()) 
            .join("rect")
            .attr("class", "bar")
            .attr("y", (d) => yScale(d.key)!)
            .attr("x", 0)
            .attr("height", barHeight)
            .attr("width", 0)
            .attr("fill", "url(#bar-gradient)")
            
            .attr("filter", "url(#drop-shadow)"); // <-- применяем тень

        bars.transition().duration(800).attr("width", (d) => xScale(d.value));

        // --- подписи и значения в квадрате ---
        const labelsGroup = g
            .selectAll(".bar-label")
            .data(visibleData)
            .join("g")
            .attr("class", "bar-label")
            
            .attr("transform", (d) => `translate(0, ${yScale(d.key)!})`);

        labelsGroup
            .append("text")
            .attr("x", 5 + 15) // центрируем текст в квадрате
            .attr("y", barHeight / 1.7)
            .attr("alignment-baseline", "middle")
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("fill", "var(--value-color)")
            .style("font-size", "22px")
            .attr("font-weight", "900")
            .text((d) => d.value);

        // Метка справа
        labelsGroup
            .append("text")
            .attr("x", 45)
            .attr("y", barHeight / 1.75)
            .attr("alignment-baseline", "middle")
            .attr("fill", "var(--text-color)")
            .style("font-size", "22px")
            .attr("font-weight", "900")
            .text((d) => d.label);
    }, [chartData, height, maxValue, barHeight]);

    return (
        <div className={styles.chartContainer} id={id ? String(id) : undefined}>
            <svg ref={svgRef} />
        </div>
    );
}


// src\components\Charts\BarChartTop\withsegments\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import styles from "../../settingsCharts.module.scss";
import { useTheme } from "../../../ThemeContext";

interface BarChartProps {
    labels: string[];
    values: number[];
    id?: string | number;
    maxValue?: number;
    height?: number;
    barHeight?: number;
    segments?: number;
    colorMode?: number;
}

interface ChartItem {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    value: number;
    fillRatios: number[];
}

const LIGHT_MODE_COLOR: Record<number, string> = {
    2: "--ui-chart-amber",
    7: "--ui-chart-green",
    8: "--ui-chart-blue",
    15: "--ui-chart-purple",
};

export default function BarChart({
    labels,
    values,
    id,
    maxValue = 100,
    height = 350,
    barHeight = 15,
    segments = 10,
    colorMode = 1,
}: BarChartProps) {
    const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
    const { theme } = useTheme();

    // Цвет сегментов
    const cssValue = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue(theme === "light" ? LIGHT_MODE_COLOR[colorMode] ?? "--ui-chart-red" : "--ui-accent-primary")
        .trim();
    const baseColor = d3.hsl(cssValue || "#f54c4c");
    const activeColor = theme === "light" || colorMode === 1
        ? baseColor.toString()
        : d3.hsl((baseColor.h + (colorMode - 1) * 22.5) % 360, baseColor.s, baseColor.l).toString();

    // Glow цвет
    const glowColor = d3.color(activeColor)?.copy({ opacity: theme === "light" ? .12 : .35 }).toString() ?? activeColor;

    // Подготовка данных и fillRatio
    const chartData: ChartItem[] = useMemo(() => {
        return labels
            .map((label, i) => {
                const parts = label.trim().split(/\s+/);
                const last = parts[0] || "";
                const initial = parts[1] ? `${parts[1][0]}.` : "";
                const value = Math.min(values[i] ?? 0, maxValue);
                const vPerSeg = maxValue / segments;
                const fillRatios = Array.from({ length: segments }, (_, j) =>
                    Math.min(Math.max(value - j * vPerSeg, 0), vPerSeg) / vPerSeg
                );
                return {
                    key: `${label}__${i}`,
                    label: `${last} ${initial}`,
                    value,
                    fillRatios,
                };
            })
            .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
            .slice(0, 5);
    }, [labels, values, maxValue, segments]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!svgRef.current) return;

        const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
        svg.attr("data-theme", theme);
        const containerWidth = svgRef.current.parentElement?.clientWidth ?? 400;

        const margin = { top: 15, right: 50, bottom: 10, left: 100 };
        const innerWidth = containerWidth - margin.left - margin.right;
        const innerHeight = chartData.length * barHeight;

        svg.attr("width", containerWidth).attr("height", innerHeight + margin.top + margin.bottom);

        // Группа для графика
        let group = svg.select<SVGGElement>(".chart-group");
        if (group.empty()) {
            group = svg.append<SVGGElement>("g").attr("class", "chart-group");
        }
        group.attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

        // defs + glow один раз
        let defs: d3.Selection<SVGDefsElement, unknown, null, undefined> = svg.select<SVGDefsElement>("defs");
        if (defs.empty()) {
            defs = svg.append<SVGDefsElement>("defs");
            const glow = defs.append<SVGFilterElement>("filter")
                .attr("id", "glow")
                .attr("x", "-20%")
                .attr("y", "-20%")
                .attr("width", "140%")
                .attr("height", "140%");
            
            glow.append("feGaussianBlur").attr("stdDeviation", 1.5).attr("result", "blur");
            glow.append("feFlood").attr("flood-color", glowColor).attr("result", "glow");
            glow.append("feComposite").attr("in", "glow").attr("in2", "blur").attr("operator", "in");
            glow.append("feMerge").html(`
                <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            `);
        }
        defs.select("feFlood").attr("flood-color", glowColor);

        const y = d3.scaleBand<string>()
            .domain(chartData.map(d => d.key))
            .range([0, innerHeight])
            .paddingInner(0.7);

        const segmentWidth = innerWidth / segments;
        const segmentPadding = 6;
        const inactiveColor = "var(--bar-bg)";

        // DATA JOIN
        const rows = group.selectAll<SVGGElement, ChartItem>(".row")
            .data(chartData, d => d.key);

        // EXIT
        rows.exit().remove();

        // ENTER
        const rowsEnter = rows.enter()
            .append("g")
            .attr("class", "row")
            .attr("transform", d => `translate(0, ${y(d.key)})`);

        // BG
        rowsEnter.selectAll<SVGRectElement, number>("rect.bg")
            .data(() => Array.from({ length: segments }, (_, i) => i))
            .enter()
            .append("rect")
            .attr("class", "bg")
            .attr("x", d => d * segmentWidth)
            .attr("width", segmentWidth - segmentPadding)
            .attr("height", y.bandwidth())
            .attr("rx", 2)
            .attr("fill", inactiveColor);

        // ACTIVE
        rowsEnter.selectAll<SVGRectElement, { fillRatio: number; i: number }>("rect.active")
            .data(d => d.fillRatios.map((r, i) => ({ fillRatio: r, i })))
            .enter()
            .append("rect")
            .attr("class", "active")
            .attr("x", d => d.i * segmentWidth)
            .attr("width", 0)
            .attr("height", y.bandwidth())
            .attr("rx", 2)
            .attr("fill", activeColor)
            .attr("filter", theme === "light" ? null : "url(#glow)")
            .transition()
            .duration(700)
            .attr("width", d => (segmentWidth - segmentPadding) * d.fillRatio);

        // LABELS
        rowsEnter.append("text")
            .attr("x", -10)
            .attr("y", y.bandwidth() / 2)
            .attr("text-anchor", "end")
            .attr("alignment-baseline", "middle")
            .attr("fill", "var(--text-color)")
            .style("font-size", "11px")
            .text(d => d.label);

        // VALUE
        rowsEnter.append("text")
            .attr("x", innerWidth + 10)
            .attr("y", y.bandwidth() / 2)
            .attr("alignment-baseline", "middle")
            .attr("fill", "var(--text-color)")
            .style("font-size", "15px")
            .style("font-weight", "900")
            .text(d => Number.isInteger(d.value) ? d.value : d.value.toFixed(2));

        // UPDATE
        rows.attr("transform", d => `translate(0, ${y(d.key)})`);
        rows.selectAll<SVGRectElement, { fillRatio: number; i: number }>("rect.active")
            .data(d => d.fillRatios.map((r, i) => ({ fillRatio: r, i })))
            .attr("fill", activeColor)
            .attr("filter", theme === "light" ? null : "url(#glow)")
            .transition()
            .duration(400)
            .attr("width", d => (segmentWidth - segmentPadding) * d.fillRatio);

        rows.select("text:last-of-type")
            .text(d => Number.isInteger(d.value) ? d.value : d.value.toFixed(2));

    }, [chartData, activeColor, glowColor, segments, barHeight, theme]);

    return (
        <div
            className={styles.chartContainer}
            id={id ? String(id) : undefined}
            style={{ height: "auto", minHeight: height }}
        >
            <svg ref={svgRef} />
        </div>
    );
}
