// src\components\Charts\ChartDataList\index.tsx
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export interface ChartDataPoint { index: number; label: string; value: number | null }
interface Props { points: ChartDataPoint[]; label: string; selectedIndex?: number | null; onSelect?(index: number): void }
const formatValue = (value: number | null) => value === null ? "Нет отметок" : `${value.toLocaleString("ru-RU", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`;

export default function ChartDataList({ points, label, selectedIndex, onSelect }: Props) {
  const selected = points.find((point) => point.index === selectedIndex && point.value !== null);
  return <details className={styles.details}>
    <summary><span className={styles.heading}><strong>Данные графика</strong><span>Периоды: {points.length}</span></span><span className={styles.summaryEnd}>{selected ? "Период выбран" : "По периодам"}<svg className={styles.chevron} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg></span></summary>
    <div className={styles.content}>
      <p className={styles.hint}>{onSelect ? "Нажмите на строку, чтобы выбрать период. Повторное нажатие снимает фильтр." : label}</p>
      <div className={styles.columns} aria-hidden="true"><span>Период</span><span>Посещаемость</span></div>
      <ul className={styles.list} aria-label={label} tabIndex={0}>{points.map((point) => {
        const active = selected?.index === point.index;
        const className = `${styles.row} ${active ? styles.active : ""} ${point.value === null ? styles.unmarked : ""}`;
        const content = <><span className={styles.period}>{point.label}</span><span className={styles.track} aria-hidden="true"><span style={{ width: `${point.value ?? 0}%` }} /></span><strong className={styles.value}>{formatValue(point.value)}</strong><span className={styles.state} aria-hidden="true">{active && <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>}</span></>;
        return <li key={point.index}>{onSelect && point.value !== null ? <button type="button" className={className} aria-pressed={active} aria-label={`${point.label}: ${formatValue(point.value)}. ${active ? "Снять фильтр периода" : "Выбрать период"}`} onClick={() => onSelect(point.index)}>{content}</button> : <div className={className}>{content}</div>}</li>;
      })}</ul>
    </div>
  </details>;
}


// src\components\Charts\CircleChart\Radar\index.module.scss
// Подписи и легенда графика интерактивны и не должны попадать в выделение текста.
.chartContainer { user-select: none; }


// src\components\Charts\CircleChart\Radar\index.tsx
import * as React from "react";
import { useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import styles from "../../settingsCharts.module.scss";
import { useTheme } from "../../../ThemeContext";

interface RadarDataPoint {
  seriesName: string;
  values: number[];
  colorToken?: string;
}

interface RadarChartProps {
  labels: string[];
  data: RadarDataPoint[];
  size?: number;
  maxValue?: number;
  colorMode?: number;
}

export default function RadarChart({
  labels,
  data,
  size = 300,
  maxValue = 5,
  colorMode = 0,
}: RadarChartProps) {
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
  const { theme } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!svgRef.current) return;

    const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
    svg.selectAll("*").remove();
    if (!labels.length || !data.length) return;
    // ================== состояние видимости серий ==================
    const seriesEnabled = new Map<number, boolean>();
    data.forEach((_, i) => seriesEnabled.set(i, true));

    const margin = 40;
    const width = size + 2 * margin;
    const height = size + 2 * margin;
    const radius = size / 2;
    const centerX = width / 2;
    const centerY = height / 2;
    const angleSlice = (Math.PI * 2) / labels.length;

    svg.attr("width", width).attr("height", height);

    const mainGroup = svg
      .append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${centerX}, ${centerY})`);

    const tooltip = d3
      .select(svgRef.current.parentElement)
      .append("div")
      .attr("class", styles.tooltip)
      .style("position", "absolute")
      .style("padding", "4px 8px")
      .style("background", "var(--grid-color)")
      .style("color", "var(--text-color)")
      .style("border", "1px solid var(--text-color)")
      .style("border-radius", "4px")
      .style("font-size", "11px")
      .style("pointer-events", "none")
      .style("opacity", 0)
      .style("transition", "opacity 0.15s");

    const rScale = d3.scaleLinear().range([0, radius]).domain([0, maxValue]);

    const angleToCoords = (angle: number, value: number) => ({
      x: rScale(value) * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 2),
      y: rScale(value) * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 2),
    });

    const levels = d3.range(1, 6).map(i => (maxValue / 5) * i);

    mainGroup
      .selectAll(".grid-circle")
      .data(levels)
      .enter()
      .append("circle")
      .attr("class", "grid-circle")
      .attr("r", d => rScale(d))
      .style("fill", "var(--bg-dark-color)")
      .style("fill-opacity", 0.8)
      .style("stroke", "var(--radar-grid-stroke)")
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0.5);

    mainGroup
      .selectAll(".axis-line")
      .data(labels)
      .enter()
      .append("line")
      .attr("class", "axis-line")
      .attr("x1", 0)
      .attr("y1", 0)
      .attr("x2", (_, i) => angleToCoords(angleSlice * i, maxValue).x)
      .attr("y2", (_, i) => angleToCoords(angleSlice * i, maxValue).y)
      .style("stroke", "var(--radar-axis-stroke)")
      .style("stroke-opacity", 0.3)
      .style("stroke-width", 1);

    mainGroup
      .selectAll(".axis-label")
      .data(labels)
      .enter()
      .append("text")
      .attr("class", "axis-label")
      .attr("x", (_, i) => angleToCoords(angleSlice * i, maxValue * 1.15).x)
      .attr("y", (_, i) => angleToCoords(angleSlice * i, maxValue * 1.15).y)
      .style("font-size", "12px")
      .style("font-weight", "700")
      .style("text-anchor", "middle")
      .style("fill", "var(--text-color)")
      .text(d => d);

    // Для светлой темы берём отдельный яркий цвет данных, не текстовый акцент.
    const getSeriesColor = (index: number, total: number, colorMode: number) => {
      const colorToken = data[index]?.colorToken;
      if (colorToken) return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(colorToken).trim();
      if (theme === "light") {
        const tokens = colorMode === 7
          ? ["--ui-chart-green", "--ui-chart-blue", "--ui-chart-red", "--ui-chart-amber"]
          : colorMode === 6
            ? ["--ui-chart-green", "--ui-chart-purple"]
            : ["--ui-chart-red", "--ui-chart-blue", "--ui-chart-green", "--ui-chart-purple"];
        return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(tokens[index % tokens.length]).trim();
      }
      const baseColor = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue('--ui-accent-primary')
        .trim();

      let h = 0, s = 70, l = 50;
      const rgb = d3.color(baseColor);
      if (rgb) {
        const hsl = d3.hsl(rgb);
        h = hsl.h;
        s = hsl.s * 100;
        l = hsl.l * 100;
      }

      const step = 360 / total; // равномерное распределение
      const hue = (h + step * index + colorMode * 22.5) % 360; // сдвиг по colorMode
      return `hsl(${hue}, ${s}%, ${l}%)`;
    };


    const radarLine = d3
      .line<{ x: number; y: number }>()
      .x(d => d.x)
      .y(d => d.y)
      .curve(d3.curveLinearClosed);

    const labelsGroup = mainGroup.append("g").attr("class", "value-labels");

    data.forEach((series, sIndex) => {
      const color = getSeriesColor(sIndex, data.length, colorMode);

      const seriesGroup = mainGroup
        .append("g")
        .attr("class", `series-group series-${sIndex}`);

      const coords = series.values.map((v, i) =>
        angleToCoords(angleSlice * i, v)
      );

      seriesGroup
        .append("path")
        .datum(coords)
        .attr("class", `radar-area radar-area-${sIndex}`)
        .attr("d", radarLine)
        .style("fill", color)
        .style("fill-opacity", 0.25)
        .style("stroke", color)
        .style("stroke-width", 2);

      seriesGroup
        .selectAll(".radar-point")
        .data(
          coords.map((p, i) => ({
            ...p,
            value: series.values[i],
            label: labels[i],
            color,
            sIndex,
            seriesName: series.seriesName,
          }))
        )
        .enter()
        .append("circle")
        .attr("class", `radar-point point-${sIndex}`)
        .attr("cx", d => d.x)
        .attr("cy", d => d.y)
        .attr("r", 4)
        .style("fill", color)
        .style("cursor", "pointer")
        .on("mouseenter", function (event, d) {
          if (!seriesEnabled.get(d.sIndex)) return
          mainGroup.select(`.series-${d.sIndex}`).raise();
          mainGroup
            .select(`.radar-area-${d.sIndex}`)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("fill-opacity", 0.7)
            .style("stroke-width", 3);

          d3.select(this)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .attr("r", 7)
            .style("filter", theme === "light" ? "var(--chart-point-shadow)" : "drop-shadow(0 0 4px white)");

          tooltip
            .style("opacity", 1)
            .html(`<b>${d.seriesName}</b><br/>${d.label}: <b>${d.value}</b>`);
        })
        .on("mousemove", function (event) {
          tooltip
            .style("left", event.offsetX + 20 + "px")
            .style("top", event.offsetY + 20 + "px");
        })
        .on("mouseleave", function (event, d) {
          mainGroup
            .select(`.radar-area-${d.sIndex}`)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("fill-opacity", 0.35)
            .style("stroke-width", 2);

          d3.select(this)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .attr("r", 4)
            .style("filter", "none");

          tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
        });
    });
    // === функции подсветки ===
    const brightenColor = (color: string, percent: number) => {
      const c = d3.hsl(color);
      c.l = Math.min(1, c.l + c.l * (percent / 200));
      return c.formatHsl();
    };
    const brightenBg = (percent: number) => {
      if (theme === "light") return "var(--ui-accent-background-hover)";
      const bg = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
        .getPropertyValue('--grid-color')
        .trim();

      const c = d3.hsl(bg);
      c.l = Math.min(1, c.l - c.l * (percent / 50));
      return c.formatHsl();
    };
    const toggleSeries = (
      i: number,
      row: d3.Selection<SVGGElement, unknown, null, undefined>
    ) => {
      const enabled = seriesEnabled.get(i)!;
      seriesEnabled.set(i, !enabled);

      // показать / скрыть серию
      mainGroup
        .select(`.series-${i}`)
        .transition()
        .duration(200)
        .style("opacity", enabled ? 0 : 1)
        .style("pointer-events", enabled ? "none" : "all");

      // квадратик легенды
      row.select("rect.legend-color")
        .transition()
        .duration(200)
        .style("fill", enabled ? "transparent" : getSeriesColor(i, data.length, colorMode))
        .style("stroke", getSeriesColor(i, data.length, colorMode))
        .style("stroke-width", enabled ? 1.5 : 0);

      // приглушить текст
      row.select("text.legend-name")
        .transition()
        .duration(200)
        .style("opacity", enabled ? 0.5 : 1);

      // убрать подписи значений
      labelsGroup.selectAll("*").remove();
    };
    // === ЛЕГЕНДА ===
    const legend = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${width - 130}, 20)`);
    // увеличение яркости цвета фона (var(--grid-color))
    const drawValueLabels = (i: number, color: string) => {
      labelsGroup.selectAll("*").remove();

      const seriesData = data[i];
      const coords = seriesData.values.map((v, idx) => {
        const angle = angleSlice * idx;
        return { ...angleToCoords(angle, v), value: v };
      });

      coords.forEach(d => {
        const text = labelsGroup
          .append("text")
          .attr("x", d.x)
          .attr("y", d.y - 10)
          .style("fill", color)
          .style("font-size", "12px")
          .style("font-weight", "600")
          .style("text-anchor", "middle")
          .text(d.value);

        const bbox = text.node()!.getBBox();

        labelsGroup
          .insert("rect", "text")
          .attr("x", bbox.x - 2)
          .attr("y", bbox.y - 1)
          .attr("width", bbox.width + 4)
          .attr("height", bbox.height + 2)
          .style("fill", "var(--grid-color)")
          .style("rx", 3)
          .style("ry", 3);
      });

      labelsGroup.raise();
    };
    const getEnabledSeries = () =>
      Array.from(seriesEnabled.entries())
        .filter(([, enabled]) => enabled)
        .map(([i]) => i);
    data.forEach((series, i) => {
      const color = getSeriesColor(i, data.length, colorMode);
      const brightColor = theme === "light" ? color : brightenColor(color, 30);
      const y = i * 22;

      const row = legend.append("g")
        .attr("class", `legend-item legend-${i}`)
        .style("cursor", "pointer")
        .on("click", () => {

          toggleSeries(i, row); mainGroup
            .selectAll(".axis-line")
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("stroke", "var(--radar-axis-stroke)")
            .style("stroke-width", 1);

        })
        .on("mouseenter", () => {
          if (!seriesEnabled.get(i)) return;

          // поднять слой серии
          mainGroup.select(`.series-${i}`).raise();

          // фон строки легенды
          row.select("rect.legend-bg")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", brightenBg(60));

          // подсветка области
          mainGroup
            .select(`.radar-area-${i}`)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("fill-opacity", 0.7)
            .style("stroke-width", 3);

          // подсветка осей
          mainGroup
            .selectAll(".axis-line")
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("stroke-width", 3)
            .style("stroke", brightColor);

          // подсветка квадрата и текста в легенде
          row.select("rect.legend-color")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", brightColor);

          row.select("text.legend-name")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", brightColor);

          // показать временные подписи значений этой серии
          drawValueLabels(i, brightColor);
        })
        .on("mouseleave", () => {
          if (!seriesEnabled.get(i)) return;

          // вернуть фон строки легенды
          row.select("rect.legend-bg")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", "var(--grid-color)");

          // убрать подсветку области
          mainGroup
            .select(`.radar-area-${i}`)
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("fill-opacity", 0.35)
            .style("stroke-width", 2);

          // вернуть стандартный цвет осей
          mainGroup
            .selectAll(".axis-line")
            .transition()
            .duration(150)
            .style("stroke", "var(--radar-axis-stroke)")
            .style("stroke-width", 1);

          // вернуть обычный цвет квадрата и текста
          row.select("rect.legend-color")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", getSeriesColor(i, data.length, colorMode));

          row.select("text.legend-name")
            .transition().duration(150)
            .style("fill", getSeriesColor(i, data.length, colorMode));

          // удалить временные подписи значений
          const enabled = getEnabledSeries();
          labelsGroup.selectAll("*").remove();

          // если осталась одна активная серия — показать её подписи
          if (enabled.length === 1) {
            const idx = enabled[0];
            drawValueLabels(
              idx,
              getSeriesColor(idx, data.length, colorMode)
            );
          }
        });



      // элемент легенды: фон строки
      row
        .append("rect")
        .attr("class", "legend-bg")
        .attr("x", 25)
        .attr("y", y - 2)
        .attr("width", 100)
        .attr("height", 18)
        .style("fill", "var(--grid-color)")
        .style("opacity", 0.9)
        .style("stroke", "var(--text-color)")
        .style("stroke-width", 1)
        .style("stroke-opacity", 0.2)
        .style("rx", 4)
        .style("ry", 4);

      // квадратик цвета
      row
        .append("rect")
        .attr("class", "legend-color")
        .attr("x", 30)
        .attr("y", y)
        .attr("width", 12)
        .attr("height", 12)
        .style("fill", color);

      // название серии
      row
        .append("text")
        .attr("class", "legend-name")
        .attr("x", 48)
        .attr("y", y + 11)
        .style("font-size", "12px")
        .style("fill", color)
        .style("user-select", "none")
        .text(series.seriesName);
    });

    return () => {
      tooltip.remove();
    };
  }, [labels, data, size, maxValue, colorMode, theme]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.chartContainer} style={{ position: "relative" }}>
      <svg ref={svgRef} />
    </div>
  );
}


// src\components\Charts\LineChart\index.module.scss

// src\components\Charts\LineChart\index.tsx
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import sharedStyles from "../settingsCharts.module.scss";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import ChartDataList, { type ChartDataPoint } from "../ChartDataList";

interface LineChartProps {
  data?: Array<number | null>;
  labels?: string[];
  length?: number;
  height?: number;
  label?: string;
  onPointSelect?(index: number): void;
  selectedIndex?: number | null;
}
type Point = ChartDataPoint;
const formatValue = (value: number | null) => value === null ? "Нет отметок" : `${value.toLocaleString("ru-RU", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`;

export default function LineChart({ data, labels, length, height = 350, label = "Динамика посещаемости", onPointSelect, selectedIndex }: LineChartProps) {
  const id = `line-chart-${useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "")}`;
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pointRefs = useRef<Record<number, SVGGElement | null>>({});
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(360);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [tabStop, setTabStop] = useState(0);
  const points = useMemo<Point[]>(() => {
    const count = Number.isFinite(length) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(length!)) : data?.length ?? 0;
    return (data ?? []).slice(0, count).map((value, index) => ({ index, label: labels?.[index] ?? `${index + 1}`, value: typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100 ? value : null }));
  }, [data, labels, length]);
  const available = points.filter((point) => point.value !== null);
  const effectiveTabStop = available.some((point) => point.index === tabStop) ? tabStop : available[0]?.index;
  const activeIndex = hovered ?? focused;
  const active = points.find((point) => point.index === activeIndex && point.value !== null);
  const chartHeight = Number.isFinite(height) ? Math.max(160, height) : 350;
  const wrappedLabels = points.some((point) => point.label.length > 14 && point.label.includes(" — "));
  const margin = { top: 24, right: 18, bottom: wrappedLabels ? 50 : 36, left: 44 };
  const innerWidth = Math.max(1, width - margin.left - margin.right);
  const innerHeight = chartHeight - margin.top - margin.bottom;
  const x = d3.scalePoint<number>().domain(points.map((point) => point.index)).range([0, innerWidth]).padding(.35);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 100]).range([innerHeight, 0]);
  const tickLines = (point: Point) => wrappedLabels && point.label.includes(" — ") ? point.label.split(" — ").map((part, index) => index ? `— ${part}` : part) : [point.label];
  const tickWidth = (point: Point) => Math.max(...tickLines(point).map((part) => part.length * 6.2));
  const ticks = points.length <= 1 ? points : (() => {
    const first = points[0], last = points[points.length - 1];
    let rightEdge = (x(first.index) ?? 0) + tickWidth(first);
    const lastLeft = (x(last.index) ?? 0) - tickWidth(last);
    // Full labels remain available in the tooltip and data list when the axis is too narrow.
    if (lastLeft < rightEdge + 12) return [first];
    const visible = [first];
    points.slice(1, -1).forEach((point) => {
      const center = x(point.index) ?? 0, halfWidth = tickWidth(point) / 2;
      if (center - halfWidth >= rightEdge + 12 && center + halfWidth <= lastLeft - 12) {
        visible.push(point); rightEdge = center + halfWidth;
      }
    });
    return [...visible, last];
  })();
  const line = d3.line<Point>().defined((point) => point.value !== null).x((point) => x(point.index) ?? 0).y((point) => y(point.value ?? 0)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);
  const area = d3.area<Point>().defined((point) => point.value !== null).x((point) => x(point.index) ?? 0).y0(innerHeight).y1((point) => y(point.value ?? 0)).curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);
  const activeX = active ? margin.left + (x(active.index) ?? 0) : 0;
  const activeY = active ? margin.top + y(active.value!) : 0;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = containerRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const update = () => {
      const next = Math.max(1, Math.round(node.getBoundingClientRect().width));
      setWidth((current) => current === next ? current : next);
    };
    update();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") {
      window.addEventListener("resize", update);
      return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", update);
    }
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const movePoint = (event: KeyboardEvent<SVGGElement>, index: number) => {
    if (onPointSelect && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) { event.preventDefault(); onPointSelect(index); return; }
    if (event.key === "Escape") { setFocused(null); setHovered(null); return; }
    if (!["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const current = available.findIndex((point) => point.index === index);
    const next = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? available.length - 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(available.length - 1, current + (event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1)));
    pointRefs.current[available[next].index]?.focus();
  };

  return <figure className={styles.figure}>
    <div ref={containerRef} className={`${sharedStyles.chartContainer} ${styles.chart}`}>
      {available.length ? <svg width="100%" height={chartHeight} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${chartHeight}`} role="group" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} aria-describedby={`${id}-description`}>
        <title id={`${id}-title`}>{label}</title><desc id={`${id}-description`}>Стрелки влево и вправо переключают точки. Home и End — первая и последняя точка. {onPointSelect ? "Enter или пробел — выбрать неделю для фильтрации. " : ""}Значения также доступны в раскрываемом списке под графиком.</desc>
        <defs><linearGradient id={`${id}-line`} x1="0%" x2="100%" y1="0%" y2="0%"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--line-start)" stopOpacity="var(--line-opacity)" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--line-end)" stopOpacity="var(--line-opacity)" /></linearGradient><linearGradient id={`${id}-area`} x1="0%" x2="0%" y1="0%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--area-start)" stopOpacity="var(--area-opacity)" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--area-end)" stopOpacity="0" /></linearGradient></defs>
        <g transform={`translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`}>
          {[0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100].map((value) => <g key={value}><line x1="0" x2={innerWidth} y1={y(value)} y2={y(value)} className={styles.gridLine} /><text x="-9" y={y(value)} dy=".35em" textAnchor="end" className={styles.axisText}>{value}%</text></g>)}
          {ticks.map((point) => <text key={point.index} x={x(point.index)} y={innerHeight + 23} textAnchor={points.length === 1 ? "middle" : point.index === 0 ? "start" : point.index === points.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"} className={styles.axisText}>{tickLines(point).map((part, index) => <tspan key={index} x={x(point.index)} dy={index ? "1.3em" : 0}>{part}</tspan>)}</text>)}
          <path d={area(points) ?? undefined} fill={`url(#${id}-area)`} className={styles.area} />
          <path d={line(points) ?? undefined} stroke={`url(#${id}-line)`} className={styles.line} />
          {active && <line x1={x(active.index)} x2={x(active.index)} y1={y(active.value!)} y2={innerHeight} className={styles.guide} />}
          {available.map((point) => <g key={point.index} ref={(node) => { pointRefs.current[point.index] = node; }} transform={`translate(${x(point.index)},${y(point.value!)})`} role={onPointSelect ? "button" : "img"} aria-pressed={onPointSelect ? selectedIndex === point.index : undefined} aria-label={`${point.label}: ${formatValue(point.value)}${onPointSelect ? ". Фильтровать по этой неделе" : ""}`} tabIndex={point.index === effectiveTabStop ? 0 : -1} className={styles.point} onClick={() => onPointSelect?.(point.index)} onPointerEnter={() => setHovered(point.index)} onPointerLeave={() => setHovered(null)} onFocus={() => { setFocused(point.index); setTabStop(point.index); }} onBlur={() => setFocused(null)} onKeyDown={(event) => movePoint(event, point.index)}>
            <circle r="13" fill="transparent" />
            {(point.index === activeIndex || point.index === selectedIndex) && <circle r="9" className={styles.focusRing} />}
            <circle r={point.index === activeIndex ? 6 : points.length > 15 ? 3.5 : 5} className={`${styles.dot} ${point.index === activeIndex ? styles.activeDot : ""}`} />
          </g>)}
        </g>
      </svg> : <div className={styles.empty} style={{ minHeight: chartHeight }}><strong>Нет данных для графика</strong><span>Заполненные отметки появятся здесь после внесения в журнал.</span></div>}
      {active && <div className={styles.tooltip} style={{ left: Math.max(8, Math.min(width - 228, activeX - 100)), top: Math.max(4, activeY - 48) }} role="tooltip"><strong>{active.label}</strong><span>{formatValue(active.value)}</span></div>}
    </div>
    {points.length > 0 && <ChartDataList points={points} label={label} selectedIndex={selectedIndex} onSelect={onPointSelect} />}
  </figure>;
}

// src\components\ConfirmDialog\index.tsx
import { useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import Modal from "../Modal";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onCancel(): void;
}

const ConfirmDialog = ({ title, children, confirmLabel = "Удалить", cancelLabel = "Отмена", busy = false, error, onConfirm, onCancel }: Props) => {
  const headingId = useId();
  const cancelRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  return <Modal labelledBy={headingId} initialFocusRef={cancelRef} layer={3000} onClose={() => { if (!busy) onCancel(); }} className={styles.dialog}>
    <span className={styles.eyebrow}>Подтверждение действия</span>
    <h2 id={headingId}>{title}</h2>
    <div className={styles.content}>{children}</div>
    {error && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <div className={styles.actions}><button ref={cancelRef} type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onCancel}>{cancelLabel}</button><button className={styles.danger} type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onConfirm}>{busy ? "Удаляем…" : confirmLabel}</button></div>
  </Modal>;
};

export default ConfirmDialog;

@use "../../styles/variables" as *;
@use "../../styles/mixins" as *;

.picker {

}

.trigger {
  @include input(12px, 11px);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-height: 45px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: none;
  gap: 10px;

// src\components\DateTimePicker\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import {
  addDays,
  addMonths,
  endOfWeek,
  format,
  isSameDay,
  isSameMonth,
  startOfMonth,
  startOfWeek,
} from "date-fns";
import { ru } from "date-fns/locale";
import { getCalendarMonthDays, getDayInMonth } from "../../domain/calendar";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import TimeWheel from "../TimeWheel";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const WEEK_DAYS = ["Пн", "Вт", "Ср", "Чт", "Пт", "Сб", "Вс"];
const MONTHS = ["Январь", "Февраль", "Март", "Апрель", "Май", "Июнь", "Июль", "Август", "Сентябрь", "Октябрь", "Ноябрь", "Декабрь"];

interface DateTimePickerProps {
  value?: Date;
  initialDate?: Date;
  onChange(value?: Date): void;
  placeholder?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  showTime?: boolean;
  allowClear?: boolean;
}

const DateTimePicker = ({ value, initialDate, onChange, placeholder = "Выберите дату", ariaLabel = "Дата и время", showTime = true, allowClear = true }: DateTimePickerProps) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dialogId = useId();
  const [visibleMonth, setVisibleMonth] = useState(() => startOfMonth(value ?? initialDate ?? new Date()));
  const [focusedDay, setFocusedDay] = useState(() => value ?? initialDate ?? new Date());
  const [view, setView] = useState<"days" | "months" | "years">("days");
  const [time, setTime] = useState(() => ({ hours: value?.getHours() ?? 9, minutes: value?.getMinutes() ?? 0 }));
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popoverRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [popoverPosition, setPopoverPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const closeOnOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node) && !popoverRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setIsOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", closeOnOutsideClick);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", closeOnOutsideClick);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      popoverRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-focused="true"], [data-selected-period="true"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [isOpen, view]);

  const close = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    triggerRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  };

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !triggerRef.current || !popoverRef.current) return;
    const placePopover = () => {
      const trigger = triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      const popover = popoverRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!trigger || !popover) return;
      const gap = 7;
      const viewportPadding = 10;
      const fitsBelow = window.innerHeight - trigger.bottom >= popover.height + gap;
      const preferredTop = fitsBelow
        ? trigger.bottom + gap
        : trigger.top - popover.height - gap;
      const top = Math.max(viewportPadding, Math.min(preferredTop, window.innerHeight - popover.height - viewportPadding));
      const left = Math.max(
        viewportPadding,
        Math.min(trigger.left, window.innerWidth - popover.width - viewportPadding),
      );
      setPopoverPosition((current) => current.top === top && current.left === left ? current : { top, left });
    };
    placePopover();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(placePopover);
    observer.observe(popoverRef.current);
    window.addEventListener("resize", placePopover);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", placePopover, true);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", placePopover);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", placePopover, true);
    };
  }, [isOpen, visibleMonth, view, showTime]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => getCalendarMonthDays(visibleMonth), [visibleMonth]);
  const changeMonth = (month: Date) => {
    setVisibleMonth(startOfMonth(month));
    setFocusedDay(getDayInMonth(focusedDay, month));
  };
  const navigatePeriod = (direction: number) => changeMonth(view === "days"
    ? addMonths(visibleMonth, direction)
    : new Date(visibleMonth.getFullYear() + direction * (view === "years" ? 12 : 1), visibleMonth.getMonth(), 1));

  const selectDay = (day: Date) => {
    setFocusedDay(day);
    if (!isSameMonth(day, visibleMonth)) setVisibleMonth(startOfMonth(day));
    const next = new Date(day);
    next.setHours(showTime ? time.hours : 0, showTime ? time.minutes : 0, 0, 0);
    onChange(next);
    if (!showTime) close();
  };

  const changeTime = (hours: number, minutes: number) => {
    setTime({ hours, minutes });
    if (!value) return;
    const next = new Date(value);
    next.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
    onChange(next);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.picker} ref={rootRef}>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.trigger} ${isOpen ? styles.triggerOpen : ""}`}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (!isOpen || event.key !== "Escape") return;
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          close();
        }}
        onClick={() => {
          setVisibleMonth(startOfMonth(value ?? initialDate ?? new Date()));
          setFocusedDay(value ?? initialDate ?? new Date());
          setTime({ hours: value?.getHours() ?? time.hours, minutes: value?.getMinutes() ?? time.minutes });
          setView("days");
          setIsOpen((current) => !current);
        }}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-label={`${ariaLabel}: ${value ? format(value, showTime ? "d MMMM yyyy, HH:mm" : "d MMMM yyyy", { locale: ru }) : placeholder}`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-controls={isOpen ? dialogId : undefined}
      >
        <span className={value ? styles.triggerValue : styles.placeholder}>
          {value ? format(value, showTime ? "d MMMM yyyy, HH:mm" : "d MMMM yyyy", { locale: ru }) : placeholder}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.calendarIcon} aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>

      {isOpen && createPortal(
        // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions -- The dialog owns Escape and focus containment for its keyboard controls.
        <div
          id={dialogId}
          ref={popoverRef}
          className={`${styles.popover} ${!showTime ? styles.dateOnly : ""}`}
          style={popoverPosition}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={`Выбор: ${ariaLabel.toLowerCase()}`}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape") {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();
              close();
            }
            if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
            const focusable = Array.from(popoverRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not([disabled]), [tabindex]') ?? [])
              .filter((element) => element.tabIndex >= 0 && element.getClientRects().length > 0);
            if (!focusable.length) return;
            const first = focusable[0];
            const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
            if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || !focusable.includes(document.activeElement as HTMLElement))) { event.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
            else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
          }}
        >
          <header className={styles.calendarHeader}>
            <button type="button" className={styles.arrowButton} onClick={() => navigatePeriod(-1)} aria-label="Предыдущий период">
              <ArrowCircle direction="left" />
            </button>
            <div className={styles.periodSelector} aria-live="polite">{view === "days" && <button type="button" onClick={() => setView("months")}>{format(visibleMonth, "LLLL", { locale: ru })}</button>}<button type="button" onClick={() => setView("years")}>{view === "years" ? `${visibleMonth.getFullYear() - 5}–${visibleMonth.getFullYear() + 6}` : visibleMonth.getFullYear()}</button></div>
            <button type="button" className={styles.arrowButton} onClick={() => navigatePeriod(1)} aria-label="Следующий период">
              <ArrowCircle />
            </button>
          </header>

          <div className={styles.pickerBody}><div className={styles.calendarBody}>{view === "days" && <><div className={styles.weekDays}>
            {WEEK_DAYS.map((day) => <span key={day}>{day}</span>)}
          </div>

          <div className={styles.daysGrid}>
            {calendarDays.map((day) => {
              const selected = Boolean(value && isSameDay(day, value));
              const today = isSameDay(day, new Date());
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={day.toISOString()}
                  className={`${styles.day} ${!isSameMonth(day, visibleMonth) ? styles.outsideDay : ""} ${today ? styles.today : ""} ${selected ? styles.selectedDay : ""}`}
                  onClick={() => selectDay(day)}
                  tabIndex={isSameDay(day, focusedDay) ? 0 : -1}
                  onFocus={() => setFocusedDay(day)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    const offsets: Partial<Record<string, number>> = { ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowUp: -7, ArrowDown: 7 };
                    const offset = offsets[event.key];
                    let next: Date;
                    if (offset !== undefined) next = addDays(day, offset);
                    else if (event.key === "Home") next = startOfWeek(day, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
                    else if (event.key === "End") next = endOfWeek(day, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
                    else if (event.key === "PageUp" || event.key === "PageDown") next = getDayInMonth(day, addMonths(day, (event.key === "PageUp" ? -1 : 1) * (event.shiftKey ? 12 : 1)));
                    else return;
                    event.preventDefault();
                    setFocusedDay(next);
                    if (!isSameMonth(next, visibleMonth)) setVisibleMonth(startOfMonth(next));
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => popoverRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-date="${format(next, "yyyy-MM-dd")}"]`)?.focus());
                  }}
                  aria-pressed={selected}
                  aria-current={today ? "date" : undefined}
                  aria-label={format(day, "EEEE, d MMMM yyyy", { locale: ru })}
                  data-calendar-day="true"
                  data-focused={isSameDay(day, focusedDay) ? "true" : undefined}
                  data-selected={selected ? "true" : undefined}
                  data-date={format(day, "yyyy-MM-dd")}
                >
                  {format(day, "d")}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div></>}
          {view === "months" && <div className={styles.monthsGrid}>{MONTHS.map((month, index) => <button type="button" aria-pressed={index === visibleMonth.getMonth()} data-selected-period={index === visibleMonth.getMonth() ? "true" : undefined} className={index === visibleMonth.getMonth() ? styles.selectedPeriod : ""} key={month} onClick={() => { changeMonth(new Date(visibleMonth.getFullYear(), index, 1)); setView("days"); }}>{month}</button>)}</div>}
          {view === "years" && <div className={styles.yearsGrid}>{Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => visibleMonth.getFullYear() - 5 + index).map((year) => <button type="button" aria-pressed={year === visibleMonth.getFullYear()} data-selected-period={year === visibleMonth.getFullYear() ? "true" : undefined} className={year === visibleMonth.getFullYear() ? styles.selectedPeriod : ""} key={year} onClick={() => { changeMonth(new Date(year, visibleMonth.getMonth(), 1)); setView("months"); }}>{year}</button>)}</div>}</div>{showTime && <TimeWheel hours={time.hours} minutes={time.minutes} onChange={changeTime} />}</div>

          <footer className={styles.footer}>
            <span className={styles.timeHint}>{!showTime ? value ? format(value, "d MMM yyyy", { locale: ru }) : "Выберите день" : value ? `Выбрано ${format(value, "HH:mm")}` : `Время ${String(time.hours).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(time.minutes).padStart(2, "0")} · выберите дату`}</span>
            <div className={styles.footerActions}>
              {value && allowClear && <button type="button" className={styles.clearButton} onClick={() => { onChange(undefined); popoverRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-focused="true"]')?.focus(); }}>Очистить</button>}
              <button type="button" className={styles.doneButton} onClick={close}>Готово</button>
            </div>
          </footer>
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DateTimePicker;

// src\components\DemoDataManager\index.tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { startOfWeek } from "date-fns";
import type { DemoImportResult } from "../../data/demoData";
import { parseCalendarDate } from "../../domain/calendar";
import Modal from "../Modal";
import Checkbox from "../Checkbox";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const DemoDataManager = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<DemoImportResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [includeJournals, setIncludeJournals] = useState(true);
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const headingId = useId();
  const lock = useRef(false);
  const anchor = parseCalendarDate(params.get("date")) ?? new Date();
  const weekStart = startOfWeek(anchor, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
  const importData = async () => {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const { importDemoData } = await import("../../data/demoData");
      setResult(await importDemoData(anchor, { journalActor: includeJournals && currentUser.role === "teacher" ? currentUser : undefined }));
    }
    catch { setError("Не удалось завершить наполнение. Повторите попытку: уже добавленные записи не продублируются."); }
    finally { lock.current = false; setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <>
    <button type="button" className={styles.trigger} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Наполнить демоданными</button>
    {open && <Modal labelledBy={headingId} onClose={() => { if (!lock.current) setOpen(false); }} className={styles.dialog}>
      <header><span>Демо-режим</span><h2 id={headingId}>Больше данных для просмотра</h2><p>Задания по четырём предметам, ответы с историей попыток, материалы, задачи и недельная динамика журналов.</p></header>
      <div className={styles.scenarios}><span>Проверка и доработка</span><span>Оценки 2–5</span><span>Сроки и просрочки</span><span>Учебные и личные задачи</span></div>
      <p className={styles.hint}>Неделя начинается {weekStart.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}. Добавим примеры на эту и соседние недели, не меняя ваши записи. Повторное наполнение не создаёт дубликатов и не переносит уже добавленные примеры на другую неделю.</p>
      {currentUser.role === "teacher" && <div className={styles.journalOption}>
        <Checkbox label="Добавить демонстрационные отметки в мои журналы" checked={includeJournals} disabled={busy} onChange={setIncludeJournals} />
        <p>С 14 сентября по 6 ноября 2026: разные недели, оценки 5/4/3/2, пропуски и неделя без оценок по анализу данных. Заполняются только отсутствующие ячейки прошедших занятий; будущие остаются пустыми. Уже сохранённые отметки, даже «не отмечено» и пустая оценка, не заменяются. Каждый импорт отмечается в истории журнала.</p>
      </div>}
      <p className={styles.localNotice}>Данные сохраняются только в этом браузере. Вложенные TXT-файлы можно открыть и скачать — это учебные примеры, не материалы университета.</p>
      {busy && <p className={styles.progress} role="status">Подготавливаем журналы, задания, ответы и файлы. Закрыть окно можно после завершения.</p>}
      {result && <div className={styles.result} role="status"><strong>{result.assignments + result.submissions + result.tasks + result.materials + result.journalCells ? result.warnings.length ? "Часть данных добавлена" : "Данные добавлены" : result.warnings.length ? "Наполнение не завершено" : "Этот набор уже добавлен"}</strong><dl><div><dt>Заданий</dt><dd>+{result.assignments}</dd></div><div><dt>Ответов</dt><dd>+{result.submissions}</dd></div><div><dt>Задач</dt><dd>+{result.tasks}</dd></div><div><dt>Материалов</dt><dd>+{result.materials}</dd></div><div><dt>Журналов дополнено</dt><dd>{result.journals}</dd></div><div><dt>Ячеек журнала</dt><dd>+{result.journalCells}</dd></div><div><dt>Оценок</dt><dd>+{result.grades}</dd></div></dl>{result.warnings.map((warning) => <p className={styles.error} key={warning}>{warning}</p>)}</div>}
      {error && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>}
      <footer><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Закрыть</button><button type="button" className={styles.primary} disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void importData(); }}>{busy ? "Добавляем данные…" : result?.warnings.length ? "Повторить наполнение" : "Добавить примеры"}</button></footer>
    </Modal>}
  </>;
};

export default DemoDataManager;

// src\components\DownloadButton\index.tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import ArrowIcon from "../ArrowIcon";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  name: string;
  onDownload(): void | Promise<void>;
  className?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}

const DownloadButton = ({ name, onDownload, className = "", compact = false }: Props) => {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const download = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try { await onDownload(); }
    catch { setError("Файл недоступен. Попробуйте ещё раз или попросите преподавателя загрузить его повторно."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <div className={styles.wrapper}>
    <button type="button" disabled={busy} className={`${styles.button} ${className}`} aria-label={`Скачать файл ${name}`} aria-busy={busy} onClick={download}><ArrowIcon direction="down" size={16} /><span>{busy ? "Подготавливаем…" : compact ? "Скачать" : name}</span></button>
    {error && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p>}
  </div>;
};

export default DownloadButton;

// src\components\Dropdown\index.tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import Select, { type SingleValue, type StylesConfig } from "react-select";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export interface DropdownOption { value: string; label: string }
export type DropdownVariant = "main" | "compact";

interface DropdownProps {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  options: DropdownOption[];
  onChange(value: string): void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  hideLabel?: boolean;
  variant?: DropdownVariant;
}

const createDropdownStyles = (variant: DropdownVariant): StylesConfig<DropdownOption, false> => {
  const main = variant === "main";
  const borderWidth = main ? 3 : 1;
  return {
    control: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      minHeight: main ? 46 : 36,
      padding: main ? "2px 8px" : "0 6px",
      borderWidth,
      borderTopWidth: main ? 0 : borderWidth,
      borderStyle: "solid",
      borderColor: state.isFocused && !state.menuIsOpen ? "var(--dropdown-accent)" : "var(--dropdown-border)",
      // The lower edge joins the menu. Keep this neutral even while focused/hovered.
      borderBottomColor: state.menuIsOpen ? "var(--dropdown-border)" : state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-accent)" : "var(--dropdown-border)",
      borderRadius: main ? "17px 17px 0 0" : state.menuIsOpen ? "8px 8px 0 0" : "8px",
      background: state.menuIsOpen || !state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-panel)" : "var(--dropdown-active)",
      boxShadow: "none",
      cursor: state.isDisabled ? "not-allowed" : "pointer",
      transition: "border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease",
      opacity: state.isDisabled ? .55 : 1,
      ":hover": {
        borderColor: state.menuIsOpen || state.isDisabled ? "var(--dropdown-border)" : "var(--dropdown-accent)",
        borderBottomColor: state.menuIsOpen || state.isDisabled ? "var(--dropdown-border)" : "var(--dropdown-accent)",
        background: state.menuIsOpen || state.isDisabled ? "var(--dropdown-panel)" : "var(--dropdown-active)",
      },
    }),
    valueContainer: (base) => ({ ...base, minWidth: 0, padding: main ? "2px 6px" : "0 4px" }),
    singleValue: (base) => ({ ...base, color: "var(--dropdown-text)", fontSize: main ? 13 : 12, lineHeight: 1.4 }),
    placeholder: (base) => ({ ...base, color: "var(--dropdown-muted)", fontSize: main ? 13 : 12, lineHeight: 1.4 }),
    menuPortal: (base) => ({ ...base, zIndex: 3500 }),
    menu: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      marginTop: 0,
      marginBottom: state.placement === "top" ? 6 : 0,
      overflow: "hidden",
      borderRight: `${borderWidth}px solid var(--dropdown-border)`,
      borderTop: state.placement === "top" ? `${borderWidth}px solid var(--dropdown-border)` : 0,
      borderBottom: `${borderWidth}px solid var(--dropdown-border)`,
      borderLeft: `${borderWidth}px solid var(--dropdown-border)`,
      borderRadius: state.placement === "top" ? "8px" : "0 0 8px 8px",
      background: "var(--dropdown-panel)",
      boxShadow: "0 18px 35px var(--dropdown-shadow)",
    }),
    menuList: (base, state) => ({ ...base, padding: main ? 6 : 4, maxHeight: Math.min(260, state.maxHeight), scrollbarWidth: "thin", scrollbarColor: "var(--dropdown-border) var(--dropdown-panel)" }),
    option: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      marginBottom: main ? 3 : 2,
      padding: main ? "9px 11px" : "7px 9px",
      border: `${main ? 2 : 1}px solid ${state.isSelected ? "var(--dropdown-panel)" : state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-accent)" : "transparent"}`,
      borderRadius: main ? 9 : 6,
      background: state.isSelected ? main ? "var(--dropdown-gradient)" : "var(--dropdown-active)" : state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-hover)" : "var(--dropdown-base)",
      color: state.isSelected ? main ? "var(--dropdown-on-accent)" : "var(--dropdown-accent)" : state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-text)" : "var(--dropdown-muted)",
      fontSize: main ? 13 : 12,
      lineHeight: 1.4,
      cursor: "pointer",
      ":active": { background: "var(--dropdown-active)", color: "var(--dropdown-text)" },
    }),
    dropdownIndicator: (base, state) => ({
      ...base,
      padding: main ? 8 : 5,
      color: state.isFocused ? "var(--dropdown-accent)" : "var(--dropdown-muted)",
      transform: state.selectProps.menuIsOpen ? "rotate(180deg)" : undefined,
      transition: "transform .15s ease",
      ":hover": { color: "var(--dropdown-accent)" },
    }),
    indicatorSeparator: () => ({ display: "none" }),
  };
};

// Kept as the default exported style configuration for existing consumers.
export const dropdownStyles = createDropdownStyles("compact");
const mainDropdownStyles = createDropdownStyles("main");

const Dropdown = ({ label, value, options, onChange, disabled = false, placeholder = "Выберите значение", className, hideLabel = false, variant = "compact" }: DropdownProps) => {
  const inputId = useId();
  return <div className={`${styles.field} ${className ?? ""}`}>
    <label className={hideLabel ? styles.visuallyHidden : undefined} htmlFor={inputId}>{label}</label>
    <Select<DropdownOption, false>
      inputId={inputId}
      aria-label={label}
      value={options.find((option) => option.value === value) ?? null}
      options={options}
      onChange={(option: SingleValue<DropdownOption>) => option && onChange(option.value)}
      styles={variant === "main" ? mainDropdownStyles : dropdownStyles}
      isDisabled={disabled}
      isSearchable={false}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      noOptionsMessage={() => "Нет доступных вариантов"}
      maxMenuHeight={260}
      minMenuHeight={80}
      menuPosition="fixed"
      menuPortalTarget={typeof document === "undefined" ? undefined : document.body}
    />
  </div>;
};

export default Dropdown;

// src\components\ErrorBoundary\index.tsx
import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { children: ReactNode }
interface State { hasError: boolean }

class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  state: State = { hasError: false };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(): State {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.state.hasError) return this.props.children;

    return <section className={styles.state} role="alert">
      <span className={styles.code}>Ошибка загрузки</span>
      <h1>Раздел временно недоступен</h1>
      <p>Попробуйте перейти в другой раздел или обновить страницу. При обновлении несохранённые изменения могут быть потеряны.</p>
      <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Обновить страницу</button>
    </section>;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

// src\components\FilePreview\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { formatFileSize, getFilePreviewFormat } from "../../domain/files";
import DownloadButton from "../DownloadButton";
import Modal from "../Modal";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const TEXT_LIMIT = 128 * 1024;
interface Props { name: string; blob: Blob; onDownload(): void | Promise<void>; onClose(): void }

const FilePreview = ({ name, blob, onDownload, onClose }: Props) => {
  const headingId = useId();
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const format = getFilePreviewFormat({ name, type: blob.type });
  const kind = format?.kind, mime = format?.mime;

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    let objectUrl = "";
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setUrl("");
    setText("");
    const prepare = async () => {
      try {
        if (!kind || !mime) throw new Error("Этот формат не поддерживает встроенный просмотр. Скачайте файл, чтобы открыть его в подходящей программе.");
        if (kind === "text") {
          const content = await blob.slice(0, TEXT_LIMIT).text();
          if (active) setText(content);
        } else {
          if (kind === "pdf" && await blob.slice(0, 5).text() !== "%PDF-") throw new Error("Не удалось распознать PDF. Попробуйте скачать оригинал или попросите преподавателя проверить файл.");
          if (!active) return;
          objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: mime }));
          setUrl(objectUrl);
        }
      } catch (failure) {
        if (active) setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : "Не удалось подготовить просмотр. Оригинал можно скачать.");
      } finally { if (active) setLoading(false); }
    };
    void prepare();
    return () => { active = false; if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); };
  }, [blob, kind, mime]);

  return <Modal labelledBy={headingId} initialFocusRef={closeRef} className={styles.preview} onClose={onClose}>
    <header className={styles.header}><div><span>Просмотр материала</span><h2 id={headingId}>{name}</h2><p>{formatFileSize(blob.size)} · Файл из локального хранилища</p></div><button ref={closeRef} type="button" className={styles.close} aria-label="Закрыть просмотр" title="Закрыть · Esc" onClick={onClose}>×</button></header>
    <div className={styles.content}>
      {loading ? <p className={styles.state} role="status">Подготавливаем просмотр…</p> : error ? <p className={styles.state} role="alert">{error}</p> : kind === "text" ? <>
        {blob.size > TEXT_LIMIT && <p className={styles.hint}>Показаны первые {formatFileSize(TEXT_LIMIT)}. Полный текст доступен в оригинальном файле.</p>}
        <pre className={styles.text} tabIndex={0} aria-label="Содержимое текстового материала">{text || "Файл пуст"}</pre>
      </> : kind === "image" && url ? <img className={styles.image} src={url} alt={name} onError={() => setError("Изображение не удалось открыть. Попробуйте скачать оригинал.")} /> : kind === "pdf" && url ? <object className={styles.pdf} data={url} type="application/pdf" tabIndex={0} title={`PDF: ${name}`} aria-label={`PDF: ${name}`}><p className={styles.state}>Браузер не поддерживает встроенный просмотр PDF. Скачайте файл кнопкой ниже.</p></object> : null}
    </div>
    <footer className={styles.footer}><span>{kind === "pdf" ? "Если PDF не отображается, скачайте оригинал. Просмотр зависит от браузера." : kind === "text" ? "Текст показан без выполнения разметки, в кодировке UTF-8." : "Оригинал не изменяется при просмотре."}</span><DownloadButton name={name} compact onDownload={onDownload} /></footer>
  </Modal>;
};

export default FilePreview;

.emptyState { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 210px; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; padding: 26px 18px; border: 1px dashed theme-alpha($color-text-secondary, .3); border-radius: 12px; color: $color-text-secondary; text-align: center; }
.emptyState strong { color: $color-text-light; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; }
.emptyState p { max-width: 460px; margin: 0; font-size: .72rem; line-height: 1.65; }
.emptyIcon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; margin-bottom: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: $color-accent-background-hover; color: $color-accent-hover; font-size: 1.45rem; }
.emptyState button { min-height: 38px; margin-top: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid theme-alpha($color-accent-primary, .3); background: $color-accent-background-hover; color: $color-accent-hover; font-size: .69rem; }
.emptyState button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: $color-accent-primary; background: $color-accent-primary; color: $color-on-accent; }

.error > span { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.error button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid theme-alpha($color-error, .3); background: transparent; color: $color-error; font-size: .64rem; }

.loading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-top: 18px; padding: 10px 0; color: $color-text-secondary; font-size: .73rem; }

// src\components\FileStorage\index.tsx
import { ChangeEvent, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { materialRepository, type StoredMaterial } from "../../data/materialRepository";
import { formatFileSize, MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE } from "../../domain/files";
import { matchesSearchText } from "../../domain/search";
import Checkbox from "../Checkbox";
import ConfirmDialog from "../ConfirmDialog";
import Dropdown from "../Dropdown";
import SearchField from "../SearchField";
import ArrowIcon from "../ArrowIcon";
import MaterialCard from "./MaterialCard";
import FilePreview from "../FilePreview";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface FileStorageProps {
  storageKey?: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  eyebrow?: string;
  emptyTitle?: string;
  emptyDescription?: string;
  readOnly?: boolean;
}

const FILE_CATEGORIES = ["Книга", "Конспект", "Сборник заданий", "Презентация", "Другое"];
const sameFile = (a: File, b: File) => a.name === b.name && a.size === b.size && a.lastModified === b.lastModified;

const FileStorage = ({
  storageKey = "cabinet",
  title = "Мои файлы",
  description = "Материалы сохраняются в этом браузере до подключения серверного хранилища.",
  eyebrow = "Локальное хранилище",
  emptyTitle,
  emptyDescription,
  readOnly = false,
}: FileStorageProps) => {
  const headingId = useId();
  const uploadId = useId();
  const descriptionId = useId();
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<StoredMaterial[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState("");
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [uploadOpen, setUploadOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFiles, setSelectedFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(FILE_CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState("Все");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<"date" | "name" | "size">("date");
  const [materialDescription, setMaterialDescription] = useState("");
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState<StoredMaterial | null>(null);
  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState<StoredMaterial | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [pinningId, setPinningId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const reloadRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const scopeVersion = useRef(0);
  const mutationLock = useRef(false);
  const busy = uploading || deleting || Boolean(pinningId);
  const emptyHeading = emptyTitle ?? (readOnly ? "Материалов пока нет" : "Загрузите первый файл");
  const emptyHint = emptyDescription ?? (readOnly ? "Когда преподаватель добавит материалы, они появятся в этом разделе." : "Конспекты, ведомости, презентации и учебные материалы");
  const hasFilters = categoryFilter !== "Все" || Boolean(query.trim());
  const visibleFiles = files
    .filter((file) => (categoryFilter === "Все" || (file.category ?? "Материал") === categoryFilter) && matchesSearchText([file.name, file.description, file.category, file.uploadedBy].filter(Boolean).join(" "), query))
    .sort((a, b) => Number(Boolean(b.pinned)) - Number(Boolean(a.pinned)) || (sort === "name" ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru-RU") : sort === "size" ? b.size - a.size : b.createdAt - a.createdAt));
  const availableCategories = ["Все", ...Array.from(new Set(files.map((file) => file.category ?? "Материал")))];
  const totalSize = files.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    let requestId = 0;
    scopeVersion.current += 1;
    mutationLock.current = false;
    setFiles([]);
    setLoadError("");
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    setSelectedFiles([]);
    setUploadOpen(false);
    setUploading(false);
    setDeleting(false);
    setPinningId(null);
    setPendingDelete(null);
    setPreviewFile(null);
    setCategoryFilter("Все");
    setQuery("");
    setMaterialDescription("");
    setPinned(false);
    const load = () => {
      const request = ++requestId;
      setLoading(true);
      setLoadError("");
      materialRepository.list(storageKey)
        .then((items) => { if (active && request === requestId) setFiles(items); })
        .catch(() => { if (active && request === requestId) setLoadError("Не удалось открыть материалы. Проверьте доступ к хранилищу браузера."); })
        .finally(() => { if (active && request === requestId) setLoading(false); });
    };
    reloadRef.current = load;
    load();
    const unsubscribe = materialRepository.subscribe(storageKey, load);
    return () => { active = false; scopeVersion.current += 1; unsubscribe(); reloadRef.current = () => {}; };
  }, [storageKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (categoryFilter !== "Все" && !files.some((file) => (file.category ?? "Материал") === categoryFilter)) setCategoryFilter("Все");
  }, [files, categoryFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (readOnly) { setUploadOpen(false); setPendingDelete(null); }
  }, [readOnly]);

  const resetFilters = () => { setQuery(""); setCategoryFilter("Все"); };
  const selectFiles = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const picked = Array.from(event.target.files ?? []);
    event.target.value = "";
    if (readOnly || busy || !picked.length) return;
    const valid = picked.filter((file) => file.size <= MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE);
    const rejected = picked.length - valid.length;
    setSelectedFiles((current) => [...current, ...valid.filter((file, index) => !current.some((existing) => sameFile(existing, file)) && valid.findIndex((other) => sameFile(other, file)) === index)]);
    setError(rejected ? "Файлы больше 25 МБ не добавлены: " + rejected + "." + (valid.length ? " Остальные готовы к загрузке." : " Выберите файлы меньшего размера.") : "");
    setMessage("");
  };

  const uploadFiles = async () => {
    if (readOnly || mutationLock.current || !selectedFiles.length) return;
    mutationLock.current = true;
    const version = scopeVersion.current;
    const queue = [...selectedFiles];
    setUploading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(queue.map(async (file) => {
        const storedFile: StoredMaterial = {
          id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: file.name, type: file.type, size: file.size,
          createdAt: Date.now(), blob: file, scope: storageKey, category,
          uploadedBy: "Преподаватель", description: materialDescription.trim() || undefined, pinned,
        };
        await materialRepository.save(storedFile);
      }));
      if (version !== scopeVersion.current) return;
      const failed = queue.filter((_, index) => results[index].status === "rejected");
      const saved = queue.length - failed.length;
      setSelectedFiles(failed);
      if (saved) {
        resetFilters();
        setMessage("Материалы добавлены: " + saved + ". Они доступны в этом разделе.");
        reloadRef.current();
      }
      if (failed.length) setError("Не удалось загрузить файлов: " + failed.length + ". Они остались в списке — повторите загрузку. Уже добавленные файлы повторно не загружаются.");
      else { setMaterialDescription(""); setPinned(false); setUploadOpen(false); }
    } finally {
      if (version === scopeVersion.current) { setUploading(false); mutationLock.current = false; }
    }
  };

  const deleteFile = async (id: string) => {
    const file = files.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!file || readOnly || mutationLock.current) return;
    mutationLock.current = true;
    const version = scopeVersion.current;
    setDeleting(true);
    setDeleteError("");
    try {
      await materialRepository.remove(id);
      if (version !== scopeVersion.current) return;
      setFiles((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
      setPendingDelete(null);
      setMessage("Материал удалён.");
      setError("");
      reloadRef.current();
    } catch {
      if (version === scopeVersion.current) setDeleteError("Не удалось удалить материал. Повторите попытку.");
    } finally {
      if (version === scopeVersion.current) { setDeleting(false); mutationLock.current = false; }
    }
  };

  const togglePinned = async (file: StoredMaterial) => {
    if (readOnly || mutationLock.current) return;
    mutationLock.current = true;
    const version = scopeVersion.current;
    setPinningId(file.id);
    setError("");
    try {
      const updated = await materialRepository.setPinned(file.id, !file.pinned);
      if (version !== scopeVersion.current) return;
      setFiles((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === file.id ? updated : item));
      setMessage(updated.pinned ? "Материал закреплён в начале списка." : "Материал откреплён.");
    } catch {
      if (version === scopeVersion.current) setError("Не удалось изменить закрепление материала. Повторите действие на карточке.");
    } finally {
      if (version === scopeVersion.current) { setPinningId(null); mutationLock.current = false; }
    }
  };

  return <section className={styles.storage} aria-labelledby={headingId}>
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <div><span className={styles.eyebrow}>{eyebrow}</span><h2 id={headingId}>{title}</h2><p>{description}</p></div>
      {!readOnly && <button type="button" className={styles.uploadButton} disabled={busy} aria-expanded={uploadOpen} aria-controls={uploadId} onClick={() => setUploadOpen((current) => !current)}><ArrowIcon direction="up" size={16} />{uploadOpen ? "Свернуть загрузку" : "Добавить материалы"}</button>}
    </header>

    {!readOnly && <div id={uploadId} hidden={!uploadOpen}>
      {uploadOpen && <div className={styles.uploadPanel}>
        <div className={styles.uploadHeading}><strong>Новые материалы</strong><span>Выберите файлы, заполните общие настройки и подтвердите загрузку.</span></div>
        <div className={styles.uploadFields}>
          <Dropdown label="Категория" disabled={busy} value={category} onChange={setCategory} options={FILE_CATEGORIES.map((item) => ({ value: item, label: item }))} />
          <label className={styles.descriptionField} htmlFor={descriptionId}>Описание · необязательно<input id={descriptionId} disabled={busy} value={materialDescription} placeholder="Чем полезны эти материалы" onChange={(event) => setMaterialDescription(event.target.value)} /></label>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.uploadOptions}><Checkbox label="Закрепить в начале списка" checked={pinned} disabled={busy} onChange={setPinned} /><span>Категория и описание применятся ко всем выбранным файлам.</span></div>
        <div className={styles.fileSelection}><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}>Выбрать файлы</button><span>До 25 МБ каждый · можно выбрать несколько</span></div>
        <input ref={inputRef} hidden disabled={busy} type="file" multiple accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.ppt,.pptx,.xls,.xlsx,.txt,.zip,.png,.jpg,.jpeg" aria-label="Файлы материалов" onChange={selectFiles} />
        {selectedFiles.length > 0 && <><ul className={styles.selectedFiles}>{selectedFiles.map((file, index) => <li key={file.name + ":" + file.lastModified + ":" + file.size}><div><strong>{file.name}</strong><span>{formatFileSize(file.size)}</span></div><button type="button" disabled={busy} aria-label={"Убрать файл " + file.name} onClick={() => setSelectedFiles((current) => current.filter((_, position) => position !== index))}>Убрать</button></li>)}</ul><div className={styles.uploadFooter}><span>Выбрано: {selectedFiles.length} · {formatFileSize(selectedFiles.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0))}</span><button type="button" disabled={busy} className={styles.uploadButton} onClick={() => { void uploadFiles(); }}>{uploading ? "Загружаем…" : "Загрузить материалы"}</button></div></>}
      </div>}
    </div>}

    {error && <div className={styles.error} role="alert"><span>{error}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => setError("")} aria-label="Скрыть сообщение об ошибке">Скрыть</button></div>}
    {message && <p className={styles.notice} role="status">{message}</p>}
    {loadError && <div className={styles.error} role="alert"><span>{loadError}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => reloadRef.current()}>Повторить загрузку</button></div>}
    {loading && <div className={styles.loading} role="status"><span className={styles.loadingDot} aria-hidden="true" />{files.length ? "Обновляем список материалов…" : "Загружаем материалы…"}</div>}

    {files.length > 0 && <>
      <div className={styles.libraryTools}><SearchField label="Поиск материалов" value={query} onChange={setQuery} placeholder="Название, описание или автор" /><Dropdown label="Порядок в списке" value={sort} onChange={(value) => setSort(value as typeof sort)} options={[{ value: "date", label: "Сначала новые" }, { value: "name", label: "По названию" }, { value: "size", label: "По размеру" }]} /></div>
      <div className={styles.categoryFilters} role="group" aria-label="Категории материалов">{availableCategories.map((item) => <button type="button" aria-pressed={categoryFilter === item} className={categoryFilter === item ? styles.categoryActive : ""} onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(item)} key={item}>{item}<span>{item === "Все" ? files.length : files.filter((file) => (file.category ?? "Материал") === item).length}</span></button>)}</div>
      <div className={styles.resultsSummary}><span>{hasFilters ? "Найдено: " + visibleFiles.length + " из " + files.length : "Материалов: " + files.length + " · " + formatFileSize(totalSize)}</span><span>{hasFilters ? <button type="button" onClick={resetFilters}>Сбросить фильтры</button> : "Закреплённые — в начале"}</span></div>
      {visibleFiles.length ? <div className={styles.fileList}>{visibleFiles.map((file) => <MaterialCard key={file.id} file={file} readOnly={readOnly} busy={busy} pinning={pinningId === file.id} onDownload={() => materialRepository.download(file)} onPreview={() => setPreviewFile(file)} onPin={() => { void togglePinned(file); }} onDelete={() => { setDeleteError(""); setPendingDelete(file); }} />)}</div> : <div className={styles.emptyState}><span className={styles.emptyIcon} aria-hidden="true">⌕</span><strong>Материалы не найдены</strong><p>Попробуйте другое название или покажите все категории.</p><button type="button" onClick={resetFilters}>Показать все материалы</button></div>}
    </>}

    {!loading && !loadError && files.length === 0 && <div className={styles.emptyState}><span className={styles.emptyIcon} aria-hidden="true">{readOnly ? "≡" : <ArrowIcon direction="up" size={22} />}</span><strong>{emptyHeading}</strong><p>{emptyHint}</p>{!readOnly && <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setUploadOpen(true); requestAnimationFrame(() => inputRef.current?.click()); }}>Выбрать первый файл</button>}</div>}
    {pendingDelete && !readOnly && <ConfirmDialog title="Удалить материал?" busy={deleting} error={deleteError} onCancel={() => setPendingDelete(null)} onConfirm={() => { void deleteFile(pendingDelete.id); }}><p><strong>{pendingDelete.name}</strong></p><p>Файл исчезнет из этого раздела. Восстановить его можно только повторной загрузкой.</p></ConfirmDialog>}
    {previewFile && <FilePreview key={previewFile.id} name={previewFile.name} blob={previewFile.blob} onDownload={() => materialRepository.download(previewFile)} onClose={() => setPreviewFile(null)} />}
  </section>;
};

export default FileStorage;

// src\components\FileStorage\MaterialCard\index.tsx
import type { StoredMaterial } from "../../../data/materialRepository";
import { formatFileSize, getFilePreviewFormat } from "../../../domain/files";
import DownloadButton from "../../DownloadButton";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  file: StoredMaterial;
  readOnly: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  pinning: boolean;
  onDownload(): void | Promise<void>;
  onPreview(): void;
  onPin(): void;
  onDelete(): void;
}

const MaterialCard = ({ file, readOnly, busy, pinning, onDownload, onPreview, onPin, onDelete }: Props) => {
  const extension = file.name.includes(".") ? file.name.split(".").pop()?.slice(0, 6) : "Файл";
  const date = new Date(file.createdAt);
  const hasDate = Number.isFinite(date.getTime());
  const canPreview = file.blob instanceof Blob && Boolean(getFilePreviewFormat({ name: file.name, type: file.blob.type }));
  return <article className={`${styles.card} ${file.pinned ? styles.pinned : ""}`}>
    <div className={styles.heading}>
      <span className={styles.fileType} aria-hidden="true">{extension || "Файл"}</span>
      <div className={styles.identity}><span className={styles.category}>{file.category ?? "Материал"}</span><h3 title={file.name}>{file.name}</h3></div>
    </div>
    {file.pinned && <span className={styles.pin}>Закреплено</span>}
    {file.description && <p className={styles.description}>{file.description}</p>}
    <dl className={styles.metadata}>
      <div><dt>Размер</dt><dd>{formatFileSize(file.size)}</dd></div>
      <div><dt>Добавлен</dt><dd>{hasDate ? <time dateTime={date.toISOString()}>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" })}</time> : "Дата не указана"}</dd></div>
    </dl>
    <p className={styles.author}>Добавил: <span>{file.uploadedBy ?? "Преподаватель"}</span></p>
    <div className={styles.actions}>
      {canPreview && <button type="button" className={styles.previewButton} onClick={onPreview} aria-label={`Просмотреть материал ${file.name}`}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 10s3-6 8-6 8 6 8 6-3 6-8 6-8-6-8-6Z" /><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="2.5" /></svg>Просмотр</button>}
      <DownloadButton name={file.name} compact className={styles.download} onDownload={onDownload} />
      {!readOnly && <div className={styles.manage}><button type="button" disabled={busy} aria-pressed={Boolean(file.pinned)} onClick={onPin}>{pinning ? "Сохраняем…" : file.pinned ? "Открепить" : "Закрепить"}</button><button type="button" disabled={busy} className={styles.deleteButton} onClick={onDelete}>Удалить</button></div>}
    </div>
  </article>;
};

export default MaterialCard;
