@container messenger (max-width: 720px) { .messages { padding: 8px 14px 58px; } .incoming, .outgoing { max-width: 90%; padding-right: 11px; padding-left: 11px; } .threadNav { padding: 0 12px; } }


// src\components\Messages\MessageThread\index.tsx
import { Fragment, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { MessageAttachment, StoredMessage } from "../../../data/messageStore";
import { downloadBlob } from "../../../domain/fileDownload";
import { matchesSearchText } from "../../../domain/search";
import { messageDayKey, messageDayLabel } from "../../../domain/messaging";
import useMessageAttachment from "../../../hooks/useMessageAttachment";
import Checkbox from "../../Checkbox";
import FilePreview from "../../FilePreview";
import MessageActionIcon from "../MessageActionIcon";
import MessageActionsMenu from "../MessageActionsMenu";
import MessageText from "../MessageText";
import ThreadSearch from "../ThreadSearch";
import ChatAttachments from "../ChatAttachments";
import MessageFileCard from "../MessageFileCard";
import MessageToast from "../MessageToast";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export interface ThreadPosition { top: number; followLatest: boolean }
interface Props { messages: StoredMessage[]; contactName: string; positions: Map<string, ThreadPosition>; positionKey: string; searchOpen: boolean; onSearchClose(): void; filesOpen: boolean; onFilesClose(): void; group: boolean; scrollRequest: number; attachmentScope: string; onDelete(messages: StoredMessage[]): void; onReply(message: StoredMessage): void; readOnly?: boolean }

const MessageThread = ({ messages, contactName, positions, positionKey, searchOpen, onSearchClose, filesOpen, onFilesClose, group, scrollRequest, attachmentScope, onDelete, onReply, readOnly = false }: Props) => {
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const initialPosition = useRef(positions.get(positionKey));
  const initialized = useRef(false);
  const followLatest = useRef(initialPosition.current?.followLatest ?? true);
  const previousLength = useRef(0);
  const previousRequest = useRef(scrollRequest);
  const [atBottom, setAtBottom] = useState(true);
  const [newCount, setNewCount] = useState(0);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [onlyFiles, setOnlyFiles] = useState(false);
  const [searchId, setSearchId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const searchIdRef = useRef(searchId);
  searchIdRef.current = searchId;
  const searchCriteria = useRef("");
  const [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ text: string; error?: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [jumpBack, setJumpBack] = useState<{ top: number; originId?: number } | null>(null);
  const [locatedId, setLocatedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const selectionAnchor = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const attachment = useMessageAttachment(attachmentScope);
  const { opening, preview } = attachment;
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState<{ id: number; x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const menuMessage = messages.find((message) => message.id === menu?.id);
  const messageRefs = useRef(new Map<number, HTMLDivElement>());
  useEffect(() => {
    const available = new Set(messages.map((message) => message.id));
    const remaining = selectedIds.filter((id) => available.has(id));
    if (remaining.length !== selectedIds.length) {
      setSelectedIds(remaining);
      if (!remaining.length) setSelectionMode(false);
    }
    if (selectionAnchor.current !== null && !available.has(selectionAnchor.current)) selectionAnchor.current = null;
    if (menu && !available.has(menu.id)) setMenu(null);
  }, [messages, selectedIds, menu]);
  const selected = messages.filter((message) => selectedIds.includes(message.id));
  const ownSelected = selected.filter((message) => !message.incoming);
  const clearSelection = () => { setSelectedIds([]); setSelectionMode(false); selectionAnchor.current = null; };
  const toggleSelection = (id: number, range = false) => {
    const anchor = messages.findIndex((message) => message.id === selectionAnchor.current);
    const target = messages.findIndex((message) => message.id === id);
    if (range && anchor >= 0 && target >= 0) setSelectedIds((ids) => [...new Set([...ids, ...messages.slice(Math.min(anchor, target), Math.max(anchor, target) + 1).map((message) => message.id)])]);
    else { setSelectedIds((ids) => ids.includes(id) ? ids.filter((value) => value !== id) : [...ids, id]); selectionAnchor.current = id; }
  };
  const goToMessage = useCallback((id: number, focus = true) => {
    const node = messageRefs.current.get(id), viewport = scrollRef.current;
    if (!node || !viewport) return;
    followLatest.current = false;
    const offset = node.getBoundingClientRect().top - viewport.getBoundingClientRect().top + viewport.scrollTop;
    viewport.scrollTop = Math.max(0, offset - Math.max(0, (viewport.clientHeight - node.offsetHeight) / 2));
    if (focus) { node.focus({ preventScroll: true }); setLocatedId(id); }
  }, []);
  const locateMessage = (id: number, originId?: number) => {
    if (!messageRefs.current.has(id)) return;
    setJumpBack((previous) => previous ?? { top: scrollRef.current?.scrollTop ?? 0, originId });
    goToMessage(id);
  };
  const returnToReading = () => {
    const viewport = scrollRef.current;
    if (!viewport || !jumpBack) return;
    viewport.scrollTop = jumpBack.top;
    const nearBottom = viewport.scrollHeight - viewport.scrollTop - viewport.clientHeight < 48;
    followLatest.current = nearBottom;
    positions.set(positionKey, { top: viewport.scrollTop, followLatest: nearBottom });
    setAtBottom(nearBottom);
    if (jumpBack.originId !== undefined) messageRefs.current.get(jumpBack.originId)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    setJumpBack(null); setLocatedId(null);
  };
  useEffect(() => { if (locatedId === null) return; const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setLocatedId(null), 1800); return () => window.clearTimeout(timer); }, [locatedId]);
  const searchMatches = useMemo(() => !searchOpen || (!query.trim() && !onlyFiles) ? [] : messages.filter((message) => (!onlyFiles || Boolean(message.attachments?.length)) && matchesSearchText([message.text, ...(message.attachments ?? []).map((file) => file.name)].join(" "), query)), [messages, searchOpen, query, onlyFiles]);
  const searchPosition = searchMatches.findIndex((message) => message.id === searchId);
  const moveSearch = (offset: number) => {
    if (!searchMatches.length) return;
    const index = (Math.max(0, searchPosition) + offset + searchMatches.length) % searchMatches.length;
    setSearchId(searchMatches[index].id); goToMessage(searchMatches[index].id, false);
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const criteria = JSON.stringify([searchOpen, query, onlyFiles]);
    const previous = criteria === searchCriteria.current ? searchMatches.find((message) => message.id === searchIdRef.current) : undefined;
    const target = previous ?? searchMatches.at(-1);
    setSearchId(target?.id ?? null);
    if (target && !previous) goToMessage(target.id, false);
    searchCriteria.current = criteria;
  }, [searchMatches, goToMessage, searchOpen, query, onlyFiles]);
  const copy = async (items: StoredMessage[]) => {
    const text = items.map((message) => [message.text, ...(message.attachments ?? []).map((file) => `📎 ${file.name}`)].filter(Boolean).join("\n")).join("\n\n");
    attachment.clearError();
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); setNotice({ text: items.length > 1 ? `Скопировано сообщений: ${items.length}` : "Сообщение скопировано" }); }
    catch { setNotice({ text: "Браузер не разрешил копирование. Можно выделить текст сообщения и нажать Ctrl / ⌘ + C.", error: true }); }
  };
  const openAttachment = (file: MessageAttachment, download = false) => { setNotice(null); void attachment.open(file, download); };

  const scrollToLatest = useCallback(() => {
    followLatest.current = true;
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
      positions.set(positionKey, { top: scrollRef.current.scrollTop, followLatest: true });
    }
    setAtBottom(true);
    setNewCount(0);
  }, [positions, positionKey]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!initialized.current) {
      initialized.current = true;
      if (initialPosition.current && !initialPosition.current.followLatest && scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollTop = initialPosition.current.top;
        const nearBottom = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight - scrollRef.current.scrollTop - scrollRef.current.clientHeight < 48;
        followLatest.current = nearBottom;
        setAtBottom(nearBottom);
      } else scrollToLatest();
    }
    else if (followLatest.current || scrollRequest !== previousRequest.current) scrollToLatest();
    else if (messages.length > previousLength.current) {
      const added = messages.length - previousLength.current;
      setNewCount((count) => count + added);
    }
    else if (messages.length < previousLength.current) setNewCount(0);
    previousLength.current = messages.length;
    previousRequest.current = scrollRequest;
  }, [messages, scrollRequest, scrollToLatest]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (followLatest.current && scrollRef.current) scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    });
    if (scrollRef.current) observer.observe(scrollRef.current);
    if (contentRef.current) observer.observe(contentRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return <div className={styles.frame} onKeyDown={(event) => {
    if (event.defaultPrevented || !event.currentTarget.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
    if (event.key === "Escape" && selectionMode) { event.preventDefault(); clearSelection(); }
    const editing = Boolean((event.target as HTMLElement).closest("input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]), textarea, [contenteditable=true]"));
    if (!selectionMode || editing) return;
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && (event.key.toLowerCase() === "a" || event.code === "KeyA")) { event.preventDefault(); setSelectedIds(messages.map((message) => message.id)); }
    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && (event.key.toLowerCase() === "c" || event.code === "KeyC") && selected.length && !window.getSelection()?.toString()) { event.preventDefault(); void copy(selected); }
    if (event.key === "Delete" && ownSelected.length && !readOnly) { event.preventDefault(); onDelete(ownSelected); }
  }}>
    {searchOpen && <ThreadSearch query={query} onQuery={setQuery} onlyFiles={onlyFiles} onOnlyFiles={() => setOnlyFiles((value) => !value)} count={searchMatches.length} position={Math.max(0, searchPosition)} onMove={moveSearch} onClose={() => { setQuery(""); setOnlyFiles(false); onSearchClose(); scrollRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }} />}
    {selectionMode && <div className={styles.selectionBar} role="toolbar" aria-label="Действия с выбранными сообщениями"><strong>Выбрано: {selected.length}</strong><button type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedIds(selected.length === messages.length ? [] : messages.map((message) => message.id))}>{selected.length === messages.length ? "Снять выбор" : "Выбрать все"}</button><button type="button" disabled={!selected.length} onClick={() => { void copy(selected); }}><MessageActionIcon name="copy" />Копировать</button><button type="button" disabled={!ownSelected.length || readOnly} onClick={() => onDelete(ownSelected)}><MessageActionIcon name="delete" />Удалить свои{ownSelected.length > 0 ? ` (${ownSelected.length})` : ""}</button><button type="button" onClick={clearSelection} aria-label="Завершить выбор"><MessageActionIcon name="close" /></button><small>Shift + клик — диапазон · Ctrl/⌘ + A — все · удаляются только ваши сообщения.</small></div>}
    {(attachment.error || notice) && <MessageToast text={attachment.error || notice!.text} error={Boolean(attachment.error || notice?.error)} onClose={() => { setNotice(null); attachment.clearError(); }} />}
    <div ref={scrollRef} className={styles.thread} tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="История сообщений" onScroll={(event) => {
      const element = event.currentTarget;
      const nearBottom = element.scrollHeight - element.scrollTop - element.clientHeight < 48;
      followLatest.current = nearBottom;
      positions.set(positionKey, { top: element.scrollTop, followLatest: nearBottom });
      setAtBottom(nearBottom);
      if (nearBottom) setNewCount(0);
    }}>
      <div ref={contentRef} className={`${styles.messages} ${selectionMode ? styles.selecting : ""}`}>
        {messages.length ? messages.map((message, index) => {
          const previous = messages[index - 1];
          const newDay = !previous || messageDayKey(previous) !== messageDayKey(message);
          const joined = !newDay && previous.incoming === message.incoming && (!group || !message.incoming) && Boolean(previous.sentAt && message.sentAt && Math.abs(Date.parse(message.sentAt) - Date.parse(previous.sentAt)) < 5 * 60_000);
          const original = message.replyTo === undefined ? undefined : messages.find((item) => item.id === message.replyTo);
          const summary = message.text || message.attachments?.[0]?.name || "Сообщение";
          return <Fragment key={message.id}>{newDay && <div className={styles.dayDivider}><span>{messageDayLabel(message)}</span></div>}<div ref={(node) => { if (node) messageRefs.current.set(message.id, node); else messageRefs.current.delete(message.id); }} tabIndex={-1} className={`${message.incoming ? styles.incoming : styles.outgoing} ${joined ? styles.joined : ""} ${selectedIds.includes(message.id) ? styles.selectedMessage : ""} ${searchOpen && searchId === message.id ? styles.searchResult : ""} ${locatedId === message.id ? styles.located : ""}`} onClick={(event) => {
            if ((event.target as HTMLElement).closest("button, a, input, label") || (!selectionMode && !event.shiftKey && window.getSelection()?.toString())) return;
            if (selectionMode || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey) { setSelectionMode(true); toggleSelection(message.id, event.shiftKey); }
            else setMenu({ id: message.id, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
          }} onContextMenu={(event) => { if (window.getSelection()?.toString()) return; event.preventDefault(); setMenu({ id: message.id, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }); }}>
            {selectionMode && <Checkbox checked={selectedIds.includes(message.id)} onChange={() => toggleSelection(message.id)} label={<span className={styles.srOnly}>{`Выбрать: ${summary.slice(0, 60)}`}</span>} />}
            <span className={styles.srOnly}>{message.incoming ? "Входящее сообщение" : "Ваше сообщение"}</span>
            {group && message.incoming && <span className={styles.sender}>Участник беседы</span>}
            {message.replyTo !== undefined && <button type="button" className={styles.quote} disabled={!original} onClick={() => locateMessage(message.replyTo!, message.id)}><strong>{original ? original.incoming ? group ? "Участник беседы" : contactName : "Вы" : "Сообщение удалено"}</strong><span>{original ? original.text.slice(0, 180) || original.attachments?.[0]?.name : "Цитата больше недоступна"}</span></button>}
            {message.text && <p><MessageText text={message.text} query={searchOpen ? query : ""} /></p>}
            {Boolean(message.attachments?.length) && <div className={styles.attachments}>{message.attachments!.map((file) => <MessageFileCard key={file.id} file={file} opening={opening} query={searchOpen ? query : ""} onOpen={(download) => openAttachment(file, download)} />)}</div>}
            <div className={styles.messageMeta}><time dateTime={message.sentAt} title={message.sentAt ? new Date(message.sentAt).toLocaleString("ru-RU") : "Время из сохранённой переписки; дата неизвестна"}>{message.time}</time><div className={styles.messageActions}><button type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={menu?.id === message.id} onClick={(event) => { const box = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect(); setMenu({ id: message.id, x: box.right - 196, y: box.bottom + 4 }); }} aria-label="Действия с сообщением" title="Действия с сообщением">•••</button></div></div>
          </div></Fragment>;
        }) : <div className={styles.empty}><strong>Начните общение</strong><span>{group ? "Подготовьте первое сообщение для участников беседы." : "Выбран только собеседник. Диалог появится в списке после отправки сообщения."}</span></div>}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div className={styles.threadNav}>{jumpBack && <button type="button" className={styles.returnButton} onClick={returnToReading} title="Вернуться к месту чтения"><MessageActionIcon name="back" />{jumpBack.originId !== undefined ? "К ответу" : "Назад"}</button>}{!atBottom && messages.length > 0 && <button type="button" className={styles.latest} onClick={() => { setJumpBack(null); scrollToLatest(); }}>К последним{newCount > 0 && <b>{newCount} новых</b>}<MessageActionIcon name="down" /></button>}</div>
    <p className={styles.srOnly} role="status">{newCount > 0 ? `Новых сообщений: ${newCount}. Можно перейти к последним сообщениям кнопкой под историей.` : ""}</p>
    {preview && <FilePreview name={preview.name} blob={preview.blob} onDownload={() => downloadBlob(preview.blob, preview.name)} onClose={attachment.closePreview} />}
    {filesOpen && <ChatAttachments messages={messages} scope={attachmentScope} name={contactName} onClose={onFilesClose} onLocate={(id) => { onFilesClose(); requestAnimationFrame(() => locateMessage(id)); }} />}
    {menu && menuMessage && <MessageActionsMenu x={menu.x} y={menu.y} onClose={() => setMenu(null)} returnFocus={() => messageRefs.current.get(menu.id)?.focus({ preventScroll: true })} actions={[
      { id: "reply", label: "Ответить", disabled: readOnly, run: () => onReply(menuMessage) },
      { id: "copy", label: "Копировать", run: () => { void copy([menuMessage]); } },
      { id: "select", label: "Выбрать", run: () => { setSelectionMode(true); selectionAnchor.current = menuMessage.id; setSelectedIds((ids) => ids.includes(menuMessage.id) ? ids : [...ids, menuMessage.id]); } },
      ...(!menuMessage.incoming ? [{ id: "delete" as const, label: "Удалить", disabled: readOnly, run: () => onDelete([menuMessage]) }] : []),
    ]} />}
  </div>;
};

export default MessageThread;

// src\components\Messages\MessageToast\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import MessageActionIcon from "../MessageActionIcon";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export default function MessageToast({ text, error = false, onClose }: { text: string; error?: boolean; onClose(): void }) {
  const closeRef = useRef(onClose);
  closeRef.current = onClose;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (error) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => closeRef.current(), 2800);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [text, error]);
  return <div className={`${styles.toast} ${error ? styles.error : ""}`} role={error ? "alert" : "status"}><span>{text}</span><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Скрыть уведомление"><MessageActionIcon name="close" /></button></div>;
}

// src\components\Messages\ThreadSearch\index.tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from "react";
import MessageActionIcon from "../MessageActionIcon";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { query: string; onQuery(value: string): void; onlyFiles: boolean; onOnlyFiles(): void; count: number; position: number; onMove(offset: number): void; onClose(): void }
export default function ThreadSearch({ query, onQuery, onlyFiles, onOnlyFiles, count, position, onMove, onClose }: Props) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => { inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, []);
  return <div className={styles.search} role="search" aria-label="Поиск в переписке" onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Escape") { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); onClose(); } }}>
    <label><MessageActionIcon name="search" /><input ref={inputRef} type="search" value={query} placeholder="Найти сообщение или файл" aria-label="Текст или название файла" title="Enter — предыдущее совпадение, Shift + Enter — следующее" onChange={(event) => onQuery(event.target.value)} onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); onMove(event.shiftKey ? 1 : -1); } }} /></label>
    <div className={styles.controls}><button type="button" className={styles.filesFilter} aria-pressed={onlyFiles} onClick={onOnlyFiles}><MessageActionIcon name="attach" />С файлами</button><span role="status" aria-live="polite">{count ? `${position + 1} из ${count}` : query.trim() || onlyFiles ? "Не найдено" : "Поиск по истории"}</span><button type="button" disabled={!count} onClick={() => onMove(-1)} aria-label="Предыдущее совпадение"><MessageActionIcon name="up" /></button><button type="button" disabled={!count} onClick={() => onMove(1)} aria-label="Следующее совпадение"><MessageActionIcon name="down" /></button><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Закрыть поиск"><MessageActionIcon name="close" /></button></div>
  </div>;
}

// src\components\Modal\index.tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { acquireBodyScrollLock } from "../../hooks/useBodyScrollLock";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface ActiveModal { element: HTMLDivElement; layer: number }
const activeModals: ActiveModal[] = [];
let outsideFocus: HTMLElement | null = null;
const focusableSelector = 'button, input, textarea, select, a[href], iframe, [tabindex]';
const getFocusable = (element: HTMLElement) => Array.from(element.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(focusableSelector))
  .filter((item) => !item.matches(":disabled") && item.tabIndex >= 0 && !item.closest('[inert], [aria-hidden="true"]') && item.getClientRects().length > 0);
const getTopModal = () => activeModals.reduce<ActiveModal | undefined>((top, modal) => !top || modal.layer >= top.layer ? modal : top, undefined);

interface ModalProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  labelledBy: string;
  onClose(): void;
  initialFocusRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  className?: string;
  layer?: number;
}

const Modal = ({ children, labelledBy, onClose, initialFocusRef, className = "", layer }: ModalProps) => {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    const releaseScrollLock = acquireBodyScrollLock();
    const previousFocus = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
    if (!activeModals.length) {
      outsideFocus = previousFocus;
    }
    const modal = { element: dialog, layer: layer ?? 1000 };
    activeModals.push(modal);
    if (getTopModal() === modal) {
      const focusable = getFocusable(dialog);
      const preferred = initialFocusRef?.current;
      (preferred && focusable.includes(preferred) ? preferred : focusable[0] ?? dialog).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }

    return () => {
      const wasTop = getTopModal() === modal;
      const index = activeModals.indexOf(modal);
      if (index !== -1) activeModals.splice(index, 1);
      releaseScrollLock();
      const next = getTopModal();
      if (!next) {
        const restore = previousFocus?.isConnected ? previousFocus : outsideFocus;
        outsideFocus = null;
        if (restore?.isConnected) restore.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } else if (wasTop) {
        const restore = previousFocus?.isConnected && next.element.contains(previousFocus) ? previousFocus : getFocusable(next.element)[0] ?? next.element;
        restore.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    };
  }, [initialFocusRef, layer]);

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    // Portalled calendars and dropdowns manage their own focus and Escape.
    if (event.defaultPrevented || getTopModal()?.element !== dialogRef.current || !event.currentTarget.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      onClose();
      return;
    }
    if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
    const focusable = dialogRef.current ? getFocusable(dialogRef.current) : [];
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (!first) { event.preventDefault(); dialogRef.current?.focus(); return; }
    if (!focusable.includes(document.activeElement as HTMLElement)) { event.preventDefault(); (event.shiftKey ? last : first).focus(); return; }
    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { event.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  };

  return createPortal(
    <div className={styles.overlay} style={layer === undefined ? undefined : { zIndex: layer }} role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget && getTopModal()?.element === dialogRef.current) onClose(); }}>
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions -- The dialog contains keyboard focus and handles Escape. */}
      <div ref={dialogRef} tabIndex={-1} className={`${styles.dialog} ${className}`} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={labelledBy} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
};

export default Modal;

// src\components\MyGroup\index.tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getAcademicGroup } from "../../data/academicCatalog";
import { getGroupStudentProfiles } from "../../data/studentProfiles";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const MyGroup = () => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const groupId = currentUser.memberships[0]?.groupIds[0];
  const group = getAcademicGroup(groupId);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const members = useMemo(() => getGroupStudentProfiles(group?.name ?? ""), [group?.name]);
  const visible = members.filter((member) => member.name.toLocaleLowerCase("ru-RU").includes(query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru-RU")));
  const countWord = members.length % 10 === 1 && members.length % 100 !== 11 ? "студент" : members.length % 10 >= 2 && members.length % 10 <= 4 && (members.length % 100 < 12 || members.length % 100 > 14) ? "студента" : "студентов";

  return <section className={styles.group} aria-labelledby="my-group-title">
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <div><span className={styles.eyebrow}>Одногруппники</span><h2 id="my-group-title">Моя группа · {group?.name ?? "—"}</h2><p>Профили и личные сообщения студентам вашей группы.</p></div>
      <strong>{members.length} {countWord}</strong>
    </header>
    {members.length > 0 && <label className={styles.search}>Поиск по группе<input type="search" value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Имя или фамилия" /></label>}
    <div className={styles.list}>
      {visible.map((member) => <article className={styles.member} key={member.id}>
        <span className={styles.avatar} aria-hidden="true">{member.initials}</span>
        <div className={styles.identity}><strong>{member.name}{member.id === currentUser.id && <small> · это вы</small>}</strong><span>{member.email}</span></div>
        <div className={styles.actions}><Link to={`/students/${member.id}`}>Профиль</Link>{member.id !== currentUser.id && <Link className={styles.message} to={`/messages?student=${member.id}`}>Написать</Link>}</div>
      </article>)}
      {!visible.length && <p className={styles.empty}>{members.length ? "По вашему запросу никого не найдено." : "Список группы пока не загружен."}</p>}
    </div>
  </section>;
};

export default MyGroup;

// src\components\Navigation\index.tsx
import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useLocation, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import {
  HomeIcon,
  ScheduleIcon,
  CabinetIcon,
  JournalIcon,
  PlannerIcon,
  StatsIcon,
  LogoIcon,
  MessagesIcon,
  NotificationsIcon,
} from "./icons";
import RoleSwitcher from "../RoleSwitcher";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import { useNotificationSummary } from "../Notifications/useNotifications";
import { useTheme } from "../ThemeContext";

const NotificationsPopup = lazy(() => import("../Notifications/Popup"));

export default function Nav() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { role } = useRole();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const { total: notificationCount, unread: unreadNotifications, error: notificationError } = useNotificationSummary();
  const showNotifications = notificationCount > 0 || Boolean(notificationError);
  const [notificationsOpen, setNotificationsOpen] = useState(false);
  const notificationButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const notificationId = useId();
  const [, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const consumedLocation = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const closeNotifications = useCallback(() => setNotificationsOpen(false), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showNotifications) setNotificationsOpen(false);
  }, [showNotifications]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if (params.get("notifications") === "open") {
      setNotificationsOpen(notificationButtonRef.current !== null);
      params.delete("notifications");
      const search = params.toString();
      consumedLocation.current = `${location.pathname}${search ? `?${search}` : ""}${location.hash}`;
      setSearchParams(params, { replace: true });
      return;
    }
    const nextLocation = `${location.pathname}${location.search}${location.hash}`;
    if (consumedLocation.current === nextLocation) { consumedLocation.current = null; return; }
    consumedLocation.current = null;
    setNotificationsOpen(false);
  }, [location, role, setSearchParams]);

  const teacherItems = [
    { to: "/", label: "Главная", Icon: HomeIcon },
    { to: "/schedule", label: "Расписание", Icon: ScheduleIcon },
    { to: "/planner", label: "Планировщик", Icon: PlannerIcon },
    { to: "/journal", activePath: "/journal", label: "Журнал", Icon: JournalIcon },
    { to: "/stats", label: "Статистика", Icon: StatsIcon },
    { to: "/messages", label: "Сообщения", Icon: MessagesIcon },
  ];
  const studentItems = [
    { to: "/", label: "Главная", Icon: HomeIcon },
    { to: "/schedule", label: "Расписание", Icon: ScheduleIcon },
    { to: "/journal", activePath: "/journal", label: "Журнал", Icon: JournalIcon },
    { to: "/messages", label: "Сообщения", Icon: MessagesIcon },
  ];
  const navItems = role === "student" ? studentItems : teacherItems;
  const cabinetItem = { to: "/cabinet", label: role === "student" ? "Профиль" : "Кабинет", Icon: CabinetIcon };

  const renderItem = (item: typeof cabinetItem) => {
    const isActive = location.pathname === item.to || ("activePath" in item && location.pathname.startsWith(String(item.activePath)));
    return <li key={item.to} className={`${styles.navItem} ${isActive && item.to !== cabinetItem.to ? styles.active : ""}`}><Link to={item.to} className={styles.navLink} aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}><item.Icon className={styles.icon} aria-hidden="true"/><span className={styles.text}>{item.label}</span></Link></li>;
  };

  return (
    <nav className={styles.sidebarNav} aria-label="Основные разделы">
      <div className={styles.navHeader}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.themeToggle}
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          aria-label={theme === "dark" ? "Включить светлую тему" : "Включить тёмную тему"}
          aria-pressed={theme === "light"}
          title={theme === "dark" ? "Светлая тема" : "Тёмная тема"}
        >
          <LogoIcon className={styles.logoImage} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <ul className={styles.navList}>{navItems.map(renderItem)}</ul>
      <div className={styles.bottomNav}>
        <RoleSwitcher />
        <div className={`${styles.profileRow} ${location.pathname === cabinetItem.to ? styles.profileActive : ""}`}>
          <ul className={styles.navList}>{renderItem(cabinetItem)}</ul>
          {showNotifications && <button ref={notificationButtonRef} type="button" className={`${styles.notificationsButton} ${notificationsOpen ? styles.notificationsOpen : ""}`} aria-label={notificationError ? "Уведомления недоступны — открыть восстановление чтения" : unreadNotifications ? `Уведомления: ${unreadNotifications} непрочитанных` : "Уведомления — всё прочитано"} aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={notificationsOpen} aria-controls={notificationsOpen ? notificationId : undefined} onClick={() => setNotificationsOpen((open) => !open)} title={notificationError ? "Ошибка чтения уведомлений" : "Уведомления"}>
            <NotificationsIcon aria-hidden="true" />
            {notificationError ? <span className={styles.badge} aria-hidden="true">!</span> : unreadNotifications > 0 && <span className={styles.badge} aria-hidden="true">{unreadNotifications > 99 ? "99+" : unreadNotifications}</span>}
          </button>}
        </div>
      </div>
      {showNotifications && notificationsOpen && <Suspense fallback={null}><NotificationsPopup key={role} id={notificationId} anchorRef={notificationButtonRef} onClose={closeNotifications} /></Suspense>}
    </nav>
  );
}

// src\components\Notifications\index.tsx
import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { type AppNotification, readNotificationState, saveNotifications } from "../../data/notificationStore";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import SearchField from "../SearchField";
import Dropdown from "../Dropdown";
import { matchesSearchText } from "../../domain/search";
import NotificationItem, { notificationKindLabels } from "./NotificationItem";
import { useNotificationItems } from "./useNotifications";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

type NotificationFilter = "all" | "unread";
type NotificationDayGroup = { label: string; items: AppNotification[] };
const dayFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" });
const yearDayFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" });
const dayKey = (date: Date) => `${date.getFullYear()}-${date.getMonth()}-${date.getDate()}`;
const dayLabel = (date: Date, now: Date) => {
  if (dayKey(date) === dayKey(now)) return "Сегодня";
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
  if (dayKey(date) === dayKey(yesterday)) return "Вчера";
  return (date.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() ? dayFormat : yearDayFormat).format(date);
};

interface Props { compact?: boolean; onNavigate?(): void }

const Notifications = ({ compact = false, onNavigate }: Props) => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const [items, setItems, readError, refreshItems] = useNotificationItems();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<NotificationFilter>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<"all" | AppNotification["kind"]>("all");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const searchId = useId();
  const filtersRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const restoreFilterFocus = () => requestAnimationFrame(() => filtersRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('button[aria-pressed="true"]')?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
  const userItems = useMemo(() => items.filter((item) => item.recipientUserId === currentUser.id).sort((left, right) => Date.parse(right.createdAt) - Date.parse(left.createdAt)), [currentUser.id, items]);
  const unreadCount = userItems.filter((item) => !item.read).length;
  const visible = userItems.filter((item) => (filter !== "unread" || !item.read) && (kind === "all" || kind === item.kind) && matchesSearchText(`${item.title} ${item.body} ${notificationKindLabels[item.kind]}`, query));
  const searching = Boolean(query.trim() || kind !== "all");
  const now = new Date();
  const groups = new Map<string, NotificationDayGroup>();
  visible.forEach((item) => {
    const date = new Date(item.createdAt);
    const key = dayKey(date);
    const group: NotificationDayGroup = groups.get(key) ?? { label: dayLabel(date, now), items: [] };
    group.items.push(item);
    groups.set(key, group);
  });
  const resetFilters = () => { setQuery(""); setKind("all"); setFilter("all"); restoreFilterFocus(); };
  const toggleSearch = () => {
    if (searchOpen) setQuery("");
    else requestAnimationFrame(() => searchRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("input")?.focus());
    setSearchOpen((open) => !open);
  };

  const persist = (next: AppNotification[]) => {
    setError(""); setMessage("");
    try { saveNotifications(next); setItems(next); return true; }
    catch { refreshItems(); setError("Не удалось сохранить статус прочтения. Попробуйте ещё раз — уведомления не изменены."); return false; }
  };
  const markRead = (id: string) => {
    const snapshot = readNotificationState();
    if (snapshot.error) { refreshItems(); setError(snapshot.error); return false; }
    const latest = snapshot.items;
    const target = latest.find((item) => item.id === id && item.recipientUserId === currentUser.id);
    if (!target) { setItems(latest); setError("Это уведомление больше недоступно. Список обновлён."); return false; }
    if (target.read) return true;
    return persist(latest.map((item) => item.id === id && item.recipientUserId === currentUser.id ? { ...item, read: true } : item));
  };
  const markAllRead = () => {
    const snapshot = readNotificationState();
    if (snapshot.error) { refreshItems(); setError(snapshot.error); return; }
    if (persist(snapshot.items.map((item) => item.recipientUserId === currentUser.id ? { ...item, read: true } : item))) {
      setMessage("Уведомления отмечены прочитанными."); restoreFilterFocus();
    }
  };
  const markSingleRead = (id: string) => {
    if (markRead(id)) { setMessage("Уведомление отмечено прочитанным."); restoreFilterFocus(); }
  };

  return <section className={`${styles.panel} ${compact ? styles.compact : ""}`}>
    <div className={styles.tools}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          {!compact && <><span className={styles.eyebrow}>События кабинета</span><h2>Последние уведомления</h2></>}
          <p className={styles.summary}><span className={`${styles.summaryIcon} ${readError ? styles.summaryError : unreadCount ? styles.hasUnread : ""}`} aria-hidden="true">{readError ? "!" : unreadCount ? "" : "✓"}</span>{readError ? "История уведомлений недоступна" : unreadCount ? `Новых: ${unreadCount}` : userItems.length ? "Всё прочитано" : "Новых событий пока нет"}</p>
        </div>
        {unreadCount > 0 && <button className={styles.readAll} type="button" disabled={Boolean(readError)} onClick={markAllRead}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m2 10 4 4 8-8m-4 7 2 2 7-8" /></svg>Прочитать все</button>}
      </header>

      {userItems.length > 0 && <>
        <div className={styles.toolbar}>
          <div ref={filtersRef} className={styles.filters} role="group" aria-label="Фильтр уведомлений">
            <button type="button" className={filter === "all" ? styles.activeFilter : ""} aria-pressed={filter === "all"} onClick={() => setFilter("all")}>Все <span>{userItems.length}</span></button>
            <button type="button" className={filter === "unread" ? styles.activeFilter : ""} aria-pressed={filter === "unread"} onClick={() => setFilter("unread")}>Непрочитанные <span>{unreadCount}</span></button>
          </div>
          {compact && <button type="button" className={`${styles.searchToggle} ${searchOpen ? styles.searchActive : ""}`} aria-label={searchOpen ? "Закрыть поиск уведомлений" : "Найти уведомление"} title={searchOpen ? "Закрыть поиск" : "Поиск уведомлений"} aria-expanded={searchOpen} aria-controls={searchOpen ? searchId : undefined} onClick={toggleSearch}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true">{searchOpen ? <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" /> : <><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="5.5" /><path d="m13 13 4 4" /></>}</svg></button>}
        </div>
        {(!compact || searchOpen) && <div id={searchId} ref={searchRef} className={`${styles.searchTools} ${compact ? styles.compactSearch : ""}`}><SearchField label="Поиск уведомлений" placeholder="Название, событие или комментарий" value={query} onChange={setQuery} />{!compact && <Dropdown label="Тип события" value={kind} onChange={(value) => setKind(value as typeof kind)} options={[{ value: "all", label: "Все события" }, ...Object.entries(notificationKindLabels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }))]} />}</div>}
      </>}
      {(readError || error) && <div className={styles.error} role="alert"><span>{readError || error}</span>{readError && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setError(""); setMessage(""); refreshItems(); }}>Повторить чтение</button>}</div>}
      <p className={styles.srOnly} role="status">{message}</p>
      {searching && <p className={styles.searchResult} role="status">Найдено: {visible.length}</p>}
    </div>

    <div className={styles.list}>
      {visible.length ? Array.from(groups, ([key, group]) => <section className={styles.dayGroup} key={key} aria-label={group.label}><h3 className={styles.dayHeading}>{group.label}<span>{group.items.length}</span></h3><ul>{group.items.map((item) => <NotificationItem key={item.id} item={item} readOnly={Boolean(readError)} onRead={markRead} onMarkRead={markSingleRead} onNavigate={onNavigate} />)}</ul></section>) : !readError && <div className={styles.empty}>
        <span className={styles.emptyIcon} aria-hidden="true">{searching ? "⌕" : "✓"}</span>
        <strong>{searching ? "Ничего не найдено" : filter === "unread" ? "Всё прочитано" : "Здесь пока тихо"}</strong>
        <p>{searching ? "Попробуйте другое название или сбросьте фильтры." : filter === "unread" ? "Новых уведомлений нет. Прочитанные события доступны во вкладке «Все»." : "Новые задания, ответы и изменения расписания появятся здесь."}</p>
        {(searching || filter === "unread") && userItems.length > 0 && <button type="button" onClick={resetFilters}>Показать все уведомления</button>}
      </div>}
    </div>
    {userItems.length > 0 && <footer className={styles.footer}>{readError ? "Показан последний доступный список. Статусы не изменяются, пока чтение не восстановится." : "Открытие события отмечает его прочитанным."}</footer>}
  </section>;
};

export default Notifications;


// src\components\Notifications\NotificationItem\index.module.scss
@use "../../../styles/variables" as *;

.row { position: relative; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid $color-border; border-radius: 10px; background: $color-dark-secondary; transition: background-color $transition-speed, border-color $transition-speed; }
.row:hover { border-color: theme-alpha($color-text-secondary, .45); background-image: linear-gradient($color-ghost, $color-ghost); }
.unread { border-color: theme-alpha($color-accent-primary, .23); background: theme-alpha($color-accent-primary, .045); }
.link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; min-width: 0; padding: 13px 12px; border-radius: 9px; color: $color-text-light; text-decoration: none; }
.link:focus-visible { outline-offset: -3px; }
.icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; background: $color-ghost; color: $color-text-secondary; }

// src\components\Notifications\NotificationItem\index.tsx
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import type { AppNotification } from "../../../data/notificationStore";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export const notificationKindLabels: Record<AppNotification["kind"], string> = {
  assignment: "Задание", submission: "Ответ", grade: "Оценка", revision: "Доработка", schedule: "Расписание",
};

const actionLabels: Record<AppNotification["kind"], string> = {
  assignment: "Открыть задание", submission: "Посмотреть ответ", grade: "Посмотреть оценку", revision: "Посмотреть замечания", schedule: "Открыть расписание",
};
const timeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
const fullDateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", { dateStyle: "long", timeStyle: "short" });

interface Props {
  item: AppNotification;
  onRead(id: string): boolean;
  onMarkRead(id: string): void;
  onNavigate?(): void;
  readOnly?: boolean;
}

const EventIcon = ({ kind }: { kind: AppNotification["kind"] }) => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
  {kind === "assignment" && <><path d="M14 3H6a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v16a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V8Z" /><path d="M14 3v5h5M8 12h8M8 16h5" /></>}
  {kind === "submission" && <><path d="M4 14v5h16v-5M12 3v11M8 10l4 4 4-4" /></>}
  {kind === "grade" && <><path d="m12 3 2.8 5.7 6.2.9-4.5 4.4 1.1 6.2-5.6-3-5.6 3 1.1-6.2L3 9.6l6.2-.9Z" /></>}
  {kind === "revision" && <><path d="M4 10a8 8 0 1 1 2 8M4 4v6h6" /><path d="M12 7v5l3 2" /></>}
  {kind === "schedule" && <><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="16" rx="2" /><path d="M8 3v4M16 3v4M4 11h16M8 15h2M14 15h2M8 18h2" /></>}
</svg>;

const ReadIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 10s3-5.5 8-5.5 8 5.5 8 5.5-3 5.5-8 5.5S2 10 2 10Z" /><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="2.3" /></svg>;

const NotificationItem = ({ item, onRead, onMarkRead, onNavigate, readOnly = false }: Props) => {
  const date = new Date(item.createdAt);
  return <li className={`${styles.row} ${!item.read ? styles.unread : ""}`}>
    <Link className={styles.link} to={item.href} onClick={(event) => {
      if (!onRead(item.id)) { event.preventDefault(); return; }
      if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) onNavigate?.();
    }}>
      <span className={`${styles.icon} ${styles[item.kind]}`}><EventIcon kind={item.kind} /></span>
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <div className={styles.meta}><span>{notificationKindLabels[item.kind]}</span><time dateTime={item.createdAt} title={fullDateFormat.format(date)}>{timeFormat.format(date)}</time></div>
        <strong>{!item.read && <span className={styles.unreadDot} role="img" aria-label="Непрочитанное" />}{item.title}</strong>
        {item.body && <p>{item.body}</p>}
        <span className={styles.action}>{actionLabels[item.kind]}<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10h13m-5-5 5 5-5 5" /></svg></span>
      </div>
    </Link>
    {!item.read && <div className={styles.readAction}>
      <button type="button" disabled={readOnly} onClick={() => onMarkRead(item.id)} aria-label={`Отметить прочитанным: ${item.title}`} title={readOnly ? "Сначала восстановите чтение уведомлений" : "Отметить прочитанным"}><ReadIcon /></button>
    </div>}
  </li>;
};

export default NotificationItem;

// src\components\Notifications\Popup\index.tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import Modal from "../../Modal";
import Notifications from "..";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  id: string;
  anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}

const NotificationsPopup = ({ id, anchorRef, onClose }: Props) => {
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState(() => window.innerWidth <= 760);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ left: 12, top: 12, maxHeight: window.innerHeight - 24 });

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setMobile(window.innerWidth <= 760);
      const rect = anchorRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;
      const width = Math.min(460, window.innerWidth - 24);
      const maxHeight = Math.min(640, window.innerHeight - 24);
      const left = rect.right + width + 24 <= window.innerWidth ? rect.right + 12 : rect.left - width - 12;
      setPosition({ left: Math.max(12, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - width - 12)), top: Math.max(12, Math.min(rect.top, window.innerHeight - maxHeight - 12)), maxHeight });
    };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, true);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("resize", update); window.removeEventListener("scroll", update, true); };
  }, [anchorRef]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (mobile) return;
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    const outside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!panelRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node) && !anchorRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) onClose();
    };
    const escape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && !event.defaultPrevented) { event.preventDefault(); onClose(); }
    };
    const focusOutside = (event: FocusEvent) => {
      if (!panelRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node) && !anchorRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", escape);
    document.addEventListener("focusin", focusOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", escape);
      document.removeEventListener("focusin", focusOutside);
      if (panelRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement) || document.activeElement === document.body) anchorRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    };
  }, [mobile, anchorRef, onClose]);

  const content = <><header className={styles.heading}><h2 id={`${id}-title`}>Уведомления</h2><button ref={closeRef} type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Закрыть уведомления"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" /></svg></button></header><Notifications compact onNavigate={onClose} /></>;
  if (mobile) return <Modal labelledBy={`${id}-title`} onClose={onClose} initialFocusRef={closeRef} className={styles.mobilePanel}><div id={id} className={styles.mobileBody}>{content}</div></Modal>;
  return createPortal(<div id={id} ref={panelRef} role="dialog" aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`} className={styles.panel} style={position}>{content}</div>, document.body);
};

export default NotificationsPopup;


// src\components\Notifications\useNotifications.ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { readNotificationState, refreshNotifications, subscribeNotifications } from "../../data/notificationStore";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";

export const useNotificationItems = () => {
  const [initialSnapshot] = useState(readNotificationState);
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initialSnapshot.items);
  const [error, setError] = useState(initialSnapshot.error);
  const refresh = useCallback(() => {
    const snapshot = readNotificationState();
    setError(snapshot.error);
    // A temporary failure must not replace the last readable list with a demo fallback.
    if (!snapshot.error) setItems(snapshot.items);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { const unsubscribe = subscribeNotifications(refresh); refreshNotifications(); return unsubscribe; }, [refresh]);
  return [items, setItems, error, refreshNotifications] as const;
};

// Navigation only needs counts, not the popup UI.
export const useNotificationSummary = () => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const [items, , error] = useNotificationItems();
  const userItems = items.filter((item) => item.recipientUserId === currentUser.id);
  return { total: userItems.length, unread: userItems.filter((item) => !item.read).length, error };
};

export const useUnreadNotifications = () => useNotificationSummary().unread;

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";

const FILTERS = [["all", "Все"], ["active", "Активные"], ["study", "Учебные"], ["personal", "Личные"], ["completed", "Готово"]] as const;
type TaskFilter = typeof FILTERS[number][0];
const VIEWS = ["board", "list"] as const;
const VIEW_KEY = "bi-university-planner-view";
const matchesFilter = (note: PlannerNote, filter: TaskFilter) => filter === "all" || (filter === "active" ? !note.completed : filter === "completed" ? note.completed : note.category === filter);

interface PlannerProps {
  selectedWeekStart: Date;
  selectedDate?: Date;
  selectedTaskId?: string | null;
  onClearTask?(): void;
  onSaved?(note: PlannerNote): void;
}

const Planner = ({ selectedWeekStart, selectedDate, selectedTaskId, onClearTask, onSaved }: PlannerProps) => {
  const { notes, setNotes, refreshNotes, error: storageError } = usePlannerNotes();
  const [editingNote, setEditingNote] = useState<PlannerNote | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<TaskFilter>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [deletedNote, setDeletedNote] = useState<PlannerNote | null>(null);
  const [saveMessage, setSaveMessage] = useState("");
  const [completionMessage, setCompletionMessage] = useState("");
  const [view, changeView] = useViewPreference(VIEW_KEY, VIEWS, "board");
  const requestedNote = selectedTaskId ? notes.find((note) => note.id === selectedTaskId) : undefined;
  const handledTaskId = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedTaskId) { handledTaskId.current = null; return; }
    if (requestedNote && handledTaskId.current !== selectedTaskId) {
      handledTaskId.current = selectedTaskId;
      setEditingNote(requestedNote);
    }
  }, [selectedTaskId, requestedNote]);
  const activeNote = editingNote;
  const closeForm = () => { setEditingNote(null); refreshNotes(); onClearTask?.(); };
  const gridRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dragScroll = useDragScroll(gridRef, { axis: "x", enabled: view === "board", resetKey: toLocalDateKey(selectedWeekStart) });
  const selectedKey = selectedDate ? toLocalDateKey(selectedDate) : "";
  const [focusedDay, setFocusedDay] = useState(selectedKey);
  useEffect(() => { setFocusedDay(selectedKey); }, [selectedKey]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (view !== "board") return;
    const grid = gridRef.current;
    const target = grid?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-date="${focusedDay}"]`);
    if (!grid || !target) return;
    const bounds = grid.getBoundingClientRect(), dayBounds = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (dayBounds.left < bounds.left) grid.scrollBy({ left: dayBounds.left - bounds.left, behavior: "auto" });
    else if (dayBounds.right > bounds.right) grid.scrollBy({ left: dayBounds.right - bounds.right, behavior: "auto" });
  }, [focusedDay, view]);

  const days = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => addDays(selectedWeekStart, index)),
    [selectedWeekStart],
  );
  const activeDay = days.find((day) => toLocalDateKey(day) === focusedDay) ?? days.find((day) => selectedDate && isSameDay(day, selectedDate)) ?? days[0];
  const selectDay = (day: Date) => {
    const key = toLocalDateKey(day);
    setFocusedDay(key);
    if (view === "list") gridRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-date="${key}"]`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "auto" });
  };

  const saveNote = (note: PlannerNote, original: PlannerNote) => {
    setSaveMessage("");
    let savedNote = note;
    const saved = setNotes((currentNotes) => {
      const latest = currentNotes.find((item) => item.id === note.id);
      if (note.id && !latest) throw new PlannerWriteError("Эта задача уже удалена. Текст оставлен в форме — можно скопировать его в новую задачу.");
      savedNote = latest ? mergePlannerDraft(original, note, latest) : { ...note, id: crypto.randomUUID() };
      return latest ? currentNotes.map((item) => item.id === note.id ? savedNote : item) : [...currentNotes, savedNote];
    });
    if (!saved) return;
    setEditingNote(null);
    setDeletedNote(null);
    const hiddenByFilters = !matchesFilter(savedNote, filter) || !matchesSearchText(`${savedNote.title} ${savedNote.text}`, query);
    if (hiddenByFilters) resetFilters();
    setFocusedDay(toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(savedNote)));
    if (onSaved) onSaved(savedNote); else onClearTask?.();
    setSaveMessage(`${note.id ? "Изменения сохранены" : "Задача добавлена"}${hiddenByFilters ? " · фильтры сброшены, чтобы показать задачу" : ""}`);
  };

  const createNoteForDay = (day: Date) => {
    onClearTask?.();
    setEditingNote(createPlannerNote(day));
  };

  const weekNotes = notes.filter((note) => days.some((day) => isSameDay(note.startAt ?? note.createdAt, day)));
  const searchedNotes = weekNotes.filter((note) => matchesSearchText(`${note.title} ${note.text}`, query));
  const filteredNotes = searchedNotes.filter((note) => matchesFilter(note, filter));
  const completedCount = weekNotes.filter((note) => note.completed).length;
  const hasFilters = filter !== "all" || Boolean(query.trim());
  const resetFilters = () => { setFilter("all"); setQuery(""); };
  const focusDayTask = (dayKey: string, preferredIds: string[] = [], revealCompleted = false) => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const day = gridRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-date="${dayKey}"]`);
    if (!day) return;
    const completed = day.querySelector<HTMLDetailsElement>("details");
    if (revealCompleted && completed) completed.open = true;
    const toggles = Array.from(day.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[data-task-toggle]")).filter((button) => button.getClientRects().length > 0);
    const preferred = preferredIds.map((id) => toggles.find((button) => button.dataset.taskToggle === id)).find(Boolean);
    (preferred ?? toggles[0] ?? day.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button"))?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });
  const toggleCompleted = (id: string) => {
    let changedNote = notes.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!setNotes((items) => {
      const latest = items.find((item) => item.id === id);
      if (!latest) throw new PlannerWriteError("Эта задача уже удалена. Обновите список, чтобы увидеть актуальные задачи.");
      const updated = { ...latest, completed: !latest.completed };
      changedNote = updated;
      return items.map((item) => item.id === id ? updated : item);
    })) return;
    if (!changedNote) return;
    setCompletionMessage(`${changedNote.completed ? "Выполнена" : "Возвращена в работу"}: «${changedNote.title}»`);
    focusDayTask(toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(changedNote)), [id]);
  };
  const deleteNote = (note: PlannerNote) => {
    const dayKey = toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(note));
    const toggles = Array.from(gridRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-date="${dayKey}"] [data-task-toggle]`) ?? []).filter((button) => button.getClientRects().length > 0);
    const index = toggles.findIndex((button) => button.dataset.taskToggle === note.id);
    const neighbours = [...toggles.slice(index + 1), ...toggles.slice(0, Math.max(0, index)).reverse()].map((button) => button.dataset.taskToggle ?? "");
    let removedNote: PlannerNote | undefined;
    if (!setNotes((items) => {
      removedNote = items.find((item) => item.id === note.id);
      if (!removedNote) throw new PlannerWriteError("Эта задача уже удалена. Обновите список, чтобы увидеть актуальные задачи.");
      return items.filter((item) => item.id !== note.id);
    })) return;
    setDeletedNote(removedNote ?? null);
    setSaveMessage("");
    focusDayTask(dayKey, neighbours);
  };
  const restoreNote = () => {
    if (!deletedNote) return;
    let restoredNote = deletedNote;
    let alreadyRestored = false;
    if (!setNotes((items) => {
      const latest = items.find((item) => item.id === deletedNote.id);
      if (latest) { restoredNote = latest; alreadyRestored = true; return items; }
      return [...items, deletedNote];
    })) return;
    const hiddenByFilters = !matchesFilter(restoredNote, filter) || !matchesSearchText(`${restoredNote.title} ${restoredNote.text}`, query);
    if (hiddenByFilters) resetFilters();
    const dayKey = toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(restoredNote));
    setDeletedNote(null);
    setFocusedDay(dayKey);
    onSaved?.(restoredNote);
    setSaveMessage(`${alreadyRestored ? "Задача уже восстановлена" : "Задача восстановлена"}${hiddenByFilters ? " · фильтры сброшены, чтобы показать задачу" : ""}`);
    focusDayTask(dayKey, [restoredNote.id], restoredNote.completed);
  };

  return (
    <section className={styles.planner} aria-label="Задачи на неделю">
      <p className={styles.srOnly} role="status">{completionMessage}</p>
      {storageError && <div className={styles.storageError} role="alert"><span>{storageError}</span><button type="button" onClick={refreshNotes}>Повторить чтение</button></div>}
      {selectedTaskId && !requestedNote && !storageError && <div className={styles.actionNotice} role="status"><span>Задача не найдена. Возможно, она уже удалена.</span><button type="button" onClick={onClearTask}>Показать неделю</button></div>}
      {(deletedNote || saveMessage) && <div className={styles.actionNotice} role="status"><span>{deletedNote ? `Задача «${deletedNote.title}» удалена` : saveMessage}</span>{deletedNote && <button type="button" onClick={restoreNote}>Отменить удаление</button>}<button type="button" className={styles.dismissNotice} aria-label="Скрыть сообщение" onClick={() => { setDeletedNote(null); setSaveMessage(""); }}>×</button></div>}
      <div className={styles.plannerToolbar}>
        <div className={styles.tools}><SearchField label="Поиск по неделе" value={query} onChange={setQuery} placeholder="Название или описание задачи" /><div className={styles.filters} role="group" aria-label="Фильтр задач">{FILTERS.map(([value, label]) => <button type="button" aria-pressed={filter === value} className={filter === value ? styles.filterActive : ""} onClick={() => setFilter(value)} key={value}>{label}<span>{searchedNotes.filter((note) => matchesFilter(note, value)).length}</span></button>)}</div><button type="button" className={styles.createButton} onClick={() => createNoteForDay(activeDay)}><PlusIcon size={14} />Добавить задачу</button></div>
        <div className={styles.toolbarBottom}><div className={styles.weekSummary}><div><span><strong>{weekNotes.length - completedCount}</strong> к выполнению</span><span><strong>{completedCount}</strong> готово</span></div><div className={styles.progress} role="progressbar" aria-label="Задачи за неделю выполнены" aria-valuenow={completedCount} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={weekNotes.length || 1}><span style={{ width: `${weekNotes.length ? completedCount / weekNotes.length * 100 : 0}%` }} /></div></div><div className={styles.viewSwitch} role="group" aria-label="Вид планировщика"><button type="button" aria-pressed={view === "board"} onClick={() => changeView("board")}>Неделя</button><button type="button" aria-pressed={view === "list"} onClick={() => changeView("list")}>Список</button></div></div>
        {hasFilters && <div className={styles.filterResult} role="status"><span>{filteredNotes.length ? `Показано ${filteredNotes.length} из ${weekNotes.length} задач` : "По этим условиям задач нет"}</span><button type="button" onClick={resetFilters}>Сбросить фильтры</button></div>}
      </div>
      <WeekNavigation days={days} counts={days.map((day) => getPlannerDayNotes(weekNotes, day).length)} selectedKey={focusedDay} boardRef={gridRef} view={view} onSelect={selectDay} />
      <div className={`${styles.weekGrid} ${view === "list" ? styles.listView : ""} ${dragScroll.dragging ? styles.dragging : ""}`} ref={gridRef} onPointerDown={dragScroll.onPointerDown} onClickCapture={dragScroll.onClickCapture} onDragStartCapture={dragScroll.onDragStartCapture} tabIndex={view === "board" ? 0 : undefined} role="region" aria-label={view === "board" ? "Задачи по дням недели. Листайте, зажав левую кнопку мыши, или прокручивайте по горизонтали" : "Задачи списком по дням недели"}>
        {days.map((day) => {
          const dayNotes = getPlannerDayNotes(filteredNotes, day);
          const allDayNotes = getPlannerDayNotes(weekNotes, day);
          const isToday = isSameDay(day, new Date());
          const hasHiddenNotes = allDayNotes.length > 0 && dayNotes.length === 0;
          const activeNotes = dayNotes.filter((note) => !note.completed);
          const doneNotes = dayNotes.filter((note) => note.completed);

          return (
            <article className={`${styles.dayColumn} ${toLocalDateKey(day) === focusedDay ? styles.selectedDay : ""}`} key={day.toISOString()} data-date={toLocalDateKey(day)}>
              <header className={styles.dayHeader}>
                <div className={styles.dayIdentity}>
                  <span className={styles.weekday}>{format(day, "EEEE", { locale: ru })}</span>
                  <div className={styles.dayDate}><time dateTime={toLocalDateKey(day)} className={`${styles.dayNumber} ${isToday ? styles.today : ""}`}>{format(day, "d")}</time><span>{isToday ? "Сегодня" : format(day, "MMM", { locale: ru })}</span></div>
                </div>
                <button type="button" className={styles.addButton} onClick={() => createNoteForDay(day)} title="Добавить задачу" aria-label={`Добавить задачу на ${format(day, "d MMMM", { locale: ru })}`}><PlusIcon size={14} /></button>
              </header>

              <div className={styles.notesList}>
                {dayNotes.length === 0 && (
                  <button type="button" className={styles.emptyState} onClick={() => hasHiddenNotes ? resetFilters() : createNoteForDay(day)}>
                    <span className={styles.emptyIcon} aria-hidden="true">{hasHiddenNotes ? "—" : <PlusIcon size={14} />}</span>
                    <strong>{hasHiddenNotes ? "Нет совпадений" : "Пока без задач"}</strong>
                    <span>{hasHiddenNotes ? "Сбросить фильтры" : "Запланировать день"}</span>
                  </button>
                )}

                {(filter === "completed" ? doneNotes : activeNotes).map((note) => <PlannerTaskCard key={note.id} note={note} onToggle={toggleCompleted} onEdit={setEditingNote} onDelete={deleteNote} />)}
                {filter !== "completed" && doneNotes.length > 0 && <details className={styles.completedGroup} open={Boolean(query.trim())}><summary><span>✓ Выполнено</span><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4" /></svg></summary><div>{doneNotes.map((note) => <PlannerTaskCard key={note.id} note={note} onToggle={toggleCompleted} onEdit={setEditingNote} onDelete={deleteNote} />)}</div></details>}
              </div>
              {dayNotes.length > 0 && <button type="button" className={styles.addAnother} onClick={() => createNoteForDay(day)}><PlusIcon size={12} />Добавить ещё</button>}
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {activeNote && <PlannerNoteForm key={activeNote.id || "new"} note={activeNote} currentNote={activeNote.id ? notes.find((note) => note.id === activeNote.id) ?? null : undefined} error={storageError} onSave={saveNote} onClose={closeForm} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default Planner;

// src\components\Planner\WeekNavigation\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { format, isSameDay } from "date-fns";
import { ru } from "date-fns/locale";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../../domain/schedule";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { days: Date[]; counts: number[]; selectedKey: string; boardRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>; view: "board" | "list"; onSelect(day: Date): void }

const WeekNavigation = ({ days, counts, selectedKey, boardRef, view, onSelect }: Props) => {
  const [scroll, setScroll] = useState({ overflow: false, left: false, right: false });
  useEffect(() => {
    const board = boardRef.current;
    if (!board) return;
    const update = () => {
      const next = { overflow: view === "board" && board.scrollWidth > board.clientWidth + 2, left: board.scrollLeft > 2, right: board.scrollLeft + board.clientWidth < board.scrollWidth - 2 };
      setScroll((current) => current.overflow === next.overflow && current.left === next.left && current.right === next.right ? current : next);
    };
    update();
    board.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update);
    const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(update);
    observer?.observe(board);
    return () => { board.removeEventListener("scroll", update); window.removeEventListener("resize", update); observer?.disconnect(); };
  }, [boardRef, view, days]);
  const move = (direction: number) => {
    const board = boardRef.current;
    if (!board) return;
    board.scrollBy({ left: board.clientWidth * .8 * direction, behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" });
  };
  return <nav className={styles.navigation} aria-label="Дни недели планировщика">
    <div className={styles.days}>{days.map((day, index) => <button type="button" key={toLocalDateKey(day)} className={`${styles.day} ${selectedKey === toLocalDateKey(day) ? styles.selected : ""} ${isSameDay(day, new Date()) ? styles.today : ""}`} aria-pressed={selectedKey === toLocalDateKey(day)} aria-label={`${format(day, "EEEE, d MMMM", { locale: ru })}. Задач: ${counts[index]}`} title={`Перейти к ${format(day, "d MMMM", { locale: ru })}`} onClick={() => onSelect(day)}><span>{format(day, "EEEEEE", { locale: ru })}</span><strong>{format(day, "d")}</strong>{counts[index] > 0 && <small>{counts[index]}</small>}</button>)}</div>
    {scroll.overflow && <div className={styles.scrollTools}><span>Листайте или тяните мышью</span><button type="button" disabled={!scroll.left} aria-label="Предыдущие дни" title="Предыдущие дни" onClick={() => move(-1)}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 10H4m5-5-5 5 5 5" /></svg></button><button type="button" disabled={!scroll.right} aria-label="Следующие дни" title="Следующие дни" onClick={() => move(1)}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10h12m-5-5 5 5-5 5" /></svg></button></div>}
  </nav>;
};

export default WeekNavigation;

// src\components\PlannerAgenda\index.tsx
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import type { PlannerNote } from "../../data/plannerStore";
import { formatPlannerTime, getNextPlannerNotes, getPlannerDayNotes, getPlannerNoteDate, getPlannerHref } from "../../domain/planner";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { date: Date; notes: PlannerNote[]; error?: string; onCreateTask?(): void }
const PlannerAgenda = ({ date, notes, error, onCreateTask }: Props) => {
  const dayNotes = getPlannerDayNotes(notes, date);
  const upcoming = !dayNotes.length;
  const visible = (upcoming ? getNextPlannerNotes(notes, date) : dayNotes).slice(0, 3);
  const href = getPlannerHref(date);
  return <section className={styles.agenda}>
    <header><div><span>Планировщик</span><h2>{upcoming ? "Ближайшие задачи" : "Задачи на выбранный день"}</h2></div><div className={styles.actions}>{onCreateTask && <button type="button" onClick={onCreateTask}>+ Задача</button>}<Link to={href}>{dayNotes.length > visible.length ? `Все (${dayNotes.length})` : "Открыть"}<ArrowCircle /></Link></div></header>
    {error ? <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{error}</p> : visible.length ? <div className={styles.tasks}>{visible.map((note) => <Link className={`${styles.task} ${note.completed ? styles.completed : ""}`} key={note.id} to={getPlannerHref(getPlannerNoteDate(note), note.id)} aria-label={`${note.title}${note.completed ? ", выполнено" : ""}. Открыть в планировщике`}><span className={`${styles.marker} ${note.priority === "high" ? styles.high : ""}`} aria-hidden="true">{note.completed ? "✓" : ""}</span><span><strong>{note.title}</strong><small>{upcoming ? `${getPlannerNoteDate(note).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short" })} · ` : ""}{formatPlannerTime(note)} · {note.category === "personal" ? "Личная" : "Учебная"}</small></span><ArrowCircle /></Link>)}</div> : <div className={styles.empty}><div><strong>Задач на этот день нет</strong><p>Можно запланировать подготовку к занятиям или личные дела.</p></div>{onCreateTask ? <button type="button" className={styles.planButton} onClick={onCreateTask}>Запланировать<ArrowCircle /></button> : <Link to={href}>Запланировать<ArrowCircle /></Link>}</div>}
  </section>;
};

export default PlannerAgenda;
