// src\components\PlannerNoteForm\index.tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { addDays, differenceInCalendarDays, differenceInMinutes, startOfDay } from "date-fns";
import type { PlannerNote } from "../../data/plannerStore";
import { formatPlannerTime } from "../../domain/planner";
import { samePlannerNote } from "../../domain/plannerDraft";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import useUnsavedChangesWarning from "../../hooks/useUnsavedChangesWarning";
import ConfirmDialog from "../ConfirmDialog";
import DateTimePicker from "../DateTimePicker";
import Dropdown from "../Dropdown";
import Modal from "../Modal";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { note: PlannerNote; currentNote?: PlannerNote | null; error?: string; onSave(note: PlannerNote, original: PlannerNote): void; onClose(): void }
const PlannerNoteForm = ({ note, currentNote, error, onSave, onClose }: Props) => {
  const id = useId();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(note.title);
  const [text, setText] = useState(note.text);
  const [startAt, setStartAt] = useState(note.startAt);
  const [endAt, setEndAt] = useState(note.endAt);
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState(note.priority);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(note.category);
  const [plannedDay, setPlannedDay] = useState(() => startOfDay(note.startAt ?? note.createdAt));
  const [confirmDiscard, setConfirmDiscard] = useState(false);
  const [validation, setValidation] = useState("");
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const initialNote = useRef(note).current;
  const changedElsewhere = currentNote && !samePlannerNote(initialNote, currentNote);
  const deletedElsewhere = Boolean(initialNote.id) && currentNote === null;
  const day = startAt ?? plannedDay;
  const dirty = title !== initialNote.title || text !== initialNote.text || priority !== initialNote.priority || category !== initialNote.category || startAt?.getTime() !== initialNote.startAt?.getTime() || endAt?.getTime() !== initialNote.endAt?.getTime() || toLocalDateKey(day) !== toLocalDateKey(initialNote.startAt ?? initialNote.createdAt);
  const duration = startAt && endAt ? differenceInMinutes(endAt, startAt) : 0;
  const durationLabel = duration > 0 ? [Math.floor(duration / 60) ? `${Math.floor(duration / 60)} ч` : "", duration % 60 ? `${duration % 60} мин` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ") : "";
  useUnsavedChangesWarning(dirty);
  const requestClose = () => { if (dirty) setConfirmDiscard(true); else onClose(); };
  const changeDay = (date?: Date) => {
    if (!date) return;
    const offset = differenceInCalendarDays(date, day);
    setPlannedDay(startOfDay(date));
    if (startAt) setStartAt(addDays(startAt, offset));
    if (endAt) setEndAt(addDays(endAt, offset));
    setValidation("");
  };
  const submit = () => {
    if (!title.trim() && !text.trim()) { setValidation("Добавьте название или описание задачи."); titleRef.current?.focus(); return; }
    if (startAt && endAt && endAt <= startAt) { setValidation("Время окончания должно быть позже времени начала."); return; }
    if (!startAt && endAt && endAt < startOfDay(plannedDay)) { setValidation("Срок окончания не может быть раньше выбранного дня задачи."); return; }
    setValidation("");
    const samePlannedDay = toLocalDateKey(day) === toLocalDateKey(initialNote.startAt ?? initialNote.createdAt);
    const createdAt = startAt || (!initialNote.startAt && samePlannedDay) ? initialNote.createdAt : plannedDay;
    onSave({ ...initialNote, title: title.trim() || "Без названия", text: text.trim(), createdAt, startAt, endAt, priority, category }, initialNote);
  };
  if (confirmDiscard) return <ConfirmDialog title="Закрыть без сохранения?" confirmLabel="Не сохранять" cancelLabel="Продолжить редактирование" onConfirm={onClose} onCancel={() => setConfirmDiscard(false)}><p>Изменения в задаче не сохранены. Можно вернуться к редактированию и сохранить их.</p></ConfirmDialog>;
  return <Modal className={styles.form} labelledBy={id} onClose={requestClose} initialFocusRef={titleRef}>
    <form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); submit(); }} onKeyDown={(event) => { if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key === "Enter" && !event.defaultPrevented) { event.preventDefault(); submit(); } }}>
      <header className={styles.header}><div><span>Планировщик</span><h2 id={id}>{note.id ? "Редактировать задачу" : "Новая задача"}</h2></div><button type="button" className={styles.close} onClick={requestClose} aria-label="Закрыть">×</button></header>
      {(changedElsewhere || deletedElsewhere) && <p className={styles.externalNotice} role="status">{deletedElsewhere ? "Задача удалена в другом месте. Черновик оставлен здесь, чтобы вы могли скопировать текст. Сохранение не восстановит удалённую задачу." : "Сохранённая задача обновилась в другом месте. Независимые правки будут объединены; при конфликте ваш черновик останется открытым."}</p>}
      <div className={styles.day}><strong>{day.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" })}</strong><span>{startAt || endAt ? `${formatPlannerTime({ ...note, startAt, endAt })}${durationLabel ? ` · ${durationLabel}` : ""}` : "Без времени — можно выполнить в течение дня"}</span></div>
      <div className={styles.field}><span>День задачи</span><DateTimePicker value={day} showTime={false} allowClear={false} onChange={changeDay} ariaLabel="День задачи" /></div>
      <label className={styles.field}>Название<input ref={titleRef} value={title} placeholder="Например, подготовить материалы к паре" onChange={(event) => { setTitle(event.target.value); setValidation(""); }} /></label>
      <div className={`${styles.columns} ${styles.metadata}`}><Dropdown label="Приоритет" value={priority} onChange={(value) => setPriority(value as PlannerNote["priority"])} options={[{ value: "low", label: "Низкий" }, { value: "medium", label: "Средний" }, { value: "high", label: "Высокий" }]} /><Dropdown label="Категория" value={category} onChange={(value) => setCategory(value as PlannerNote["category"])} options={[{ value: "study", label: "Учебная" }, { value: "personal", label: "Личная" }]} /></div>
      <label className={styles.field}>Описание<textarea value={text} placeholder="Детали, ссылки и заметки" onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)} /></label>
      <div className={styles.columns}><div className={styles.field}><span>Начало · необязательно</span><DateTimePicker value={startAt} initialDate={plannedDay} onChange={(date) => { if (date) setPlannedDay(startOfDay(date)); setStartAt(date); setValidation(""); }} placeholder="Без времени" ariaLabel="Начало задачи" /></div><div className={styles.field}><span>Окончание · необязательно</span><DateTimePicker value={endAt} initialDate={startAt ?? plannedDay} onChange={(date) => { setEndAt(date); setValidation(""); }} placeholder="Не задано" ariaLabel="Окончание задачи" /></div></div>
      {!startAt && endAt && <p className={styles.timeHint}>Задача останется в выбранном дне. «Окончание» — её крайний срок, даже если он позже этого дня.</p>}
      {(validation || error) && <p className={styles.error} role="alert">{validation || error}</p>}
      <footer className={styles.footer}><span className={styles.saveHint}>{dirty ? "Есть несохранённые изменения" : "Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter — сохранить"}</span><div className={styles.actions}><button type="button" onClick={requestClose}>Отмена</button><button type="submit" className={styles.save}>{note.id ? "Сохранить изменения" : "Добавить задачу"}</button></div></footer>
    </form>
  </Modal>;
};

export default PlannerNoteForm;

// src\components\RoleContext\index.tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { Dispatch, ReactNode, SetStateAction } from "react";

export type UserRole = "teacher" | "student";

export type AcademicMembership = {
  subjectId: string;
  groupIds: string[];
};

export type CurrentUser = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: UserRole;
  scheduleName?: string; // Краткое имя преподавателя в старых записях расписания без ID.
  memberships: AcademicMembership[];
};

const DEMO_USERS: Record<UserRole, CurrentUser> = {
  teacher: {
    id: "teacher-elena-volkova",
    name: "Елена Волкова",
    role: "teacher",
    scheduleName: "Волкова Е.В.",
    memberships: [
      { subjectId: "theory-of-probability", groupIds: ["112-mko", "113-mko", "211-ivt"] },
      { subjectId: "mathematical-statistics", groupIds: ["112-mko", "311-pmi", "312-pmi"] },
      { subjectId: "data-analysis", groupIds: ["112-mko", "411-bi", "412-bi", "413-bi"] },
      { subjectId: "discrete-mathematics", groupIds: ["112-mko", "111-is", "112-is"] },
    ],
  },
  student: {
    id: "anna-smirnova",
    name: "Анна Смирнова",
    role: "student",
    memberships: [
      { subjectId: "theory-of-probability", groupIds: ["112-mko"] },
      { subjectId: "mathematical-statistics", groupIds: ["112-mko"] },
      { subjectId: "data-analysis", groupIds: ["112-mko"] },
      { subjectId: "discrete-mathematics", groupIds: ["112-mko"] },
    ],
  },
};

type RoleContextValue = {
  role: UserRole;
  currentUser: CurrentUser;
  setRole: Dispatch<SetStateAction<UserRole>>;
  canAccessJournal: (subjectId: string, groupId: string) => boolean;
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "bi-university-demo-role";
const RoleContext = createContext<RoleContextValue | null>(null);

export const RoleProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
  const [role, setRole] = useState<UserRole>(() => {
    try {
      const savedRole = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return savedRole === "student" ? "student" : "teacher";
    } catch {
      return "teacher";
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, role); } catch { /* Переключатель остаётся рабочим в текущей вкладке. */ }
  }, [role]);

  const value = useMemo(() => {
    const currentUser = DEMO_USERS[role];
    return {
      role,
      currentUser,
      setRole,
      canAccessJournal: (subjectId: string, groupId: string) => currentUser.memberships.some(
        (membership) => membership.subjectId === subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(groupId),
      ),
    };
  }, [role]);

  return <RoleContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</RoleContext.Provider>;
};

export const useRole = () => {
  const context = useContext(RoleContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useRole must be used inside RoleProvider");
  return context;
};


// src\components\RoleRoute\index.tsx
import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useRole, UserRole } from "../RoleContext";

interface RoleRouteProps {
  allow: UserRole;
  children: ReactNode;
}

const RoleRoute = ({ allow, children }: RoleRouteProps) => {
  const { role } = useRole();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (role !== allow) {
    return <Navigate to={role === "student" ? "/journal" : "/"} replace state={{ deniedPath: location.pathname }} />;
  }

  return children;
};

export default RoleRoute;

// src\components\RoleSwitcher\index.tsx
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useRole, UserRole } from "../RoleContext";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import DemoDataManager from "../DemoDataManager";

const roles: Array<{ value: UserRole; label: string }> = [
  { value: "teacher", label: "Преподаватель" },
  { value: "student", label: "Студент" },
];

const RoleSwitcher = () => {
  const { role, setRole } = useRole();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const selectRole = (nextRole: UserRole) => {
    if (nextRole === role) return;
    setRole(nextRole);
    navigate("/");
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <span className={styles.label}>Демо-режим</span>
      <div className={styles.switcher} aria-label="Роль пользователя">
        {roles.map((item) => (
          <button
            key={item.value}
            type="button"
            className={role === item.value ? styles.active : ""}
            aria-pressed={role === item.value}
            onClick={() => selectRole(item.value)}
          >
            {item.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <DemoDataManager />
    </div>
  );
};

export default RoleSwitcher;

// src\components\ScheduleCard\index.tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import type { ScheduleItem } from "../../types/sched";
import { scheduleLessonTypeLabels } from "../../domain/scheduleLayout";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { item: ScheduleItem; compact?: boolean; grid?: boolean; list?: boolean; readOnly?: boolean; style?: CSSProperties; onOpen(item: ScheduleItem): void }

const ScheduleCard = ({ item, compact = false, grid = false, list = false, readOnly = false, style, onOpen }: Props) => {
  const typeClass = `${styles.type} ${styles[item.type === "Пр." ? "practice" : item.type === "Лаб." ? "lab" : "lecture"]}`;
  const className = `${styles.card} ${grid ? styles.grid : ""} ${list ? styles.row : ""} ${compact ? styles.compact : ""} ${readOnly ? styles.readOnly : ""}`;
  const title = `${item.subject} · ${item.startTime}–${item.endTime} · ${item.location} · ${item.teacher ?? ""}${readOnly ? " · Только просмотр расписания" : ""}`;
  const label = `${item.subject}, ${item.startTime}–${item.endTime}, ${item.group ?? ""}, ${item.location}. ${readOnly ? "Только просмотр расписания" : "Открыть занятие"}`;
  const content = list ? <>
    <span className={styles.rowTime}><time dateTime={`${item.date}T${item.startTime}`}>{item.startTime}</time><time dateTime={`${item.date}T${item.endTime}`}>до {item.endTime}</time></span>
    <span className={styles.rowContent}><strong className={styles.subject}>{item.subject}</strong><span className={styles.rowMeta}><span className={typeClass}>{scheduleLessonTypeLabels[item.type]}</span>{item.group && <span>{item.group}</span>}<span>{item.location}</span>{item.teacher && <span>{item.teacher}</span>}{readOnly && <span className={styles.viewOnly}>Только расписание</span>}</span></span>
    {!readOnly && <ArrowCircle className={styles.rowArrow} />}
  </> : <>
    <span className={styles.top}><time dateTime={`${item.date}T${item.startTime}`}>{item.startTime}–{item.endTime}</time><span className={typeClass}>{scheduleLessonTypeLabels[item.type]}</span></span>
    <strong className={styles.subject}>{item.subject}</strong>
    <span className={styles.info}><span>{item.location}</span>{item.group && <span>{item.group}</span>}</span>
    {item.teacher && <span className={styles.teacher}>{item.teacher}</span>}
    {!readOnly ? <span className={styles.footer}>{!grid && <span className={styles.openLabel}>Подробнее</span>}<ArrowCircle /></span> : !grid && <span className={styles.viewOnly}>Только расписание</span>}
  </>;
  return readOnly
    ? <article className={className} style={style} aria-label={label} title={title}>{content}</article>
    : <button type="button" className={className} style={style} onClick={() => onOpen(item)} aria-label={label} title={title}>{content}</button>;
};

export default ScheduleCard;

// src\components\ScheduleWeek\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import type { ScheduleItem, WeeklyScheduleData } from "../../types/sched";
import { getAssignments, subscribeAssignmentStore } from "../../data/assignmentStore";
import { getScheduleRange, getWeekDays, layoutScheduleDay, timeToMinutes } from "../../domain/scheduleLayout";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import { formatCount } from "../../domain/formatCount";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import { isAcademicMembershipMatch } from "../../data/academicCatalog";
import { canOpenScheduleLesson } from "../../domain/scheduleAccess";
import ScheduleCard from "../ScheduleCard";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import LessonDetails from "./LessonDetails";
import WeekList from "./WeekList";
import useDragScroll from "../../hooks/useDragScroll";
import useViewPreference from "../../hooks/useViewPreference";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const PIXELS_PER_MINUTE = 1.1;
const TIME_COLUMN_WIDTH = 46;
const MIN_DAY_WIDTH = 176;
const VIEWS = ["grid", "list"] as const;
interface Props { schedule: WeeklyScheduleData; selectedWeek: Date }
const WeeklySchedule = ({ schedule, selectedWeek }: Props) => {
  const { role, currentUser } = useRole();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(900);
  const [view, setView] = useViewPreference(`bi-university-schedule-view:${currentUser.role}:${currentUser.id}`, VIEWS, "list");
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState<ScheduleItem | null>(null);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState(getAssignments);
  const [scrollState, setScrollState] = useState({ left: false, right: true });
  useEffect(() => subscribeAssignmentStore(() => setAssignments(getAssignments())), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rootRef.current) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => setWidth(entry.contentRect.width));
    observer.observe(rootRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  const days = getWeekDays(selectedWeek);
  const weekKey = days[0].key;
  const dragScroll = useDragScroll(scrollRef, { axis: "both", enabled: view === "grid", resetKey: weekKey });
  const weekKeys = new Set(days.map((entry) => entry.key));
  const lessons = schedule.filter((item) => weekKeys.has(item.date)).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || timeToMinutes(a.startTime) - timeToMinutes(b.startTime));
  const activeView = view;
  const dayWidth = Math.max(MIN_DAY_WIDTH, (width - TIME_COLUMN_WIDTH) / Math.max(1, Math.min(7, Math.floor((width - TIME_COLUMN_WIDTH) / MIN_DAY_WIDTH))));
  const range = getScheduleRange(lessons);
  const height = (range.end - range.start) * PIXELS_PER_MINUTE;
  const times = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil((range.end - range.start) / 60) + 1 }, (_, index) => range.start + index * 60);
  const today = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
  const canOpen = (item: ScheduleItem) => canOpenScheduleLesson(item, currentUser);
  const openLesson = (item: ScheduleItem) => { if (canOpen(item)) setOpened(item); };
  const lessonAssignments = (item: ScheduleItem) => canOpen(item) ? assignments.filter((assignment) => (assignment.status === "published" || (role === "teacher" && assignment.status === "draft")) && assignment.subject === item.subject && assignment.group === item.group && assignment.lessonDate.startsWith(item.date) && isAcademicMembershipMatch(currentUser.memberships, assignment.subject, assignment.group)) : [];
  const syncScroll = () => {
    const element = scrollRef.current;
    if (element) setScrollState({ left: element.scrollLeft > 1, right: element.scrollLeft + element.clientWidth < element.scrollWidth - 1 });
  };
  useEffect(() => { setOpened(null); scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0 }); }, [weekKey, schedule, currentUser.id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const element = scrollRef.current;
      if (element) setScrollState({ left: element.scrollLeft > 1, right: element.scrollLeft + element.clientWidth < element.scrollWidth - 1 });
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [width, activeView, lessons.length]);
  const move = (direction: number) => scrollRef.current?.scrollBy({ left: dayWidth * direction, behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" });
  const onGridKey = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") { event.preventDefault(); move(event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1); }
  };

  return <div className={styles.container} ref={rootRef}>
    <div className={styles.toolbar}><div className={styles.summary}><strong>{formatCount(lessons.length, ["занятие", "занятия", "занятий"])}</strong><span>{formatCount(new Set(lessons.map((item) => item.date)).size, ["учебный день", "учебных дня", "учебных дней"])}</span></div><div className={styles.actions}><div className={styles.views} aria-label="Вид расписания"><button type="button" aria-pressed={activeView === "grid"} onClick={() => setView("grid")}>Сетка</button><button type="button" aria-pressed={activeView === "list"} onClick={() => setView("list")}>Список</button></div><button type="button" className={styles.print} onClick={() => window.print()}>Печать / PDF</button></div></div>
    {!lessons.length ? <div className={styles.empty} role="status"><strong>На этой неделе занятий нет</strong><span>Выберите другую неделю или измените запрос поиска.</span></div> : <>
      <div className={`${styles.gridView} ${activeView !== "grid" ? styles.inactive : ""}`}>
        <div className={styles.gridTools}><span>Зажмите мышь и перемещайте сетку · на сенсорном экране листайте пальцем</span><div><button type="button" disabled={!scrollState.left} onClick={() => move(-1)} aria-label="Предыдущие дни"><ArrowCircle direction="left" /></button><button type="button" disabled={!scrollState.right} onClick={() => move(1)} aria-label="Следующие дни"><ArrowCircle /></button></div></div>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions, jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-tabindex -- A focusable scroll region supports keyboard scrolling; lessons remain native buttons. */}
        <div className={`${styles.scroller} ${dragScroll.dragging ? styles.dragging : ""}`} ref={scrollRef} role="region" tabIndex={0} aria-label="Недельное расписание. Стрелки влево и вправо переключают дни. Зажмите мышь для перемещения сетки" onScroll={syncScroll} onKeyDown={onGridKey} onPointerDown={dragScroll.onPointerDown} onClickCapture={dragScroll.onClickCapture} onDragStartCapture={dragScroll.onDragStartCapture}>
          <div className={styles.calendar} style={{ "--time-width": `${TIME_COLUMN_WIDTH}px`, "--day-width": `${dayWidth}px`, "--hour-height": `${60 * PIXELS_PER_MINUTE}px` } as CSSProperties}>
            <div className={styles.corner}>Время</div>{days.map(({ date, key }) => <div className={`${styles.dayHeader} ${key === today ? styles.today : ""}`} key={key}><span>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "short" })}</span><time dateTime={key}>{date.getDate()} {date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { month: "short" }).replace(".", "")}</time></div>)}
            <div className={styles.timeColumn} style={{ height }}>{times.map((time) => <time key={time} style={{ top: (time - range.start) * PIXELS_PER_MINUTE }} aria-hidden="true">{String(Math.floor(time / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:00</time>)}</div>
            {days.map(({ key }) => <div className={`${styles.dayColumn} ${key === today ? styles.todayColumn : ""}`} key={key} style={{ height }}>{layoutScheduleDay(lessons.filter((item) => item.date === key), range.start, PIXELS_PER_MINUTE).map(({ item, top, height: cardHeight, lane, lanes }) => <ScheduleCard key={item.id} grid compact={lanes > 1} readOnly={!canOpen(item)} item={item} onOpen={openLesson} style={{ position: "absolute", top: top + 2, height: Math.max(24, cardHeight - 4), left: `calc(${lane / lanes * 100}% + 3px)`, width: `calc(${100 / lanes}% - 6px)` }} />)}</div>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={`${styles.listView} ${activeView !== "list" ? styles.inactive : ""}`}>
        <WeekList lessons={lessons} selectedWeek={selectedWeek} canOpen={canOpen} onOpen={openLesson} />
      </div>
    </>}
    {opened && canOpen(opened) && lessons.some((item) => item.id === opened.id) && <LessonDetails item={opened} assignments={lessonAssignments(opened)} onClose={() => setOpened(null)} />}
  </div>;
};

export default WeeklySchedule;

// src\components\ScheduleWeek\LessonDetails\index.tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import type { ScheduleItem } from "../../../types/sched";
import type { Assignment } from "../../../data/assignmentStore";
import { getJournalHref } from "../../../data/academicCatalog";
import { getAssignmentHref } from "../../../domain/journalNavigation";
import { canOpenScheduleLesson } from "../../../domain/scheduleAccess";
import { scheduleLessonTypeLabels } from "../../../domain/scheduleLayout";
import { useRole } from "../../RoleContext";
import ArrowCircle from "../../ArrowCircle";
import Modal from "../../Modal";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { item: ScheduleItem; assignments: Assignment[]; onClose(): void }
const LessonDetails = ({ item, assignments, onClose }: Props) => {
  const titleId = useId();
  const { currentUser, role } = useRole();
  if (!canOpenScheduleLesson(item, currentUser)) return null;
  const journalHref = getJournalHref(item.subject, item.group);
  const date = new Date(`${item.date}T12:00`);
  const lessonAssignments = assignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.subject === item.subject && assignment.group === item.group && assignment.lessonDate.startsWith(item.date) && (assignment.status === "published" || (role === "teacher" && assignment.status === "draft")));
  return <Modal labelledBy={titleId} onClose={onClose} className={styles.dialog}>
    <header className={styles.header}><div><span className={styles.type}>{scheduleLessonTypeLabels[item.type]}</span><h2 id={titleId}>{item.subject}</h2></div><button type="button" className={styles.close} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Закрыть занятие" title="Закрыть">×</button></header>
    <time className={styles.date} dateTime={`${item.date}T${item.startTime}`}><span><small>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long" })}</small><strong>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" })}</strong></span><span className={styles.time}><small>Время занятия</small><strong>{item.startTime}–{item.endTime}</strong></span></time>
    <dl className={styles.details}><div><dt>Аудитория</dt><dd>{item.location}</dd></div><div><dt>Группа</dt><dd>{item.group ?? "Не указана"}</dd></div><div><dt>Преподаватель</dt><dd>{item.teacher ?? "Не указан"}</dd></div></dl>
    <nav className={styles.links} aria-label="Разделы занятия"><Link className={styles.journalLink} to={journalHref}><span><strong>{role === "student" ? "Открыть мой журнал" : "Открыть журнал"}</strong><small>{role === "student" ? "Мои оценки и посещаемость" : "Посещаемость и оценки"}</small></span><ArrowCircle /></Link><Link to={`${journalHref}?tab=materials`}><span><strong>Открыть материалы</strong><small>Файлы по предмету</small></span><ArrowCircle /></Link></nav>
    <section className={styles.assignments}><div className={styles.sectionHeading}><h3>Задания к занятию</h3><span>{lessonAssignments.length}</span></div>{lessonAssignments.length ? <div className={styles.assignmentList}>{lessonAssignments.map((assignment) => <Link key={assignment.id} to={getAssignmentHref(assignment)}><span><strong>{assignment.title}</strong><small>{assignment.status === "draft" ? "Черновик · " : ""}До {new Date(assignment.deadline).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}</small></span><ArrowCircle /></Link>)}</div> : <div className={styles.empty}><strong>Заданий пока нет</strong><p>{role === "teacher" ? "Добавьте задание в журнале предмета и привяжите его к этой дате." : "Когда преподаватель добавит задание на эту дату, оно появится здесь."}</p></div>}<Link className={styles.allAssignments} to={`${journalHref}?tab=assignments`}><span>{role === "teacher" ? "Управление заданиями" : "Все задания по предмету"}</span><ArrowCircle /></Link></section>
  </Modal>;
};
export default LessonDetails;

// src\components\ScheduleWeek\WeekList\EmptySlot\index.tsx
import type { ScheduleItem, ScheduleSlot } from "../../../../types/sched";
import { timeToMinutes } from "../../../../domain/scheduleLayout";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { slot: ScheduleSlot; date: string; overlapping: ScheduleItem[] }
const EmptySlot = ({ slot, date, overlapping }: Props) => {
  const continuation = overlapping.length > 0 && overlapping.every((item) => timeToMinutes(item.startTime) < timeToMinutes(slot.startTime));
  const label = overlapping.length ? continuation ? "Продолжение занятия" : "Занятие в изменённое время" : "Нет занятий";
  return <div className={`${styles.row} ${overlapping.length ? styles.overlapping : ""}`}>
    <span className={styles.time}><time dateTime={`${date}T${slot.startTime}`}>{slot.startTime}</time><time dateTime={`${date}T${slot.endTime}`}>до {slot.endTime}</time></span>
    <span className={styles.content}><span>{label}</span>{overlapping.length > 0 && <small>{overlapping.map((item) => `${item.subject} · ${item.startTime}–${item.endTime}`).join("; ")}</small>}</span>
  </div>;
};

export default EmptySlot;

// src\components\ScheduleWeek\WeekList\index.tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import type { ScheduleItem } from "../../../types/sched";
import { getScheduleDayRows, getWeekDays } from "../../../domain/scheduleLayout";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../../domain/schedule";
import { DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS } from "../../../data/scheduleSlots";
import ScheduleCard from "../../ScheduleCard";
import EmptySlot from "./EmptySlot";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props { lessons: ScheduleItem[]; selectedWeek: Date; canOpen(item: ScheduleItem): boolean; onOpen(item: ScheduleItem): void }
const WeekList = ({ lessons, selectedWeek, canOpen, onOpen }: Props) => {
  const id = useId();
  const days = getWeekDays(selectedWeek);
  const today = toLocalDateKey(new Date());
  return <section className={styles.list} aria-label="Расписание всей недели списком">
    <nav className={styles.jumpNav} aria-label="Перейти к дню недели"><span>Перейти к дню</span><div>{days.map(({ date, key }) => <button type="button" key={key} aria-label={`Перейти: ${date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" })}`} aria-current={key === today ? "date" : undefined} onClick={() => document.getElementById(`${id}-${key}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "auto" })}>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "short" })}<b>{date.getDate()}</b></button>)}</div></nav>
    <div className={styles.columns} aria-hidden="true"><span>День</span><span>№</span><span>Время</span><span>Занятие</span></div>
    <div className={styles.days}>{days.map(({ date, key }) => {
      const events = lessons.filter((item) => item.date === key);
      const rows = getScheduleDayRows(events, DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS);
      return <section key={key} id={`${id}-${key}`} className={`${styles.day} ${key === today ? styles.today : ""} ${!events.length ? styles.free : ""}`} aria-label={date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long" })}>
        <header className={styles.dayHeading}><div className={styles.dayHeadingContent}><div className={styles.dayIdentity}><h3>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long" })}</h3><time dateTime={key}>{date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" })}</time></div><div className={styles.daySummary}>{key === today && <span className={styles.todayBadge}>Сегодня</span>}<span>{events.length ? `Занятий: ${events.length}` : "Свободный день"}</span></div></div></header>
        <div className={styles.rows}>{rows.map((row) => <div key={row.key} className={`${styles.slotRow} ${!row.lessons.length ? styles.emptySlot : ""}`}><span className={styles.slotNumber} aria-label={row.slot ? `Пара ${row.slot.number}` : "Вне сетки звонков"} title={row.slot ? `Пара ${row.slot.number}` : "Вне сетки звонков"}>{row.slot?.number ?? "—"}</span><div className={styles.slotContent}>{!row.slot && <p className={styles.specialTime}>Вне сетки звонков · проверьте время</p>}{row.lessons.length ? row.lessons.map((item) => <ScheduleCard key={item.id} list readOnly={!canOpen(item)} item={item} onOpen={onOpen} />) : row.slot && <EmptySlot slot={row.slot} date={key} overlapping={row.overlapping} />}</div></div>)}</div>
      </section>;
    })}</div>
  </section>;
};

export default WeekList;

// src\components\ScheduleWidget\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import type { WeeklyScheduleData } from "../../types/sched";
import { getLessonStatus, toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface ScheduleProps {
  schedule: WeeklyScheduleData;
  currentTime: Date;
}

export default function Schedule({ schedule, currentTime }: ScheduleProps) {
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const lessons = [...schedule].sort((a, b) => `${a.date}T${a.startTime}`.localeCompare(`${b.date}T${b.startTime}`));
  const activeId = lessons.find((lesson) => getLessonStatus(lesson, currentTime).state !== "past")?.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = listRef.current;
    const target = container?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-lesson-id="${activeId}"]`);
    if (!container || !target) return;
    container.scrollTo({ top: target.offsetTop, behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [activeId]);

  if (!lessons.length) return <p className={styles.empty}>Сегодня занятий нет. <Link to="/schedule">Посмотреть неделю <ArrowCircle hoverBackground="transparent" hoverColor="inherit" /></Link></p>;

  return (
    <div className={styles.scheduleWrapper} ref={listRef}>
      <ul className={styles.scheduleList}>
        {lessons.map((item) => {
          const status = getLessonStatus(item, currentTime);
          const label = item.date !== toLocalDateKey(currentTime) && status.state === "next" ? "Запланировано" : status.label;
          return (
            <li key={item.id} data-lesson-id={item.id} className={`${styles.scheduleItem} ${styles[status.state]} ${item.id === activeId && status.state === "next" ? styles.firstNext : ""}`}>
              <div className={styles.scheduleTime}>{item.startTime}–{item.endTime}<span className={styles.status}>{label}</span></div>
              <div className={styles.scheduleInfo}>
                <div className={styles.subject}>{item.subject}</div>
                <div className={styles.group}>{item.group} · {item.location}</div>
                <div className={styles.group}>{item.teacher}</div>
              </div>
              <Link to={`/schedule?date=${item.date}`} className={styles.lessonLink} aria-label={`Открыть расписание: ${item.subject}`}><ArrowCircle hoverBackground="transparent" hoverColor="inherit" /></Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

// src\components\SearchField\index.tsx
import { useId, useRef } from "react";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

interface Props {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange(value: string): void;
  placeholder?: string;
}

const SearchField = ({ label, value, onChange, placeholder = "Поиск" }: Props) => {
  const id = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  return <div className={styles.field}>
    <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
    <div className={styles.row}><input id={id} ref={inputRef} type="search" value={value} placeholder={placeholder} className={value ? styles.hasValue : ""} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} />{value && <button type="button" aria-label={`Очистить: ${label}`} onClick={() => { onChange(""); inputRef.current?.focus(); }}>Очистить</button>}</div>
  </div>;
};

export default SearchField;

// Search.tsx
import React from "react";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import SearchInput from "./search";

interface SearchProps {
  searchMode: "group" | "auditorium";
  setSearchMode: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<"group" | "auditorium">>;
  query: string;
  setQuery: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
  onSearch: () => void;
}

const Search: React.FC<SearchProps> = ({ searchMode, setSearchMode, query, setQuery, onSearch }) => {
  
  const placeholderText = searchMode === "group" 
    ? "Введите название группы" 
    : "Введите номер аудитории";

  return (
    <div className={styles.dashboardCard}>
      <div className={styles.toggleRow}>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={searchMode === "auditorium"}
          className={`${styles.toggleButton} ${searchMode === "auditorium" ? styles.active : ""}`}
          onClick={() => setSearchMode("auditorium")}
        >
          Поиск по аудитории
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={searchMode === "group"}
          className={`${styles.toggleButton} ${searchMode === "group" ? styles.active : ""}`}
          onClick={() => setSearchMode("group")}
        >
          Поиск по группе
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Вместо старого блока searchRow используем новый компонент SearchInput */}
      <SearchInput
        query={query}
        setQuery={setQuery}
        placeholder={placeholderText}
        onSearch={onSearch} // Передаем функцию поиска
        // Передаем классы из ваших исходных стилей, чтобы сохранить внешний вид
        containerClassName={styles.searchRow}
        inputClassName={styles.input}
        searchButtonClassName={styles.searchButton}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Search;


// src\components\SearchWidget\search.tsx
// SearchInput.tsx

import React from "react";

interface SearchInputProps {
  /** Текущее значение поля ввода */
  query: string;
  /** Функция для обновления значения поля ввода */
  setQuery: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
  /** Текст-подсказка (placeholder) для поля ввода */
  placeholder: string;
  /** Функция, вызываемая при нажатии на кнопку поиска или Enter (опционально) */
  onSearch: () => void;
  /** CSS-класс для контейнера, для инпута и для кнопки (если нужно сохранить ваши стили) */
  inputClassName?: string;
  searchButtonClassName?: string;
  containerClassName?: string;
}

const SearchInput: React.FC<SearchInputProps> = ({
  query,
  setQuery,
  placeholder,
  onSearch,
  inputClassName = "input", // Условные классы
  searchButtonClassName = "searchButton", // Условные классы
  containerClassName = "searchRow" // Условные классы
}) => {
  // Добавляем обработчик нажатия Enter для удобства
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onSearch();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={containerClassName}>
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder={placeholder}
        aria-label={placeholder}
        value={query}
        onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        className={inputClassName}
      />
      <button 
        type="button"
        aria-label="Найти расписание"
        onClick={onSearch} 
        className={searchButtonClassName}
      >
        {/* SVG-иконка лупы */}
        <svg
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          width="20"
          height="20"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        >
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
          <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SearchInput;

// src\components\StudyPlan\index.tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getSemesterSubjects, getSubjectHours } from "../../data/studyPlan";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const semesters = [3, 4] as const;

const StudyPlan = ({ teacher = false }: { teacher?: boolean }) => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const [semester, setSemester] = useState<(typeof semesters)[number]>(3);
  const availableSemesters = teacher ? semesters.filter((item) => getSemesterSubjects(item).some((subject) => subject.teacher === currentUser.name)) : semesters;
  const subjects = useMemo(() => getSemesterSubjects(semester).filter((subject) => !teacher || subject.teacher === currentUser.name), [semester, teacher, currentUser.name]);
  const totals = useMemo(() => subjects.reduce((result, subject) => ({
    lectures: result.lectures + subject.lectures, practice: result.practice + subject.practice,
    labs: result.labs + subject.labs, independent: result.independent + subject.independent,
    all: result.all + getSubjectHours(subject),
  }), { lectures: 0, practice: 0, labs: 0, independent: 0, all: 0 }), [subjects]);
  const classroomHours = totals.lectures + totals.practice + totals.labs;

  return <section className={styles.plan} aria-labelledby="study-plan-title">
    <header className={styles.header}>
      <div><span>{teacher ? "Учебная нагрузка" : "2026/2027 учебный год"}</span><h2 id="study-plan-title">Учебный план</h2><p>{teacher ? "Распределение часов по дисциплинам и видам занятий." : "Дисциплины, нагрузка и формы промежуточной аттестации."}</p></div>
      <div className={styles.semesters} aria-label="Выбор семестра">{availableSemesters.map((item) => <button type="button" aria-pressed={semester === item} className={semester === item ? styles.activeSemester : ""} onClick={() => setSemester(item)} key={item}>{item} семестр</button>)}</div>
    </header>
    <div className={styles.summary}>
      <div><span>Дисциплины</span><strong>{subjects.length}</strong></div><div><span>Всего часов</span><strong>{totals.all}</strong></div>
      <div><span>Аудиторные</span><strong>{classroomHours}</strong></div><div><span>Самостоятельные</span><strong>{totals.independent}</strong></div>
    </div>
    <div className={styles.tableWrap}><table>
      <thead><tr><th>Дисциплина</th><th>Лекции</th><th>Практика</th><th>Лаб.</th><th>Самост.</th><th>Всего</th><th>Контроль</th><th aria-label="Дополнительно" /></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{subjects.map((subject) => <tr key={subject.id}>
        <td data-label="Дисциплина"><Link to={`/journal/${subject.id}`}><strong>{subject.name}</strong></Link><span>{subject.teacher}</span></td>
        <td data-label="Лекции">{subject.lectures || "—"}</td><td data-label="Практика">{subject.practice || "—"}</td><td data-label="Лабораторные">{subject.labs || "—"}</td>
        <td data-label="Самостоятельно">{subject.independent}</td><td data-label="Всего"><strong>{getSubjectHours(subject)}</strong></td><td data-label="Контроль"><span className={styles.control}>{subject.control}</span></td>
        <td className={styles.actions}>{subject.hasProgram ? <span title="Рабочая программа появится после подключения документов вуза">РПД</span> : <span title="Рабочая программа пока не загружена">—</span>}</td>
      </tr>)}</tbody>
      <tfoot><tr><td>Итого за семестр</td><td>{totals.lectures}</td><td>{totals.practice}</td><td>{totals.labs}</td><td>{totals.independent}</td><td>{totals.all}</td><td colSpan={2} /></tr></tfoot>
    </table></div>
    <p className={styles.note}>РПД — рабочая программа дисциплины. Документы станут доступны после подключения API университета.</p>
  </section>;
};
export default StudyPlan;

// src\components\Tabs\index.tsx
import { KeyboardEvent, useRef } from "react";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export interface TabItem { value: string; label: string; count?: number }
interface TabsProps { items: TabItem[]; value: string; ariaLabel: string; onChange(value: string): void }

const Tabs = ({ items, value, ariaLabel, onChange }: TabsProps) => {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const move = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const direction = event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1;
    const index = items.findIndex((item) => item.value === value);
    const next = items[(index + direction + items.length) % items.length];
    onChange(next.value);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-tab="${next.value}"]`)?.focus());
  };

  return <div ref={rootRef} className={styles.tabs} role="tablist" aria-label={ariaLabel} tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={move}>{items.map((item) => <button type="button" role="tab" data-tab={item.value} aria-selected={value === item.value} tabIndex={value === item.value ? 0 : -1} className={value === item.value ? styles.active : ""} onClick={() => onChange(item.value)} key={item.value}>{item.label}{item.count !== undefined && <span>{item.count}</span>}</button>)}</div>;
};

export default Tabs;

// src\components\TeacherStatistics\index.tsx
import { useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { getAcademicGroup, getAcademicSubjectDefinition, getJournalHrefById } from "../../data/academicCatalog";
import { getAssignments, getSubmissions } from "../../data/assignmentStore";
import { readAnalyticsJournals } from "../../data/teacherAnalytics";
import { useDashboardUpdate } from "../../data/studentDashboard";
import { calculateTeacherAnalytics, createAnalyticsCsv, getAnalyticsRange, type AnalyticsPeriod } from "../../domain/teacherAnalytics";
import { formatDashboardValue } from "../../domain/dashboard";
import { formatCount } from "../../domain/formatCount";
import { downloadJournalCsv } from "../../domain/journalExport";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import LineChart from "../Charts/LineChart";
import SelectField from "../SelectField";
import SortControls, { type SortDirection } from "../SortControls";
import WeekPicker from "../WeekPicker";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const PERIODS = [{ value: "semester", label: "С начала семестра" }, { value: "week", label: "Выбранная неделя" }, { value: "month", label: "Текущий месяц" }, { value: "four-weeks", label: "Последние 4 недели" }];
const GRADE_SEGMENTS = [{ label: "Отлично", grade: 5, color: "var(--ui-chart-green)" }, { label: "Хорошо", grade: 4, color: "var(--ui-chart-purple)" }, { label: "Удовл.", grade: 3, color: "var(--ui-chart-amber)" }, { label: "Неудовл.", grade: 2, color: "var(--ui-chart-red)" }];
const polarPoint = (radius: number, angle: number) => { const radians = (angle - 90) * Math.PI / 180; return { x: 55 + radius * Math.cos(radians), y: 55 + radius * Math.sin(radians) }; };
const donutSegmentPath = (start: number, end: number, selected: boolean) => {
  const outer = selected ? 47 : 44;
  const inner = selected ? 31 : 37;
  if (end - start >= 360 - 1e-7) {
    const top = polarPoint(outer, start), bottom = polarPoint(outer, start + 180);
    const innerTop = polarPoint(inner, start), innerBottom = polarPoint(inner, start + 180);
    return `M ${top.x} ${top.y} A ${outer} ${outer} 0 1 1 ${bottom.x} ${bottom.y} A ${outer} ${outer} 0 1 1 ${top.x} ${top.y} Z M ${innerTop.x} ${innerTop.y} A ${inner} ${inner} 0 1 0 ${innerBottom.x} ${innerBottom.y} A ${inner} ${inner} 0 1 0 ${innerTop.x} ${innerTop.y} Z`;
  }
  const gap = Math.min(1.4, (end - start) * .15);
  const outerStart = polarPoint(outer, start + gap), outerEnd = polarPoint(outer, end - gap);
  const innerEnd = polarPoint(inner, end - gap), innerStart = polarPoint(inner, start + gap);
  const largeArc = end - start - gap * 2 > 180 ? 1 : 0;
  return `M ${outerStart.x} ${outerStart.y} A ${outer} ${outer} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${outerEnd.x} ${outerEnd.y} L ${innerEnd.x} ${innerEnd.y} A ${inner} ${inner} 0 ${largeArc} 0 ${innerStart.x} ${innerStart.y} Z`;
};
const formatPercent = (value: number | null) => value === null ? "—" : `${formatDashboardValue(value)}%`;
const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
const weekRange = (date: string, range: { start: Date; end: Date }) => {
  const monday = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00`);
  const sunday = new Date(monday);
  sunday.setDate(sunday.getDate() + 7);
  sunday.setMilliseconds(-1);
  return { start: new Date(Math.max(monday.getTime(), range.start.getTime())), end: new Date(Math.min(sunday.getTime(), range.end.getTime())) };
};
const formatWeek = (range: { start: Date; end: Date }) => `${dateFormat.format(range.start)} — ${dateFormat.format(range.end)}`;

const TeacherStatistics = () => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const now = useDashboardUpdate();
  const [subjectId, setSubjectId] = useState("all");
  const [groupId, setGroupId] = useState("all");
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<AnalyticsPeriod>("semester");
  const [selectedWeek, setSelectedWeek] = useState(() => new Date());
  const [selectedGrade, setSelectedGrade] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [drillWeek, setDrillWeek] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showAllRisks, setShowAllRisks] = useState(false);
  const [attendanceSort, setAttendanceSort] = useState<SortDirection>("desc");
  const [gradeSort, setGradeSort] = useState<SortDirection>("desc");
  const [exportMessage, setExportMessage] = useState("");
  const segmentRefs = useRef<Array<SVGGElement | null>>([]);
  const { journals, warnings } = useMemo(() => readAnalyticsJournals(currentUser.memberships), [currentUser.memberships, now]);
  const subjects = currentUser.memberships.flatMap((membership) => { const subject = getAcademicSubjectDefinition(membership.subjectId); return subject ? [subject] : []; });
  const groups = Array.from(new Set(currentUser.memberships.filter((membership) => subjectId === "all" || membership.subjectId === subjectId).flatMap((membership) => membership.groupIds))).flatMap((id) => { const group = getAcademicGroup(id); return group ? [group] : []; });
  const baseRange = getAnalyticsRange(period, now, selectedWeek);
  const drilledRange = drillWeek ? weekRange(drillWeek, baseRange) : null;
  const range = drilledRange && drilledRange.start <= drilledRange.end ? drilledRange : baseRange;
  const scopedJournals = useMemo(() => journals.filter((journal) => (subjectId === "all" || journal.subjectId === subjectId) && (groupId === "all" || journal.groupId === groupId)), [journals, subjectId, groupId]);
  const selected = selectedGrade;
  const rangeStart = range.start.getTime(), rangeEnd = range.end.getTime();
  const baseStart = baseRange.start.getTime(), baseEnd = baseRange.end.getTime();
  const { gradeContext, analytics, trend } = useMemo(() => {
    const assignments = getAssignments(), submissions = getSubmissions();
    const scopedRange = { start: new Date(rangeStart), end: new Date(rangeEnd) };
    const gradeContext = calculateTeacherAnalytics(scopedJournals, assignments, submissions, scopedRange);
    return {
      gradeContext,
      analytics: selected === null ? gradeContext : calculateTeacherAnalytics(scopedJournals, assignments, submissions, scopedRange, GRADE_SEGMENTS[selected].grade),
      trend: calculateTeacherAnalytics(scopedJournals, assignments, submissions, { start: new Date(baseStart), end: new Date(baseEnd) }).trend,
    };
  }, [scopedJournals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, baseStart, baseEnd, selected]);
  const rangeLabel = `${dateFormat.format(range.start)} — ${dateFormat.format(range.end)} ${range.end.getFullYear()}`;
  const attendanceGroups = [...analytics.groupMetrics].sort((a, b) => a.attendance === null ? b.attendance === null ? 0 : 1 : b.attendance === null ? -1 : attendanceSort === "asc" ? a.attendance - b.attendance : b.attendance - a.attendance);
  const gradeGroups = analytics.groupMetrics.filter((group): group is typeof group & { average: number } => group.average !== null).sort((a, b) => gradeSort === "asc" ? a.average - b.average : b.average - a.average);
  const completion = analytics.work.expected ? analytics.work.received / analytics.work.expected * 100 : null;
  const activeTrend = trend.find((point) => point.date === drillWeek) ?? trend.at(-1);
  const gradeShare = (index: number) => gradeContext.distribution[index] && !gradeContext.shares[index] ? "<1%" : `${gradeContext.shares[index]}%`;
  const moveSegment = (event: KeyboardEvent<SVGGElement>, index: number) => {
    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault(); setSelectedGrade(selected === index ? null : index); setExportMessage(""); return;
    }
    if (!["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const available = gradeContext.distribution.flatMap((count, item) => count ? [item] : []);
    const position = available.indexOf(index);
    const next = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? available.length - 1 : (position + (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1) + available.length) % available.length;
    segmentRefs.current[available[next]]?.focus();
  };
  const exportReport = () => {
    try {
      const context = `${getAcademicSubjectDefinition(subjectId)?.name ?? "Все дисциплины"} · ${getAcademicGroup(groupId)?.name ?? "Все группы"}${selected !== null ? ` · Оценка ${GRADE_SEGMENTS[selected].grade}` : ""}${warnings.length ? " · Не все журналы доступны для чтения" : ""}`;
      downloadJournalCsv(createAnalyticsCsv(analytics, range, context), `statistics-${period}-${toLocalDateKey(period === "week" || drillWeek ? range.start : now)}${selected !== null ? `-grade-${GRADE_SEGMENTS[selected].grade}` : ""}.csv`);
      setExportMessage("CSV подготовлен. Скачивание зависит от настроек браузера.");
    } catch { setExportMessage("Не удалось подготовить отчёт. Попробуйте ещё раз."); }
  };

  return <div className={styles.dashboard}>
    <div className={styles.filters}>
      <SelectField variant="main" label="Дисциплина" value={subjectId} onChange={(value) => { setSubjectId(value); setGroupId("all"); setSelectedGrade(null); setExportMessage(""); }} options={[{ value: "all", label: "Все дисциплины" }, ...subjects.map((subject) => ({ value: subject.id, label: subject.name }))]} />
      <SelectField variant="main" label="Группа" value={groupId} onChange={(value) => { setGroupId(value); setSelectedGrade(null); setExportMessage(""); }} options={[{ value: "all", label: "Все группы" }, ...groups.map((group) => ({ value: group.id, label: group.name }))]} />
      <SelectField variant="main" label="Период" value={period} onChange={(value) => { setPeriod(value as AnalyticsPeriod); setDrillWeek(null); setSelectedGrade(null); setExportMessage(""); }} options={PERIODS} />
    </div>
    {period === "week" && <WeekPicker value={selectedWeek} onWeekChange={(date) => { setSelectedWeek(date); setDrillWeek(null); setSelectedGrade(null); setExportMessage(""); }} />}
    {(selected !== null || drillWeek) && <div className={styles.activeFilters} aria-label="Активные фильтры"><span>Фильтры:</span>{selected !== null && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setSelectedGrade(null); setExportMessage(""); }}>Оценка {GRADE_SEGMENTS[selected].grade} ×</button>}{drillWeek && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDrillWeek(null); setExportMessage(""); }}>{formatWeek(range)} ×</button>}<button type="button" onClick={() => { setSelectedGrade(null); setDrillWeek(null); setExportMessage(""); }}>Сбросить всё</button>{selected !== null && <small>Посещаемость, работы и риски — по студентам, получившим эту оценку за период. Баллы — только выбранная оценка.</small>}</div>}
    <div className={styles.contextBar}><div><strong>{rangeLabel}</strong><span>Локальные учебные данные · обновляются вместе с журналом</span></div><button type="button" onClick={exportReport}>Скачать отчёт CSV <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></button></div>
    {exportMessage && <p className={styles.exportStatus} role="status">{exportMessage}</p>}
    {warnings.length > 0 && <p className={styles.dataWarning} role="alert">Не удалось прочитать журналы: {warnings.join(", ")}. Они исключены из расчётов; сохранённые записи не изменены.</p>}
    <section className={styles.metrics} aria-label="Ключевые показатели">
      <article><span>Студентов</span><strong>{analytics.students}</strong><small>Без повторов · {formatCount(analytics.groups, ["группа", "группы", "групп"])} · {formatCount(analytics.journals, ["журнал", "журнала", "журналов"])}</small></article>
      <article><span>Посещаемость</span><strong>{formatPercent(analytics.attendance)}</strong><small>{analytics.marked ? `По ${formatCount(analytics.marked, ["заполненной отметке", "заполненным отметкам", "заполненным отметкам"])}` : "За период нет отметок посещаемости"}</small></article>
      <article><span>Средний балл</span><strong>{formatDashboardValue(analytics.averageGrade, 2)}</strong><small>{analytics.gradesCount ? `По ${formatCount(analytics.gradesCount, ["оценке", "оценкам", "оценкам"])} · практики и лабораторные` : "За практики и лабораторные оценок нет"}</small></article>
      <article className={styles.riskMetric}><span>Требуют внимания</span><strong>{analytics.risks.length}</strong><small>По отметкам и просроченным работам</small></article>
    </section>
    <details className={styles.methodology}><summary>Как считаются показатели</summary><p>Посещаемость — доля присутствий среди заполненных отметок проведённых занятий. Уважительная причина и пропуск входят в знаменатель; «не отмечено» — нет. Средний балл и распределение учитывают только выставленные оценки 5, 4, 3 и 2 за проведённые практики и лабораторные за период. Лекции и занятия без оценки не учитываются и не заменяются нулём. Один студент одной группы учитывается в численности один раз, даже если изучает несколько дисциплин.</p><p>Задания отбираются по дате занятия, без черновиков и архива. Ожидаемые ответы считаются по текущему составу группы. Внимание: посещаемость ниже 65% при наличии хотя бы трёх отметок, средний балл ниже 3 при двух оценках или две работы к сдаче после срока. Это сигналы для преподавателя, не официальный статус студента.</p></details>

    <div className={styles.mainGrid}>
      <section className={styles.chartCard}>
        <header><div><span>Оценки · выбор фильтра</span><h2>Распределение результатов</h2></div><strong className={styles.sampleCount}>{gradeContext.gradesCount}</strong></header>
        {gradeContext.gradesCount ? <><div className={styles.gradeChart}>
          <div className={styles.donutWrap}><svg className={`${styles.donut} ${selected !== null ? styles.filteredDonut : ""}`} viewBox="0 0 110 110" role="group" aria-label="Распределение оценок журнала">
            {GRADE_SEGMENTS.map((segment, index) => {
              if (!gradeContext.distribution[index]) return null;
              const start = gradeContext.distribution.slice(0, index).reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0) / gradeContext.gradesCount * 360;
              const end = start + gradeContext.distribution[index] / gradeContext.gradesCount * 360;
              const toggle = () => { setSelectedGrade(selected === index ? null : index); setExportMessage(""); };
              return <g key={segment.grade} ref={(node) => { segmentRefs.current[index] = node; }} className={styles.segmentGroup} style={{ color: segment.color }} role="button" tabIndex={0} aria-pressed={selected === index} onClick={toggle} onKeyDown={(event) => moveSegment(event, index)} aria-label={`Оценка ${segment.grade}, ${segment.label}: ${gradeContext.distribution[index]}, ${gradeShare(index)}. ${selected === index ? "Снять фильтр" : "Фильтровать данные"}`}><path className={styles.hitSegment} d={donutSegmentPath(start, end, false)} /><path className={`${styles.donutSegment} ${selected === index ? styles.selectedSegment : ""}`} d={donutSegmentPath(start, end, selected === index)} fill={selected === index ? segment.color : "none"} stroke={segment.color} /></g>;
            })}
          </svg><div className={styles.donutValue}><strong>{selected === null ? "100%" : gradeShare(selected)}</strong><span>{selected === null ? "Все оценки" : `${formatCount(gradeContext.distribution[selected], ["оценка", "оценки", "оценок"])} «${GRADE_SEGMENTS[selected].grade}»`}</span></div></div>
          <div className={styles.legend}>{GRADE_SEGMENTS.map((segment, index) => <button type="button" disabled={!gradeContext.distribution[index] && selected !== index} aria-pressed={selected === index} className={selected === index ? styles.activeLegend : ""} onClick={() => { setSelectedGrade(selected === index ? null : index); setExportMessage(""); }} key={segment.grade}><i style={{ background: segment.color }} /><span>{segment.grade} · {segment.label}<small>{formatCount(gradeContext.distribution[index], ["оценка", "оценки", "оценок"])}</small></span><strong>{gradeShare(index)}</strong></button>)}</div>
        </div><p className={styles.chartHint}>Нажмите на оценку, чтобы отфильтровать показатели, сравнения, работы и риски. Повторный клик снимает фильтр. Круг сохраняет все оценки выбранного периода для переключения.</p></> : <div className={styles.chartEmpty}><strong>Пока нет оценок за практики и лабораторные</strong><p>Выберите другой период или внесите оценки в журнал. Лекции и занятия без оценки в график не входят.</p><Link to="/journal">Открыть журнал →</Link></div>}
      </section>
      <section className={`${styles.chartCard} ${styles.trendCard}`}><header><div><span>Обзор периода · выбор недели</span><h2>Посещаемость по неделям</h2></div><div className={styles.trendValue}><strong>{formatPercent(activeTrend?.value ?? null)}</strong><small>{activeTrend ? `${drillWeek === activeTrend.date ? "Выбрано: " : "Последняя: "}${formatWeek(weekRange(activeTrend.date, baseRange))}` : "Нет отметок"}</small></div></header>
        {trend.length ? <><LineChart data={trend.map((point) => Math.round(point.value * 10) / 10)} labels={trend.map((point) => formatWeek(weekRange(point.date, baseRange)))} length={trend.length} height={260} selectedIndex={trend.findIndex((point) => point.date === drillWeek)} onPointSelect={(index) => { setDrillWeek(drillWeek === trend[index].date ? null : trend[index].date); setExportMessage(""); }} /><p className={styles.chartHint}>Нажмите на точку недели: показатели и CSV будут отобраны за её даты. Для переключения график сохраняет полный период и всех студентов выбранных групп, независимо от фильтра оценки. Повторный клик снимает фильтр недели.</p></> : <div className={styles.chartEmpty}><strong>Нет данных для динамики</strong><p>За выбранный период нет заполненных отметок проведённых занятий.</p></div>}
      </section>
    </div>

    <div className={styles.middleGrid}>
      <section className={`${styles.chartCard} ${styles.riskCard}`}><header><div><span>Контроль</span><h2>Требуют внимания</h2></div>{analytics.risks.length > 4 && <button type="button" aria-expanded={showAllRisks} onClick={() => setShowAllRisks((value) => !value)}>{showAllRisks ? "Свернуть" : `Все ${analytics.risks.length}`}</button>}</header>
        <div className={styles.riskList}>{analytics.risks.slice(0, showAllRisks ? analytics.risks.length : 4).map((student) => <div key={student.key}><span>{student.initials}</span><p><strong><Link to={getJournalHrefById(student.subjectId, student.groupId)} title="Открыть журнал группы">{student.name}</Link> <em>{student.groupName}</em></strong><small>{student.reasons.join(" · ")}</small></p><b className={student.level === "Средний" ? styles.medium : ""}>{student.level}</b></div>)}{!analytics.risks.length && <p className={styles.emptyRisk}>По доступным данным за этот период сигналов риска нет.</p>}</div>
      </section>
      <section className={`${styles.chartCard} ${styles.workCard}`}><header><div><span>Учебная активность</span><h2>Выполнение работ</h2></div><strong>{formatPercent(completion)}</strong></header>
        <p className={styles.chartHint}>{analytics.work.received} из {analytics.work.expected} ожидаемых ответов · заданий: {analytics.work.assignments}</p>
        <div className={styles.workProgress} role="progressbar" aria-label="Получено ответов" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={Math.max(analytics.work.expected, 1)} aria-valuenow={analytics.work.received}><i style={{ width: `${completion ?? 0}%` }} /></div>
        <div className={styles.workStats}><div><span>Первый ответ вовремя</span><strong>{analytics.work.onTime}</strong></div><div><span>На проверке</span><strong>{analytics.work.waiting}</strong></div><div><span>Без ответа после срока</span><strong>{analytics.work.overdue}</strong></div><div><span>На доработке</span><strong>{analytics.work.revision}</strong></div><div><span>Проверено</span><strong>{analytics.work.graded}</strong></div><Link to="/journal"><strong>Журнал →</strong><span>Открыть задания групп</span></Link></div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <div className={styles.lowerGrid}>
      <section className={styles.chartCard}><header><div><span>Сравнение журналов</span><h2>Посещаемость</h2></div><SortControls value={attendanceSort} onChange={setAttendanceSort} /></header>{attendanceGroups.length ? <div className={styles.groupBars}>{attendanceGroups.map((group) => <Link className={styles.groupBar} to={getJournalHrefById(group.subjectId, group.groupId)} key={group.id} title={`${group.subjectName} · открыть журнал`}><span>{group.groupName}<small>{group.subjectShortName}</small></span><div><i style={{ width: `${group.attendance ?? 0}%` }} /></div><strong>{formatPercent(group.attendance)}</strong></Link>)}</div> : <p className={styles.chartHint}>Нет журналов для сравнения с выбранными фильтрами. Измените период или снимите фильтр оценки.</p>}<p className={styles.chartHint}>Процент считается по заполненным отметкам, а не средним из процентов групп. «—» означает, что отметок нет, а не нулевую посещаемость.</p></section>
      <section className={styles.chartCard}><header><div><span>Сравнение журналов</span><h2>Средний балл</h2></div><SortControls value={gradeSort} onChange={setGradeSort} /></header>{gradeGroups.length ? <div className={styles.groupBars}>{gradeGroups.map((group) => <Link className={styles.groupBar} to={getJournalHrefById(group.subjectId, group.groupId)} key={group.id} title={`${group.subjectName} · открыть журнал`}><span>{group.groupName}<small>{group.subjectShortName}</small></span><div><i style={{ width: `${group.average / 5 * 100}%` }} /></div><strong>{formatDashboardValue(group.average, 2)}</strong></Link>)}</div> : <p className={styles.chartHint}>Нет оценок за практики и лабораторные для сравнения.</p>}<p className={styles.chartHint}>Только практики и лабораторные; журналы без оценок не отображаются. Нажмите на строку, чтобы открыть журнал.</p></section>
    </div>
  </div>;
};

export default TeacherStatistics;


// src\components\ThemeContext\index.tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

type Theme = "dark" | "light";
type ThemeContextValue = { theme: Theme; toggleTheme(): void };

const STORAGE_KEY = "bi-university-theme";
const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | null>(null);

const readTheme = (): Theme => {
  try { return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === "light" ? "light" : "dark"; }
  catch { return "dark"; }
};

export const ThemeProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(readTheme);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    try { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, theme); }
    catch { /* Переключатель работает до перезагрузки даже без доступа к хранилищу. */ }
  }, [theme]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    theme,
    toggleTheme: () => {
      const next = theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = next;
      setTheme(next);
    },
  }), [theme]);

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider");
  return context;
};

// src\components\TimeWheel\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from "react";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const ITEM_HEIGHT = 38;

interface TimeColumnProps {
  label: string;
  max: number;
  value: number;
  onChange(value: number): void;
}

const TimeColumn = ({ label, max, value, onChange }: TimeColumnProps) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const optionId = useId();
  const scrollTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const latest = useRef({ value, onChange });
  const values = Array.from({ length: max + 1 }, (_, index) => index);

  useEffect(() => { latest.current = { value, onChange }; }, [value, onChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = value * ITEM_HEIGHT;
    if (ref.current && Math.abs(ref.current.scrollTop - target) > 1) ref.current.scrollTo({ top: target });
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (scrollTimer.current) clearTimeout(scrollTimer.current);
  }, []);

  const selectFromScroll = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(max, Math.round(ref.current.scrollTop / ITEM_HEIGHT)));
    if (next !== latest.current.value) latest.current.onChange(next);
  };

  const move = (direction: number) => onChange(Math.max(0, Math.min(max, value + direction)));

  return <div className={styles.columnWrap}>
    <span className={styles.columnLabel}>{label}</span>
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={styles.column}
      role="listbox"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-activedescendant={`${optionId}-${value}`}
      onScroll={() => {
        if (scrollTimer.current) clearTimeout(scrollTimer.current);
        scrollTimer.current = setTimeout(selectFromScroll, 70);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "ArrowDown") { event.preventDefault(); move(1); }
        if (event.key === "ArrowUp") { event.preventDefault(); move(-1); }
        if (event.key === "PageDown") { event.preventDefault(); move(5); }
        if (event.key === "PageUp") { event.preventDefault(); move(-5); }
        if (event.key === "Home") { event.preventDefault(); onChange(0); }
        if (event.key === "End") { event.preventDefault(); onChange(max); }
      }}
    >
      {values.map((item) => <button id={`${optionId}-${item}`} tabIndex={-1} type="button" role="option" aria-selected={item === value} className={item === value ? styles.selected : ""} key={item} onClick={() => { onChange(item); ref.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }}>{String(item).padStart(2, "0")}</button>)}
    </div>
  </div>;
};

interface TimeWheelProps {
  hours: number;
  minutes: number;
  onChange(hours: number, minutes: number): void;
}

const TimeWheel = ({ hours, minutes, onChange }: TimeWheelProps) => <div className={styles.timeWheel} aria-label="Выбор времени">
  <div className={styles.selectedRail} aria-hidden="true" />
  <TimeColumn label="Часы" max={23} value={hours} onChange={(next) => onChange(next, minutes)} />
  <span className={styles.separator}>:</span>
  <TimeColumn label="Минуты" max={59} value={minutes} onChange={(next) => onChange(hours, next)} />
</div>;

export default TimeWheel;

// src\components\TodaySchedule\index.tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import Schedule from "../ScheduleWidget";
import { useRole } from "../RoleContext";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule, getPersonalSchedule } from "../../data/schedule";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import ArrowCircle from "../ArrowCircle";

interface Props { date?: Date }
export default function TodaySchedule({ date }: Props) {
  const { role } = useRole();
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date());
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 15000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  const selectedDate = date ?? now;
  const key = toLocalDateKey(selectedDate);
  const isToday = key === toLocalDateKey(now);
  const schedule = getPersonalSchedule(getDemoWeekSchedule(selectedDate), role).filter((lesson) => lesson.date === key);
  let nextDate: Date | undefined;
  let nextSchedule = schedule;
  if (!schedule.length) {
    for (let offset = 1; offset <= 14; offset++) {
      const candidate = new Date(selectedDate);
      candidate.setDate(candidate.getDate() + offset);
      const lessons = getPersonalSchedule(getDemoWeekSchedule(candidate), role).filter((lesson) => lesson.date === toLocalDateKey(candidate));
      if (lessons.length) { nextDate = candidate; nextSchedule = lessons.slice(0, 2); break; }
    }
  }
  const href = `/schedule?date=${key}`;

  return (
    <section className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <h2>{isToday ? "Сегодня, " : ""}{selectedDate.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" })}</h2>
        <Link to={href}>Расписание<ArrowCircle hoverBackground="transparent" hoverColor="inherit" /></Link>
      </div>
      <p className={styles.caption}>{selectedDate.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { weekday: "long" })} · демонстрационное расписание</p>
      {schedule.length ? <Schedule schedule={schedule} currentTime={now} /> : <>
        <div className={styles.freeDay}><span aria-hidden="true">✓</span><div><strong>{isToday ? "Сегодня без занятий" : "На этот день занятий нет"}</strong><p>Можно уделить время задачам и подготовке к следующей паре.</p></div></div>
        {nextDate && <div className={styles.nextDay}><div className={styles.nextHeader}><span>Следующий учебный день</span><Link to={`/schedule?date=${toLocalDateKey(nextDate)}`}>{nextDate.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" })}<ArrowCircle /></Link></div><Schedule schedule={nextSchedule} currentTime={now} /></div>}
      </>}
    </section>
  );
}

// src\components\Tooltip\index.tsx
import { cloneElement, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const OPEN_EVENT = "bi-university-tooltip-open";
interface Props { label: string; children: ReactElement<{ "aria-describedby"?: string }> }
const Tooltip = ({ label, children }: Props) => {
  const id = useId();
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ left: 0, top: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    const hide = () => setVisible(false);
    const escape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === "Escape") hide(); };
    const hideForAnother = (event: Event) => { if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail !== id) hide(); };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", hide, true);
    window.addEventListener("resize", hide);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", escape);
    document.addEventListener(OPEN_EVENT, hideForAnother);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("scroll", hide, true); window.removeEventListener("resize", hide); document.removeEventListener("keydown", escape); document.removeEventListener(OPEN_EVENT, hideForAnother); };
  }, [visible, id]);
  const show = () => {
    const rect = anchorRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect) return;
    const width = Math.min(240, window.innerWidth - 24);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(OPEN_EVENT, { detail: id }));
    setPosition({ left: Math.max(12, Math.min(rect.left + rect.width / 2 - width / 2, window.innerWidth - width - 12)), top: rect.bottom + 60 < window.innerHeight ? rect.bottom + 8 : Math.max(8, rect.top - 52) });
    setVisible(true);
  };
  return <div className={styles.anchor} ref={anchorRef} onMouseEnter={show} onMouseLeave={() => { if (!anchorRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement)) setVisible(false); }} onFocus={show} onBlur={(event) => { if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setVisible(false); }}>
    {cloneElement(children, { "aria-describedby": visible ? [children.props["aria-describedby"], id].filter(Boolean).join(" ") : children.props["aria-describedby"] })}
    {visible && createPortal(<div id={id} role="tooltip" className={styles.tooltip} style={position}>{label}</div>, document.body)}
  </div>;
};

export default Tooltip;
