// src\components\WeekPicker\index.tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import Dropdown from '../Dropdown';
import {
  startOfWeek,
  endOfWeek,
  addWeeks,
  format,
  differenceInCalendarWeeks,
  isBefore,
  isAfter,
} from 'date-fns';
import { ru } from 'date-fns/locale';
import styles from './index.module.scss';
import ArrowCircle from '../ArrowCircle';

const WEEK_OPTIONS = { locale: ru, weekStartsOn: 1 as 1 };


const formatDateRange = (startDate: Date, endDate: Date): string => {
  const startDay = format(startDate, 'd', WEEK_OPTIONS);
  const startMonth = format(startDate, 'MMMM', WEEK_OPTIONS);
  const endDay = format(endDate, 'd', WEEK_OPTIONS);
  const endMonth = format(endDate, 'MMMM', WEEK_OPTIONS);
  const year = format(endDate, 'yyyy', WEEK_OPTIONS);

  if (startMonth === endMonth) {
    return `${startDay} - ${endDay} ${endMonth} ${year} г.`;
  } else {
    return `${startDay} ${startMonth} - ${endDay} ${endMonth} ${year} г.`;
  }
};
const getWeekNumberAndType = (date: Date, start: Date) => {
  const weekNumber =
    differenceInCalendarWeeks(date, start, WEEK_OPTIONS) + 1;

  const type = weekNumber % 2 === 1 ? 'числ.' : 'знам.';
  return { weekNumber, type };
};

const getAcademicYearBounds = (date: Date) => {
  const month = date.getMonth(); // 0 = январь
  const year = date.getFullYear();

  // январь–июль → учебный год начался в прошлом году
  const startYear = month < 8 ? year - 1 : year;

  const start = new Date(startYear, 8, 1); // 1 сентября
  const end = new Date(startYear + 1, 6, 31); // 31 июля

  return { start, end };
};

interface WeekOption {
  value: Date;
  label: string;
}

interface WeekPickerProps {
  onWeekChange?: (week: Date) => void;
  value?: Date;
}

const WeekPicker: React.FC<WeekPickerProps> = ({ onWeekChange, value }) => {
  const today = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const [internalDate, setCurrentDate] = useState<Date>(today);
  const currentDate = value ?? internalDate;
const weeks: WeekOption[] = useMemo(() => {
  // A Monday can fall in August while its teaching week already includes 1 September.
  const { start, end } = getAcademicYearBounds(endOfWeek(currentDate, WEEK_OPTIONS));

  const list: WeekOption[] = [];
  let current = startOfWeek(start, WEEK_OPTIONS);

  while (!isAfter(current, end)) {
    const weekStart = startOfWeek(current, WEEK_OPTIONS);
    const weekEnd = endOfWeek(current, WEEK_OPTIONS);
    const { weekNumber, type } = getWeekNumberAndType(weekStart, start);

    list.push({
      value: weekStart,
      label: `${formatDateRange(isBefore(weekStart, start) ? start : weekStart, isAfter(weekEnd, end) ? end : weekEnd)} (неделя ${weekNumber}, ${type})`,
    });

    current = addWeeks(current, 1);
  }

  return list;
}, [currentDate]);


  const minWeek = weeks[0]?.value;
  const maxWeek = weeks[weeks.length - 1]?.value;
  const goToCurrentWeek = () => {
  setCurrentDate(today);
  onWeekChange?.(today);
  };
  const changeWeek = (offset: number) => {
    const next = addWeeks(currentDate, offset);
    const bounded = minWeek && isBefore(next, minWeek) ? minWeek : maxWeek && isAfter(next, maxWeek) ? maxWeek : next;
    setCurrentDate(bounded);
    onWeekChange?.(bounded);
  };

  const handleChange = (value: string) => {
    const selected = weeks.find((week) => String(week.value.getTime()) === value);
    if (!selected) return;
    setCurrentDate(selected.value);
    onWeekChange?.(selected.value);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.weekPicker}>
      <div className={styles.weekPickerControls}>
        <div className={styles.weekPickerDisplayWrapper}>
          <Dropdown
            variant="main"
            label="Учебная неделя"
            hideLabel
            value={String(startOfWeek(currentDate, WEEK_OPTIONS).getTime())}
            onChange={handleChange}
            options={weeks.map((week) => ({ value: String(week.value.getTime()), label: week.label }))}
          />
        </div>

        <button
          className={styles.weekPickerArrow}
          onClick={() => changeWeek(-1)}
          disabled={minWeek && isBefore(addWeeks(currentDate, -1), minWeek)}
          aria-label="Предыдущая неделя"
        >
          <ArrowCircle direction="left" />
        </button>

        <button
          className={styles.weekPickerCurrentButton}
          onClick={goToCurrentWeek}
        >
          Текущая неделя
        </button>

        <button
          className={styles.weekPickerArrow}
          onClick={() => changeWeek(1)}
          disabled={maxWeek && isAfter(addWeeks(currentDate, 1), maxWeek)}
          aria-label="Следующая неделя"
        >
          <ArrowCircle />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default WeekPicker;


// src\data\academicCatalog.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { ACADEMIC_GROUPS, getAcademicGroup, getAcademicSubjectByName, getJournalHref, isAcademicMembershipMatch, SUBJECT_GROUP_OFFERINGS, SUBJECTS } from "./academicCatalog";

describe("academic catalog", () => {
  const memberships = [{ subjectId: "data-analysis", groupIds: ["112-mko", "411-bi"] }];

  it("resolves canonical subject and group values", () => {
    expect(getAcademicSubjectByName("Анализ данных")?.id).toBe("data-analysis");
    expect(getAcademicGroup("411-bi")?.name).toBe("411-БИ");
  });

  it("builds journal routes without manual transliteration", () => {
    expect(getJournalHref("Анализ данных", "411-БИ")).toBe("/journal/data-analysis/411-bi");
    expect(getJournalHref("Неизвестный предмет", "411-БИ")).toBe("/journal");
  });

  it("matches a subject and group against memberships", () => {
    expect(isAcademicMembershipMatch(memberships, "Анализ данных", "411-БИ")).toBe(true);
    expect(isAcademicMembershipMatch(memberships, "Анализ данных", "412-БИ")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("contains unique IDs and no dangling offerings", () => {
    expect(new Set(SUBJECTS.map((item) => item.id)).size).toBe(SUBJECTS.length);
    expect(new Set(ACADEMIC_GROUPS.map((item) => item.id)).size).toBe(ACADEMIC_GROUPS.length);
    const subjectIds = new Set(SUBJECTS.map((item) => item.id));
    const groupIds = new Set(ACADEMIC_GROUPS.map((item) => item.id));
    const pairs = SUBJECT_GROUP_OFFERINGS.map((item) => `${item.subjectId}:${item.groupId}`);
    expect(new Set(pairs).size).toBe(pairs.length);
    expect(SUBJECT_GROUP_OFFERINGS.every((item) => subjectIds.has(item.subjectId) && groupIds.has(item.groupId))).toBe(true);
  });
});


// src\data\academicCatalog.ts
export interface AcademicGroup {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  students: number;
  course: number;
}

export interface AcademicSubjectDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  semester: string;
  color: "red" | "purple" | "orange" | "green";
}

export interface AcademicSubject extends AcademicSubjectDefinition {
  groups: Array<AcademicGroup & { attendance: number }>;
}

export interface SubjectGroupOffering {
  subjectId: string;
  groupId: string;
  attendance: number;
}

export interface AcademicMembership {
  subjectId: string;
  groupIds: string[];
}

export const getAcademicGroup = (groupId?: string) => ACADEMIC_GROUPS.find((group) => group.id === groupId);
export const getAcademicGroupByName = (name?: string) => ACADEMIC_GROUPS.find((group) => group.name === name);
export const getAcademicSubjectDefinition = (subjectId?: string) => SUBJECTS.find((subject) => subject.id === subjectId);
export const getAcademicSubjectByName = (name?: string) => SUBJECTS.find((subject) => subject.name === name);
export const getSubjectGroups = (subjectId: string) => SUBJECT_GROUP_OFFERINGS
  .filter((offering) => offering.subjectId === subjectId)
  .flatMap((offering) => {
    const group = getAcademicGroup(offering.groupId);
    return group ? [{ ...group, attendance: offering.attendance }] : [];
  });

export const ACADEMIC_SUBJECTS: AcademicSubject[] = SUBJECTS.map((subject) => ({ ...subject, groups: getSubjectGroups(subject.id) }));
export const getAcademicSubject = (subjectId?: string) => ACADEMIC_SUBJECTS.find((subject) => subject.id === subjectId);

export const isAcademicMembershipMatch = (memberships: AcademicMembership[], subjectName: string, groupName: string) => {
  const subjectId = getAcademicSubjectByName(subjectName)?.id;
  const groupId = getAcademicGroupByName(groupName)?.id;
  return Boolean(subjectId && groupId && memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(groupId)));
};

export const getJournalHref = (subjectName: string, groupName?: string) => {
  const subjectId = getAcademicSubjectByName(subjectName)?.id;
  if (!subjectId) return "/journal";
  const groupId = getAcademicGroupByName(groupName)?.id;
  return groupId ? `/journal/${subjectId}/${groupId}` : `/journal/${subjectId}`;
};

export const getJournalHrefById = (subjectId?: string, groupId?: string) => {
  if (!getAcademicSubjectDefinition(subjectId)) return "/journal";
  return groupId && getAcademicGroup(groupId) ? `/journal/${subjectId}/${groupId}` : `/journal/${subjectId}`;
};


// src\data\answerDraftStore.ts
interface AnswerDraft { text: string; fileName?: string }
interface DraftState { draft?: AnswerDraft; error: string }

// Drafts stay in this tab and are isolated by student, assignment and attempt.
export const getAnswerDraftKey = (studentId: string, assignmentId: string, attemptId?: string) =>
  `bi-university-answer-draft:${JSON.stringify([studentId, assignmentId, attemptId ?? "first"])}`;

export const readAnswerDraft = (key: string): DraftState => {
  try {
    const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
    if (!saved) return { error: "" };
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("text" in value) || typeof value.text !== "string" || ("fileName" in value && typeof value.fileName !== "string")) throw new Error("Invalid answer draft");
    return { draft: { text: value.text, fileName: "fileName" in value ? value.fileName as string : undefined }, error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { error: "Не удалось восстановить черновик из этой вкладки. Новый текст можно ввести и отправить вручную." };
  }
};

export const saveAnswerDraft = (key: string, draft: AnswerDraft) => {
  try { sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(draft)); return true; }
  catch { return false; }
};

export const removeAnswerDraft = (key: string) => {
  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(key); return true; }
  catch { return false; }
};


// src\data\assignmentStore.test.ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { getAssignments, getSubmissions, removeAssignmentRecords, saveAssignments, saveSubmissions, type Submission } from "./assignmentStore";

const values = new Map<string, string>();
const storage = {
  getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
  setItem: vi.fn((key: string, value: string) => { values.set(key, value); }),
  removeItem: (key: string) => { values.delete(key); },
};
const dispatch = vi.fn();
const answer: Submission = { id: "answer-1", assignmentId: "linear-algebra-rgr-2", studentId: "anna-smirnova", studentName: "Анна Смирнова", text: "Финальный ответ", grade: "5", teacherComment: "Хорошо", status: "graded", sentAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-13T12:00", attachmentId: "latest-file", attachmentName: "latest.pdf" };

beforeEach(() => {
  values.clear();
  storage.setItem.mockClear();
  dispatch.mockClear();
  vi.stubGlobal("localStorage", storage);
  vi.stubGlobal("window", { dispatchEvent: dispatch });
});
afterEach(() => { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); });

describe("assignment persistence", () => {
  it("migrates legacy answers without losing their feedback", () => {
    saveSubmissions([answer]);
    const saved = getSubmissions()[0];
    expect(saved.attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(saved.attempts?.[0]).toMatchObject({ text: answer.text, grade: "5", teacherComment: "Хорошо", attachmentId: "latest-file", status: "graded" });
  });

  it("does not copy the latest grade, file, or comment into earlier attempts", () => {
    saveSubmissions([{ ...answer, attempts: [
      { id: "first", number: 1, text: "Первый ответ", status: "revision", teacherComment: "Исправить", sentAt: answer.sentAt, updatedAt: answer.sentAt, submittedLate: false },
      { id: "second", number: 2, text: answer.text, grade: "5", status: "graded", teacherComment: "Хорошо", attachmentId: "latest-file", attachmentName: "latest.pdf", sentAt: answer.updatedAt, updatedAt: answer.updatedAt, submittedLate: false },
    ] }]);
    const saved = getSubmissions()[0];
    expect(saved.attempts?.[0].grade).toBeUndefined();
    expect(saved.attempts?.[0].attachmentId).toBeUndefined();
    expect(saved.attempts?.[0].teacherComment).toBe("Исправить");
    expect(saved.grade).toBe("5");
    saveSubmissions([saved]);
    expect(getSubmissions()[0]).toEqual(saved);
  });

  it("preserves an empty answer and absent feedback in a structured attempt", () => {
    saveSubmissions([{ ...answer, attempts: [{ id: "first", number: 1, text: "", status: "submitted", sentAt: answer.sentAt, updatedAt: answer.sentAt, submittedLate: false }] }]);
    expect(getSubmissions()[0]).toMatchObject({ text: "", status: "submitted", grade: undefined, teacherComment: undefined, attachmentId: undefined });
  });

  it("deletes only a selected assignment and its answers", () => {
    const assignments = getAssignments();
    saveAssignments(assignments);
    saveSubmissions([answer, { ...answer, id: "other", assignmentId: assignments[1].id }]);
    const removed = removeAssignmentRecords(assignments[0].id);
    expect(removed.submissions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(getAssignments()).toEqual([assignments[1]]);
    expect(getSubmissions().map((item) => item.id)).toEqual(["other"]);
  });

  it("restores both records when saving the linked deletion fails", () => {
    saveAssignments(getAssignments());
    saveSubmissions([answer]);
    const before = new Map(values);
    const write = storage.setItem.getMockImplementation()!;
    storage.setItem.mockImplementationOnce(write).mockImplementationOnce(() => { throw new Error("quota"); });
    expect(() => removeAssignmentRecords(answer.assignmentId)).toThrow("quota");
    expect(values).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("restores the absence of a key for untouched demo records", () => {
    const write = storage.setItem.getMockImplementation()!;
    storage.setItem.mockImplementationOnce(write).mockImplementationOnce(() => { throw new Error("quota"); });
    expect(() => removeAssignmentRecords(answer.assignmentId)).toThrow("quota");
    expect(values.size).toBe(0);
    expect(getAssignments()).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});


// src\data\assignmentStore.ts
import { getAcademicGroupByName, getAcademicSubjectByName } from "./academicCatalog";
import { getAttachmentError } from "../domain/files";
import { downloadBlob } from "../domain/fileDownload";

export type LessonType = "Лекция" | "Практика" | "Лабораторная";
export type AssignmentStatus = "draft" | "published" | "closed" | "archived";
export type SubmissionStatus = "submitted" | "revision" | "graded";

export interface Assignment {
  id: string;
  subjectId: string;
  groupId: string;
  subject: string;
  group: string;
  lessonDate: string;
  lessonType: LessonType;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  deadline: string;
  attachmentId?: string;
  attachmentName?: string;
  status: AssignmentStatus;
  allowLateSubmissions: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface SubmissionAttempt {
  id: string;
  number: number;
  sentAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  text: string;
  attachmentId?: string;
  attachmentName?: string;
  status: SubmissionStatus;
  submittedLate: boolean;
  teacherComment?: string;
  grade?: string;
  reviewedAt?: string;
}

/**
 * Submission is a student's assignment workflow. The top-level answer fields mirror
 * the latest attempt so older screens and persisted demo data remain compatible.
 */
export interface Submission {
  id: string;
  assignmentId: string;
  studentId: string;
  studentName: string;
  sentAt: string;
  text: string;
  attachmentId?: string;
  attachmentName?: string;
  comment?: string;
  grade?: string;
  teacherComment?: string;
  status: SubmissionStatus;
  updatedAt: string;
  /** Added in the attempt-history schema; optional for legacy typed consumers. */
  attemptCount?: number;
  attempts?: SubmissionAttempt[];
}

const ASSIGNMENTS_KEY = "bi-university-demo-assignments";
const SUBMISSIONS_KEY = "bi-university-demo-submissions";
const DB_NAME = "bi-university-learning-files";
const STORE_NAME = "files";
const CHANGE_EVENT = "bi-university-assignments-change";

const initialAssignments: Assignment[] = [
  { id: "linear-algebra-rgr-2", subjectId: "theory-of-probability", groupId: "112-mko", subject: "Теория вероятностей", group: "112-МКо", lessonDate: "2026-09-12T09:00", lessonType: "Практика", title: "Расчётно-графическая работа №2", description: "Решить задачи 1–8 и приложить оформленное решение одним файлом.", deadline: "2026-09-14T23:59", status: "published", allowLateSubmissions: true, createdAt: "2026-09-10T10:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-10T10:00" },
  { id: "programming-sort", subjectId: "mathematical-statistics", groupId: "112-mko", subject: "Математическая статистика", group: "112-МКо", lessonDate: "2026-09-15T11:00", lessonType: "Лабораторная", title: "Статистическая выборка", description: "Подготовить выборку и рассчитать основные статистические характеристики.", deadline: "2026-09-19T18:00", status: "published", allowLateSubmissions: false, createdAt: "2026-09-11T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-11T12:00" },
];

const readList = <T,>(key: string, fallback: T[]) => {
  try {
    const value = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (!value) return fallback;
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed as T[] : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const isSubmissionStatus = (value: unknown): value is SubmissionStatus =>
  value === "submitted" || value === "revision" || value === "graded";

const normalizeAssignment = (item: Partial<Assignment> & Pick<Assignment, "id" | "subject" | "group" | "lessonDate" | "lessonType" | "title" | "description" | "deadline">): Assignment => ({
  ...item,
  subjectId: item.subjectId ?? getAcademicSubjectByName(item.subject)?.id ?? "unknown-subject",
  groupId: item.groupId ?? getAcademicGroupByName(item.group)?.id ?? "unknown-group",
  status: item.status ?? "published",
  allowLateSubmissions: item.allowLateSubmissions ?? true,
  createdAt: item.createdAt ?? item.lessonDate,
  updatedAt: item.updatedAt ?? item.createdAt ?? item.lessonDate,
});

type PersistedSubmission = Partial<Submission> & Pick<Submission, "id" | "assignmentId" | "studentId" | "studentName" | "sentAt">;

const normalizeAttempt = (
  item: Partial<SubmissionAttempt>,
  number: number,
  fallback: PersistedSubmission,
  legacy: boolean,
): SubmissionAttempt => {
  const status = isSubmissionStatus(item.status)
    ? item.status
    : item.grade ? "graded" : legacy && isSubmissionStatus(fallback.status) ? fallback.status : legacy && fallback.grade ? "graded" : "submitted";
  return {
    id: item.id ?? `${fallback.id}-attempt-${number}`,
    number,
    sentAt: item.sentAt ?? fallback.sentAt,
    updatedAt: item.updatedAt ?? fallback.updatedAt ?? item.sentAt ?? fallback.sentAt,
    text: item.text ?? (legacy ? fallback.text : undefined) ?? "",
    attachmentId: item.attachmentId ?? (legacy ? fallback.attachmentId : undefined),
    attachmentName: item.attachmentName ?? (legacy ? fallback.attachmentName : undefined),
    status,
    submittedLate: item.submittedLate ?? false,
    teacherComment: item.teacherComment ?? (legacy ? fallback.teacherComment ?? fallback.comment : undefined),
    grade: item.grade ?? (legacy ? fallback.grade : undefined),
    reviewedAt: item.reviewedAt,
  };
};

const normalizeSubmission = (item: PersistedSubmission): Submission => {
  const legacy = !Array.isArray(item.attempts) || item.attempts.length === 0;
  const sourceAttempts = legacy ? [{}] : item.attempts!;
  const attempts = sourceAttempts.map((attempt, index) => normalizeAttempt(attempt, index + 1, item, legacy));
  const current = attempts[attempts.length - 1];

  return {
    ...item,
    sentAt: attempts[0].sentAt,
    text: current.text,
    attachmentId: current.attachmentId,
    attachmentName: current.attachmentName,
    teacherComment: current.teacherComment,
    grade: current.grade,
    status: current.status,
    updatedAt: current.updatedAt,
    attemptCount: attempts.length,
    attempts,
  };
};

export const getAssignments = () => readList(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, initialAssignments).map(normalizeAssignment);
export const saveAssignments = (items: Assignment[]) => {
  localStorage.setItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
};
export const getSubmissions = () => readList<PersistedSubmission>(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, []).map(normalizeSubmission);
export const saveSubmissions = (items: Submission[]) => {
  localStorage.setItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
};

/** Add an explicit demo pack without replacing existing or edited records. */
export const appendLearningDemoRecords = (assignments: Assignment[], submissions: Submission[]) => {
  const oldAssignments = localStorage.getItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY);
  const oldSubmissions = localStorage.getItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY);
  for (const raw of [oldAssignments, oldSubmissions]) {
    if (raw !== null && !Array.isArray(JSON.parse(raw))) throw new Error("Повреждённые данные обучения");
  }
  const currentAssignments = getAssignments();
  const currentSubmissions = getSubmissions();
  const assignmentIds = new Set(currentAssignments.map((item) => item.id));
  const submissionIds = new Set(currentSubmissions.map((item) => item.id));
  const addedAssignments = assignments.filter((item) => !assignmentIds.has(item.id));
  const addedIds = new Set(addedAssignments.map((item) => item.id));
  // Never add mock answers to an existing assignment the user may have changed.
  const addedSubmissions = submissions.filter((item) => addedIds.has(item.assignmentId) && !submissionIds.has(item.id));
  if (!addedAssignments.length) return { assignments: 0, submissions: 0 };
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify([...currentAssignments, ...addedAssignments]));
    localStorage.setItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify([...currentSubmissions, ...addedSubmissions]));
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      if (oldAssignments === null) localStorage.removeItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY); else localStorage.setItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, oldAssignments);
      if (oldSubmissions === null) localStorage.removeItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY); else localStorage.setItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, oldSubmissions);
    } finally { window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT)); }
    throw error;
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  return { assignments: addedAssignments.length, submissions: addedSubmissions.length };
};

/** Commit linked records together; do not notify subscribers about a partial deletion. */
export const removeAssignmentRecords = (id: string) => {
  const assignments = getAssignments();
  const submissions = getSubmissions();
  const related = submissions.filter((item) => item.assignmentId === id);
  const previousAssignments = localStorage.getItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY);
  const previousSubmissions = localStorage.getItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(assignments.filter((item) => item.id !== id)));
    localStorage.setItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(submissions.filter((item) => item.assignmentId !== id)));
  } catch (error) {
    try {
      if (previousAssignments === null) localStorage.removeItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY);
      else localStorage.setItem(ASSIGNMENTS_KEY, previousAssignments);
      if (previousSubmissions === null) localStorage.removeItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY);
      else localStorage.setItem(SUBMISSIONS_KEY, previousSubmissions);
    } finally { window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT)); }
    throw error;
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  return { assignment: assignments.find((item) => item.id === id), submissions: related };
};

export const subscribeAssignmentStore = (listener: () => void) => {
  const handleStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
    if (event.key === null || event.key === ASSIGNMENTS_KEY || event.key === SUBMISSIONS_KEY) listener();
  };
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
  window.addEventListener("storage", handleStorage);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
    window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorage);
  };
};

const openDatabase = () => new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {
  const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
  request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
    if (!request.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) request.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
  };
  request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
});

export const saveAssignmentFile = async (file: File) => {
  const error = getAttachmentError(file);
  if (error) throw new Error(error);
  const id = crypto.randomUUID();
  const database = await openDatabase();
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(file, id);
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
  } finally { database.close(); }
  return id;
};

export const deleteAssignmentFile = async (id: string) => {
  const database = await openDatabase();
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME).delete(id);
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
};

export const downloadAssignmentFile = async (id: string, name: string) => {
  const database = await openDatabase();
  let blob: Blob | undefined;
  try {
    blob = await new Promise<Blob | undefined>((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME);
      const request = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME).get(id);
      transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(request.result as Blob | undefined);
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
      transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
    });
  } finally { database.close(); }
  if (!(blob instanceof Blob)) throw new Error("Attachment not found");
  downloadBlob(blob, name);
};


// src\data\demo\journals.ts
import type { AttendanceStatus, Grade, Student } from "../../components/Attendance/data/students";
import { createSubjectLessons } from "../lessons";

const gradeProfiles: Grade[][] = [
  [5, 5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 3, 2, null, null],
  [5, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, null, null],
  [5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, null],
  [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 4, 4, 4, 3, null],
  [5, 4, 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, null, null],
];
const stableSeed = (value: string) => [...value].reduce((sum, letter, index) => sum + letter.charCodeAt(0) * (index + 1), 0);
const hasKey = (record: object, key: string) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(record, key);

/** Adds only missing cells of the extended catalog; even an existing null/unmarked value is protected. */
export const createJournalDemoAdditions = (subjectId: string, groupId: string, students: Student[]) => {
  const lessons = createSubjectLessons(subjectId, groupId).filter((lesson) => lesson.id.includes(":weekly:") && lesson.state === "completed");
  const seed = stableSeed(`${subjectId}:${groupId}`);
  let cells = 0;
  let grades = 0;
  const changedLessons = new Set<string>();
  const next = students.map((student) => {
    const attendance = { ...student.attendance };
    const marks = { ...student.grades };
    const person = stableSeed(student.id);
    lessons.forEach((lesson, index) => {
      const week = Math.floor(index / 3);
      const sample = (seed + person + index * 13) % 23;
      const profile = (seed + week) % gradeProfiles.length;
      const generated: AttendanceStatus = sample === 0 ? "unmarked" : sample < 3 ? "sick" : sample < (profile === 4 ? 9 : 6) ? "absent" : "present";
      if (!hasKey(attendance, lesson.id)) {
        attendance[lesson.id] = generated;
        cells++;
        changedLessons.add(lesson.id);
      }
      if (!hasKey(marks, lesson.id)) {
        // An intentionally ungraded week verifies gaps, rather than fake zero grades, on charts.
        const ungradedWeek = subjectId === "data-analysis" && lesson.date >= "2026-09-28" && lesson.date <= "2026-10-02";
        const grade = lesson.type === "lecture" || attendance[lesson.id] !== "present" || ungradedWeek
          ? null : gradeProfiles[profile][(person + index * 7 + seed) % gradeProfiles[profile].length];
        marks[lesson.id] = grade;
        cells++;
        if (grade !== null) grades++;
        changedLessons.add(lesson.id);
      }
    });
    return { ...student, attendance, grades: marks };
  });
  return { students: next, cells, grades, lessons: changedLessons.size, from: lessons[0]?.date, to: lessons[lessons.length - 1]?.date };
};


// src\data\demo\learning.ts
import { addDays, startOfWeek } from "date-fns";
import type { Assignment, Submission, SubmissionAttempt, SubmissionStatus } from "../assignmentStore";

const PREFIX = "demo-expanded-v1";
const localDateTime = (date: Date) => new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
const dateAt = (day: Date, hours: number, minutes = 0) => { const date = new Date(day); date.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0); return date; };

const TOPICS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "theory-of-probability": ["События и комбинаторика", "Условная вероятность и формула Байеса", "Случайные величины", "Распределения и математическое ожидание", "Подготовка к контрольной", "Итоговый разбор задач"],
  "mathematical-statistics": ["Описательная статистика", "Доверительные интервалы", "Проверка статистических гипотез", "Корреляция и регрессия", "План статистического исследования", "Разбор типичных ошибок"],
  "data-analysis": ["Очистка исходных данных", "Разведочный анализ", "Визуализация показателей", "Сравнение моделей классификации", "Проект: анализ учебного датасета", "Обсуждение результатов проекта"],
  "discrete-mathematics": ["Множества и отношения", "Логические выражения", "Графы и поиск кратчайшего пути", "Деревья и остовные графы", "Комбинаторный практикум", "Разбор контрольной работы"],
};

export const createLearningDemo = (anchor: Date) => {
  const monday = startOfWeek(anchor, { weekStartsOn: 1 });
  const assignments: Assignment[] = [];
  const submissions: Submission[] = [];
  SUBJECTS.forEach((subject, subjectIndex) => {
    const primaryGroup = getAcademicGroup("112-mko");
    const extraGroup = getSubjectGroups(subject.id).find((group) => group.id !== "112-mko");
    const groups = [primaryGroup, extraGroup].filter((group) => group !== undefined);
    groups.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
      const roster = getJournalSnapshot(subject.id, group.id);
      const count = groupIndex === 0 ? 6 : 2;
      for (let scenario = 0; scenario < count; scenario++) {
        const targetDay = addDays(monday, [-7, -7, 0, 2, 7, -14][scenario]);
        const scheduled = getDemoWeekSchedule(targetDay)
          .filter((lesson) => lesson.subject === subject.name && lesson.group === group.name && lesson.teacherId === "teacher-elena-volkova")
          .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(new Date(`${a.date}T${a.startTime}`).getTime() - targetDay.getTime()) - Math.abs(new Date(`${b.date}T${b.startTime}`).getTime() - targetDay.getTime()))[0];
        const lesson = scheduled ? new Date(`${scheduled.date}T${scheduled.startTime}`) : dateAt(targetDay, 10, 10);
        const deadline = dateAt(addDays(lesson, [4, 5, 6, 7, 7, 5][scenario]), 23, 59);
        const id = `${PREFIX}:${subject.id}:${group.id}:${scenario}`;
        const assignment: Assignment = {
          id, subjectId: subject.id, groupId: group.id, subject: subject.name, group: group.name,
          title: TOPICS[subject.id][scenario],
          description: `Демонстрационное задание по теме «${TOPICS[subject.id][scenario]}».\n\n1. Изучите основные определения и разберите пример из конспекта.\n2. Решите задания своего варианта, приведите ход решения и объясните результат.\n3. Сформулируйте краткий вывод. Можно приложить файл с расчётами.\n\nВариант определяется номером в списке группы. Вопросы по условию можно задать преподавателю.`,
          lessonDate: localDateTime(lesson), lessonType: scheduled?.type === "Лек." ? "Лекция" : scheduled?.type === "Лаб." ? "Лабораторная" : "Практика",
          deadline: localDateTime(deadline), status: scenario === 0 ? "closed" : scenario === 4 ? "draft" : scenario === 5 ? "archived" : "published",
          allowLateSubmissions: scenario === 1, createdAt: localDateTime(addDays(lesson, -5)), updatedAt: localDateTime(addDays(lesson, -4)),
        };
        assignments.push(assignment);
        if (scenario >= 3) continue;
        roster.slice(0, 4).forEach((student, studentIndex) => {
          const status: SubmissionStatus = scenario === 0 ? "graded" : scenario === 1 ? studentIndex % 2 ? "graded" : "revision" : "submitted";
          const sent = dateAt(scenario === 1 && studentIndex === 3 ? addDays(deadline, 1) : addDays(lesson, 1), 14 + studentIndex, 10);
          const attemptId = `${id}:${student.id}`;
          const makeAttempt = (number: number, state: SubmissionStatus, date: Date): SubmissionAttempt => ({
            id: `${attemptId}:attempt-${number}`, number, sentAt: date.toISOString(), updatedAt: dateAt(date, date.getHours(), 40).toISOString(),
            text: number === 1 ? `Вариант ${studentIndex + 1}. Выполнены расчёты по теме «${assignment.title}».\n\nПроверил исходные данные, записал формулы и получил результат. В последнем пункте привёл пояснение к решению.` : "Исправил решение по замечаниям: добавил обоснование выбора метода, проверку расчётов и итоговый вывод.",
            status: state, submittedLate: date.getTime() > deadline.getTime(),
            ...(state !== "submitted" ? { teacherComment: state === "revision" ? "Добавьте обоснование решения во втором пункте и проверьте вычисления. Итоговый результат нужно сопроводить выводом." : "Решение проверено. Основной ход рассуждений верный; замечания обсудим на занятии.", reviewedAt: dateAt(date, date.getHours(), 40).toISOString() } : {}),
            ...(state === "graded" ? { grade: String(5 - ((studentIndex + subjectIndex) % 4)) } : {}),
          });
          const attempts = scenario === 2 && studentIndex === 0 || scenario === 0 && studentIndex === 0
            ? [makeAttempt(1, "revision", sent), makeAttempt(2, status, dateAt(addDays(sent, 1), 16))]
            : [makeAttempt(1, status, sent)];
          const current = attempts[attempts.length - 1];
          submissions.push({ id: attemptId, assignmentId: id, studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, sentAt: attempts[0].sentAt, updatedAt: current.updatedAt, text: current.text, status: current.status, grade: current.grade, teacherComment: current.teacherComment, attempts, attemptCount: attempts.length });
        });
      }
    });
  });
  return { assignments, submissions };
};

// src\data\demoData.ts
import { SUBJECTS, getAcademicGroup, getAcademicSubjectDefinition } from "./academicCatalog";
import { appendLearningDemoRecords, deleteAssignmentFile, getAssignments, getSubmissions, saveAssignmentFile } from "./assignmentStore";
import { createLearningDemo, createPlannerDemo } from "./demo/learning";
import { materialRepository } from "./materialRepository";
import { appendPlannerDemoNotes } from "./plannerStore";
import { addNotification } from "./notificationStore";
import { getAssignmentHref } from "../domain/journalNavigation";
import { getSubmissionAttempts } from "../domain/assignments";
import { appendJournalDemoRecords } from "./journalStore";
import type { JournalActor } from "./journalStore";

export interface DemoImportResult { assignments: number; submissions: number; tasks: number; materials: number; journals: number; journalCells: number; grades: number; warnings: string[] }
export interface DemoImportOptions { journalActor?: JournalActor }

const runDemoImport = async (anchor: Date, options: DemoImportOptions): Promise<DemoImportResult> => {
  const result: DemoImportResult = { assignments: 0, submissions: 0, tasks: 0, materials: 0, journals: 0, journalCells: 0, grades: 0, warnings: [] };
  const actor = options.journalActor;
  if (actor) {
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    for (const membership of actor.memberships ?? []) {
      for (const groupId of membership.groupIds) {
        const key = `${membership.subjectId}:${groupId}`;
        if (visited.has(key)) continue;
        visited.add(key);
        try {
          const added = appendJournalDemoRecords(membership.subjectId, groupId, actor);
          result.journals += added.journals;
          result.journalCells += added.cells;
          result.grades += added.grades;
        } catch {
          result.warnings.push(`Отметки «${getAcademicSubjectDefinition(membership.subjectId)?.shortName ?? membership.subjectId} · ${getAcademicGroup(groupId)?.name ?? groupId}» не добавлены. Журнал или история недоступны; сохранённые данные не перезаписаны.`);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const generatedFiles: string[] = [];
  const usedFileIds = () => {
    // Public readers intentionally fall back to defaults on invalid storage.
    // Cleanup must not interpret that fallback as proof a file is unused.
    for (const key of ["bi-university-demo-assignments", "bi-university-demo-submissions"]) {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (raw !== null && !Array.isArray(JSON.parse(raw))) throw new Error("Не удалось проверить ссылки на файлы");
    }
    return new Set([
      ...getAssignments().flatMap((item) => item.attachmentId ? [item.attachmentId] : []),
      ...getSubmissions().flatMap((item) => getSubmissionAttempts(item).flatMap((attempt) => attempt.attachmentId ? [attempt.attachmentId] : [])),
    ]);
  };
  const cleanupUnusedFiles = async () => {
    if (!generatedFiles.length) return;
    try {
      // Never delete an attachment unless persisted references can be read safely.
      const used = usedFileIds();
      const cleanup = await Promise.allSettled(generatedFiles.filter((id) => !used.has(id)).map(deleteAssignmentFile));
      if (cleanup.some((item) => item.status === "rejected")) result.warnings.push("Не удалось удалить часть временных файлов импорта. Сохранённые вложения не затронуты.");
    } catch { result.warnings.push("Очистка временных файлов отложена: не удалось проверить сохранённые вложения."); }
  };
  try {
    const pack = createLearningDemo(anchor);
    const existingIds = new Set(getAssignments().map((item) => item.id));
    const newAssignments = pack.assignments.filter((item) => !existingIds.has(item.id));
    // Real small UTF-8 files: download actions work without remote assets or fake PDF links.
    for (const assignment of newAssignments.filter((item) => item.groupId === "112-mko" && item.status === "published")) {
      const name = `${assignment.title}.txt`;
      const id = await saveAssignmentFile(new File([`${assignment.title}\n${assignment.subject} · ${assignment.group}\n\n${assignment.description}\n\nЭто учебный демонстрационный файл.`], name, { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }));
      generatedFiles.push(id);
      assignment.attachmentId = id;
      assignment.attachmentName = name;
    }
    const newIds = new Set(newAssignments.map((item) => item.id));
    for (const submission of pack.submissions.filter((item) => newIds.has(item.assignmentId) && item.studentId === "anna-smirnova" && item.status === "submitted")) {
      const name = "Решение — повторная попытка.txt";
      const id = await saveAssignmentFile(new File([submission.text], name, { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }));
      generatedFiles.push(id);
      submission.attachmentId = id;
      submission.attachmentName = name;
      const current = submission.attempts?.[submission.attempts.length - 1];
      if (current) { current.attachmentId = id; current.attachmentName = name; }
    }
    const added = appendLearningDemoRecords(newAssignments, pack.submissions);
    result.assignments = added.assignments;
    result.submissions = added.submissions;
  } catch {
    result.warnings.push("Не удалось добавить задания и ответы. Проверьте доступ к хранилищу браузера.");
  } finally { await cleanupUnusedFiles(); }
  try { result.tasks = appendPlannerDemoNotes(createPlannerDemo(anchor)); }
  catch { result.warnings.push("Задачи не добавлены: проверьте хранилище планировщика."); }

  for (const subject of SUBJECTS) {
    const scope = `group:${subject.id}:112-mko`;
    try {
      const existing = new Set((await materialRepository.list(scope)).map((file) => file.id));
      const templates = [
        { key: "notes", title: "Краткий конспект", category: "Конспект", text: "Основные определения\n\nЗапишите ключевые понятия темы, сопоставьте формулы с примерами и проверьте ограничения их применения.\n\nПосле занятия: решите два примера самостоятельно и подготовьте вопросы." },
        { key: "practice", title: "Сборник тренировочных заданий", category: "Сборник заданий", text: "Практикум\n\n1. Приведите пример применения метода.\n2. Решите задачу своего варианта.\n3. Объясните результат.\n4. Найдите ошибку в альтернативном решении.\n\nНомер варианта совпадает с номером в списке группы." },
        { key: "checklist", title: "Памятка по оформлению работы", category: "Другое", text: "Перед отправкой\n\n□ Указаны группа и автор.\n□ Видны промежуточные вычисления.\n□ Есть итоговый вывод.\n□ Проверены название файла и срок сдачи.\n\nЭто демонстрационные материалы, не официальные требования университета." },
      ];
      for (const [index, template] of templates.entries()) {
        const id = `demo-expanded-v1:material:${subject.id}:${template.key}`;
        if (existing.has(id)) continue;
        const blob = new Blob([`${subject.name}\n112-МКо\n\n${template.text}`], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
        await materialRepository.save({ id, name: `${template.title} — ${subject.shortName}.txt`, type: blob.type, size: blob.size, blob, scope, category: template.category, description: "Демонстрационный материал для знакомства с интерфейсом.", pinned: index === 0, uploadedBy: "Елена Волкова", createdAt: anchor.getTime() - index * 86400_000 });
        result.materials++;
      }
    } catch { result.warnings.push(`Материалы «${subject.name}» добавлены не полностью. Можно повторить импорт.`); }
  }
  if (result.assignments) {
    try {
      const assignments = getAssignments();
      for (const subject of SUBJECTS) {
        const assignment = assignments.find((item) => item.id === `demo-expanded-v1:${subject.id}:112-mko:2`);
        if (!assignment) continue;
        addNotification({ recipientUserId: "teacher-elena-volkova", kind: "submission", title: "Демонстрационные работы готовы к проверке", body: `${subject.name} · 112-МКо`, href: getAssignmentHref(assignment), dedupeKey: `demo-expanded-v1:teacher:${subject.id}` });
        addNotification({ recipientUserId: "anna-smirnova", kind: "assignment", title: "В журнале появились учебные задания", body: `${subject.name} · можно посмотреть историю сдачи и результаты`, href: getAssignmentHref(assignment), dedupeKey: `demo-expanded-v1:student:${subject.id}` });
      }
    } catch { result.warnings.push("Уведомления добавлены не полностью. Задания и ответы уже доступны в журнале."); }
  }
  return result;
};

let pendingImport: Promise<DemoImportResult> | null = null;

/** Serialize clicks and cooperating tabs; the pack's stable IDs preserve edited records. */
export const importDemoData = (anchor: Date, options: DemoImportOptions = {}): Promise<DemoImportResult> => {
  if (pendingImport) return pendingImport;
  if (!Number.isFinite(anchor.getTime())) return Promise.reject(new Error("Некорректная дата демонабора"));
  const date = new Date(anchor);
  pendingImport = Promise.resolve(navigator.locks
    ? navigator.locks.request("bi-university-demo-import", () => runDemoImport(date, options))
    : runDemoImport(date, options)).finally(() => { pendingImport = null; });
  return pendingImport;
};


// src\data\journalStore.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createDemoJournal, decodeJournal, journalKey } from "./journalStore";

describe("journalStore", () => {
  it("isolates journals by subject and group", () => {
    expect(journalKey("data-analysis", "112-mko")).not.toBe(journalKey("data-analysis", "113-mko"));
    expect(journalKey("data-analysis", "112-mko")).not.toBe(journalKey("discrete-mathematics", "112-mko"));
  });

  it("creates stable demo data with the current student in their group", () => {
    expect(createDemoJournal("data-analysis", "112-mko")).toEqual(createDemoJournal("data-analysis", "112-mko"));
    expect(createDemoJournal("data-analysis", "112-mko").some((student) => student.id === "anna-smirnova")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects malformed or duplicate saved records", () => {
    expect(decodeJournal("not-json")).toBeNull();
    expect(decodeJournal(JSON.stringify([{ id: "1", name: "A", attendance: {}, grades: {} }, { id: "1", name: "B", attendance: {}, grades: {} }]))).toBeNull();
    expect(decodeJournal(JSON.stringify([{ id: "1", name: "A", attendance: { "2026-09-04": "unknown" }, grades: {} }]))).toBeNull();
  });
});

export const createDemoJournal = (subject: string, group: string): Student[] => {
  const lessons = createSubjectLessons(subject, group).filter((lesson) => !lesson.id.includes(":weekly:"));
  const seed = [...`${subject}:${group}`].reduce((sum, letter) => sum + letter.charCodeAt(0), 0);
