    "Виктор Андреев", "Юлия Григорьева", "Игорь Егоров", "Наталья Соколова", "Артём Кузнецов",
    "Марина Лебедева", "Константин Орлов", "Ирина Воронова", "Михаил Тихонов", "Светлана Киселёва",
    "Николай Зайцев", "Анастасия Фролова", "Андрей Савельев", "Елизавета Михайлова", "Олег Дмитриев",
    "Виктория Павлова", "Аркадий Романов", "Полина Алексеева", "Владислав Семёнов", "Ксения Ефимова",
    "Максим Соколов", "Дарья Белова",
  ];
  return names.slice(0, getAcademicGroup(group)?.students ?? 5).map((name, index) => ({
    id: index === 0 && group === "112-mko" ? CURRENT_STUDENT_ID : `${group}-${index + 1}`,
    name,
    attendance: Object.fromEntries(lessons.map((lesson, day) => [lesson.id, (seed + index + day) % 11 === 0 ? "unmarked" : (seed + index + day) % 13 === 0 ? "sick" : (seed + index + day) % 7 === 0 ? "absent" : "present"])),
    grades: Object.fromEntries(lessons.map((lesson, day) => [lesson.id, lesson.type === "lecture" ? null : ([2, 3, 4, 5, 4, 5, null] as Grade[])[(seed + index + day) % 7]])),
  }));
};

export const decodeJournal = (raw: string): Student[] | null => {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    const isRecord = (item: unknown): item is Record<string, unknown> => typeof item === "object" && item !== null && !Array.isArray(item);
    const value: unknown = isRecord(parsed) && parsed.version === JOURNAL_SCHEMA_VERSION ? parsed.students : parsed;
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
    if (!value.every((item: unknown) => isRecord(item) && typeof item.id === "string" && typeof item.name === "string"
      && isRecord(item.attendance) && Object.values(item.attendance).every((status) => ["unmarked", "present", "sick", "absent"].includes(String(status)))
      && isRecord(item.grades) && Object.values(item.grades).every((grade) => grade === null || [2, 3, 4, 5].includes(grade as number)))) return null;
    if (new Set(value.map((item: Student) => item.id)).size !== value.length) return null;
    return value as Student[];
  } catch { return null; }
};

export const encodeJournal = (students: Student[]) => JSON.stringify({ version: JOURNAL_SCHEMA_VERSION, students });

const readHistoryState = (key: string): { changes: JournalChange[]; error: string } => {
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) ?? "[]");
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Invalid history");
    const changes = value.filter((item): item is JournalChange => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return false;
      const entry = item as Partial<JournalChange>;
      const validValue = (cell: unknown) => cell === null || typeof cell === "string" || (typeof cell === "number" && Number.isFinite(cell));
      return typeof entry.id === "string" && Boolean(entry.id) && typeof entry.changedAt === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(entry.changedAt))
        && typeof entry.studentId === "string" && typeof entry.studentName === "string" && (entry.lessonId === undefined || typeof entry.lessonId === "string")
        && ["attendance", "grade", "roster", "demo"].includes(entry.field ?? "") && validValue(entry.previousValue) && validValue(entry.nextValue)
        && Boolean(entry.actor && typeof entry.actor.id === "string" && typeof entry.actor.name === "string");
    });
    const unique = Array.from(new Map(changes.map((change) => [change.id, change])).values());
    return { changes: unique.sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.changedAt) - Date.parse(a.changedAt)), error: unique.length === value.length ? "" : "Часть записей истории повреждена и не показана. Исходные данные не изменены; сохранение журнала приостановлено, чтобы не перезаписать историю." };
  } catch { return { changes: [], error: "Не удалось прочитать историю журнала. Сохранение приостановлено, исходные данные не изменены." }; }
};

const collectChanges = (previous: Student[], next: Student[], actor: JournalActor): JournalChange[] => {
  const changedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const changes: JournalChange[] = [];
  const previousById = new Map(previous.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const nextById = new Map(next.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const add = (change: Omit<JournalChange, "id" | "changedAt" | "actor">) => changes.push({ ...change, id: crypto.randomUUID(), changedAt, actor });

  next.forEach((student) => {
    const before = previousById.get(student.id);
    if (!before) {
      add({ studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, field: "roster", previousValue: null, nextValue: "added" });
      return;
    }
    if (before.name !== student.name) add({ studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, field: "roster", previousValue: before.name, nextValue: student.name });
    const lessonIds = new Set([...Object.keys(before.attendance), ...Object.keys(student.attendance), ...Object.keys(before.grades), ...Object.keys(student.grades)]);
    lessonIds.forEach((lessonId) => {
      const oldAttendance = before.attendance[lessonId] ?? "unmarked";
      const newAttendance = student.attendance[lessonId] ?? "unmarked";
      if (oldAttendance !== newAttendance) add({ studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, lessonId, field: "attendance", previousValue: oldAttendance, nextValue: newAttendance });
      const oldGrade = before.grades[lessonId] ?? null;
      const newGrade = student.grades[lessonId] ?? null;
      if (oldGrade !== newGrade) add({ studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, lessonId, field: "grade", previousValue: oldGrade, nextValue: newGrade });
    });
  });
  previous.forEach((student) => {
    if (!nextById.has(student.id)) add({ studentId: student.id, studentName: student.name, field: "roster", previousValue: "active", nextValue: "removed" });
  });
  return changes;
};

const migrateLessonKeys = (students: Student[], subject: string, group: string) => {
  const lessons = createSubjectLessons(subject, group);
  const lessonByDate = new Map(lessons.map((lesson) => [lesson.date, lesson.id]));
  const migrateRecord = <T,>(record: Record<string, T>) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(record).map(([key, value]) => [lessonByDate.get(key) ?? key, value]));
  return students.map((student) => {
    const grades = migrateRecord(student.grades);
    lessons.forEach((lesson) => { if (lesson.type === "lecture") grades[lesson.id] = null; });
    return { ...student, attendance: migrateRecord(student.attendance), grades };
  });
};

export const getJournalSnapshot = (subject: string, group: string) => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(journalKey(subject, group));
    const students = raw === null ? createDemoJournal(subject, group) : decodeJournal(raw);
    return students ? migrateLessonKeys(students, subject, group) : createDemoJournal(subject, group);
  } catch {
    return createDemoJournal(subject, group);
  }
};

export const subscribeJournalStore = (listener: () => void) => {
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
  window.addEventListener("storage", listener);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
    window.removeEventListener("storage", listener);
  };
};

/** Explicit demo action only. Existing cells and roster stay intact; audit uses the normal 200-record retention. */
export const appendJournalDemoRecords = (subject: string, group: string, actor: JournalActor) => {
  if (actor.role !== "teacher" || !actor.memberships?.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === subject && membership.groupIds.includes(group))
    || !getAcademicSubjectDefinition(subject) || !getAcademicGroup(group) || !SUBJECT_GROUP_OFFERINGS.some((offering) => offering.subjectId === subject && offering.groupId === group)) {
    throw new JournalWriteError("Недостаточно прав для добавления демонстрационных отметок в этот журнал.");
  }
  const key = journalKey(subject, group);
  const auditKey = historyKey(subject, group);
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
  const previous = raw === null ? createDemoJournal(subject, group) : decodeJournal(raw);
  if (!previous) throw new JournalWriteError("Журнал повреждён: демонстрационные отметки не добавлены, исходные данные сохранены.");
  const history = readHistoryState(auditKey);
  if (history.error) throw new JournalWriteError(history.error);
  const addition = createJournalDemoAdditions(subject, group, migrateLessonKeys(previous, subject, group));
  if (!addition.cells) return { journals: 0, cells: 0, grades: 0 };
  const event: JournalChange = {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(), changedAt: new Date().toISOString(), actor,
    studentId: "demo-import", studentName: "Демонстрационный набор", field: "demo", previousValue: null,
    nextValue: `Добавлены отсутствующие ячейки: ${addition.cells}, в том числе оценки: ${addition.grades}; занятий: ${addition.lessons}. Период: ${addition.from} — ${addition.to}. Это демонстрационные, а не реальные отметки.`,
  };
  const previousHistory = localStorage.getItem(auditKey);
  // One event per journal, not thousands of fabricated historical edits; repeated imports are no-ops.
  const encodedHistory = JSON.stringify([event, ...history.changes].slice(0, 200));
  const encoded = encodeJournal(addition.students);
  localStorage.setItem(auditKey, encodedHistory);
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, encoded); }
  catch (error) {
    try {
      if (previousHistory === null) localStorage.removeItem(auditKey);
      else localStorage.setItem(auditKey, previousHistory);
    } catch { throw new JournalWriteError("Демонстрационные отметки не сохранены. Не удалось восстановить прежнюю историю после сбоя хранилища; проверьте её перед повторным импортом."); }
    throw error;
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  return { journals: 1, cells: addition.cells, grades: addition.grades };
};

export const useJournal = (subject: string, group: string, actor: JournalActor = { id: "demo-user", name: "Демо-пользователь" }) => {
  const key = journalKey(subject, group);
  const auditKey = historyKey(subject, group);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const getSnapshot = useCallback(() => {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch { return "unavailable"; }
  }, [key]);
  const raw = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeJournalStore, getSnapshot);
  const decoded = useMemo(() => {
    const students = raw === null ? createDemoJournal(subject, group) : decodeJournal(raw);
    return students ? migrateLessonKeys(students, subject, group) : null;
  }, [raw, subject, group]);
  const students = decoded ?? [];
  const historyState = readHistoryState(auditKey);
  const history = historyState.changes;
  const canEdit = actor.role === "teacher" && actor.memberships?.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === subject && membership.groupIds.includes(group)) === true;
  const setStudents = useCallback((action: SetStateAction<Student[]>) => {
    if (!canEdit) {
      setError("Недостаточно прав для изменения журнала этой группы.");
      throw new Error("Journal access denied");
    }
    try {
      const current = localStorage.getItem(key);
      const saved = current === null ? createDemoJournal(subject, group) : decodeJournal(current);
      const previous = saved ? migrateLessonKeys(saved, subject, group) : null;
      if (!previous) throw new Error("invalid data");
      const next = typeof action === "function" ? action(previous) : action;
      const changes = collectChanges(previous, next, actor);
      const encoded = encodeJournal(next);
      const currentHistory = readHistoryState(auditKey);
      if (currentHistory.error) throw new JournalWriteError(currentHistory.error);
      if (changes.length) {
        const previousHistory = localStorage.getItem(auditKey);
        localStorage.setItem(auditKey, JSON.stringify([...changes.reverse(), ...currentHistory.changes].slice(0, 200)));
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, encoded); }
        catch (error) {
          try {
            if (previousHistory === null) localStorage.removeItem(auditKey);
            else localStorage.setItem(auditKey, previousHistory);
          } catch { throw new JournalWriteError("Журнал не сохранён. Не удалось восстановить прежнюю историю после сбоя хранилища; проверьте её перед повторным сохранением."); }
          throw error;
        }
      } else localStorage.setItem(key, encoded);
      setError("");
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof JournalDraftConflictError || error instanceof JournalWriteError ? error.message : "Не удалось сохранить журнал. Проверьте доступность хранилища браузера и повторите попытку.";
      setError(message);
      throw new Error(message);
    }
  }, [key, auditKey, subject, group, actor, canEdit]);
  return { students, setStudents, canEdit, history, historyError: historyState.error, lastSavedAt: history[0]?.changedAt ?? null, error: error || (decoded === null ? "Не удалось прочитать журнал. Сохранённые данные не изменены." : "") };
};


// src\data\lessons.ts
import type { AcademicLesson, LessonType } from "../domain/academic";

const initialLessonTemplates: Array<{ date: string; startsAt: string; type: LessonType; topic: string; room: string }> = [
  { date: "2026-09-04", startsAt: "10:10", type: "lecture", topic: "Введение в дисциплину", room: "305" },
  { date: "2026-09-07", startsAt: "12:10", type: "practice", topic: "Основные понятия", room: "214" },
  { date: "2026-09-08", startsAt: "10:10", type: "lecture", topic: "Методы решения задач", room: "305" },
  { date: "2026-09-09", startsAt: "14:10", type: "laboratory", topic: "Практическое исследование", room: "412" },
  { date: "2026-09-10", startsAt: "12:10", type: "practice", topic: "Разбор результатов", room: "214" },
];

const weeklyTopics = ["Методы и примеры", "Самостоятельное исследование", "Проверка гипотез", "Работа с исходными данными", "Сравнение решений", "Контрольный практикум", "Разбор сложных случаев", "Обобщение результатов"];
const weeklySlots: Array<{ day: number; startsAt: string; type: LessonType; room: string }> = [
  { day: 0, startsAt: "08:30", type: "lecture", room: "305" },
  { day: 2, startsAt: "12:10", type: "practice", room: "214" },
  { day: 4, startsAt: "13:50", type: "laboratory", room: "412" },
];

/** Stable catalog: old lesson IDs remain valid; new dates are empty until an explicit demo import. */
export const createSubjectLessons = (subjectId: string, groupId: string): AcademicLesson[] => {
  const initial: AcademicLesson[] = initialLessonTemplates.map((lesson, index) => ({
    ...lesson,
    id: `${subjectId}:${groupId}:2026-fall:${index + 1}`,
    subjectId,
    groupId,
    semesterId: "2026-fall",
    state: "completed",
  }));
  const now = Date.now();
  const additional: AcademicLesson[] = weeklyTopics.flatMap((topic, week) => weeklySlots.map((slot): AcademicLesson => {
    const day = new Date(2026, 8, 14 + week * 7 + slot.day, 12);
    const date = `${day.getFullYear()}-${String(day.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    return {
      id: `${subjectId}:${groupId}:2026-fall:weekly:${date}:${slot.type}`,
      subjectId, groupId, semesterId: "2026-fall", date, startsAt: slot.startsAt, type: slot.type,
      topic: `${topic} · ${slot.type === "lecture" ? "теория" : slot.type === "practice" ? "решение задач" : "исследование"}`,
      room: slot.room,
      state: new Date(`${date}T${slot.startsAt}`).getTime() + 90 * 60_000 <= now ? "completed" : "scheduled",
    };
  }));
  return [...initial, ...additional];
};


// src\data\materialRepository.ts
import { downloadBlob } from "../domain/fileDownload";

export interface StoredMaterial {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  size: number;
  createdAt: number;
  blob: Blob;
  scope: string;
  category?: string;
  uploadedBy?: string;
  description?: string;
  pinned?: boolean;
}

const DB_NAME = "bi-university-cabinet";
const STORE_NAME = "teacher-files";
const CHANGE_EVENT = "bi-university-materials-change";

const openDatabase = () => new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {
  const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
  request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
    if (!request.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
      request.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: "id" });
    }
  };
  request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
  request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
});

export const materialRepository = {
  subscribe(scope: string, listener: () => void) {
    const handleChange = (event: Event) => { if ((event as CustomEvent<string>).detail === scope) listener(); };
    window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, handleChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, handleChange);
  },
  async list(scope: string) {
    const database = await openDatabase();
    try {
      return await new Promise<StoredMaterial[]>((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = database.transaction(STORE_NAME).objectStore(STORE_NAME).getAll();
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(
          (request.result as StoredMaterial[])
            .filter((file) => (file.scope || "cabinet") === scope)
            .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt),
        );
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
  },

  async save(file: StoredMaterial) {
    const database = await openDatabase();
    try {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
        transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(file);
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
      });
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CHANGE_EVENT, { detail: file.scope }));
  },

  async remove(id: string) {
    const database = await openDatabase();
    let scope: string | undefined;
    try {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
        const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
        const request = store.get(id);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
          const file = request.result as StoredMaterial | undefined;
          if (file) scope = file.scope || "cabinet";
          store.delete(id);
        };
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
      });
    } finally {
      database.close();
    }
    if (scope) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CHANGE_EVENT, { detail: scope }));
  },

  async setPinned(id: string, pinned: boolean) {
    const database = await openDatabase();
    let updated: StoredMaterial | undefined;
    try {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const transaction = database.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
        const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
        const request = store.get(id);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
          const current = request.result as StoredMaterial | undefined;
          if (!current) { transaction.abort(); return; }
          updated = { ...current, pinned };
          store.put(updated);
        };
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error ?? new Error("Материал уже удалён"));
      });
    } finally { database.close(); }
    if (!updated) throw new Error("Материал не найден");
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CHANGE_EVENT, { detail: updated.scope || "cabinet" }));
    return updated;
  },

  download(file: StoredMaterial) {
    downloadBlob(file.blob, file.name);
  },
};


// src\data\messageAttachmentRepository.ts
import type { MessageAttachment } from "./messageStore";
import { getAttachmentError } from "../domain/files";

type AttachmentRecord = MessageAttachment & { scope: string; blob: Blob };
const STORE = "attachments";
const openDatabase = () => new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {
  let blocked = false;
  const request = indexedDB.open("bi-university-message-files", 1);
  request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore(STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
  request.onsuccess = () => { if (blocked) request.result.close(); else resolve(request.result); };
  request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  request.onblocked = () => { blocked = true; reject(new Error("Хранилище файлов занято другой вкладкой")); };
});

/** Binary files never enter localStorage. Scope is checked on every read/removal. */
export const messageAttachmentRepository = {
  async save(scope: string, files: File[]): Promise<MessageAttachment[]> {
    if (!files.length) return [];
    if (files.length > 5 || files.some((file) => getAttachmentError(file))) throw new Error("Можно приложить до 5 файлов, каждый до 25 МБ.");
    const records: AttachmentRecord[] = files.map((file) => ({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: file.name, type: file.type, size: file.size, scope, blob: file }));
    const database = await openDatabase();
    try {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const transaction = database.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
        records.forEach((record) => transaction.objectStore(STORE).add(record));
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
      });
      return records.map(({ id, name, type, size }) => ({ id, name, type, size }));
    } finally { database.close(); }
  },
  async read(scope: string, id: string): Promise<AttachmentRecord> {
    const database = await openDatabase();
    try {
      return await new Promise<AttachmentRecord>((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = database.transaction(STORE).objectStore(STORE).get(id);
        request.onsuccess = () => {
          const file = request.result as AttachmentRecord | undefined;
          if (!file || file.scope !== scope || !(file.blob instanceof Blob)) reject(new Error("Файл недоступен в этом браузере"));
          else resolve(file);
        };
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    } finally { database.close(); }
  },
  async remove(scope: string, ids: string[]) {
    if (!ids.length) return;
    const database = await openDatabase();
    try {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const transaction = database.transaction(STORE, "readwrite");
        const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE);
        ids.forEach((id) => {
          const request = store.get(id);
          request.onsuccess = () => { if ((request.result as AttachmentRecord | undefined)?.scope === scope) store.delete(id); };
        });
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
      });
    } finally { database.close(); }
  },
};


// src\data\messageDraftStore.ts
import type { UserRole } from "../components/RoleContext";

interface MessageDraftReadState { text?: string; error: string }
interface MessageDraftWriteState { error: string }

// Only text is stored here. Files and reply targets have a different lifecycle.
export const getMessageDraftKey = (role: UserRole, userId: string, dialogId: string) =>
  `bi-university-message-draft:${JSON.stringify([role, userId, dialogId])}`;

export const readMessageDraft = (key: string): MessageDraftReadState => {
  try {
    const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
    if (saved === null) return { error: "" };
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("version" in value) || value.version !== 1
      || !("text" in value) || typeof value.text !== "string" || value.text.length > 16000) throw new Error("Invalid message draft");
    return { text: value.text, error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { error: "Не удалось восстановить текстовый черновик из этой вкладки. Сохранённые данные не изменены. Можно ввести и отправить сообщение вручную." };
  }
};

export const saveMessageDraft = (key: string, text: string): MessageDraftWriteState => {
  const snapshot = readMessageDraft(key);
  if (snapshot.error) return { error: snapshot.error };
  try {
    if (!text || text.length > 16000) throw new Error("Invalid message draft text");
    sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, text }));
    return { error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { error: "Текст пока только в памяти: не удалось сохранить черновик в этой вкладке. Отправка доступна, но после ухода из раздела новые изменения могут потеряться." };
  }
};

export const removeMessageDraft = (key: string): MessageDraftWriteState => {
  const snapshot = readMessageDraft(key);
  if (snapshot.error) return { error: "Не удалось прочитать и очистить сохранённый черновик. Исходные данные не изменены; старый текст может появиться при возвращении." };
  try {
    if (snapshot.text !== undefined) sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
    return { error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { error: "Не удалось удалить сохранённый черновик из этой вкладки. Старый текст может появиться при возвращении." };
  }
};


// src\data\messageStore.test.ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { messageRepository, type MessagingState } from "./messageStore";

const values = new Map<string, string>();

beforeEach(() => {
  values.clear();
  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, "localStorage", { configurable: true, value: {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => values.set(key, value),
  } });
});

afterEach(() => { Reflect.deleteProperty(globalThis, "localStorage"); });

describe("message repository", () => {
  it("stores teacher and student conversations separately", () => {
    const state: MessagingState = { dialogIds: ["teacher-1"], messages: { "teacher-1": [{ id: 1, incoming: false, text: "Ответ", time: "12:00" }] }, unread: { students: 0, teachers: 1, groups: 0 } };
    expect(messageRepository.save("student", state)).toBe(true);
    expect(messageRepository.read("student")).toEqual(state);
    expect(messageRepository.read("teacher")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("returns a safe fallback for corrupted data", () => {
    values.set("bi-university-messages-v1:student", "not-json");
    expect(messageRepository.read("student")).toBeNull();
  });
});


// src\data\messageStore.ts
import type { UserRole } from "../components/RoleContext";

export type MessageAttachment = { id: string; name: string; type: string; size: number };
export type StoredMessage = { id: number; incoming: boolean; text: string; time: string; attachments?: MessageAttachment[]; replyTo?: number; sentAt?: string };
export type MessageTab = "students" | "teachers" | "groups";

export interface StoredMessageGroup {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  memberIds: string[];
  createdAt: number;
}

export interface MessagingState {
  dialogIds: string[];
  messages: Record<string, StoredMessage[]>;
  unread: Record<MessageTab, number>;
  groups?: StoredMessageGroup[];
  leftGroupIds?: string[];
}

const DEMO_USER_IDS: Record<UserRole, string> = { teacher: "teacher-elena-volkova", student: "anna-smirnova" };
const keyFor = (role: UserRole, userId: string) => "bi-university-messages-v2:" + role + ":" + encodeURIComponent(userId);
const emptyUnread = (): MessagingState["unread"] => ({ students: 0, teachers: 0, groups: 0 });
export const createEmptyMessagingState = (): MessagingState => ({ dialogIds: [], messages: {}, unread: emptyUnread() });
export interface MessagingReadState { state: MessagingState | null; error: string }
const isMessage = (value: unknown): value is StoredMessage => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const message = value as Partial<StoredMessage>;
  const attachmentsValid = message.attachments === undefined || (Array.isArray(message.attachments) && message.attachments.length <= 5 && message.attachments.every((file) => file && typeof file.id === "string" && Boolean(file.id) && typeof file.name === "string" && typeof file.type === "string" && Number.isFinite(file.size) && file.size >= 0));
  return typeof message.id === "number" && Number.isFinite(message.id) && typeof message.incoming === "boolean" && typeof message.text === "string" && (Boolean(message.text.trim()) || Boolean(message.attachments?.length)) && typeof message.time === "string" && attachmentsValid && (message.replyTo === undefined || (typeof message.replyTo === "number" && Number.isFinite(message.replyTo))) && (message.sentAt === undefined || (typeof message.sentAt === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(message.sentAt))));
};
const isGroup = (value: unknown): value is StoredMessageGroup => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false;
  const group = value as Partial<StoredMessageGroup>;
  return typeof group.id === "string" && Boolean(group.id) && typeof group.name === "string" && Boolean(group.name.trim()) && Array.isArray(group.memberIds) && group.memberIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string") && typeof group.createdAt === "number" && Number.isFinite(group.createdAt);
};

const readMessagingState = (role: UserRole, userId = DEMO_USER_IDS[role]): MessagingReadState => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(keyFor(role, userId));
      // Old role-only history belongs exclusively to the original demo identity.
      const legacy = saved === null && userId === DEMO_USER_IDS[role] ? localStorage.getItem("bi-university-messages-v1:" + role) : null;
      if (saved === null && legacy === null) return { state: null, error: "" };
      const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(saved ?? legacy ?? "null");
      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || !("dialogIds" in parsed) || !("messages" in parsed)) throw new Error("Invalid messaging data");
      const value = parsed as Partial<MessagingState>;
      if (!Array.isArray(value.dialogIds) || !value.dialogIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string" && Boolean(id.trim())) || !value.messages || typeof value.messages !== "object" || Array.isArray(value.messages)) throw new Error("Invalid dialogs");
      if (Object.entries(value.messages).some(([id, messages]) => !id.trim() || !Array.isArray(messages) || !messages.every(isMessage) || new Set(messages.map((message) => message.id)).size !== messages.length)) throw new Error("Invalid messages");
      if (value.groups !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(value.groups) || !value.groups.every(isGroup))) throw new Error("Invalid conversations");
      if (value.leftGroupIds !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(value.leftGroupIds) || !value.leftGroupIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string" && Boolean(id.trim())))) throw new Error("Invalid conversation membership");
      const unread = emptyUnread();
      for (const tab of ["students", "teachers", "groups"] as const) {
        const count = value.unread?.[tab];
        if (typeof count === "number" && Number.isFinite(count) && count > 0) unread[tab] = Math.floor(count);
      }
      return { state: {
        dialogIds: [...new Set(value.dialogIds)],
        messages: value.messages,
        unread,
        ...(Array.isArray(value.groups) ? { groups: value.groups.filter(isGroup).map((group) => ({ ...group, memberIds: [...new Set(group.memberIds)] })) } : {}),
        ...(Array.isArray(value.leftGroupIds) ? { leftGroupIds: [...new Set(value.leftGroupIds)] } : {}),
      }, error: "" };
    } catch {
      return { state: null, error: "Не удалось прочитать сохранённую переписку. Запись приостановлена, чтобы не потерять историю. Исходные данные не изменены; попробуйте повторить чтение." };
    }
};

export const messageRepository = {
  readState: readMessagingState,
  subscribe(role: UserRole, userId: string, listener: () => void) {
    const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === null || event.key === keyFor(role, userId) || (userId === DEMO_USER_IDS[role] && event.key === "bi-university-messages-v1:" + role)) listener();
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
  },
  read(role: UserRole, userId = DEMO_USER_IDS[role]): MessagingState | null {
    return readMessagingState(role, userId).state;
  },

  save(role: UserRole, state: MessagingState, userId = DEMO_USER_IDS[role]) {
    try {
      if (readMessagingState(role, userId).error) return false;
      localStorage.setItem(keyFor(role, userId), JSON.stringify(state));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  },
};


// src\data\notificationStore.ts
import type { UserRole } from "../components/RoleContext";

export type NotificationKind = "assignment" | "submission" | "grade" | "revision" | "schedule";

export interface AppNotification {
  id: string;
  recipientUserId: string;
  kind: NotificationKind;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  href: string;
  createdAt: string;
  read: boolean;
  dedupeKey?: string;
}

type AddNotificationInput = Pick<AppNotification, "kind" | "title" | "body" | "href"> & {
  recipientUserId?: string;
  /** @deprecated Передавайте recipientUserId. Поле оставлено для совместимости старых вызовов. */
  recipientRole?: UserRole;
  dedupeKey?: string;
};

type StoredNotifications = {
  version: 2;
  items: AppNotification[];
};

export interface NotificationReadState {
  items: AppNotification[];
  error: string;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "bi-university-demo-notifications";
const CHANGE_EVENT = "bi-university-notifications-change";
const STORAGE_VERSION = 2;
const AUTO_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS = 60_000;

const ROLE_RECIPIENTS: Record<UserRole, string> = {
  teacher: "teacher-elena-volkova",
  student: "anna-smirnova",
};

const notificationKinds: NotificationKind[] = ["assignment", "submission", "grade", "revision", "schedule"];

const initialNotifications: AppNotification[] = [
  {
    id: "student-schedule-change",
    recipientUserId: ROLE_RECIPIENTS.student,
    kind: "schedule",
    title: "Изменилась аудитория",
    body: "Линейная алгебра 14 сентября пройдёт в аудитории 318.",
    href: "/schedule",
    createdAt: "2026-09-12T08:30:00",
    read: false,
  },
  {
    id: "teacher-new-answer",
    recipientUserId: ROLE_RECIPIENTS.teacher,
    kind: "submission",
    title: "Получен новый ответ",
    body: "Анна Смирнова отправила расчётно-графическую работу.",
    href: "/journal/theory-of-probability/112-mko?tab=assignments&assignment=linear-algebra-rgr-2",
    createdAt: "2026-09-12T10:15:00",
    read: false,
  },
];

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => (
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
);

const isNotificationKind = (value: unknown): value is NotificationKind => (
  typeof value === "string" && notificationKinds.includes(value as NotificationKind)
);

const normalizeHref = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return "/notifications";
  const href = value.trim();
  return href.startsWith("/") && !href.startsWith("//") && !href.includes("\\") && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(href) ? href : "/notifications";
};

const normalizeDate = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(value))) return null;
  return new Date(value).toISOString();
};

const legacyId = (index: number, createdAt: string) => `migrated-${createdAt.replace(/\D/g, "")}-${index}`;

const normalizeNotification = (value: unknown, index: number): AppNotification | null => {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isNotificationKind(value.kind)) return null;
  if ((value.body !== undefined && typeof value.body !== "string") || (value.read !== undefined && typeof value.read !== "boolean")) return null;

  const title = typeof value.title === "string" ? value.title.trim() : "";
  const body = typeof value.body === "string" ? value.body.trim() : "";
  const createdAt = normalizeDate(value.createdAt);
  const legacyRole = value.recipientRole === "teacher" || value.recipientRole === "student"
    ? value.recipientRole
    : null;
  const recipientUserId = typeof value.recipientUserId === "string"
    ? value.recipientUserId.trim()
    : typeof value.userId === "string"
      ? value.userId.trim()
      : legacyRole
        ? ROLE_RECIPIENTS[legacyRole]
        : "";

  if (!title || !createdAt || !recipientUserId) return null;

  return {
    id: typeof value.id === "string" && value.id.trim() ? value.id.trim() : legacyId(index, createdAt),
    recipientUserId,
    kind: value.kind,
    title,
    body,
    href: normalizeHref(value.href),
    createdAt,
    read: value.read === true,
    ...(typeof value.dedupeKey === "string" && value.dedupeKey.trim()
      ? { dedupeKey: value.dedupeKey.trim() }
      : {}),
  };
};

const deduplicateStoredItems = (items: AppNotification[]) => {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const explicitKeys = new Set<string>();

  return items.filter((item) => {
    const scopedKey = item.dedupeKey ? `${item.recipientUserId}:${item.dedupeKey}` : null;
    if (ids.has(item.id) || (scopedKey && explicitKeys.has(scopedKey))) return false;
    ids.add(item.id);
    if (scopedKey) explicitKeys.add(scopedKey);
    return true;
  });
};

const normalizeItems = (items: unknown[], currentVersion = false) => {
  if (currentVersion && items.some((item) => !isRecord(item)
    || typeof item.id !== "string" || !item.id.trim()
    || typeof item.recipientUserId !== "string" || !item.recipientUserId.trim()
    || typeof item.body !== "string" || typeof item.href !== "string" || typeof item.read !== "boolean"
    || (item.dedupeKey !== undefined && typeof item.dedupeKey !== "string"))) throw new Error("Invalid current notifications");
  const normalized = items.map(normalizeNotification);
  if (normalized.some((item) => item === null)) throw new Error("Invalid notifications");
  const sorted = normalized.filter((item): item is AppNotification => item !== null)
    .sort((left, right) => Date.parse(right.createdAt) - Date.parse(left.createdAt));
  const unique = deduplicateStoredItems(sorted);
  if (unique.length !== items.length) throw new Error("Duplicate notifications");
  return unique;
};

const emitChange = () => window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
/** Refresh all open consumers without writing to storage. */
export const refreshNotifications = () => emitChange();

const writeNotifications = (items: AppNotification[]) => {
  const payload: StoredNotifications = { version: STORAGE_VERSION, items };
  window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
  emitChange();
};

/** Reading never migrates, repairs or replaces stored data. */
export const readNotificationState = (): NotificationReadState => {
  try {
    const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === null) return { items: initialNotifications.map((item) => ({ ...item })), error: "" };

    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
    const source = Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed
      : isRecord(parsed) && (parsed.version === undefined || parsed.version === 1 || parsed.version === STORAGE_VERSION) && Array.isArray(parsed.items)
        ? parsed.items
        : null;

    if (!source) throw new Error("Invalid notifications storage");
    return { items: normalizeItems(source, isRecord(parsed) && parsed.version === STORAGE_VERSION), error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { items: [], error: "Не удалось прочитать сохранённые уведомления. Запись приостановлена, чтобы не потерять данные. Исходная история не изменена; повторите чтение." };
  }
};

export const getNotifications = (): AppNotification[] => readNotificationState().items;

const requireNotificationItems = () => {
  const snapshot = readNotificationState();
  if (snapshot.error) { emitChange(); throw new Error(snapshot.error); }
  return snapshot.items;
};

export const saveNotifications = (items: AppNotification[]) => {
  requireNotificationItems();
  writeNotifications(normalizeItems(items, true));
};

const createAutomaticDedupeKey = (notification: AddNotificationInput, recipientUserId: string) => [
  recipientUserId,
  notification.kind,
  notification.title.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru-RU"),
  notification.body.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru-RU"),
  normalizeHref(notification.href),
].join("|");

export const addNotification = (notification: AddNotificationInput) => {
  const recipientUserId = notification.recipientUserId?.trim()
    || (notification.recipientRole ? ROLE_RECIPIENTS[notification.recipientRole] : "");
  const title = notification.title.trim();
  if (!recipientUserId || !title || !isNotificationKind(notification.kind)) return null;

  const items = requireNotificationItems();
  const now = new Date();
  const explicitDedupeKey = notification.dedupeKey?.trim();
  const dedupeKey = explicitDedupeKey || createAutomaticDedupeKey(notification, recipientUserId);
  const duplicate = items.find((item) => {
    if (item.recipientUserId !== recipientUserId) return false;
    if (explicitDedupeKey) return item.dedupeKey === explicitDedupeKey;
    const itemKey = createAutomaticDedupeKey(item, item.recipientUserId);
    return itemKey === dedupeKey && now.getTime() - Date.parse(item.createdAt) < AUTO_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS;
  });

  if (duplicate) return duplicate;

  const created: AppNotification = {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    recipientUserId,
    kind: notification.kind,
    title,
    body: notification.body.trim(),
    href: normalizeHref(notification.href),
    createdAt: now.toISOString(),
    read: false,
    ...(explicitDedupeKey ? { dedupeKey: explicitDedupeKey } : {}),
  };

  saveNotifications([created, ...items]);
  return created;
};

export const subscribeNotifications = (listener: () => void) => {
  const handleStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
    if (event.key === null || event.key === STORAGE_KEY) listener();
  };

  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
  window.addEventListener("storage", handleStorage);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
    window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorage);
  };
};


// src\data\plannerStore.ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { PlannerDraftConflictError } from "../domain/plannerDraft";

export interface PlannerNote {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  startAt?: Date;
  endAt?: Date;
  createdAt: Date;
  completed: boolean;
  priority: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  category: "study" | "personal";
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "bi-university-demo-planner";
const CHANGE_EVENT = "bi-university-planner-change";
export class PlannerWriteError extends Error {}
const validDate = (value: unknown) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return undefined;
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date : undefined;
};

export const readPlannerState = (): { notes: PlannerNote[]; error: string } => {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!saved) return { notes: [], error: "" };
    const payload: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!Array.isArray(payload)) throw new Error("Invalid planner data");
    const notes = payload.flatMap((value): PlannerNote[] => {
      if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return [];
      const note = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      const createdAt = validDate(note.createdAt);
      if (typeof note.id !== "string" || typeof note.title !== "string" || !createdAt) return [];
      return [{ id: note.id, title: note.title, text: typeof note.text === "string" ? note.text : "", createdAt, startAt: validDate(note.startAt), endAt: validDate(note.endAt), completed: note.completed === true, priority: note.priority === "low" || note.priority === "high" ? note.priority : "medium", category: note.category === "personal" ? "personal" : "study" }];
    });
    if (notes.length !== payload.length || new Set(notes.map((note) => note.id)).size !== notes.length) return { notes, error: "В данных планировщика есть повреждённые записи. Сохранение приостановлено, чтобы не потерять задачи." };
    return { notes, error: "" };
  } catch {
    return { notes: [], error: "Не удалось прочитать задачи планировщика из браузера." };
  }
};

export const subscribePlannerStore = (listener: () => void) => {
  const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (!event.key || event.key === STORAGE_KEY) listener(); };
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener);
  window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
  return () => { window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, listener); window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage); };
};

export const appendPlannerDemoNotes = (notes: PlannerNote[]) => {
  const current = readPlannerState();
  if (current.error) throw new PlannerWriteError(current.error);
  const ids = new Set(current.notes.map((note) => note.id));
  const added = notes.filter((note) => !ids.has(note.id));
  if (!added.length) return 0;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify([...current.notes, ...added]));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  return added.length;
};

export const usePlannerNotes = () => {
  const [state, setState] = useState(readPlannerState);
  const refreshNotes = useCallback(() => setState(readPlannerState()), []);
  useEffect(() => subscribePlannerStore(refreshNotes), [refreshNotes]);
  const setNotes = (update: PlannerNote[] | ((notes: PlannerNote[]) => PlannerNote[])) => {
    try {
      const current = readPlannerState();
      if (current.error) throw new PlannerWriteError(`${current.error} Сохранение отменено, чтобы не перезаписать данные.`);
      const notes = typeof update === "function" ? update(current.notes) : update;
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(notes));
      setState({ notes, error: "" });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      setState((current) => ({ ...current, error: error instanceof PlannerWriteError || error instanceof PlannerDraftConflictError ? error.message : "Не удалось сохранить изменения. Данные не изменены — повторите попытку." }));
      return false;
    }
  };
  return { notes: state.notes, error: state.error, setNotes, refreshNotes };
};


// src\data\schedule.ts
import type { WeeklyScheduleData } from "../types/sched";
import { getWeekStart, toLocalDateKey } from "../domain/schedule";
import { SUBJECTS, getSubjectGroups } from "./academicCatalog";
import { DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS } from "./scheduleSlots";

export const DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP = "112-МКо";
export const DEMO_TEACHER = "Волкова Е.В.";

// Повторяемая демонстрационная неделя до подключения API вуза.
export const getDemoWeekSchedule = (date: Date): WeeklyScheduleData => {
  const monday = getWeekStart(date);
  const slotsByDay = [[0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 2, 3, 5], [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 4], [0, 1, 2, 6]];
  return Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, day) => {
    const lessonDate = new Date(monday);
    lessonDate.setDate(monday.getDate() + day);
    const dateKey = toLocalDateKey(lessonDate);
    const lessons: WeeklyScheduleData = slotsByDay[day].map((slot) => {
      const { startTime, endTime } = DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS[slot];
      const subject = SUBJECTS[(day + slot) % SUBJECTS.length];
      return {
        id: Number(dateKey.replaceAll("-", "")) * 10 + slot,
        date: dateKey,
        dayOfWeek: day + 1,
        subject: subject.name,
        type: slot >= 4 ? "Лаб." : slot % 2 === 0 ? "Лек." : "Пр.",
        startTime,
        endTime,
        location: `Ауд. ${[101, 202, 303, 101, 405, 406, 407][slot]}`,
        teacher: slot === 1 ? "Петров П.П." : DEMO_TEACHER,
        teacherId: slot === 1 ? "teacher-pavel-petrov" : "teacher-elena-volkova",
        group: slot >= 3 ? getSubjectGroups(subject.id).find((group) => group.name !== DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP)?.name ?? DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP : DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP,
      };
    });
    // A parallel class keeps the student's lesson with another teacher visible,
    // while the teacher has a full seven-slot day without overlapping own classes.
    if (day === 2) {
      const subject = SUBJECTS[(day + 1) % SUBJECTS.length];
      const { startTime, endTime } = DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS[1];
      lessons.push({
        id: Number(dateKey.replaceAll("-", "")) * 10 + 7,
        date: dateKey, dayOfWeek: day + 1, subject: subject.name, type: "Пр.",
        startTime, endTime, location: "Ауд. 405", teacher: DEMO_TEACHER,
        teacherId: "teacher-elena-volkova",
        group: getSubjectGroups(subject.id).find((group) => group.name !== DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP)?.name ?? DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP,
      });
    }
    return lessons.sort((a, b) => a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime) || a.id - b.id);
  }).flat();
};

export const getPersonalSchedule = (schedule: WeeklyScheduleData, role: "teacher" | "student") =>
  schedule.filter((lesson) => role === "student" ? lesson.group === DEMO_STUDENT_GROUP : lesson.teacher === DEMO_TEACHER);

import type { ScheduleSlot } from "../types/sched";

// src\data\studentDashboard.ts
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getAssignments, getSubmissions, subscribeAssignmentStore } from "./assignmentStore";
import { getJournalSnapshot, subscribeJournalStore } from "./journalStore";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule, getPersonalSchedule } from "./schedule";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../domain/schedule";
import {
  calculateDashboardJournalMetrics,
  type DashboardJournal,
  type DashboardMembership,
} from "../domain/dashboard";
import { getAcademicGroup } from "./academicCatalog";
import { getStudentDashboardTasks } from "../domain/dashboardAssignments";
import { getAssignmentHref } from "../domain/journalNavigation";
import { getSubmissionStatus } from "../domain/assignments";
import { createSubjectLessons } from "./lessons";

export const useDashboardUpdate = () => {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date());
  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = () => setNow(new Date());
    const unsubscribeAssignments = subscribeAssignmentStore(refresh);
    const unsubscribeJournal = subscribeJournalStore(refresh);
    const timer = window.setInterval(refresh, 60_000);
    return () => {
      unsubscribeAssignments();
      unsubscribeJournal();
      window.clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, []);
  return now;
};

const readJournal = (subjectId: string, groupId: string): DashboardJournal => {
  return { subjectId, groupId, students: getJournalSnapshot(subjectId, groupId), lessons: createSubjectLessons(subjectId, groupId) };
};

const readMembershipJournals = (memberships: DashboardMembership[]) => memberships.flatMap(
  (membership) => membership.groupIds.map((groupId) => readJournal(membership.subjectId, groupId)),
);

export const getStudentDashboard = ({
  studentId,
  memberships,
  now,
}: {
  studentId: string;
  memberships: DashboardMembership[];
  now: Date;
}) => {
  const groupId = memberships[0]?.groupIds[0];
  const groupName = getAcademicGroup(groupId)?.name;
  const journals = readMembershipJournals(memberships);
  const journal = calculateDashboardJournalMetrics(journals, studentId);
  const tasks = getStudentDashboardTasks(getAssignments(), getSubmissions(), memberships, studentId, now);
  const weekSchedule = getPersonalSchedule(getDemoWeekSchedule(now), "student");
  const todaySchedule = weekSchedule.filter((lesson) => lesson.date === toLocalDateKey(now));
  const nextTask = tasks.find((task) => task.canSubmit);

  return {
    groupName: groupName ?? "Группа не указана",
    weekLessons: weekSchedule.length,
    todayLessons: todaySchedule.length,
    activeAssignments: tasks.filter((task) => task.canSubmit).length,
    awaitingReview: tasks.filter((task) => task.state === "submitted" || task.state === "resubmitted").length,
    tasks,
    attendance: journal.attendance,
    averageGrade: journal.averageGrade,
    gradesCount: journal.gradesCount,
    nextAction: nextTask ? {
      title: nextTask.state === "revision" ? "Исправить работу по комментарию" : nextTask.overdue ? "Сдать работу с опозданием" : "Ближайший учебный дедлайн",
      description: `${nextTask.subject} · ${nextTask.title}. ${nextTask.deadline}`,
      href: nextTask.href,
    } : null,
  };
};

export const getTeacherDashboard = ({ memberships, now }: { memberships: DashboardMembership[]; now: Date }) => {
  const schedule = getPersonalSchedule(getDemoWeekSchedule(now), "teacher");
  const today = schedule.filter((lesson) => lesson.date === toLocalDateKey(now));
  const nowTime = now.getTime();
  const conducted = today.filter((lesson) => new Date(`${lesson.date}T${lesson.endTime}:00`).getTime() <= nowTime).length;
  const journal = calculateDashboardJournalMetrics(readMembershipJournals(memberships));
  const assignments = getAssignments().filter((assignment) => memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === assignment.subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(assignment.groupId)));
  const submissions = getSubmissions().filter((submission) => {
    const assignment = assignments.find((item) => item.id === submission.assignmentId);
    return assignment !== undefined;
  });
  const pendingAnswers = submissions.filter((submission) => getSubmissionStatus(submission) === "submitted");
  const pendingReview = pendingAnswers.length;
  const firstReviewAssignment = assignments.find((assignment) => assignment.id === pendingAnswers[0]?.assignmentId);
  const firstDraft = assignments.find((assignment) => assignment.status === "draft");
  const firstWithoutAnswers = assignments.find((assignment) => assignment.status === "published" && !submissions.some((submission) => submission.assignmentId === assignment.id));
  const drafts = assignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "draft").length;
  const assignmentsWithoutAnswers = assignments.filter((assignment) =>
    assignment.status === "published" && !submissions.some((submission) => submission.assignmentId === assignment.id),
  ).length;
  const focus = [
    pendingReview ? {
      level: "urgent" as const,
      title: `Работ на проверку: ${pendingReview}`,
      description: "Ответы студентов готовы к обратной связи",
      action: "Проверить",
      href: firstReviewAssignment ? getAssignmentHref(firstReviewAssignment, pendingAnswers[0].id) : "/journal",
    } : null,
    journal.unmarked ? {
      level: "warning" as const,
      title: `В журналах не заполнено ${journal.unmarked} отметок`,
      description: "Данные рассчитаны по доступным дисциплинам и группам",
      action: "Заполнить",
      href: "/journal",
    } : null,
    drafts ? {
      level: "normal" as const,
      title: `${drafts} ${drafts === 1 ? "задание осталось" : "задания остались"} в черновиках`,
      description: "Опубликуйте их, когда материалы будут готовы",
      action: "Открыть",
      href: firstDraft ? getAssignmentHref(firstDraft) : "/journal",
    } : assignmentsWithoutAnswers ? {
      level: "normal" as const,
      title: `По ${assignmentsWithoutAnswers} заданиям пока нет ответов`,
      description: "Можно проверить сроки и напомнить группе",
      action: "Посмотреть",
      href: firstWithoutAnswers ? getAssignmentHref(firstWithoutAnswers) : "/journal",
    } : null,
  ].filter((item): item is NonNullable<typeof item> => item !== null);

  return {
    todayLessons: today.length,
    conductedLessons: conducted,
    attendanceMarked: journal.attendanceMarked,
    gradesCount: journal.gradesCount,
    journalCells: journal.totalCells,
    gradeCells: journal.gradeCells,
    focus,
  };
};

// src\data\studyPlan.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getSemesterHours, getSemesterSubjects, getSubjectHours, STUDY_PLAN_TOTAL_HOURS } from "./studyPlan";

describe("study plan", () => {
  it("calculates subject and semester hours from workload types", () => {
    const subject = getSemesterSubjects(3)[0];
    expect(getSubjectHours(subject)).toBe(subject.lectures + subject.practice + subject.labs + subject.independent);
    expect(getSemesterHours(3)).toBe(STUDY_PLAN_TOTAL_HOURS);
  });

  it("keeps subjects isolated by semester", () => {
    expect(getSemesterSubjects(3).every((subject) => subject.semester === 3)).toBe(true);
    expect(getSemesterSubjects(4).every((subject) => subject.semester === 4)).toBe(true);
  });
});

// src\data\teacherAnalytics.ts
import type { DashboardMembership } from "../domain/dashboard";
import type { AnalyticsJournal } from "../domain/teacherAnalytics";
import { getAcademicGroup, getAcademicSubjectDefinition } from "./academicCatalog";
import { decodeJournal, getJournalSnapshot, journalKey } from "./journalStore";
import { createSubjectLessons } from "./lessons";

/** Read-only adapter. Damaged saved journals must not masquerade as demo statistics. */
export const readAnalyticsJournals = (memberships: DashboardMembership[]) => {
  const journals: AnalyticsJournal[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  memberships.forEach((membership) => membership.groupIds.forEach((groupId) => {
    const subject = getAcademicSubjectDefinition(membership.subjectId);
    const group = getAcademicGroup(groupId);
    const key = `${membership.subjectId}:${groupId}`;
    if (!subject || !group || seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(journalKey(subject.id, group.id));
      if (raw !== null && decodeJournal(raw) === null) { warnings.push(`${subject.shortName} · ${group.name}`); return; }
      journals.push({ subjectId: subject.id, subjectName: subject.name, subjectShortName: subject.shortName, groupId: group.id, groupName: group.name, students: getJournalSnapshot(subject.id, group.id), lessons: createSubjectLessons(subject.id, group.id) });
    } catch { warnings.push(`${subject.shortName} · ${group.name}`); }
  }));
  return { journals, warnings };
};

// src\domain\assignmentForm.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getAssignmentFormError, getAssignmentVisibility, type AssignmentForm } from "./assignmentForm";

const memberships = [{ subjectId: "theory-of-probability", groupIds: ["112-mko"] }];
const form: AssignmentForm = { title: "Практическая работа", description: "Решите задачи", subject: "Теория вероятностей", group: "112-МКо", lessonDate: "2026-10-10T09:00", deadline: "2026-10-12T23:59", lessonType: "Практика", status: "published", allowLateSubmissions: false };
describe("assignment publication validation", () => {
  it("accepts a complete assigned task", () => expect(getAssignmentFormError(form, memberships)).toBe(""));
  it.each(["title", "description"] as const)("rejects whitespace-only %s", (field) => expect(getAssignmentFormError({ ...form, [field]: "  \n  " }, memberships)).toContain("не только пробелы"));
  it.each(["lessonDate", "deadline"] as const)("rejects an unset %s", (field) => expect(getAssignmentFormError({ ...form, [field]: "" }, memberships)).toContain("Выберите дату"));
  it("rejects a deadline before the lesson", () => expect(getAssignmentFormError({ ...form, deadline: "2026-10-09T23:59" }, memberships)).toContain("раньше даты"));
  it("does not let a teacher save to an unassigned group", () => expect(getAssignmentFormError({ ...form, group: "113-МКо" }, memberships)).toContain("не назначены"));
  it("describes the actual visibility and acceptance rules for each status", () => {
    expect(getAssignmentVisibility("draft")).toContain("только преподавателю");
    expect(getAssignmentVisibility("published")).toContain("отправлять ответы");
    expect(getAssignmentVisibility("closed")).toContain("не принимаются");
    expect(getAssignmentVisibility("archived")).toContain("не будет видно студентам");
  });
});


// src\domain\assignmentForm.ts
import type { Assignment } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { isAcademicMembershipMatch, type AcademicMembership } from "../data/academicCatalog";

export type AssignmentForm = Pick<Assignment, "subject" | "group" | "lessonDate" | "lessonType" | "title" | "description" | "deadline" | "status" | "allowLateSubmissions">;

export const getAssignmentFormError = (form: AssignmentForm, memberships: AcademicMembership[]) => {
  if (!form.title.trim() || !form.description.trim()) return "Укажите название и описание задания — не только пробелы.";
  const lesson = Date.parse(form.lessonDate);
  const deadline = Date.parse(form.deadline);
  if (!Number.isFinite(lesson) || !Number.isFinite(deadline)) return "Выберите дату занятия и срок сдачи.";
  if (deadline < lesson) return "Срок сдачи не может быть раньше даты занятия.";
  if (!isAcademicMembershipMatch(memberships, form.subject, form.group)) return "Предмет или группа не назначены вашему профилю.";
  return "";
};

export const getAssignmentVisibility = (status: Assignment["status"]) => status === "published" ? "Студенты увидят задание и смогут отправлять ответы." : status === "closed" ? "Студенты увидят задание и историю ответов, но новые ответы не принимаются." : status === "draft" ? "Черновик виден только преподавателю. Для сдачи его нужно опубликовать." : "Задание будет в архиве преподавателя и не будет видно студентам.";


// src\domain\assignments.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Assignment, Submission } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getStudentAssignmentState, isAssignmentVisibleToStudent, isSubmissionAllowed } from "./assignments";

const assignment = (overrides: Partial<Assignment> = {}): Assignment => ({
  id: "task-1", subjectId: "data-analysis", groupId: "112-mko", subject: "Анализ данных", group: "112-МКо", lessonDate: "2026-09-12T09:00",
  lessonType: "Практика", title: "Работа", description: "Описание", deadline: "2026-09-20T18:00",
  status: "published", allowLateSubmissions: false, createdAt: "2026-09-10T10:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-10T10:00",
  ...overrides,
});

const submission = (overrides: Partial<Submission> = {}): Submission => ({
  id: "answer-1", assignmentId: "task-1", studentId: "student-1", studentName: "Анна Смирнова",
  sentAt: "2026-09-19T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-19T12:00", text: "Ответ", status: "submitted", ...overrides,
});

describe("assignment rules", () => {
  const beforeDeadline = new Date("2026-09-19T12:00:00");
  const afterDeadline = new Date("2026-09-21T12:00:00");

  it("shows only published or closed tasks for the student's group", () => {
    expect(isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(assignment(), "112-МКо")).toBe(true);
    expect(isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(assignment({ status: "closed" }), "112-МКо")).toBe(true);
    expect(isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(assignment({ status: "draft" }), "112-МКо")).toBe(false);
    expect(isAssignmentVisibleToStudent(assignment(), "113-МКо")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("respects publication, deadline and late submission settings", () => {
    expect(isSubmissionAllowed(assignment(), beforeDeadline)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubmissionAllowed(assignment(), afterDeadline)).toBe(false);
    expect(isSubmissionAllowed(assignment({ allowLateSubmissions: true }), afterDeadline)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubmissionAllowed(assignment({ status: "closed", allowLateSubmissions: true }), beforeDeadline)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("prioritizes an existing answer state over the deadline", () => {
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment(), submission({ grade: "5", status: "graded" }), afterDeadline)).toBe("graded");
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment(), submission({ status: "revision" }), afterDeadline)).toBe("revision");
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment(), submission(), afterDeadline)).toBe("submitted");
  });

  it("distinguishes overdue tasks with and without late submission", () => {
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment(), undefined, afterDeadline)).toBe("overdue");
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment({ allowLateSubmissions: true }), undefined, afterDeadline)).toBe("late-allowed");
    expect(getStudentAssignmentState(assignment(), undefined, beforeDeadline)).toBe("pending");
  });
});


// src\domain\assignments.ts
import type { Assignment, Submission, SubmissionAttempt, SubmissionStatus } from "../data/assignmentStore";

export type StudentAssignmentState =
  | "graded"
  | "revision"
  | "resubmitted"
  | "submitted"
  | "late-allowed"
  | "overdue"
  | "pending";

export type AssignmentDeadlineState = "scheduled" | "due-soon" | "overdue";

const DAY_IN_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export const isAssignmentVisibleToStudent = (assignment: Assignment, studentGroup: string) =>
  assignment.group === studentGroup && (assignment.status === "published" || assignment.status === "closed");

export const isSubmissionAllowed = (assignment: Assignment, now = new Date()) => {
  if (assignment.status !== "published") return false;
  return assignment.allowLateSubmissions || new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime() >= now.getTime();
};

export const getSubmissionAttempts = (submission?: Submission): SubmissionAttempt[] => {
  if (!submission) return [];
  if (submission.attempts?.length) return submission.attempts;

  return [{
    id: `${submission.id}-attempt-1`,
    number: 1,
    sentAt: submission.sentAt,
    updatedAt: submission.updatedAt,
    text: submission.text,
    attachmentId: submission.attachmentId,
    attachmentName: submission.attachmentName,
    status: submission.status,
    submittedLate: false,
    teacherComment: submission.teacherComment ?? submission.comment,
    grade: submission.grade,
  }];
};

export const getCurrentSubmissionAttempt = (submission?: Submission) => {
  const attempts = getSubmissionAttempts(submission);
  return attempts[attempts.length - 1];
};

export const getSubmissionStatus = (submission?: Submission): SubmissionStatus | undefined =>
  getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(submission)?.status ?? submission?.status;

export const isAttemptLate = (assignment: Assignment, sentAt: string) =>
  new Date(sentAt).getTime() > new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime();

export const getAssignmentDeadlineState = (assignment: Assignment, now = new Date()): AssignmentDeadlineState => {
  const remaining = new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime() - now.getTime();
  if (remaining < 0) return "overdue";
  if (remaining <= DAY_IN_MS * 2) return "due-soon";
  return "scheduled";
};

export const getStudentAssignmentState = (
  assignment: Assignment,
  submission?: Submission,
  now = new Date(),
): StudentAssignmentState => {
  const currentAttempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(submission);
  if (currentAttempt?.status === "graded") return "graded";
  if (currentAttempt?.status === "revision") return "revision";
  if (currentAttempt?.status === "submitted") {
    return getSubmissionAttempts(submission).length > 1 ? "resubmitted" : "submitted";
  }
  if (new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime() < now.getTime()) {
    return isSubmissionAllowed(assignment, now) ? "late-allowed" : "overdue";
  }
  return "pending";
};


// src\domain\calendar.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getCalendarMonthDays, getDayInMonth } from "./calendar";

describe("calendar navigation", () => {
  it("fills complete Monday-to-Sunday weeks including adjacent months", () => {
    const days = getCalendarMonthDays(new Date(2026, 9, 1));
    expect(days).toHaveLength(35);
    expect(days[0]).toEqual(new Date(2026, 8, 28));
    expect(days.at(-1)).toEqual(new Date(2026, 10, 1));
  });

  it("keeps six rows when a month does not fit in five", () => {
    const days = getCalendarMonthDays(new Date(2026, 2, 1));
    expect(days).toHaveLength(42);
    expect(days[0].getDay()).toBe(1);
    expect(days.at(-1)?.getDay()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("clamps the focused day to February without skipping to March", () => {
    expect(getDayInMonth(new Date(2026, 0, 31), new Date(2026, 1, 1))).toEqual(new Date(2026, 1, 28));
    expect(getDayInMonth(new Date(2028, 0, 31), new Date(2028, 1, 1))).toEqual(new Date(2028, 1, 29));
  });

  it("preserves the day across year boundaries", () => {
    expect(getDayInMonth(new Date(2026, 11, 15), new Date(2027, 0, 1))).toEqual(new Date(2027, 0, 15));
  });
});


// src\domain\calendar.ts
import { addDays, endOfMonth, endOfWeek, startOfMonth, startOfWeek } from "date-fns";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "./schedule";

export const parseCalendarDate = (value: string | null): Date | undefined => {
  if (!value || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return undefined;
  const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day, 12);
  return toLocalDateKey(date) === value ? date : undefined;
};

export const getCalendarMonthDays = (month: Date): Date[] => {
  const firstDay = startOfWeek(startOfMonth(month), { weekStartsOn: 1 });
  const lastDay = endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month), { weekStartsOn: 1 });
  const days = Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, index) => addDays(firstDay, index));
  return days.filter((day) => day <= lastDay);
};

export const getDayInMonth = (day: Date, month: Date): Date => new Date(
  month.getFullYear(),
  month.getMonth(),
  Math.min(day.getDate(), endOfMonth(month).getDate()),
);


// src\domain\csv.ts
export type CsvCell = string | number | null | undefined;

/** Spreadsheet formula protection applies to text; real numeric cells stay numeric. */
const escapeCsvCell = (value: CsvCell) => {
  const text = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  const safe = typeof value === "string" && /^[\s]*[=+\-@]/.test(text) ? `'${text}` : text;
  return `"${safe.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
};

export const createCsv = (rows: CsvCell[][]) => `\uFEFF${rows.map((row) => row.map(escapeCsvCell).join(";")).join("\r\n")}`;


// src\domain\dashboard.ts
import { isPerformanceLesson, type AcademicLesson } from "./academic";
import { isPerformanceGrade } from "./gradeDistribution";

export type DashboardMembership = {
  subjectId: string;
  groupIds: string[];
};

export type DashboardJournalStudent = {
  id: string;
  attendance: Record<string, string>;
  grades: Record<string, number | null>;
};

export type DashboardJournal = {
  subjectId: string;
  groupId: string;
  students: DashboardJournalStudent[];
  lessons?: AcademicLesson[];
};

export type DashboardJournalMetrics = {
  averageGrade: number | null;
  attendance: number | null;
  attendanceMarked: number;
  gradesCount: number;
  gradeCells: number;
  totalCells: number;
  unmarked: number;
};

export const calculateDashboardJournalMetrics = (
  journals: DashboardJournal[],
  studentId?: string,
): DashboardJournalMetrics => {
  const students = journals.flatMap((journal) => {
    const lessons = journal.lessons?.filter((lesson) => lesson.state === "completed");
    const attendanceIds = lessons?.map((lesson) => lesson.id);
    const gradeIds = lessons?.filter(isPerformanceLesson).map((lesson) => lesson.id);
    return (studentId ? journal.students.filter((student) => student.id === studentId) : journal.students)
      .map((student) => ({ student, attendanceIds, gradeIds }));
  });
  const attendance = students.flatMap(({ student, attendanceIds }) => attendanceIds
    ? attendanceIds.map((id) => student.attendance[id] ?? "unmarked") : Object.values(student.attendance));
  const attendanceMarked = attendance.filter((status) => status !== "unmarked");
  const grades = students
    .flatMap(({ student, gradeIds }) => gradeIds ? gradeIds.map((id) => student.grades[id]) : Object.values(student.grades))
    .filter(isPerformanceGrade);
  const present = attendanceMarked.filter((status) => status === "present").length;

  return {
    averageGrade: grades.length ? grades.reduce((sum, grade) => sum + grade, 0) / grades.length : null,
    attendance: attendanceMarked.length ? present / attendanceMarked.length * 100 : null,
    attendanceMarked: attendanceMarked.length,
    gradesCount: grades.length,
    gradeCells: students.reduce((total, { student, gradeIds }) => total + (gradeIds?.length ?? Object.keys(student.grades).length), 0),
    totalCells: attendance.length,
    unmarked: attendance.filter((status) => status === "unmarked").length,
  };
};

const startOfDay = (date: Date) => {
  const result = new Date(date);
  result.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return result;
};

export const formatDashboardDeadline = (deadline: string, now: Date) => {
  const value = new Date(deadline);
  const days = Math.round((startOfDay(value).getTime() - startOfDay(now).getTime()) / 86_400_000);
  const time = value.toLocaleTimeString("ru-RU", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });

  if (days < -1) return `Просрочено на ${Math.abs(days)} дн.`;
  if (days === -1) return "Просрочено со вчера";
  if (days === 0) return `Сегодня, ${time}`;
  if (days === 1) return `Завтра, ${time}`;
  return value.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" });
};

export const formatDashboardValue = (value: number | null, digits = 0) =>
  value === null ? "—" : value.toFixed(digits).replace(".", ",");


// src\domain\dashboardAssignments.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Assignment, Submission } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getStudentDashboardTasks } from "./dashboardAssignments";

const now = new Date("2026-10-10T12:00:00");
const memberships = [{ subjectId: "data-analysis", groupIds: ["112-mko"] }];
const task = (overrides: Partial<Assignment> = {}): Assignment => ({
  id: "task-1", subjectId: "data-analysis", groupId: "112-mko", subject: "Анализ данных", group: "112-МКо",
  title: "Работа", description: "Описание", lessonDate: "2026-10-09T09:00", lessonType: "Практика",
  deadline: "2026-10-11T18:00", status: "published", allowLateSubmissions: false,

});
const answer = (overrides: Partial<Submission> = {}): Submission => ({
  id: "answer-1", assignmentId: "task-1", studentId: "student-1", studentName: "Студент",
  sentAt: "2026-10-09T10:00", updatedAt: "2026-10-09T10:00", text: "Ответ", status: "submitted", ...overrides,

// src\domain\dashboardAssignments.ts
import type { Assignment, Submission } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getCurrentSubmissionAttempt, getStudentAssignmentState, isSubmissionAllowed } from "./assignments";
import { formatDashboardDeadline, type DashboardMembership } from "./dashboard";
import { getAssignmentHref } from "./journalNavigation";

const stateLabels = {
  pending: "Новое",
  submitted: "На проверке",
  resubmitted: "На проверке",
  revision: "На доработке",
  graded: "Проверено",
  "late-allowed": "Можно сдать позже",
  overdue: "Приём завершён",
} as const;

export const getStudentDashboardTasks = (
  assignments: Assignment[],
  submissions: Submission[],
  memberships: DashboardMembership[],
  studentId: string,
  now: Date,
) => {
  const answers = new Map(submissions.filter((answer) => answer.studentId === studentId).map((answer) => [answer.assignmentId, answer]));
  return assignments
    .filter((assignment) => (assignment.status === "published" || assignment.status === "closed")
      && memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === assignment.subjectId && membership.groupIds.includes(assignment.groupId)))
    .map((assignment) => {
      const answer = answers.get(assignment.id);
      const attempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(answer);
      const state = getStudentAssignmentState(assignment, answer, now);
      const canSubmit = isSubmissionAllowed(assignment, now) && (!answer || attempt?.status === "revision");
      const completed = state === "graded";
      const overdue = (state === "pending" || state === "revision" || state === "overdue" || state === "late-allowed") && new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime() < now.getTime();
      return {
        id: assignment.id,
        subject: assignment.subject,
        subjectId: assignment.subjectId,
        title: assignment.title,
        deadline: canSubmit ? formatDashboardDeadline(assignment.deadline, now) : new Date(assignment.deadline).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" }),
        deadlineAt: new Date(assignment.deadline).getTime(),
        tag: assignment.status === "closed" && (!answer || attempt?.status === "revision") ? "Приём завершён" : stateLabels[state],
        state,
        completed,
        overdue,
        canSubmit,
        href: getAssignmentHref(assignment),
        action: canSubmit ? attempt?.status === "revision" ? "Исправить ответ" : "Ответить" : answer ? "Посмотреть ответ" : "Открыть задание",
      };
    })
    .sort((first, second) => Number(second.canSubmit) - Number(first.canSubmit) || Number(first.completed) - Number(second.completed) || first.deadlineAt - second.deadlineAt);
};


// src\domain\fileDownload.ts
/** Keep the URL alive while the browser starts its download; never navigate the current page. */
export const downloadBlob = (blob: Blob, name: string) => {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = name;
  try { document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); }
  finally { link.remove(); window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000); }
};

// src\domain\files.ts
export const MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE = 25 * 1024 * 1024;

export const formatFileSize = (bytes: number) => {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} Б`;
  if (bytes < 1024 ** 2) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} КБ`;
  return `${(bytes / 1024 ** 2).toFixed(1)} МБ`;
};

export const getAttachmentError = (file: Pick<File, "size">) =>
  file.size > MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE ? "Размер файла не должен превышать 25 МБ." : "";

const RASTER_TYPES: Record<string, string> = { png: "image/png", jpg: "image/jpeg", jpeg: "image/jpeg", gif: "image/gif", webp: "image/webp", avif: "image/avif" };
export interface FilePreviewFormat { kind: "image" | "pdf" | "text"; mime: string }

/** Only inert formats are previewed. HTML, SVG and office documents remain download-only. */
export const getFilePreviewFormat = (file: { name: string; type: string }): FilePreviewFormat | null => {
  const dot = file.name.lastIndexOf(".");
  const extension = dot > 0 ? file.name.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase() : "";
  if (["html", "htm", "svg", "svgz", "xml", "xhtml"].includes(extension)) return null;
  const mime = file.type.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  if (Object.values(RASTER_TYPES).includes(mime)) return { kind: "image", mime };
  if (!mime && Object.hasOwn(RASTER_TYPES, extension)) return { kind: "image", mime: RASTER_TYPES[extension] };
  if (mime === "application/pdf" || (!mime && extension === "pdf")) return { kind: "pdf", mime: "application/pdf" };
  if (["text/plain", "text/csv", "text/markdown"].includes(mime) || (!mime && ["txt", "csv", "md"].includes(extension))) return { kind: "text", mime: "text/plain" };
  return null;
};


// src\domain\formatCount.ts
const russianPluralRules = new Intl.PluralRules("ru-RU");

/** Forms are supplied in the required case: «оценка/оценки/оценок» or «оценке/оценкам/оценкам». */
export const formatCount = (count: number, forms: readonly [one: string, few: string, many: string]) => {
  const category = russianPluralRules.select(count);
  const form = category === "one" ? forms[0] : category === "few" ? forms[1] : forms[2];
  return `${count} ${form}`;
};

  });
