// src\domain\gradeDistribution.ts
export const PERFORMANCE_GRADES = [5, 4, 3, 2] as const;
export type PerformanceGrade = typeof PERFORMANCE_GRADES[number];
export const isPerformanceGrade = (value: unknown): value is PerformanceGrade =>
  typeof value === "number" && PERFORMANCE_GRADES.some((grade) => grade === value);

/** Округляет доли так, чтобы сумма отображаемых процентов была ровно 100. */
export const normalizeGradeShares = (counts: number[]): number[] => {
  const values = counts.map((count) => Number.isFinite(count) ? Math.max(0, count) : 0);
  const total = values.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
  if (total === 0) return values.map(() => 0);

  const exact = values.map((count) => count / total * 100);
  const rounded = exact.map(Math.floor);
  const remainder = 100 - rounded.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  const order = exact.map((value, index) => ({ index, fraction: value - rounded[index] }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.fraction - a.fraction || a.index - b.index);

  for (let index = 0; index < remainder; index += 1) rounded[order[index].index] += 1;
  return rounded;
};


// src\domain\journal.ts
import type { Student } from "../components/Attendance/data/students";
import { isPerformanceGrade, PERFORMANCE_GRADES } from "./gradeDistribution";

export const getJournalMetrics = (students: Student[], dates: string[], gradeDates = dates) => {
  const grades = students.flatMap((student) => gradeDates.map((date) => student.grades[date])).filter(isPerformanceGrade);
  const attendance = students.flatMap((student) => dates.map((date) => student.attendance[date])).filter((status) => status && status !== "unmarked");
  const present = attendance.filter((status) => status === "present").length;
  const total = students.length * dates.length;
  return {
    average: grades.length ? grades.reduce((sum, grade) => sum + grade, 0) / grades.length : null,
    attendance: attendance.length ? present / attendance.length * 100 : null,
    marked: attendance.length,
    total,
    unmarked: Math.max(total - attendance.length, 0),
    completion: total ? attendance.length / total * 100 : 0,
    gradesCount: grades.length,
    distribution: PERFORMANCE_GRADES.map((grade) => ({ grade, count: grades.filter((value) => value === grade).length })),
  };
};


// src\domain\journalDraft.ts
import type { Student } from "../components/Attendance/data/students";

export class JournalDraftConflictError extends Error {}
const keysFor = (first: Record<string, unknown>, second: Record<string, unknown>) => new Set([...Object.keys(first), ...Object.keys(second)]);
const sameOrder = (first: string[], second: string[]) => first.length === second.length && first.every((id, index) => id === second[index]);

export const countJournalDraftChanges = (original: Student[], draft: Student[]) => {
  const before = new Map(original.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const afterIds = new Set(draft.map((student) => student.id));
  let count = original.filter((student) => !afterIds.has(student.id)).length;
  draft.forEach((student) => {
    const previous = before.get(student.id);
    if (!previous) { count += 1; return; }
    if (student.name !== previous.name) count += 1;
    keysFor(previous.attendance, student.attendance).forEach((key) => { if ((previous.attendance[key] ?? "unmarked") !== (student.attendance[key] ?? "unmarked")) count += 1; });
    keysFor(previous.grades, student.grades).forEach((key) => { if ((previous.grades[key] ?? null) !== (student.grades[key] ?? null)) count += 1; });
  });
  const beforeCommon = original.filter((student) => afterIds.has(student.id)).map((student) => student.id);
  const afterCommon = draft.filter((student) => before.has(student.id)).map((student) => student.id);
  return count + Number(!sameOrder(beforeCommon, afterCommon));
};

/** Only changed fields are applied. A stale draft never overwrites a conflicting saved cell. */
export const mergeJournalDraft = (original: Student[], draft: Student[], latest: Student[]): Student[] => {
  if (new Set(draft.map((student) => student.id)).size !== draft.length) throw new JournalDraftConflictError("В черновике повторяются ученики. Сохранение отменено.");
  if (draft.some((student) => !student.name.trim())) throw new JournalDraftConflictError("Укажите имя для каждого ученика перед сохранением.");
  const before = new Map(original.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const after = new Map(draft.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const current = new Map(latest.map((student) => [student.id, student]));
  const conflict = (name: string, field: string): never => { throw new JournalDraftConflictError(`Не удалось сохранить: ${field} для «${name}» уже изменены в другом месте. Ваш черновик оставлен открытым. Отмените эту правку или скопируйте её перед повторным открытием журнала.`); };

  original.forEach((student) => {
    if (after.has(student.id)) return;
    const saved = current.get(student.id);
    if (saved && countJournalDraftChanges([student], [saved]) > 0) conflict(student.name, "данные ученика");
    current.delete(student.id);
  });
  draft.forEach((student) => {
    const previous = before.get(student.id);
    const saved = current.get(student.id);
    if (!previous) {
      if (saved && countJournalDraftChanges([student], [saved]) > 0) conflict(student.name, "данные нового ученика");
      if (!saved) current.set(student.id, { ...student, attendance: { ...student.attendance }, grades: { ...student.grades } });
      return;
    }
    if (!saved) {
      if (countJournalDraftChanges([previous], [student]) > 0) conflict(student.name, "состав группы: ученик удалён, его данные");
      return;
    }
    const merged = { ...saved, attendance: { ...saved.attendance }, grades: { ...saved.grades } };
    if (student.name !== previous.name) {
      if (saved.name !== previous.name && saved.name !== student.name) conflict(previous.name, "имя и данные");
      merged.name = student.name.trim();
    }
    keysFor(previous.attendance, student.attendance).forEach((key) => {
      const oldValue = previous.attendance[key] ?? "unmarked", nextValue = student.attendance[key] ?? "unmarked", savedValue = saved.attendance[key] ?? "unmarked";
      if (oldValue === nextValue) return;
      if (savedValue !== oldValue && savedValue !== nextValue) conflict(student.name, "отметки посещаемости");
      merged.attendance[key] = nextValue;
    });
    keysFor(previous.grades, student.grades).forEach((key) => {
      const oldValue = previous.grades[key] ?? null, nextValue = student.grades[key] ?? null, savedValue = saved.grades[key] ?? null;
      if (oldValue === nextValue) return;
      if (savedValue !== oldValue && savedValue !== nextValue) conflict(student.name, "оценки");
      merged.grades[key] = nextValue;
    });
    current.set(student.id, merged);
  });
  const common = original.filter((student) => after.has(student.id) && current.has(student.id)).map((student) => student.id);
  const commonSet = new Set(common);
  const desiredOrder = draft.filter((student) => commonSet.has(student.id)).map((student) => student.id);
  const latestOrder = latest.filter((student) => commonSet.has(student.id)).map((student) => student.id);
  const reordered = !sameOrder(common, desiredOrder) || draft.some((student) => !before.has(student.id));
  if (reordered && !sameOrder(common, latestOrder) && !sameOrder(desiredOrder, latestOrder)) throw new JournalDraftConflictError("Порядок учеников уже изменён в другом месте. Черновик оставлен открытым; актуальный журнал не перезаписан.");
  const orderedIds = reordered ? draft.map((student) => student.id) : latest.map((student) => student.id);
  const result: Student[] = [];
  const included = new Set<string>();
  [...orderedIds, ...current.keys()].forEach((id) => { const student = current.get(id); if (student && !included.has(id)) { result.push(student); included.add(id); } });
  return result;
};


// src\domain\journalExport.ts
import type { Student } from "../components/Attendance/data/students";
import type { AcademicLesson } from "./academic";
import { lessonTypeLabels } from "./academic";
import { createCsv } from "./csv";
import { downloadBlob } from "./fileDownload";

const attendanceLabels: Record<string, string> = { unmarked: "Не отмечено", present: "Присутствовал", sick: "Уважительная причина", absent: "Пропуск" };

export const createJournalCsv = (students: Student[], lessons: AcademicLesson[]) => {
  const header = ["Студент", ...lessons.flatMap((lesson) => [`${lesson.date} · ${lessonTypeLabels[lesson.type]} · посещаемость`, `${lesson.date} · ${lessonTypeLabels[lesson.type]} · оценка`]), "Посещаемость, %", "Средний балл"];
  const rows = students.map((student) => {
    const marked = lessons.filter((lesson) => (student.attendance[lesson.id] ?? "unmarked") !== "unmarked");
    const present = marked.filter((lesson) => student.attendance[lesson.id] === "present").length;
    const grades = lessons.map((lesson) => student.grades[lesson.id]).filter((grade): grade is 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 => grade != null);
    return [
      student.name,
      ...lessons.flatMap((lesson) => [attendanceLabels[student.attendance[lesson.id] ?? "unmarked"], student.grades[lesson.id] ?? ""]),
      marked.length ? Math.round(present / marked.length * 100) : "",
      grades.length ? (grades.reduce((sum, grade) => sum + grade, 0) / grades.length).toFixed(2) : "",
    ];
  });
  return createCsv([header, ...rows]);
};

export const downloadJournalCsv = (csv: string, fileName: string) => {
  downloadBlob(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }), fileName);
};


// src\domain\journalHistory.ts
import type { AcademicLesson } from "./academic";
import type { JournalChange } from "../data/journalStore";
import { createCsv } from "./csv";

export const journalFieldLabels: Record<JournalChange["field"], string> = { attendance: "Посещаемость", grade: "Оценка", roster: "Состав группы", demo: "Демонстрационное наполнение" };
const attendanceLabels: Record<string, string> = { unmarked: "Не отмечено", present: "Присутствие", sick: "Уважительная причина", absent: "Пропуск" };
const rosterLabels: Record<string, string> = { added: "Добавлен", active: "В группе", removed: "Удалён" };
export type JournalChangeGroup = { id: string; changedAt: string; actorName: string; changes: JournalChange[] };
export const formatJournalChangeValue = (value: JournalChange["previousValue"], field: JournalChange["field"]) => {
  if (value === null) return field === "grade" ? "Без оценки" : field === "attendance" ? "Не отмечено" : "—";
  return (field === "attendance" ? attendanceLabels[String(value)] : field === "roster" ? rosterLabels[String(value)] : undefined) ?? String(value);
};

export const groupJournalChanges = (changes: JournalChange[]) => {
  const groups = new Map<string, JournalChangeGroup>();
  [...changes].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.changedAt) - Date.parse(a.changedAt)).forEach((change) => {
    const id = `${change.changedAt}:${change.actor.id}`;
    const group: JournalChangeGroup = groups.get(id) ?? { id, changedAt: change.changedAt, actorName: change.actor.name, changes: [] };
    group.changes.push(change); groups.set(id, group);
  });
  return Array.from(groups.values());
};

export const createHistoryCsv = (changes: JournalChange[], lessons: AcademicLesson[]) => {
  const byId = new Map(lessons.map((lesson) => [lesson.id, lesson]));
  return createCsv([["Время изменения", "Автор", "Студент", "Поле", "Дата занятия", "Тема", "Было", "Стало"], ...changes.map((change) => {
    const lesson = change.lessonId ? byId.get(change.lessonId) : undefined;
    return [new Date(change.changedAt).toLocaleString("ru-RU"), change.actor.name, change.studentName, journalFieldLabels[change.field], lesson?.date ?? "", lesson?.topic ?? "", formatJournalChangeValue(change.previousValue, change.field), formatJournalChangeValue(change.nextValue, change.field)];
  })]);
};

// src\domain\journalNavigation.ts
import { getJournalHrefById } from "../data/academicCatalog";
import type { Assignment } from "../data/assignmentStore";

export type JournalSection = "journal" | "assignments" | "materials" | "history";

export const getJournalSection = (params: URLSearchParams, allowHistory = false): JournalSection => {
  const tab = params.get("tab");
  if (tab === "journal" || tab === "assignments" || tab === "materials" || (tab === "history" && allowHistory)) return tab;
  return params.get("assignment") ? "assignments" : "journal";
};

export const changeJournalSection = (params: URLSearchParams, section: string) => {
  const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
  if (section === "journal") next.delete("tab");
  else next.set("tab", section);
  next.delete("assignment");
  next.delete("submission");
  return next;
};

export const getAssignmentHref = (assignment: Pick<Assignment, "id" | "subjectId" | "groupId">, submissionId?: string) => {
  const journal = getJournalHrefById(assignment.subjectId, assignment.groupId);
  if (journal === "/journal") return journal;
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ tab: "assignments", assignment: assignment.id });
  if (submissionId) params.set("submission", submissionId);
  return `${journal}?${params}`;
};


// src\domain\messaging.ts
import type { StoredMessage } from "../data/messageStore";
export type MessagingContact = { id: string; initials: string; name: string; subtitle: string; kind: "student" | "teacher" | "group" };

export const messagePreview = (message?: StoredMessage) => message?.text || (message?.attachments?.length ? `Файл: ${message.attachments[0].name}${message.attachments.length > 1 ? ` и ещё ${message.attachments.length - 1}` : ""}` : "");

export const messageDayKey = (message: StoredMessage) => message.sentAt ? new Date(message.sentAt).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU") : "legacy";

export const messageDayLabel = (message: StoredMessage, now = new Date()) => {
  if (!message.sentAt) return "Предыдущая переписка";
  const date = new Date(message.sentAt);
  const yesterday = new Date(now);
  yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
  if (date.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) return "Сегодня";
  if (date.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()) return "Вчера";
  return date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: date.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear() ? "numeric" : undefined });
};

export const dialogTime = (message?: StoredMessage, now = new Date()) => {
  if (!message) return "";
  if (!message.sentAt) return message.time;
  const date = new Date(message.sentAt);
  return date.toDateString() === now.toDateString() ? message.time : date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
};


// src\domain\planner.ts
import type { PlannerNote } from "../data/plannerStore";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "./schedule";

export const getPlannerNoteDate = (note: PlannerNote) => note.startAt ?? note.createdAt;
export const formatPlannerTime = (note: PlannerNote) => {
  const time = (date: Date) => date.toLocaleTimeString("ru-RU", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
  const dateTime = (date: Date) => `${date.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "short" })}, ${time(date)}`;
  if (!note.startAt) return note.endAt ? `До ${dateTime(note.endAt)}` : "Без времени";
  if (!note.endAt) return time(note.startAt);
  return `${time(note.startAt)} — ${toLocalDateKey(note.startAt) === toLocalDateKey(note.endAt) ? time(note.endAt) : dateTime(note.endAt)}`;
};
export const createPlannerNote = (date: Date): PlannerNote => {
  const day = new Date(date);
  day.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return { id: "", title: "", text: "", createdAt: day, completed: false, priority: "medium", category: "study" };
};
export const getPlannerHref = (date: Date, noteId?: string) => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ date: toLocalDateKey(date) });
  if (noteId) params.set("task", noteId);
  return `/planner?${params}`;
};
export const getPlannerDayNotes = (notes: PlannerNote[], date: Date) => notes
  .filter((note) => toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(note)) === toLocalDateKey(date))
  .sort((a, b) => Number(a.completed) - Number(b.completed) || (a.startAt?.getTime() ?? 0) - (b.startAt?.getTime() ?? 0));

export const getNextPlannerNotes = (notes: PlannerNote[], date: Date) => notes
  .filter((note) => !note.completed && toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(note)) >= toLocalDateKey(date))
  .sort((a, b) => getPlannerNoteDate(a).getTime() - getPlannerNoteDate(b).getTime());


// src\domain\plannerDraft.ts
import type { PlannerNote } from "../data/plannerStore";

export class PlannerDraftConflictError extends Error {}

const sameDate = (first?: Date, second?: Date) => first?.getTime() === second?.getTime();
const sameSchedule = (first: PlannerNote, second: PlannerNote) => sameDate(first.createdAt, second.createdAt)
  && sameDate(first.startAt, second.startAt) && sameDate(first.endAt, second.endAt);
const TEXT_FIELDS = ["title", "text", "priority", "category", "completed"] as const;
const FIELD_LABELS = { title: "название", text: "описание", priority: "приоритет", category: "категория", completed: "состояние выполнения" };

export const samePlannerNote = (first: PlannerNote, second: PlannerNote) => first.id === second.id
  && sameSchedule(first, second) && TEXT_FIELDS.every((field) => first[field] === second[field]);

/** A day and its optional start/end form one schedule; they must not be merged independently. */
export const mergePlannerDraft = (original: PlannerNote, draft: PlannerNote, latest: PlannerNote): PlannerNote => {
  if (!original.id || original.id !== draft.id || original.id !== latest.id) throw new PlannerDraftConflictError("Не удалось определить исходную задачу. Черновик оставлен в форме, данные не перезаписаны.");
  const merged = { ...latest };
  const conflict = (field: string): never => {
    throw new PlannerDraftConflictError(`Не удалось сохранить: поле «${field}» уже изменено в другом месте. Ваш текст оставлен в форме. Скопируйте нужные изменения и заново откройте задачу; сохранённая версия не перезаписана.`);
  };
  for (const field of TEXT_FIELDS) {
    if (draft[field] === original[field]) continue;
    if (latest[field] !== original[field] && latest[field] !== draft[field]) conflict(FIELD_LABELS[field]);
    // Each branch keeps the field's literal union type without widening the record.
    if (field === "title") merged.title = draft.title;
    else if (field === "text") merged.text = draft.text;
    else if (field === "priority") merged.priority = draft.priority;
    else if (field === "category") merged.category = draft.category;
    else merged.completed = draft.completed;
  }
  if (!sameSchedule(original, draft)) {
    if (!sameSchedule(original, latest) && !sameSchedule(draft, latest)) conflict("дата или время");
    merged.createdAt = draft.createdAt;
    merged.startAt = draft.startAt;
    merged.endAt = draft.endAt;
  }
  return merged;
};


// src\domain\schedule.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getLessonStatus, getWeekStart, hasTimeOverlap, toLocalDateKey } from "./schedule";
import { DEMO_TEACHER, getDemoWeekSchedule, getPersonalSchedule } from "../data/schedule";

describe("schedule rules", () => {
  it("normalizes Sunday to Monday midnight across a month boundary", () => {
    expect(getWeekStart(new Date(2026, 10, 1, 18, 35))).toEqual(new Date(2026, 9, 26));
  });

  it("uses the lesson date and exact start/end boundaries", () => {
    const lesson = { date: "2026-09-21", startTime: "10:00", endTime: "11:30" };
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 21, 9, 49, 59)).state).toBe("next");
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 21, 9, 50)).state).toBe("soon");
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 21, 9, 59, 59)).state).toBe("soon");
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 21, 10)).state).toBe("now");
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 21, 11, 30)).state).toBe("past");
    expect(getLessonStatus(lesson, new Date(2026, 8, 22, 9)).state).toBe("past");
  });

  it("shares stable lessons across daily and weekly views with personal role scopes", () => {
    const monday = getDemoWeekSchedule(new Date(2026, 8, 21, 0));
    const sunday = getDemoWeekSchedule(new Date(2026, 8, 27, 23));
    expect(monday).toEqual(sunday);
    expect(new Set(monday.map((lesson) => lesson.id)).size).toBe(monday.length);
    expect(monday.some((lesson) => lesson.dayOfWeek === 0 || lesson.dayOfWeek === 6)).toBe(false);
    const student = getPersonalSchedule(monday, "student");
    const teacher = getPersonalSchedule(monday, "teacher");
    expect(student.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(teacher.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(student.every((lesson) => lesson.group === "112-МКо")).toBe(true);
    expect(teacher.every((lesson) => lesson.teacher === DEMO_TEACHER)).toBe(true);
    expect(student).not.toEqual(teacher);
  });

  it("detects intersecting slots but allows adjacent lessons", () => {
    const slots = [{ start: 9 * 60, end: 10 * 60 + 30 }];
    expect(hasTimeOverlap(10 * 60, 11 * 60, slots)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasTimeOverlap(10 * 60 + 30, 12 * 60, slots)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("formats a date using local calendar parts", () => {
    expect(toLocalDateKey(new Date(2026, 8, 7, 23, 30))).toBe("2026-09-07");
  });
});


// src\domain\schedule.ts
export interface TimeSlot {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

export const hasTimeOverlap = (start: number, end: number, slots: TimeSlot[]) =>
  slots.some((slot) => Math.max(slot.start, start) < Math.min(slot.end, end));

export const toLocalDateKey = (date: Date) =>
  `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;


export const getWeekStart = (date: Date) => {
  const monday = new Date(date);
  monday.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  monday.setDate(monday.getDate() - (monday.getDay() + 6) % 7);
  return monday;
};

export const getLessonStatus = (lesson: { date: string; startTime: string; endTime: string }, now: Date) => {
  const start = new Date(`${lesson.date}T${lesson.startTime}:00`).getTime();
  const end = new Date(`${lesson.date}T${lesson.endTime}:00`).getTime();
  if (now.getTime() >= end) return { state: "past", label: "Завершено" };
  if (now.getTime() >= start) return { state: "now", label: "Сейчас" };
  const minutes = Math.ceil((start - now.getTime()) / 60000);
  if (minutes <= 10) return { state: "soon", label: "Скоро" };
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  return { state: "next", label: hours ? `Через ${hours} ч ${minutes % 60} мин` : `Через ${minutes} мин` };
};


// src\domain\scheduleAccess.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { CurrentUser } from "../components/RoleContext";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule } from "../data/schedule";
import { canOpenScheduleLesson } from "./scheduleAccess";

const item = getDemoWeekSchedule(new Date(2026, 9, 5))[0];
const memberships = [{ subjectId: "theory-of-probability", groupIds: ["112-mko"] }];
const teacher: CurrentUser = { id: "teacher-elena-volkova", name: "Елена Волкова", scheduleName: "Волкова Е.В.", role: "teacher", memberships };
const student: CurrentUser = { id: "anna-smirnova", name: "Анна Смирнова", role: "student", memberships };

describe("schedule lesson access", () => {
  it("allows students to open their group's lessons with any teacher", () => {
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson(item, student)).toBe(true);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacher: "Петров П.П.", teacherId: "teacher-pavel-petrov" }, student)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("denies other groups and subjects even when visible in schedule search", () => {
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, group: "113-МКо" }, student)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, subject: "Анализ данных" }, student)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, group: undefined }, student)).toBe(false);
  });
  it("allows teachers only their own lessons in an assigned journal", () => {
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson(item, teacher)).toBe(true);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacher: "Петров П.П.", teacherId: "teacher-pavel-petrov" }, teacher)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, group: "113-МКо" }, teacher)).toBe(false);
  });
  it("gives teacher IDs priority over a matching displayed name", () => {
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacherId: "different-teacher" }, teacher)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacher: "Изменённое имя" }, teacher)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("supports legacy exact names without granting access to unknown teachers", () => {
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacherId: undefined }, teacher)).toBe(true);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacherId: undefined, teacher: "Петров П.П." }, teacher)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacherId: undefined, teacher: undefined }, teacher)).toBe(false);
    expect(canOpenScheduleLesson({ ...item, teacherId: undefined }, { ...teacher, scheduleName: undefined })).toBe(false);
  });
});


// src\domain\scheduleAccess.ts
import type { CurrentUser } from "../components/RoleContext";
import type { ScheduleItem } from "../types/sched";
import { isAcademicMembershipMatch } from "../data/academicCatalog";

/** Поиск расписания не расширяет доступ к журналам и заданиям. */
export const canOpenScheduleLesson = (item: ScheduleItem, user: CurrentUser) => {
  if (!item.group || !isAcademicMembershipMatch(user.memberships, item.subject, item.group)) return false;
  if (user.role === "student") return true;
  // ID имеет приоритет: совпадение имени не должно открывать пару другого преподавателя.
  if (item.teacherId) return item.teacherId === user.id;
  return Boolean(user.scheduleName && item.teacher?.trim() === user.scheduleName.trim());
};


// src\domain\scheduleLayout.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { filterSchedule, getScheduleDayRows, getScheduleRange, getScheduleSuggestions, getWeekDays, layoutScheduleDay } from "./scheduleLayout";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule } from "../data/schedule";
import { DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS } from "../data/scheduleSlots";
import type { ScheduleItem } from "../types/sched";

const schedule = getDemoWeekSchedule(new Date(2026, 9, 5));
const item = (id: number, startTime: string, endTime: string): ScheduleItem => ({ ...schedule[0], id, startTime, endTime });
describe("schedule layout and search", () => {
  it("creates all seven local dates across a month boundary", () => {
    expect(getWeekDays(new Date(2026, 10, 1)).map((day) => day.key)).toEqual(["2026-10-26", "2026-10-27", "2026-10-28", "2026-10-29", "2026-10-30", "2026-10-31", "2026-11-01"]);
  });
  it("derives suggestions and counts from actual lessons", () => {
    expect(getScheduleSuggestions(schedule, "group")).toEqual([{ title: "112-МКо", count: 15 }, { title: "113-МКо", count: 5 }]);
    expect(getScheduleSuggestions(schedule, "teacher", "волкова")).toEqual([{ title: "Волкова Е.В.", count: 15 }]);
    expect(getScheduleSuggestions(schedule, "auditory", "202")).toEqual([{ title: "Ауд. 202", count: 5 }]);
  });
  it("filters rooms and groups and combines query words in any order", () => {
    expect(filterSchedule(schedule, "group", "мко 112")).toHaveLength(15);
    expect(filterSchedule(schedule, "auditory", "303")).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(filterSchedule(schedule, "teacher", "Е.В. ВОЛКОВА")).toHaveLength(15);
    expect(filterSchedule(schedule, "teacher", "неизвестный")).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("keeps a useful time range while including early and late lessons", () => {
    expect(getScheduleRange(schedule)).toEqual({ start: 480, end: 960 });
    expect(getScheduleRange([item(1, "07:15", "08:00"), item(2, "20:30", "22:15")])).toEqual({ start: 420, end: 1380 });
  });
  it("preserves exact offsets and durations without viewport-dependent sizing", () => {
    const [entry] = layoutScheduleDay([item(1, "08:30", "10:00")], 480, 2);
    expect(entry).toMatchObject({ top: 60, height: 180, lane: 0, lanes: 1 });
  });
  it("separates overlapping lessons, reuses free lanes and leaves later clusters full-width", () => {
    const source = [item(4, "12:00", "13:00"), item(3, "09:00", "10:00"), item(1, "08:00", "10:00"), item(2, "08:00", "09:00")];
    const result = layoutScheduleDay(source, 480, 2);
    expect(result.map(({ item, lane, lanes }) => [item.id, lane, lanes])).toEqual([[1, 0, 2], [2, 1, 2], [3, 1, 2], [4, 0, 1]]);
    expect(source.map((lesson) => lesson.id)).toEqual([4, 3, 1, 2]);
  });
  it("does not treat adjacent lessons as overlapping", () => {
    expect(layoutScheduleDay([item(1, "08:00", "09:00"), item(2, "09:00", "10:00")], 480, 2).every((entry) => entry.lanes === 1)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("ignores invalid durations in the grid", () => {
    expect(layoutScheduleDay([item(1, "10:00", "09:00"), item(2, "invalid", "11:00")], 480, 2)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("keeps all seven numbered periods when a day has no lessons", () => {
    const rows = getScheduleDayRows([], DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.slot?.number)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]);
    expect(rows.every((row) => !row.lessons.length && !row.overlapping.length)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("does not renumber later lessons across empty periods", () => {
    const early = item(1, "10:10", "11:40");
    const late = item(2, "19:20", "20:50");
    const rows = getScheduleDayRows([late, early], DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS);
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(7);
    expect(rows[0].lessons).toEqual([]);
    expect(rows[1].lessons).toEqual([early]);
    expect(rows[6].lessons).toEqual([late]);
  });
  it("keeps changed times in their own chronological row without pretending the intersected slot is free", () => {
    const changed = item(1, "09:00", "10:30");
    const rows = getScheduleDayRows([changed], DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS);
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(8);
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ slot: { number: 1 }, lessons: [], overlapping: [changed] });
    expect(rows[1]).toMatchObject({ slot: null, lessons: [changed] });
    expect(rows[2]).toMatchObject({ slot: { number: 2 }, overlapping: [changed] });
    expect(rows.flatMap((row) => row.lessons)).toEqual([changed]);
  });
  it("marks slots crossed by a long lesson but not slots starting exactly when it ends", () => {
    const long = item(1, "08:30", "12:10");
    const rows = getScheduleDayRows([long], DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS);
    expect(rows[0].lessons).toEqual([long]);
    expect(rows[1].overlapping).toEqual([long]);
    expect(rows[2].overlapping).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("keeps simultaneous lessons in one numbered period without dropping any", () => {
    const sameTime = [item(1, "08:30", "10:00"), item(2, "08:30", "10:00")];
    expect(getScheduleDayRows(sameTime, DEMO_SCHEDULE_SLOTS)[0].lessons).toEqual(sameTime);
  });
});


// src\domain\scheduleLayout.ts
import type { ScheduleItem, ScheduleSlot } from "../types/sched";
import { getWeekStart, toLocalDateKey } from "./schedule";
import { matchesSearchText } from "./search";

export type ScheduleSearchType = "group" | "auditory" | "teacher";
export const scheduleLessonTypeLabels: Record<ScheduleItem["type"], string> = { "Лек.": "Лекция", "Пр.": "Практика", "Лаб.": "Лабораторная", "Зач.": "Зачёт", "Экз.": "Экзамен" };
export const timeToMinutes = (time: string) => {
  const [hours, minutes] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return hours * 60 + minutes;
};
export const getWeekDays = (week: Date) => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => {
  const date = getWeekStart(week);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + index);
  return { date, key: toLocalDateKey(date) };
});
export const filterSchedule = (schedule: ScheduleItem[], type: ScheduleSearchType, query: string) => schedule.filter((lesson) => matchesSearchText(type === "group" ? lesson.group ?? "" : type === "auditory" ? lesson.location : lesson.teacher ?? "", query));
export const getScheduleSuggestions = (schedule: ScheduleItem[], type: ScheduleSearchType, query = "") => {
  const values = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const lesson of schedule) {
    const value = type === "group" ? lesson.group : type === "auditory" ? lesson.location : lesson.teacher;
    if (value && matchesSearchText(value, query)) values.set(value, (values.get(value) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return [...values].map(([title, count]) => ({ title, count })).sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru-RU", { numeric: true }));
};
export const getScheduleRange = (schedule: ScheduleItem[]) => ({
  start: schedule.length ? Math.min(8 * 60, ...schedule.map((lesson) => Math.floor(timeToMinutes(lesson.startTime) / 60) * 60)) : 8 * 60,
  end: schedule.length ? Math.max(16 * 60, ...schedule.map((lesson) => Math.ceil(timeToMinutes(lesson.endTime) / 60) * 60)) : 16 * 60,
});

export interface ScheduleListRow {
  key: string;
  slot: ScheduleSlot | null;
  lessons: ScheduleItem[];
  overlapping: ScheduleItem[];
}

/** Пустые слоты не сдвигают номера пар; нестандартное время остаётся отдельной строкой. */
export const getScheduleDayRows = (lessons: ScheduleItem[], slots: ScheduleSlot[]): ScheduleListRow[] => {
  const rows: ScheduleListRow[] = slots.map((slot) => ({
    key: `slot-${slot.number}`,
    slot,
    lessons: lessons.filter((item) => item.startTime === slot.startTime),
    overlapping: lessons.filter((item) => item.startTime !== slot.startTime && timeToMinutes(item.startTime) < timeToMinutes(slot.endTime) && timeToMinutes(item.endTime) > timeToMinutes(slot.startTime)),
  }));
  const starts = new Set(slots.map((slot) => slot.startTime));
  const extraStarts = new Set(lessons.filter((item) => !starts.has(item.startTime)).map((item) => item.startTime));
  for (const start of extraStarts) rows.push({ key: `extra-${start}`, slot: null, lessons: lessons.filter((item) => item.startTime === start), overlapping: [] });
  return rows.sort((a, b) => timeToMinutes(a.slot?.startTime ?? a.lessons[0].startTime) - timeToMinutes(b.slot?.startTime ?? b.lessons[0].startTime));
};

/** Overlapping lessons occupy separate lanes within the same time range. */
export const layoutScheduleDay = (lessons: ScheduleItem[], start: number, pixelsPerMinute: number) => {
  const sorted = [...lessons].sort((a, b) => timeToMinutes(a.startTime) - timeToMinutes(b.startTime) || a.id - b.id);
  const result: { item: ScheduleItem; top: number; height: number; lane: number; lanes: number }[] = [];
  let cluster: typeof result = [];
  let ends: number[] = [];
  let clusterEnd = -Infinity;
  const flush = () => { result.push(...cluster.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, lanes: ends.length }))); cluster = []; ends = []; };
  for (const item of sorted) {
    const from = timeToMinutes(item.startTime);
    const to = timeToMinutes(item.endTime);
    if (!Number.isFinite(from) || !Number.isFinite(to) || to <= from) continue;
    if (from >= clusterEnd) flush();
    let lane = ends.findIndex((end) => end <= from);
    if (lane < 0) lane = ends.length;
    ends[lane] = to;
    clusterEnd = Math.max(clusterEnd, to);
    cluster.push({ item, top: (from - start) * pixelsPerMinute, height: (to - from) * pixelsPerMinute, lane, lanes: 1 });
  }
  flush();
  return result;
};


// src\domain\search.ts
const normalize = (value: string) => value.normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase("ru-RU").replaceAll("ё", "е");

/** All words must match; name order, case and ё/е do not affect the result. */
export const matchesSearchText = (text: string, query: string) => {
  const value = normalize(text);
  return normalize(query).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).every((word) => value.includes(word));
};


// src\domain\submissionReview.test.ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Submission, SubmissionStatus } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getNextReviewSubmission, getReviewSubmissions } from "./submissionReview";
import { matchesSearchText } from "./search";

const answer = (id: string, studentName: string, status: SubmissionStatus = "submitted", sentAt = "2026-09-12T12:00"): Submission => ({ id, studentName, status, sentAt, assignmentId: "task", studentId: id, updatedAt: sentAt, text: "Ответ" });
const ids = (items: Submission[]) => items.map((item) => item.id);

describe("submission review queue", () => {
  const answers = [answer("graded", "Анна Смирнова", "graded"), answer("new", "Иван Иванов", "submitted", "2026-09-13T12:00"), answer("old", "Елена Козлова"), answer("revision", "Мария Петрова", "revision")];

  it("puts awaiting answers first, oldest first, without mutating the source", () => {
    expect(ids(getReviewSubmissions(answers))).toEqual(["old", "new", "revision", "graded"]);
    expect(ids(answers)).toEqual(["graded", "new", "old", "revision"]);
  });

  it("matches all query words regardless of order, case, ё or whitespace", () => {
    expect(matchesSearchText("Алёна Смирнова", "  СМИРНОВА алена ")).toBe(true);
    expect(matchesSearchText("Алёна Смирнова", "алена иванова")).toBe(false);
    expect(matchesSearchText("Ответ", "  ")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("combines status and name filters", () => {
    expect(ids(getReviewSubmissions(answers, "submitted", "Иванов"))).toEqual(["new"]);
    expect(getReviewSubmissions(answers, "submitted", "Смирнова")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("uses the latest attempt's date and status rather than stale workflow fields", () => {
    const resubmitted = { ...answers[0], attempts: [
      { id: "first", number: 1, sentAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-12T12:00", text: "Первый", status: "revision" as const, submittedLate: false },
      { id: "second", number: 2, sentAt: "2026-09-14T12:00", updatedAt: "2026-09-14T12:00", text: "Второй", status: "submitted" as const, submittedLate: false },
    ] };
    expect(ids(getReviewSubmissions([resubmitted, answers[1]], "submitted", "", "newest"))).toEqual(["graded", "new"]);
    expect(ids(getReviewSubmissions([resubmitted, answers[1]], "submitted", "", "oldest"))).toEqual(["new", "graded"]);
  });

  it("sorts by Russian names", () => {
    expect(ids(getReviewSubmissions(answers, "all", "", "name"))).toEqual(["graded", "old", "new", "revision"]);
  });

  it("starts at the first pending answer and wraps without reviewed answers", () => {
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers)?.id).toBe("old");
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, "old")?.id).toBe("new");
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, "new")?.id).toBe("old");
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, "graded")?.id).toBe("old");
  });

  it("respects the search and selected sort when advancing", () => {
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, null, "Иванов")?.id).toBe("new");
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, "new", "Иванов")).toBeNull();
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission(answers, null, "", "newest")?.id).toBe("new");
  });

  it("returns null when nothing remains or the last pending answer is current", () => {
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission([], "unknown")).toBeNull();
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission([answers[0], answers[3]])).toBeNull();
    expect(getNextReviewSubmission([answers[1]], "new")).toBeNull();
  });
});


// src\domain\submissionReview.ts
import type { Submission } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getCurrentSubmissionAttempt, getSubmissionStatus } from "./assignments";
import { matchesSearchText } from "./search";

export type ReviewFilter = "all" | "submitted" | "revision" | "graded";
export type ReviewSort = "queue" | "newest" | "oldest" | "name";
export type ReviewDraft = { comment: string; grade: string };

const priority = { submitted: 0, revision: 1, graded: 2 };
const sentAt = (answer: Submission) => {
  const value = new Date(getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(answer)?.sentAt ?? answer.sentAt).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
};

export const getReviewSubmissions = (answers: Submission[], filter: ReviewFilter = "all", query = "", sort: ReviewSort = "queue") => answers
  .filter((answer) => (filter === "all" || getSubmissionStatus(answer) === filter) && matchesSearchText(answer.studentName, query))
  .sort((first, second) => {
    const nameOrder = first.studentName.localeCompare(second.studentName, "ru-RU");
    if (sort === "name") return nameOrder || first.id.localeCompare(second.id);
    const timeOrder = sentAt(first) - sentAt(second);
    if (sort === "queue") {
      const statusOrder = priority[getSubmissionStatus(first) ?? "submitted"] - priority[getSubmissionStatus(second) ?? "submitted"];
      if (statusOrder) return statusOrder;
    }
    return (sort === "newest" ? -timeOrder : timeOrder) || nameOrder || first.id.localeCompare(second.id);
  });

export const getNextReviewSubmission = (answers: Submission[], currentId?: string | null, query = "", sort: ReviewSort = "queue") => {
  const queue = getReviewSubmissions(answers, "submitted", query, sort);
  const index = queue.findIndex((answer) => answer.id === currentId);
  if (index < 0) return queue[0] ?? null;
  if (queue.length === 1) return null;
  return queue[(index + 1) % queue.length];
};


// src\domain\teacherAnalytics.ts
import { isPerformanceLesson, type AcademicLesson } from "./academic";
import type { Student } from "../components/Attendance/data/students";
import type { Assignment, Submission } from "../data/assignmentStore";
import { getCurrentSubmissionAttempt, getSubmissionAttempts } from "./assignments";
import { getJournalMetrics } from "./journal";
import { isPerformanceGrade, normalizeGradeShares, PERFORMANCE_GRADES } from "./gradeDistribution";
import { createCsv } from "./csv";
import { getWeekStart } from "./schedule";

export type AnalyticsPeriod = "semester" | "month" | "four-weeks" | "week";
export type AnalyticsJournal = { subjectId: string; subjectName: string; subjectShortName: string; groupId: string; groupName: string; students: Student[]; lessons: AcademicLesson[] };
export type AnalyticsRange = { start: Date; end: Date };
type StudentSignal = { id: string; name: string; groupId: string; groupName: string; subjectId: string; marked: number; present: number; grades: number[]; overdue: number };

export const getAnalyticsRange = (period: AnalyticsPeriod, now: Date, selectedWeek = now): AnalyticsRange => {
  if (period === "week") {
    const start = getWeekStart(selectedWeek);
    const end = new Date(start);
    end.setDate(end.getDate() + 7);
    end.setMilliseconds(-1);
    if (start.getMonth() === 7 && end.getMonth() === 8) start.setMonth(8, 1);
    return { start, end };
  }
  const start = new Date(now);
  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  if (period === "month") start.setDate(1);
  else if (period === "four-weeks") start.setDate(start.getDate() - 27);
  else {
    const month = now.getMonth();
    start.setFullYear(month === 0 ? now.getFullYear() - 1 : now.getFullYear(), month >= 8 || month === 0 ? 8 : 1, 1);
  }
  return { start, end: new Date(now) };
};

const inRange = (date: string, range: AnalyticsRange) => {
  const timestamp = new Date(date).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(timestamp) && timestamp >= range.start.getTime() && timestamp <= range.end.getTime();
};
const journalId = (subjectId: string, groupId: string) => `${subjectId}:${groupId}`;
const initials = (name: string) => name.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).map((word) => word[0]).join("");
const weekKey = (date: string) => {
  const value = new Date(`${date}T12:00:00`);
  value.setDate(value.getDate() - (value.getDay() + 6) % 7);
  return `${value.getFullYear()}-${String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

export const calculateTeacherAnalytics = (journals: AnalyticsJournal[], assignments: Assignment[], submissions: Submission[], range: AnalyticsRange, gradeFilter?: number) => {
  const scoped = journals.map((journal) => {
    const lessons = journal.lessons.filter((lesson) => lesson.state === "completed" && inRange(`${lesson.date}T${lesson.startsAt}`, range));
    const students = gradeFilter === undefined ? journal.students : journal.students
      .filter((student) => lessons.some((lesson) => isPerformanceLesson(lesson) && student.grades[lesson.id] === gradeFilter))
      .map((student) => ({ ...student, grades: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(student.grades).filter(([, grade]) => grade === gradeFilter)) }));
    return { ...journal, lessons, students };
  }).filter((journal) => gradeFilter === undefined || journal.students.length > 0);
  const journalById = new Map(scoped.map((journal) => [journalId(journal.subjectId, journal.groupId), journal]));
  const uniqueStudents = new Set(scoped.flatMap((journal) => journal.students.map((student) => `${journal.groupId}:${student.id}`)));
  const totals = { marked: 0, present: 0, unmarked: 0, cells: 0, grades: [] as number[] };
  const weeks = new Map<string, { present: number; marked: number }>();
  const students = new Map<string, StudentSignal>();
  const groupMetrics = scoped.map((journal) => {
    const ids = journal.lessons.map((lesson) => lesson.id);
    const metrics = getJournalMetrics(journal.students, ids, journal.lessons.filter(isPerformanceLesson).map((lesson) => lesson.id));
    totals.marked += metrics.marked; totals.unmarked += metrics.unmarked; totals.cells += metrics.total;
    journal.students.forEach((student) => {
      const key = `${journal.groupId}:${student.id}`;
      const item: StudentSignal = students.get(key) ?? { id: student.id, name: student.name, groupId: journal.groupId, groupName: journal.groupName, subjectId: journal.subjectId, marked: 0, present: 0, grades: [], overdue: 0 };
      journal.lessons.forEach((lesson) => {
        const status = student.attendance[lesson.id] ?? "unmarked";
        const grade = student.grades[lesson.id];
        if (isPerformanceLesson(lesson) && isPerformanceGrade(grade)) { totals.grades.push(grade); item.grades.push(grade); }
        if (status !== "unmarked") {
          const present = Number(status === "present");
          item.marked += 1; item.present += present; totals.present += present;
          const key = weekKey(lesson.date);
          const point = weeks.get(key) ?? { present: 0, marked: 0 };
          point.marked += 1; point.present += present; weeks.set(key, point);
        }
      });
      students.set(key, item);
    });
    return { ...metrics, id: journalId(journal.subjectId, journal.groupId), subjectId: journal.subjectId, subjectName: journal.subjectName, subjectShortName: journal.subjectShortName, groupId: journal.groupId, groupName: journal.groupName, students: journal.students.length };
  });
  const visibleAssignments = assignments.filter((assignment) => (assignment.status === "published" || assignment.status === "closed") && journalById.has(journalId(assignment.subjectId, assignment.groupId)) && inRange(assignment.lessonDate, range));
  const answers = new Map<string, Submission>();
  submissions.forEach((submission) => {
    const key = `${submission.assignmentId}:${submission.studentId}`;
    const previous = answers.get(key);
    if (!previous || Date.parse(submission.updatedAt) > Date.parse(previous.updatedAt)) answers.set(key, submission);
  });
  const work = { assignments: visibleAssignments.length, expected: 0, received: 0, onTime: 0, waiting: 0, revision: 0, graded: 0, overdue: 0 };
  visibleAssignments.forEach((assignment) => {
    const journal = journalById.get(journalId(assignment.subjectId, assignment.groupId));
    if (!journal) return;
    journal.students.forEach((student) => {
      work.expected += 1;
      const answer = answers.get(`${assignment.id}:${student.id}`);
      const attempt = getCurrentSubmissionAttempt(answer);
      if (attempt && new Date(attempt.sentAt).getTime() <= range.end.getTime()) {
        work.received += 1;
        const firstAttempt = getSubmissionAttempts(answer)[0];
        if (firstAttempt && Date.parse(firstAttempt.sentAt) <= Date.parse(assignment.deadline)) work.onTime += 1;
        if (attempt.status === "submitted") work.waiting += 1;
        if (attempt.status === "revision") work.revision += 1;
        if (attempt.status === "graded") work.graded += 1;
      } else if (Date.parse(assignment.deadline) < range.end.getTime()) work.overdue += 1;
      if ((!attempt || attempt.status === "revision") && Date.parse(assignment.deadline) < range.end.getTime()) {
        const person = students.get(`${journal.groupId}:${student.id}`);
        if (person) person.overdue += 1;
      }
    });
  });
  const risks = Array.from(students.values()).flatMap((student) => {
    const attendance = student.marked ? student.present / student.marked * 100 : null;
    const average = student.grades.length ? student.grades.reduce((sum, grade) => sum + grade, 0) / student.grades.length : null;
    const reasons: string[] = [];
    if (student.marked >= 3 && attendance !== null && attendance < 65) reasons.push(`Посещаемость ${Math.round(attendance)}%`);
    if (student.grades.length >= 2 && average !== null && average < 3) reasons.push(`Средний балл ${average.toFixed(2).replace(".", ",")}`);
    if (student.overdue >= 2) reasons.push(`Работ к сдаче после срока: ${student.overdue}`);
    if (!reasons.length) return [];
    const high = (student.marked >= 3 && attendance !== null && attendance < 50) || (student.grades.length >= 2 && average !== null && average < 2.5) || student.overdue >= 3;
    return [{ ...student, key: `${student.groupId}:${student.id}`, initials: initials(student.name), reasons, level: high ? "Высокий" : "Средний" }];
  }).sort((a, b) => Number(b.level === "Высокий") - Number(a.level === "Высокий") || b.overdue - a.overdue || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru"));
  const distribution = PERFORMANCE_GRADES.map((grade) => totals.grades.filter((value) => value === grade).length);
  return {
    students: uniqueStudents.size, groups: new Set(scoped.map((journal) => journal.groupId)).size, journals: scoped.length,
    attendance: totals.marked ? totals.present / totals.marked * 100 : null,
    averageGrade: totals.grades.length ? totals.grades.reduce((sum, grade) => sum + grade, 0) / totals.grades.length : null,
    marked: totals.marked, unmarked: totals.unmarked, cells: totals.cells, gradesCount: totals.grades.length,
    distribution, shares: normalizeGradeShares(distribution), groupMetrics, risks, work,
    trend: Array.from(weeks, ([date, point]) => ({ date, value: point.present / point.marked * 100, marked: point.marked })).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)),
  };
};

export type TeacherAnalytics = ReturnType<typeof calculateTeacherAnalytics>;

export const createAnalyticsCsv = (analytics: TeacherAnalytics, range: AnalyticsRange, context: string) => {
  const value = (number: number | null) => number === null ? "" : number.toFixed(2).replace(".", ",");
  const rows: Array<Array<string | number>> = [
    ["Статистика преподавателя", context], ["Период", range.start.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU"), range.end.toLocaleDateString("ru-RU")],
    ["Студентов (без повторов внутри группы)", analytics.students], ["Групп", analytics.groups],
    ["Посещаемость, %", value(analytics.attendance)], ["Средний балл (практики и лабораторные)", value(analytics.averageGrade)],
    ["Отметок посещаемости", analytics.marked], ["Не заполнено", analytics.unmarked], ["Оценок", analytics.gradesCount],
    [], ["Группа", "Дисциплина", "Студентов", "Посещаемость, %", "Средний балл (практики и лабораторные)", "Заполнено", "Всего ячеек"],
    ...analytics.groupMetrics.map((group) => [group.groupName, group.subjectName, group.students, value(group.attendance), value(group.average), group.marked, group.total]),
    [], ["Оценка (практики и лабораторные)", "Количество", "Доля, %"], ...PERFORMANCE_GRADES.map((grade, index) => [grade, analytics.distribution[index], analytics.shares[index]]),
    [], ["Заданий (по дате занятия)", analytics.work.assignments], ["Ожидается ответов", analytics.work.expected], ["Получено ответов", analytics.work.received], ["На проверке", analytics.work.waiting], ["На доработке", analytics.work.revision], ["Проверено", analytics.work.graded], ["Без ответа после срока", analytics.work.overdue],
    [], ["Требуют внимания", "Группа", "Уровень", "Причины"], ...analytics.risks.map((student) => [student.name, student.groupName, student.level, student.reasons.join(" · ")]),
  ];
  return createCsv(rows);
};


// src\hooks\useBodyScrollLock.ts
import { useLayoutEffect } from "react";

interface BodyScrollLock {
  count: number;
  overflow: string;
  priority: string;
}

const bodyLocks = new Map<HTMLElement, BodyScrollLock>();

// Each overlay releases only its own lock, regardless of closing order.
export const acquireBodyScrollLock = () => {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.body) return () => {};
  const body = document.body;
  const existing = bodyLocks.get(body);
  const lock = existing ?? { count: 0, overflow: body.style.getPropertyValue("overflow"), priority: body.style.getPropertyPriority("overflow") };
  if (!existing) {
    bodyLocks.set(body, lock);
    body.style.setProperty("overflow", "hidden", lock.priority);
  }
  lock.count += 1;
  let released = false;

  return () => {
    if (released) return;
    released = true;
    lock.count -= 1;
    if (lock.count > 0) return;
    if (lock.overflow) body.style.setProperty("overflow", lock.overflow, lock.priority);
    else body.style.removeProperty("overflow");
    bodyLocks.delete(body);
  };
};

const useBodyScrollLock = (active = true) => {
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (active) return acquireBodyScrollLock();
  }, [active]);
};

export default useBodyScrollLock;


// src\hooks\useDragScroll.ts
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type DragEventHandler, type MouseEventHandler, type PointerEventHandler, type RefObject } from "react";

interface DragScrollOptions {
  axis?: "x" | "both";
  enabled?: boolean;
  resetKey?: string;
}

// Keep normal clicks and native touch scrolling; only take over a deliberate mouse drag.
const useDragScroll = (ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, { axis = "x", enabled = true, resetKey }: DragScrollOptions = {}) => {
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const stopRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});
  const suppressClickUntil = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    stopRef.current();
    suppressClickUntil.current = 0;
  }, [axis, enabled, resetKey]);

  const onPointerDown: PointerEventHandler<HTMLElement> = (event) => {
    stopRef.current();
    suppressClickUntil.current = 0;
    const board = ref.current;
    if (!enabled || !board || event.pointerType !== "mouse" || event.button !== 0 || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey || event.shiftKey) return;
    const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
    if (target?.closest("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable='false']), [data-no-drag]")) return;
    const bounds = board.getBoundingClientRect();
    const localX = event.clientX - bounds.left - board.clientLeft;
    const localY = event.clientY - bounds.top - board.clientTop;
    if (localX < 0 || localY < 0 || localX >= board.clientWidth || localY >= board.clientHeight) return;
    const canX = board.scrollWidth > board.clientWidth + 1;
    const canY = axis === "both" && board.scrollHeight > board.clientHeight + 1;
    if (!canX && !canY) return;

    const pointerId = event.pointerId;
    const startX = event.clientX, startY = event.clientY;
    const startLeft = board.scrollLeft, startTop = board.scrollTop;
    let active = false;
    let stopped = false;
    let restoreStyles: (() => void) | undefined;
    const stop = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      stopped = true;
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", finish);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", finish);
      window.removeEventListener("blur", stop);
      if (board.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) board.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
      restoreStyles?.();
      if (active) {
        suppressClickUntil.current = Date.now() + 400;
        setDragging(false);
      }
      stopRef.current = () => {};
    };
    const move = (next: PointerEvent) => {
      if (next.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
      if (!(next.buttons & 1)) { stop(); return; }
      const dx = next.clientX - startX, dy = next.clientY - startY;
      if (!active) {
        if (Math.hypot(canX ? dx : 0, canY ? dy : 0) < 6) return;
        active = true;
        setDragging(true);
        const body = board.ownerDocument.body;
        const previousCursor = body.style.cursor, previousSelection = body.style.userSelect;
        body.style.cursor = "grabbing";
        body.style.userSelect = "none";
        restoreStyles = () => { body.style.cursor = previousCursor; body.style.userSelect = previousSelection; };
        const selection = board.ownerDocument.getSelection();
        if (selection?.anchorNode && board.contains(selection.anchorNode)) selection.removeAllRanges();
        try { board.setPointerCapture(pointerId); } catch { /* Window listeners still complete the drag. */ }
      }
      next.preventDefault();
      if (canX) board.scrollLeft = startLeft - dx;
      if (canY) board.scrollTop = startTop - dy;
    };
    const finish = (next: PointerEvent) => { if (next.pointerId === pointerId) stop(); };
    stopRef.current = stop;
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", move, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", finish);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", finish);
    window.addEventListener("blur", stop);
  };

  const onClickCapture: MouseEventHandler<HTMLElement> = (event) => {
    if (event.detail === 0 || Date.now() > suppressClickUntil.current) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    suppressClickUntil.current = 0;
  };
  const onDragStartCapture: DragEventHandler<HTMLElement> = (event) => {
    if (enabled && event.target instanceof Element && !event.target.closest("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable='false']), [data-no-drag]")) event.preventDefault();
  };

  return { dragging, onPointerDown, onClickCapture, onDragStartCapture };
};

export default useDragScroll;


// src\hooks\useMessageAttachment.ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { messageAttachmentRepository } from "../data/messageAttachmentRepository";
import type { MessageAttachment } from "../data/messageStore";
import { downloadBlob } from "../domain/fileDownload";
import { getFilePreviewFormat } from "../domain/files";

export default function useMessageAttachment(scope: string) {
  const [opening, setOpening] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<{ name: string; blob: Blob } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const request = useRef(0);
  const busy = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    request.current++; busy.current = false;
    setOpening(null); setPreview(null); setError("");
    return () => { request.current++; busy.current = false; };
  }, [scope]);
  const open = useCallback(async (file: MessageAttachment, download = false) => {
    if (busy.current) return;
    busy.current = true;
    const id = ++request.current;
    setOpening(file.id); setError("");
    try {
      const stored = await messageAttachmentRepository.read(scope, file.id);
      if (id !== request.current) return;
      if (download || !getFilePreviewFormat(stored)) downloadBlob(stored.blob, stored.name);
      else setPreview({ name: stored.name, blob: stored.blob });
    } catch {
      if (id === request.current) setError("Файл недоступен. Он хранится только в браузере, в котором был прикреплён.");
    } finally {
      if (id === request.current) { busy.current = false; setOpening(null); }
    }
  }, [scope]);
  return { opening, preview, error, open, closePreview: () => setPreview(null), clearError: () => setError("") };
}


// src\hooks\useMessageDrafts.ts
import { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { UserRole } from "../components/RoleContext";
import { getMessageDraftKey, readMessageDraft, removeMessageDraft, saveMessageDraft } from "../data/messageDraftStore";

interface DraftEntry { text: string; error: string; saved: boolean; operation: "read" | "save" | "remove"; sent?: boolean }
type DraftEntries = Record<string, DraftEntry>;

const useMessageDrafts = (role: UserRole, userId: string, dialogIds: string[], temporaryDialogId?: string) => {
  const owner = JSON.stringify([role, userId]);
  const idsKey = JSON.stringify([...new Set(dialogIds)]);
  const readEntry = useCallback((id: string): DraftEntry => {
    if (id === temporaryDialogId) return { text: "", error: "", saved: false, operation: "read" };
    const snapshot = readMessageDraft(getMessageDraftKey(role, userId, id));
    return { text: snapshot.text ?? "", error: snapshot.error, saved: !snapshot.error, operation: "read" };
  }, [role, userId, temporaryDialogId]);
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => ({ owner, entries: Object.fromEntries(dialogIds.map((id) => [id, readEntry(id)])) as DraftEntries }));
  const latest = useRef(state);
  const entries = state.owner === owner ? state.entries : {};
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const previous = latest.current.owner === owner ? latest.current.entries : {};
    const next = { ...previous };
    const ids: string[] = JSON.parse(idsKey);
    ids.forEach((id) => { if (!Object.hasOwn(next, id)) next[id] = readEntry(id); });
    if (latest.current.owner !== owner || ids.some((id) => !Object.hasOwn(previous, id))) {
      const updated = { owner, entries: next };
      latest.current = updated; setState(updated);
    }
  }, [owner, idsKey, readEntry]);

  const update = (id: string, entry: DraftEntry) => {
    const previous = latest.current.owner === owner ? latest.current.entries : {};
    const next = { owner, entries: { ...previous, [id]: entry } };
    latest.current = next; setState(next);
  };
  const changeDraft = (id: string, text: string) => {
    // Until the first message, a new group's identity and members exist only in memory.
    if (id === temporaryDialogId) { update(id, { text, error: "", saved: false, operation: "save" }); return; }
    const result = text ? saveMessageDraft(getMessageDraftKey(role, userId, id), text) : removeMessageDraft(getMessageDraftKey(role, userId, id));
    update(id, { text, error: result.error, saved: !result.error, operation: text ? "save" : "remove" });
  };
  const completeDraft = (id: string) => {
    if (id === temporaryDialogId) { update(id, { text: "", error: "", saved: true, operation: "remove", sent: true }); return; }
    const result = removeMessageDraft(getMessageDraftKey(role, userId, id));
    update(id, { text: "", error: result.error ? `Сообщение сохранено. ${result.error}` : "", saved: !result.error, operation: "remove", sent: true });
  };
  const retryDraft = (id: string) => {
    const entry = latest.current.owner === owner ? latest.current.entries[id] : undefined;
    if (!entry) return;
    if (entry.operation === "read") update(id, readEntry(id));
    else if (entry.operation === "save") changeDraft(id, entry.text);
    else if (entry.sent) completeDraft(id);
    else changeDraft(id, "");
  };
  const forgetDraft = (id: string) => {
    const previous = latest.current.owner === owner ? latest.current.entries : {};
    const nextEntries = { ...previous };
    delete nextEntries[id];
    const next = { owner, entries: nextEntries };
    latest.current = next; setState(next);
  };
  return {
    drafts: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entries).map(([id, entry]) => [id, entry.text])),
    errors: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entries).map(([id, entry]) => [id, entry.error])),
    saved: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entries).map(([id, entry]) => [id, entry.saved])),
    hasUnsavedText: Object.values(entries).some((entry) => Boolean(entry.text.trim()) && !entry.saved),
    changeDraft, completeDraft, retryDraft, forgetDraft,
  };
};

export default useMessageDrafts;


// src\hooks\useUnsavedChangesWarning.ts
import { useEffect } from "react";

/** Browser reload/tab-close warning only; internal navigation needs its own guard. */
const useUnsavedChangesWarning = (enabled: boolean) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const warn = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = ""; };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, [enabled]);
};

export default useUnsavedChangesWarning;


// src\hooks\useViewPreference.ts
import { useState } from "react";

// Preferences are optional: unavailable browser storage must never block a view change.
const useViewPreference = <T extends string>(key: string, options: readonly T[], fallback: T) => {
  const read = (): T => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return options.find((option) => option === saved) ?? fallback;
    } catch { return fallback; }
  };
  const [preference, setPreference] = useState(() => ({ key, value: read() }));
  const value = preference.key === key ? preference.value : read();
  const changeView = (next: T) => {
    if (!options.includes(next)) return;
    setPreference({ key, value: next });
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, next); } catch { /* Keep the selected view for this visit. */ }
  };
  return [value, changeView] as const;
};

export default useViewPreference;

// src\pages\home\index.tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import Calendar from "../../components/CalendarWidget";
import ArrowCircle from "../../components/ArrowCircle";
import { useRole } from "../../components/RoleContext";
import Search from "../../components/SearchWidget";
import TodaySchedule from "../../components/TodaySchedule";
import { getTeacherDashboard, useDashboardUpdate } from "../../data/studentDashboard";
import { usePlannerNotes, type PlannerNote } from "../../data/plannerStore";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule, getPersonalSchedule } from "../../data/schedule";
import { createPlannerNote, getPlannerDayNotes, getPlannerNoteDate, getPlannerHref } from "../../domain/planner";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import PlannerAgenda from "../../components/PlannerAgenda";
import PlannerNoteForm from "../../components/PlannerNoteForm";
import { parseCalendarDate } from "../../domain/calendar";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

export default function Home() {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchMode, setSearchMode] = useState<"group" | "auditorium">("group");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const now = useDashboardUpdate();
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const dateParam = params.get("date");
  const selectedDate = useMemo(() => parseCalendarDate(dateParam), [dateParam]);
  const activeDate = selectedDate ?? now;
  const { notes, setNotes, error: plannerError } = usePlannerNotes();
  const [taskDraft, setTaskDraft] = useState<PlannerNote | null>(null);
  const [savedTask, setSavedTask] = useState<PlannerNote | null>(null);
  const saveTask = (note: PlannerNote) => {
    const task = { ...note, id: crypto.randomUUID() };
    if (!setNotes((current) => [...current, task])) return;
    setTaskDraft(null);
    setSavedTask(task);
  };
  const getDaySummary = (date: Date) => ({
    lessons: getPersonalSchedule(getDemoWeekSchedule(date), "teacher").filter((lesson) => lesson.date === toLocalDateKey(date)).length,
    tasks: plannerError ? null : getPlannerDayNotes(notes, date).length,
  });

  const dashboard = useMemo(
    () => getTeacherDashboard({ memberships: currentUser.memberships, now }),
    [currentUser.memberships, now],
  );

  return (
    <div className="pageContainer">
      <div className={styles.dashboardGrid}>
        <div className={styles.leftColumn}>
          <Search
            searchMode={searchMode}
            setSearchMode={setSearchMode}
            query={query}
            setQuery={setQuery}
            onSearch={() => {
              const params = new URLSearchParams({ date: toLocalDateKey(activeDate) });
              if (query.trim()) {
                params.set("type", searchMode === "auditorium" ? "auditory" : "group");
                params.set("query", query.trim());
              }
              navigate(`/schedule${params.size ? `?${params}` : ""}`);
            }}
          />

          <div className={`${styles.dashboardCard} ${styles.scheduleCard}`}>
            <TodaySchedule date={activeDate} />
          </div>

          <div className={styles.dashboardCard}>
            <PlannerAgenda date={activeDate} notes={notes} error={plannerError} onCreateTask={() => setTaskDraft(createPlannerNote(activeDate))} />
            {savedTask && <div className={styles.taskNotice} role="status"><span>Добавлено на {getPlannerNoteDate(savedTask).toLocaleDateString("ru-RU", { day: "numeric", month: "long" })}: <strong>{savedTask.title}</strong></span><Link to={getPlannerHref(getPlannerNoteDate(savedTask), savedTask.id)}>Открыть<ArrowCircle /></Link><button type="button" aria-label="Скрыть сообщение" onClick={() => setSavedTask(null)}>×</button></div>}
          </div>

          <div className={`${styles.dashboardCard} ${styles.flexParams}`}>
            <div className={styles.paramBox}>
              <div className={styles.summaryValue}>{dashboard.todayLessons ? `${dashboard.conductedLessons} / ${dashboard.todayLessons}` : "Нет пар"}</div>
              <div className={styles.summaryLabel}>Проведено пар сегодня</div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.paramBox}>
              <div className={styles.summaryValue}>{dashboard.attendanceMarked} / {dashboard.journalCells}</div>
              <div className={styles.summaryLabel}>Заполнено отметок</div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.paramBox}>
              <div className={styles.summaryValue}>{dashboard.gradesCount} / {dashboard.gradeCells}</div>
              <div className={styles.summaryLabel}>Оценки · практики и лабораторные</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.rightColumn}>
          <div className={`${styles.dashboardCard} ${styles.focusCard}`}>
            <div className={styles.focusHeader}>
              <div><span>Фокус на сегодня</span><h2 className={styles.cardTitle}>Что требует внимания</h2></div>
              <strong>{dashboard.focus.length}</strong>
            </div>
            {dashboard.focus.length ? (
              <div className={styles.focusList}>
                {dashboard.focus.map((item) => (
                  <Link to={item.href} key={item.title}>
                    <i className={item.level === "urgent" ? styles.urgent : item.level === "warning" ? styles.warning : undefined} />
                    <div><strong>{item.title}</strong><span>{item.description}</span></div>
                    <b>{item.action}<ArrowCircle hoverBackground="transparent" hoverColor="inherit" /></b>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className={styles.emptyState}>
                <strong>Всё под контролем</strong>
                <span>Непроверенных работ и незаполненных журналов сейчас нет.</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className={`${styles.dashboardCard} ${styles.calendarCard}`}>
            <h2 className={styles.cardTitle}>Календарь</h2>
            <Calendar selectedDate={activeDate} onSelectDate={(date) => setParams((current) => { const next = new URLSearchParams(current); if (toLocalDateKey(date) === toLocalDateKey(now)) next.delete("date"); else next.set("date", toLocalDateKey(date)); return next; }, { replace: true })} getDaySummary={getDaySummary} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {taskDraft && <PlannerNoteForm note={taskDraft} error={plannerError} onSave={saveTask} onClose={() => setTaskDraft(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}


// src\pages\journal\chartsCalculation.ts
import type { Student } from '../../components/Attendance/data/students';
import { isPerformanceLesson, type AcademicLesson } from '../../domain/academic';
import { isPerformanceGrade, PERFORMANCE_GRADES } from '../../domain/gradeDistribution';

export interface RadarDataPoint {
  seriesName: string;
  values: number[];
  colorToken?: string;
}

// --- Вспомогательные вычисления ---
export const calculateAttendanceCounts = (students: Student[], lessonIds?: string[]) =>
  students.map((student) => {
    const values = lessonIds ? lessonIds.map((id) => student.attendance[id]) : Object.values(student.attendance);
    return values.filter((value) => value === 'present').length;
  });

export const calculateGradeCounts = (students: Student[], lessonIds?: string[]) =>
  students.map(student => {
    const values = lessonIds ? lessonIds.map((id) => student.grades[id]) : Object.values(student.grades);
    const gradesArray = values.filter(isPerformanceGrade);
    if (gradesArray.length === 0) return null;
    return +(gradesArray.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / gradesArray.length).toFixed(2);
  });

export const getTopBottom = (students: Student[], values: Array<number | null>, top = true, count = 5) => {
  return [...students]
    .map((s, i) => ({ s, value: values[i] }))
    .filter((item): item is { s: Student; value: number } => item.value != null && Number.isFinite(item.value))
    .sort((a, b) => top ? b.value - a.value : a.value - b.value)
    .slice(0, count);
};

export const calculateBlobValues = (students: Student[], lessons: AcademicLesson[]) =>
  lessons.filter(isPerformanceLesson).map(lesson => {
    const counts: Record<number, number> = { 5: 0, 4: 0, 3: 0, 2: 0 };
    students.forEach(student => {
      const g = student.grades[lesson.id];
      if (isPerformanceGrade(g)) counts[g] += 1;
    });
    return counts;
  });

export const prepareRadarData = (students: Student[], lessons: AcademicLesson[]) => {
  const gradedLessons = lessons.filter((lesson) => isPerformanceLesson(lesson) && students.some((student) => isPerformanceGrade(student.grades[lesson.id])));
  const blobValues = calculateBlobValues(students, gradedLessons);

  const gradeColors = { 5: '--ui-chart-green', 4: '--ui-chart-purple', 3: '--ui-chart-amber', 2: '--ui-chart-red' };
  const radarDataGrades: RadarDataPoint[] = PERFORMANCE_GRADES.map((grade) => ({
    seriesName: `Оценка ${grade}`, values: blobValues.map((counts) => counts[grade]), colorToken: gradeColors[grade],
  }));

  const maxRadarValue = Math.max(...radarDataGrades.flatMap(d => d.values), 1);

  const attendanceRadarData: RadarDataPoint[] = [
    { seriesName: 'Присутствие', values: lessons.map(lesson => students.filter(s => s.attendance[lesson.id] === 'present').length) },
    { seriesName: 'Болезнь', values: lessons.map(lesson => students.filter(s => s.attendance[lesson.id] === 'sick').length) },
    { seriesName: 'Пропуски', values: lessons.map(lesson => students.filter(s => s.attendance[lesson.id] === 'absent').length) },
    { seriesName: 'Не отмечено', values: lessons.map(lesson => students.filter(s => (s.attendance[lesson.id] ?? 'unmarked') === 'unmarked').length) },
  ];

  const maxAttendanceValue = Math.max(...attendanceRadarData.flatMap(d => d.values), 1);

  const lessonLabel = (lesson: AcademicLesson) => {
    const date = new Date(`${lesson.date}T00:00:00`);
    return `${date.getDate()}.${date.getMonth() + 1}`;
  };
  const radarLabels = lessons.map(lessonLabel);
  const gradeRadarLabels = gradedLessons.map(lessonLabel);

  const daysCount = lessons.length;

  return { radarDataGrades, maxRadarValue, attendanceRadarData, maxAttendanceValue, radarLabels, gradeRadarLabels, daysCount };
};
