// src\pages\journal\index.tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { AttendanceTable } from "../../components/Attendance";
import BarChartTop from "../../components/Charts/BarChartTop/withsegments";
import RadarChart from "../../components/Charts/CircleChart/Radar";
import JournalMaterials from "../../components/JournalMaterials";
import {
  calculateAttendanceCounts,
  calculateGradeCounts,
  getTopBottom,
  prepareRadarData,
} from "./chartsCalculation";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import { getSubject } from "./data";
import AssignmentCenter from "../../components/AssignmentCenter";
import Tabs from "../../components/Tabs";
import { JOURNAL_PERIOD, useJournal } from "../../data/journalStore";
import { useRole } from "../../components/RoleContext";
import { createSubjectLessons } from "../../data/lessons";
import JournalHistory from "../../components/JournalHistory";
import JournalSummary from "../../components/JournalSummary";
import AttendanceLegend from "../../components/AttendanceLegend";
import LessonTypeFilter from "../../components/LessonTypeFilter";
import type { LessonTypeFilterValue } from "../../components/LessonTypeFilter";
import { createJournalCsv, downloadJournalCsv } from "../../domain/journalExport";
import { changeJournalSection, getJournalSection } from "../../domain/journalNavigation";
import { isPerformanceLesson } from "../../domain/academic";
import { useDashboardUpdate } from "../../data/studentDashboard";
import { formatCount } from "../../domain/formatCount";

const formatIdentifier = (value = "") =>
  decodeURIComponent(value).replaceAll("-", " ");

const Journal = () => {
  const { subjectId, groupId } = useParams();
  const now = useDashboardUpdate();
  const { canAccessJournal, currentUser } = useRole();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const activeSection = getJournalSection(searchParams, true);
  const setActiveSection = (section: string) => setSearchParams((current) => changeJournalSection(current, section));
  const [lessonType, setLessonType] = useState<LessonTypeFilterValue>("all");
  const subjectName = getSubject(subjectId)?.name ?? formatIdentifier(subjectId);
  const groupName = getSubject(subjectId)?.groups.find((group) => group.id === groupId)?.name ?? formatIdentifier(groupId).toUpperCase();
  const journal = useJournal(subjectId ?? "", groupId ?? "", currentUser);
  const { students, setStudents } = journal;
  const lessons = useMemo(() => createSubjectLessons(subjectId ?? "", groupId ?? ""), [subjectId, groupId, now]);
  const visibleLessons = useMemo(() => lessonType === "all" ? lessons : lessons.filter((lesson) => lesson.type === lessonType), [lessonType, lessons]);
  const exportJournal = () => downloadJournalCsv(createJournalCsv(students, visibleLessons), `journal-${subjectId}-${groupId}.csv`);

  const chartsData = useMemo(() => {
    const completedLessons = visibleLessons.filter((lesson) => lesson.state === "completed");
    const lessonIds = completedLessons.map((lesson) => lesson.id);
    const attendanceCounts = calculateAttendanceCounts(students, lessonIds);
    const gradeCounts = calculateGradeCounts(students, completedLessons.filter(isPerformanceLesson).map((lesson) => lesson.id));
    return {
      topAttendance: getTopBottom(students, attendanceCounts, true),
      bottomAttendance: getTopBottom(students, attendanceCounts, false),
      topGrades: getTopBottom(students, gradeCounts, true),
      bottomGrades: getTopBottom(students, gradeCounts, false),
      ...prepareRadarData(students, completedLessons),
    };
  }, [students, visibleLessons]);

  if (!subjectId || !groupId || !canAccessJournal(subjectId, groupId)) return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <h1>Журнал недоступен</h1>
      <p>Эта группа или дисциплина не назначена текущему преподавателю.</p>
      <Link to="/journal">Вернуться к журналам</Link>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <nav className={styles.breadcrumbs} aria-label="Навигационная цепочка">
            <Link to="/journal">Журнал</Link>
            <span>/</span><Link to={`/journal/${subjectId}`}>{subjectName}</Link><span>/</span><span aria-current="page">{groupName}</span>
          </nav>
          <h1>{subjectName}</h1>
          <p>Группа {groupName}</p>
        </div>
        {activeSection === "journal" && <button type="button" className={styles.exportButton} disabled={!students.length || !visibleLessons.length || Boolean(journal.error)} onClick={exportJournal}>Экспортировать CSV</button>}
      </header>

      <Tabs ariaLabel="Разделы журнала" value={activeSection} onChange={setActiveSection} items={[{ value: "journal", label: "Журнал и аналитика" }, { value: "assignments", label: "Задания" }, { value: "materials", label: "Материалы" }, { value: "history", label: "История", count: journal.history.length }]} />
      {journal.historyError && activeSection !== "history" && <p className={styles.pageError} role="alert">{journal.historyError}</p>}

      {activeSection === "journal" && <section className={styles.tableSection}>
        <div className={styles.sectionHeading}>
          <div><span>Электронный журнал</span><h2>Студенты группы</h2></div>
          <strong>{formatCount(students.length, ["студент", "студента", "студентов"])} · {JOURNAL_PERIOD}</strong>
        </div>
        {journal.error ? <p className={styles.pageError} role="alert">{journal.error}</p> : journal.lastSavedAt && <p className={styles.saveStatus} role="status">Сохранено {new Date(journal.lastSavedAt).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", month: "short" })}</p>}
        <div className={styles.tableFilters}><LessonTypeFilter lessons={lessons} value={lessonType} onChange={setLessonType} /><AttendanceLegend /></div>
        <AttendanceTable students={students} setStudents={setStudents} lessons={visibleLessons} />
        <div className={styles.inlineAnalytics}>
          <div className={styles.sectionHeading}><div><span>Срез данных</span><h2>Аналитика группы</h2></div><strong>Проведённые занятия по текущему фильтру</strong></div>
          <JournalSummary students={students} lessons={visibleLessons} period={JOURNAL_PERIOD} />
          <div className={styles.chartsGrid}>
            <div className={styles.chartCard}>
              <h3>Лидеры по посещаемости</h3>
              <BarChartTop labels={chartsData.topAttendance.map((item) => item.s.name)} values={chartsData.topAttendance.map((item) => item.value)} maxValue={chartsData.daysCount} segments={5} height={100} colorMode={8} />
              <RadarChart labels={chartsData.radarLabels} data={chartsData.attendanceRadarData} maxValue={chartsData.maxAttendanceValue} size={300} colorMode={7} />
              <h3>Требуют внимания</h3>
              <BarChartTop labels={chartsData.bottomAttendance.map((item) => item.s.name)} values={chartsData.bottomAttendance.map((item) => item.value)} maxValue={chartsData.daysCount} segments={5} height={100} colorMode={2} />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.chartCard}>
              <p className={styles.chartHint}>Только практики и лабораторные · без оценок занятия не отображаются</p>
              {chartsData.topGrades.length ? <><h3>Лидеры по успеваемости</h3>
              <BarChartTop labels={chartsData.topGrades.map((item) => item.s.name)} values={chartsData.topGrades.map((item) => item.value)} maxValue={5} segments={5} height={100} colorMode={7} />
              <h3>Оценки по занятиям</h3>
              <RadarChart labels={chartsData.gradeRadarLabels} data={chartsData.radarDataGrades} maxValue={chartsData.maxRadarValue} size={300} colorMode={6} />
              <h3>Низкая успеваемость</h3>
              <BarChartTop labels={chartsData.bottomGrades.map((item) => item.s.name)} values={chartsData.bottomGrades.map((item) => item.value)} maxValue={5} segments={5} height={100} colorMode={15} /></> : <p className={styles.chartEmpty}>За выбранные занятия нет оценок для графика.</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>}

      {activeSection === "materials" && <div className={styles.groupMaterials}>
        <JournalMaterials subject={{ id: subjectId, name: subjectName }} group={{ id: groupId, name: groupName }} />
      </div>}

      {activeSection === "assignments" && <section className={styles.tableSection}>
        <div className={styles.sectionHeading}><div><span>По датам занятий</span><h2>Задания и ответы</h2></div></div>
        <AssignmentCenter key={`${subjectId}:${groupId}`} subject={subjectName} group={groupName} />
      </section>}

      {activeSection === "history" && <JournalHistory changes={journal.history} lessons={lessons} error={journal.historyError} />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Journal;

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { startOfWeek } from "date-fns";
import Planner from "../../components/Planner";
import WeekPicker from "../../components/WeekPicker";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";
import { parseCalendarDate } from "../../domain/calendar";
import { toLocalDateKey } from "../../domain/schedule";
import { getPlannerNoteDate } from "../../domain/planner";

const PlannerPage = () => {
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const dateParam = params.get("date");
  const selectedDate = useMemo(() => parseCalendarDate(dateParam) ?? new Date(), [dateParam]);
  const selectedWeekStart = useMemo(() => startOfWeek(selectedDate, { weekStartsOn: 1 }), [selectedDate]);

  return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <WeekPicker value={selectedDate} onWeekChange={(date) => setParams({ date: toLocalDateKey(date) })} />
      <Planner selectedWeekStart={selectedWeekStart} selectedDate={selectedDate} selectedTaskId={params.get("task")} onClearTask={() => { if (params.has("task")) setParams((current) => { const next = new URLSearchParams(current); next.delete("task"); return next; }, { replace: true }); }} onSaved={(note) => setParams({ date: toLocalDateKey(getPlannerNoteDate(note)) }, { replace: true })} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default PlannerPage;

  "Ауд. 101",
  "Ауд. 202",
  "Ауд. 303",
  "Ауд. 404",
  "Онлайн (Zoom)",
];

const TEACHERS = [
  "Волкова Е.В.",
  "Петров П.П.",
  "Сидоров С.С.",
  "Доц. Смирнова",
  "Имк. Коалов",
];
const GROUPS = ["112-МКо", "113-МКо", "211-ИВТ", "311-ПМИ"];

const START_HOUR = 8;
const END_HOUR = 18;
const SLOT_MINUTES = 90;

// --- Случайное целое число ---
const randomInt = (min: number, max: number) => Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;

// --- Генерация случайного дня без наложений ---
const generateDaySchedule = (date: Date): ScheduleItem[] => {
  const lessons: ScheduleItem[] = [];
  const usedSlots: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  const lessonsCount = randomInt(2, 5);

  for (let i = 0; i < lessonsCount; i++) {
    let startMinutes = 0, endMinutes = 0;
    let tries = 0;
    let slotFound = false;

    do {
      const hour = randomInt(START_HOUR, END_HOUR - 1);
      const minute = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 0 : 30;
      startMinutes = hour * 60 + minute;
      endMinutes = startMinutes + SLOT_MINUTES;
      tries++;
      if (!hasTimeOverlap(startMinutes, endMinutes, usedSlots)) slotFound = true;
      if (tries > 50) break;
    } while (hasTimeOverlap(startMinutes, endMinutes, usedSlots));

    if (!slotFound) continue;

    usedSlots.push({ start: startMinutes, end: endMinutes });

    const startHour = Math.floor(startMinutes / 60);
    const startMin = startMinutes % 60;
    const endHour = Math.floor(endMinutes / 60);
    const endMin = endMinutes % 60;

    lessons.push({
      id: Date.now() + i + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
      date: toLocalDateKey(date),
      dayOfWeek: date.getDay(),
      subject: LESSONS[randomInt(0, LESSONS.length - 1)],
      type: TYPES[randomInt(0, TYPES.length - 1)],
      startTime: `${startHour.toString().padStart(2, "0")}:${startMin.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`,
      endTime: `${endHour.toString().padStart(2, "0")}:${endMin.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`,
      location: LOCATIONS[randomInt(0, LOCATIONS.length - 1)],
      teacher: TEACHERS[randomInt(0, TEACHERS.length - 1)],
      group: GROUPS[randomInt(0, GROUPS.length - 1)],
    });
  }

  return lessons;
};

// --- Генерация расписания на месяц (только Пн-Пт) ---
export const generateMockMonthSchedule = (startDate: Date): WeeklyScheduleData => {
  const schedule: WeeklyScheduleData = [];
  const daysInMonth = 30;

  for (let i = 0; i < daysInMonth; i++) {
    const currentDate = new Date(startDate.getTime() + i * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    if (currentDate.getDay() >= 1 && currentDate.getDay() <= 5) {
      schedule.push(...generateDaySchedule(currentDate));
    }
  }

  return schedule;
};

// src\pages\schedule\index.tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useState, useMemo, useId, useRef } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import WeeklySchedule from '../../components/ScheduleWeek'; 
import WeekPicker from '../../components/WeekPicker';
import styles from './index.module.scss';
import Filters, { FilterResult } from "../../components/Filters";
import { getDemoWeekSchedule, getPersonalSchedule } from "../../data/schedule";
import { useRole } from '../../components/RoleContext';
import { filterSchedule, type ScheduleSearchType } from '../../domain/scheduleLayout';
import ArrowCircle from '../../components/ArrowCircle';
import { parseCalendarDate } from '../../domain/calendar';
import { toLocalDateKey } from '../../domain/schedule';

const ScheduleIndex: React.FC = () => {
    const { role } = useRole();
    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    const filterType = searchParams.get('type');
    const filterQuery = searchParams.get('query')?.trim() ?? '';
    const selectedSchedule: { title: string; type: ScheduleSearchType } | null = filterQuery && (filterType === 'group' || filterType === 'auditory' || filterType === 'teacher')
        ? { title: filterQuery, type: filterType } : null;
    const dateParam = searchParams.get('date');
    const selectedWeek = useMemo(() => parseCalendarDate(dateParam) ?? new Date(), [dateParam]);
    const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
    const searchId = useId();
    const searchRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
    const searchToggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
    const toggleSearch = () => {
        setSearchOpen((open) => !open);
        if (!searchOpen) requestAnimationFrame(() => searchRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[type="search"]')?.focus());
    };
    const searchSchedule = (result: FilterResult) => {
        setSearchParams((current) => { const next = new URLSearchParams(current); next.set('type', result.type); next.set('query', result.title); return next; });
        setSearchOpen(false);
        if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1100px)').matches) searchToggleRef.current?.focus();
    };

    const sourceSchedule = useMemo(() => getDemoWeekSchedule(selectedWeek), [selectedWeek]);
    const scheduleForWeek = useMemo(() => {
        const schedule = sourceSchedule;
        if (!filterQuery || (filterType !== 'group' && filterType !== 'auditory' && filterType !== 'teacher')) return getPersonalSchedule(schedule, role);
        return filterSchedule(schedule, filterType, filterQuery);
    }, [sourceSchedule, filterType, filterQuery, role]);

    return (
        <div className="pageContainer">
            <div className={`${styles.toolbar} ${selectedSchedule ? styles.hasSelection : ""}`}>
                {selectedSchedule && <span className={styles.selection}>{selectedSchedule.title}</span>}
                <div className={styles.headerActions}>{selectedSchedule && <button onClick={() => setSearchParams((current) => { const next = new URLSearchParams(current); next.delete('type'); next.delete('query'); return next; })}>Моё расписание</button>}<button type="button" ref={searchToggleRef} className={styles.mobileSearchToggle} aria-expanded={searchOpen} aria-controls={searchId} onClick={toggleSearch}>Найти расписание<ArrowCircle direction={searchOpen ? "up" : "down"} /></button></div>
            </div>
            
            <div className={styles.mainContent}>
                <div className={styles.scheduleColumn}>
                    <WeekPicker value={selectedWeek} onWeekChange={(week: Date) => setSearchParams((current) => { const next = new URLSearchParams(current); next.set('date', toLocalDateKey(week)); return next; })} />
                    <WeeklySchedule schedule={scheduleForWeek} selectedWeek={selectedWeek} />
                </div>
                <aside id={searchId} ref={searchRef} className={`${styles.searchColumn} ${!searchOpen ? styles.searchClosed : ""}`} aria-label="Поиск другого расписания"><Filters schedule={sourceSchedule} selected={selectedSchedule} onSearch={searchSchedule} /></aside>
                
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

export default ScheduleIndex;

import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import FileStorage from "../../components/FileStorage";
import StudyPlan from "../../components/StudyPlan";
import Tabs from "../../components/Tabs";
import MyGroup from "../../components/MyGroup";
import { useRole } from "../../components/RoleContext";
import { getAcademicGroup } from "../../data/academicCatalog";
import styles from "../studentArea.module.scss";

const StudentCabinet = () => {
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const group = getAcademicGroup(currentUser.memberships[0]?.groupIds[0]);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(true);
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const requestedTab = searchParams.get("tab");
  const activeTab = requestedTab === "group" || requestedTab === "study-plan" ? requestedTab : "overview";
  const setActiveTab = (tab: string) => setSearchParams((current) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(current);
    if (tab === "overview") next.delete("tab");
    else next.set("tab", tab);
    return next;
  }, { replace: true });
  return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <Tabs ariaLabel="Разделы профиля" value={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} items={[{ value: "overview", label: "Обзор" }, { value: "group", label: "Моя группа" }, { value: "study-plan", label: "Учебный план" }]} />
      {activeTab === "study-plan" ? <StudyPlan /> : activeTab === "group" ? <MyGroup /> : <><div className={styles.grid}>
        <section className={`${styles.card} ${styles.profile}`}><div className={styles.avatar}>АС</div><div><h2>{currentUser.name}</h2><p>Студент · Прикладная математика и информатика</p><button className={`${styles.button} ${styles.profileAction}`} onClick={() => navigate(`/students/${currentUser.id}`)}>Открыть профиль</button></div></section>
        <section className={styles.card}><div className={styles.detailGrid}><div className={styles.detail}><span>Группа</span><strong>{group?.name ?? "—"}</strong></div><div className={styles.detail}><span>Курс</span><strong>{group ? `${group.course} курс` : "—"}</strong></div><div className={styles.detail}><span>Студенческий билет</span><strong>БИ-240184</strong></div><div className={styles.detail}><span>Форма обучения</span><strong>Очная</strong></div></div></section>
      </div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 18 }}><FileStorage /></div>
      <section className={styles.card} style={{ marginTop: 18 }}><div className={styles.cardHeader}><div><span className={styles.eyebrow}>Настройки</span><h2>Уведомления о занятиях и сроках</h2></div><button className={styles.button} role="switch" aria-checked={notifications} onClick={() => setNotifications((value) => !value)}>{notifications ? "Включены" : "Выключены"}</button></div></section>
      </>}

// src\pages\studentJournal\index.tsx
﻿import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import AssignmentCenter from "../../components/AssignmentCenter";
import { AttendanceTable } from "../../components/Attendance";
import JournalMaterials from "../../components/JournalMaterials";
import Tabs from "../../components/Tabs";
import { getSubject, JOURNAL_SUBJECTS } from "../journal/data";
import styles from "../journal/index.module.scss";
import catalogStyles from "../../components/JournalCatalog/index.module.scss";
import { JOURNAL_PERIOD, useJournal } from "../../data/journalStore";
import { useRole } from "../../components/RoleContext";
import { createSubjectLessons } from "../../data/lessons";
import AttendanceLegend from "../../components/AttendanceLegend";
import JournalSummary from "../../components/JournalSummary";
import LessonTypeFilter from "../../components/LessonTypeFilter";
import type { LessonTypeFilterValue } from "../../components/LessonTypeFilter";
import ArrowCircle from "../../components/ArrowCircle";
import { changeJournalSection, getJournalSection } from "../../domain/journalNavigation";
import { useDashboardUpdate } from "../../data/studentDashboard";

const StudentJournal = () => {
  const { subjectId, groupId } = useParams();
  const now = useDashboardUpdate();
  const { currentUser, canAccessJournal } = useRole();
  const subjectMembership = currentUser.memberships.find((membership) => membership.subjectId === subjectId);
  const studentGroup = groupId ?? subjectMembership?.groupIds[0] ?? "";
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const activeSection = getJournalSection(searchParams);
  const setActiveSection = (section: string) => setSearchParams((current) => changeJournalSection(current, section));
  const [lessonType, setLessonType] = useState<LessonTypeFilterValue>("all");
  const subject = getSubject(subjectId);
  const subjects = JOURNAL_SUBJECTS.filter((item) => currentUser.memberships.some((membership) => membership.subjectId === item.id));
  const group = subject?.groups.find((item) => item.id === studentGroup);
  const journal = useJournal(subjectId ?? "", studentGroup);
  const student = journal.students.find((item) => item.id === currentUser.id);
  const lessons = useMemo(() => createSubjectLessons(subjectId ?? "", studentGroup), [subjectId, studentGroup, now]);
  const visibleLessons = useMemo(() => lessonType === "all" ? lessons : lessons.filter((lesson) => lesson.type === lessonType), [lessonType, lessons]);

  if (subjectId && (!subject || !group || !canAccessJournal(subjectId, groupId ?? studentGroup))) return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <h1>Дисциплина недоступна</h1>
      <p>Выберите предмет своей группы в журнале.</p>
      <Link to="/journal">Вернуться к журналу</Link>
    </div>
  );

  if (!subject || !group) return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${catalogStyles.page}`}>
      <header className={catalogStyles.pageHeader}>
        <nav className={catalogStyles.breadcrumbs} aria-label="Навигационная цепочка"><span aria-current="page">Журнал</span></nav>
      </header>
      <div className={catalogStyles.subjectsGrid}>
        {subjects.map((item) => {
          const membershipGroupId = currentUser.memberships.find((membership) => membership.subjectId === item.id)?.groupIds[0] ?? "";
          const membershipGroup = item.groups.find((entry) => entry.id === membershipGroupId);
          return (
          <section className={`${catalogStyles.subjectCard} ${catalogStyles[item.color]}`} key={item.id}>
            <header className={catalogStyles.subjectHeader}>
              <div className={catalogStyles.subjectIcon}>{item.shortName}</div>
              <div><Link className={catalogStyles.subjectLink} to={`/journal/${item.id}`}><h2>{item.name}</h2></Link><p>{item.semester}</p></div>
            </header>
            <div className={catalogStyles.groupsGrid}>
              <Link className={catalogStyles.groupCard} to={`/journal/${item.id}/${membershipGroupId}`}>
                <div className={catalogStyles.groupTopline}><strong>Мой журнал · {membershipGroup?.name ?? membershipGroupId}</strong><ArrowCircle className={catalogStyles.arrow} hoverBackground="var(--subject-accent)" /></div>
                <span>Посещаемость, оценки, задания и материалы</span>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </section>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <nav className={styles.breadcrumbs} aria-label="Навигационная цепочка"><Link to="/journal">Журнал</Link><span>/</span><span>{subject.name}</span><span>/</span><span aria-current="page">{group.name}</span></nav>
          <h1>{subject.name}</h1>
          <p>Группа {group.name}</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <Tabs ariaLabel="Разделы журнала" value={activeSection} onChange={setActiveSection} items={[{ value: "journal", label: "Журнал и прогресс" }, { value: "assignments", label: "Задания" }, { value: "materials", label: "Материалы" }]} />
      {activeSection === "journal" && <section className={styles.tableSection}>
        <div className={styles.sectionHeading}><div><span>Электронный журнал</span><h2>Мои результаты</h2></div><strong>{JOURNAL_PERIOD}</strong></div>
        {journal.error && <p className={styles.pageError} role="alert">{journal.error}</p>}
        <div className={styles.tableFilters}><LessonTypeFilter lessons={lessons} value={lessonType} onChange={setLessonType} /><AttendanceLegend /></div>
        {student ? <AttendanceTable students={[student]} readOnly lessons={visibleLessons} /> : <p>Записи студента пока не найдены.</p>}
        {student && <div className={styles.inlineAnalytics}>
          <div className={styles.sectionHeading}><div><span>Личный срез</span><h2>Мой прогресс</h2></div><strong>По текущему фильтру занятий</strong></div>
          <JournalSummary students={[student]} lessons={visibleLessons} period={JOURNAL_PERIOD} />
        </div>}
      </section>}
      {activeSection === "assignments" && <section className={styles.tableSection}>
        <div className={styles.sectionHeading}><div><span>По датам занятий</span><h2>Задания и ответы</h2></div></div>
        <AssignmentCenter key={`${subject.id}:${group.id}`} subject={subject.name} group={group.name} />
      </section>}
      {activeSection === "materials" && <div className={styles.groupMaterials}>
        <JournalMaterials subject={subject} group={group} readOnly />
      </div>}
    </div>
  );
};

export default StudentJournal;



// src\pages\teacher\index.module.scss
@use "../../styles/variables" as *;@use "../../styles/mixins" as *;.page{position:relative;z-index:1;box-sizing:border-box}.back{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:18px;color:$color-text-secondary;text-decoration:none}.back:hover{color:$color-accent-hover}.empty{@include dashboard-card($color-dark-secondary,24px)}


// src\pages\teacher\index.tsx
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import TeacherProfile from "../../components/TeacherProfile";
import { useRole } from "../../components/RoleContext";
import { getTeacherProfile } from "../../data/teacherProfiles";
import styles from "./index.module.scss";

const TeacherPage = () => {
  const { teacherId } = useParams();
  const { currentUser } = useRole();
  const teacher = getTeacherProfile(teacherId);
  const ownProfile = teacherId === currentUser.id;
  return <div className={`pageContainer ${styles.page}`}>
    <Link className={styles.back} to={ownProfile ? "/cabinet" : "/messages"}>← {ownProfile ? "Назад в кабинет" : "Назад к сообщениям"}</Link>
    {teacher ? <TeacherProfile teacher={teacher} /> : <section className={styles.empty}><h1>Преподаватель не найден</h1></section>}
  </div>;
};

export default TeacherPage;

// src\svg.d.ts


// src\types\sched.tsx
// src/types/schedule.ts

export interface ScheduleItem {
  id: number;
  subject: string;
  date: string;
  type: 'Лек.' | 'Пр.' | 'Лаб.' | 'Зач.' | 'Экз.';
  startTime: string; // Например, "10:00"
  endTime: string;   // Например, "11:30"
  dayOfWeek: number; // 0=Воскресенье, 1=Понедельник, ..., 6=Суббота
  location: string;  // Например, "Ауд. 424/1"
  teacher?: string;  // Например, "Смирнова А.Б."
  teacherId?: string;
  group?: string;
  link?: string;
}

export type WeeklyScheduleData = ScheduleItem[];

export interface ScheduleSlot {
  number: number;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
}
